jobs.title: Chasseur immobilier / Agent commercial (H/F) - Nîmes
jobs.excerpt: Vous voulez travailler dans l'immobilier côté acheteur, à votre compte, sans partir de zéro ?
jobs.description:
Vous voulez travailler dans l'immobilier côté acheteur, à votre compte, sans partir de zéro ?
Mon Chasseur Immo recrute un chasseur immobilier indépendant à Nîmes.

POURQUOI NÎMES, POURQUOI MAINTENANT

En six mois, 42 familles nous ont contactés dans le Gard. Nos 2 chasseurs sur place ne peuvent pas répondre à toutes ces demandes, et c'est pour cela que nous recrutons. Le marché existe déjà : vous démarrez avec des clients qui attendent.

LE MÉTIER

Le chasseur immobilier travaille pour l'acheteur, jamais pour le vendeur. Vous n'avez ni mandat de vente à décrocher, ni pige, ni boîtage. Vous partez du projet de votre client et vous trouvez le bien, y compris parmi ceux qui ne sont pas en annonce.

Au quotidien :

  • vous signez des mandats de recherche exclusifs ;

  • vous développez votre réseau local : agences, notaires, prescripteurs ;

  • vous cherchez les biens sur le marché et en off-market ;

  • vous faites les pré-visites et sélectionnez les biens ;

  • vous négociez uniquement dans l'intérêt de votre client ;

  • vous suivez le dossier jusqu'à la signature chez le notaire.

CE QUE VOUS N'AVEZ PAS À FAIRE

  • Obtenir une carte professionnelle : vous travaillez sous la carte T du réseau, avec une attestation de collaborateur.

  • Avoir un diplôme en immobilier.

  • Payer un droit d'entrée, une redevance mensuelle ou une licence : nous ne sommes pas une franchise.

CE QUE NOUS VOUS APPORTONS

  • Une formation de départ de 3 semaines, entièrement prise en charge.

  • Un référent métier dédié pendant vos 6 premiers mois.

  • Un CRM, une application client et des outils pour trouver les biens.

  • La notoriété d'un réseau créé en 2012 : près de 200 chasseurs, 88 départements couverts et près de 17 000 projets accompagnés. Une note de 4,9/5 sur plus de 3 400 avis.

  • Des demandes de clients qui arrivent directement chez nous, en plus de celles que vous trouvez vous-même.

  • De la formation continue, des conventions et des groupes régionaux.

LA RÉMUNÉRATION

Vous êtes indépendant : vos revenus dépendent de votre activité, sans plafond.

  • Vous touchez jusqu'à 70 % des honoraires encaissés, et 10 points de plus au-delà de 100 000 € de chiffre d'affaires par an.

La première année, vos revenus seront plus faibles, le temps de constituer votre clientèle : il faut compter 2 à 6 mois entre la signature d'un mandat et l'achat.

QUI NOUS RECRUTONS

Deux types de profils réussissent chez nous :

  • des professionnels de l'immobilier qui veulent passer du côté de l'acheteur et ne plus chercher de mandats de vente ;

  • des commerciaux ou des personnes en reconversion sans expérience dans l'immobilier. C'est le cas de 7 chasseurs sur 10.

Ce qui compte le plus : l'autonomie, aimer le contact, la rigueur dans le suivi des dossiers, et pouvoir tenir les premiers mois sans revenu garanti. Le reste s'apprend en formation. Bien connaître Nîmes et son marché est un vrai plus.

COMMENT ÇA SE PASSE

  1. Un premier échange avec l'équipe recrutement sur votre projet et votre secteur.

  2. Un entretien pour faire connaissance des deux côtés.

  3. La formation de 3 semaines, puis un démarrage accompagné.

Envie d'en parler ? Postulez, nous vous répondons sous 48 heures.

Requirements

Profil recherché

  • professionnel de l'immobilier souhaitant évoluer côté acquéreur ;

  • ou commercial confirmé, à l'aise avec une clientèle exigeante ;

  • bonne connaissance du marché de Nîmes et de ses environs ;

  • sens du service, rigueur et ambition.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As Data Analyst working on Veeva OpenData, you will be instrumental in building a high-quality data product. You will be identifying and analyzing data quality issues, integrating data sources and improving processes. By taking full ownership of the work, you will become a subject matter expert and a key member of a high performing team.

  • Coordinate with other Data Analysts on common processes, best practices, as well as peer reviews

Requirements

  • Excellent attention to detail, a meticulous approach, especially when working with data
  • 3+ years of experience working as a Data Analyst or in a similar role.
  • Strong SQL skills including a good understanding of relational database schemas
  • Able to document work with precision and clarity
  • Good written and verbal communications skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience with customer reference data for the life sciences industry
  • Experience with relational database administration

Perks & Benefits

  • Flexible “work from anywhere” policy
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

jobs.description:
Important IT company At the Latin American level, growth requires:

AI Augmented Fullstack

Role overview

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to build and maintain a multi-service application using C#, Core, React, TypeScript, and Azure. The role includes integration with the planned DataFusion backend platform using PostgreSQL, Delta Lake tables, and Databricks. The developer will own implementation, integration, reliability, security, and production support.

The developer will use AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery while validating generated code and ensuring independently developed services work together consistently.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and develop REST APIs and background workers using C# and Core.

  • Build React interfaces and integrate micro frontends with clear shell and remote boundaries.

  • Implement asynchronous communication using Azure Service Bus queues, topics, and subscriptions.

  • Define API and event contracts, including versioning and backward compatibility.

  • Develop and optimize PostgreSQL queries, stored procedures, and functions where appropriate; manage indexing, transactions, schema migrations, and database performance.

  • Integrate APIs and services with the planned DataFusion backend platform through defined interfaces and data contracts, using PostgreSQL and Delta Lake tables according to workload requirements.

  • Develop, integrate, and troubleshoot Databricks data workflows using SQL and Python/PySpark as appropriate, including ingestion, transformation, Delta table updates, data validation, and job monitoring.

  • Review and improve AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.

  • Write appropriate units, integration, contracts, and end-to-end tests.

  • Implement authentication, authorization, structured logging, tracing, and monitoring.

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines, support releases, investigate incidents, and document architecture decisions.

Required technical skills

  • Years of experience: 8+ years of professional C#/.NET development, with hands-on delivery of production applications. Working experience with React, Databricks, PostgreSQL, and Delta Lake is required.

  • Backend development: C#, Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, async/await, cancellation, background services, validation, and consistent API error handling.

  • Frontend development: React, TypeScript, hooks, routing, state management, HTML, CSS, accessibility, and browser debugging.

  • Micro frontends: Module Federation or equivalent integration approach; shared dependencies, routing, authentication integration, CSS isolation, and independent deployments.

  • Messaging and distributed systems: Azure Service Bus settlement, message locks, retries, dead-letter queues, duplicate delivery, ordering, eventual consistency, service boundaries, and failure recovery.

  • Data and security: PostgreSQL, SQL, EF Core with Npgsql, transactions, indexing, migrations, concurrency, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, authorization, managed identities, and secrets management. Understanding transactional PostgreSQL and analytical Delta Lake workloads is required.

  • Databricks and Delta Lake: Hands-on working experience with Databricks notebooks, SQL, jobs/workflows, and Python/PySpark for relevant data tasks. Experience with Delta tables, schema enforcement and evolution, MERGE/upserts, incremental processing, data quality, and performance troubleshooting.

  • DataFusion backend integration: Ability to integrate .NET applications with the planned DataFusion platform, define API and data contracts, and work with PostgreSQL and Delta Lake-backed datasets through supported interfaces. Understanding data ownership, consistency, access controls, and operational failure handling.

  • Testing and delivery: xUnit or equivalent, React Testing Library, Git, Docker, CI/CD, Azure hosting, Application Insights, and distributed tracing.

  • AI application integration: Working understanding of agent workflows, tool/function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Ability to integrate AI capabilities with .NET APIs and business applications while applying output validation, access controls, and guardrails.

  • AI-assisted engineering: Proficiency with AI coding assistants and the ability to validate generated code and dependencies, maintain shared engineering instructions, and apply sound judgment to architecture, security, performance, and test coverage.

Good to have - Agentic AI experience

  • Agent frameworks: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, or an equivalent framework.

  • RAG and enterprise knowledge: Experience with document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, grounding, citations, and enterprise knowledge bases.

  • Microsoft AI platform: Familiarity with Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, and related Azure AI and model services.

  • Agent integration and reliability: Experience integrating agents with .NET APIs, databases, tools, or MCP servers, with awareness of evaluation, guardrails, access controls, human approval, token usage, latency, and cost optimization.

ADVANCED CONVERSATIONAL ENGLISH AND SPANISH ESSENTIAL (Will be evaluated).

If you are a foreingner residing in Mexico, you must have a valid INE, CURP, NSS and RFC.

Location: Mexico -This position is fully remote; however, candidates must be currently residing in Mexico.

Salary: $100,000 MXN gross

Benefits: Excellent superior benefits.

jobs.excerpt: Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail.
jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

Reporting to the Digital Technology Solutions (DTS) PMO, the Principal Project Manager is a senior delivery leader responsible for driving complex, cross-functional technology initiatives to successful and predictable outcomes. With primary accountability for the IT and engineering components of an initiative, this role leads delivery across the full project lifecycle, from planning and mobilization through execution, implementation, and transition to operations.

The Principal Project Manager brings structure, discipline, and transparency to complex initiatives by establishing clear scope, integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and accountability. They work closely with engineering teams, business partners, operational teams, vendors, and project and program management counterparts across Alignment to connect work across organizational boundaries and maintain momentum toward shared outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong relationship building and collaboration. The Principal Project Manager establishes trusted partnerships across the company, creates alignment among diverse stakeholders, anticipates delivery challenges, surfaces risks and dependencies early, facilitates timely decisions, and helps teams navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.

The Principal Project Manager also contributes to the continued development of the DTS PMO and our project delivery capabilities. Working collaboratively with PMO leadership, project managers, engineering leaders, and partners across Alignment, this role will lead or contribute to selected workstreams focused on creating repeatable and scalable project management processes, artifacts, tools, reporting, and ways of working that enable predictable delivery. The Principal Project Manager will bring practical experience and lessons learned from active project delivery into this work, helping ensure our standards are useful, adaptable, and effective in practice.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Project Management Framework: Design, implement, and govern a standardized, scalable project management methodology (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) that is tailored to our organization's needs and ensures consistency, predictability, and quality in project delivery.

  • Process Optimization Leadership: Act as the lead subject matter expert in process improvement. Conduct comprehensive analysis of current business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for automation and optimization.

  • Capacity and Demand Management:Develop, implement, maintain and report on the capacity of the IT organization to intake work, prioritize it, and report on demand for those resources. This will support work execution and resource planning.

  • Change Management: Lead the change management initiatives required to ensure the successful adoption of new project management methodologies and optimized business processes across all departments. This includes developing training materials, conducting workshops, and providing ongoing support.

  • Enterprise Project Management: Lead multiple complex, enterprise-wide initiatives with significant financial and operational impact.

  • Mentorship and Coaching: Serve as a senior-level mentor and coach to project managers and operational teams. Provide expert guidance on best practices in project planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder communication, as well as process analysis and continuous improvement techniques.

  • Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for both project health and process efficiency. Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that provide executive leadership with a clear, data-driven view of our project portfolio and operational performance.

  • Tooling and Technology: Evaluate, select, and optimize project management and business process management (BPM) software and tools to support our methodologies and improve overall efficiency.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with senior leaders and stakeholders across the organization to align project and process optimization initiatives with strategic business goals. Facilitate cross-functional teams to drive and implement complex improvements.

  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and address risks related to project execution and process failures. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate these risks and ensure business continuity.

  • Continuous Improvement Culture: Foster a culture of continuous improvement by promoting lean principles, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in a combination of project management, process improvement, information technology, and business analysis roles, with a minimum of 5 years in a principal or leadership capacity.

  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) and/or other relevant certifications (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Agile, Scrum Master) are required.

jobs.excerpt: Emerging Tech (ET) was founded to meet the emergent need for a standards-based, end-to-end IT consultancy.
jobs.description:
Emerging Tech (ET) was founded to meet the emergent need for a standards-based, end-to-end IT consultancy. Our experts across the United States design and implement cutting-edge solutions that transform our customers' capabilities.

We are seeking two Cisco Secure Access (SSE) Deployment Engineers on a 1099 independent contractor basis to support a zero-trust access implementation for a mid-sized, cloud-first nonprofit organization. The client has licensed Cisco Secure Access and needs experienced engineers to deploy, tune, and hand over the platform so that access to critical SaaS applications is identity-verified, device-aware, and controlled across headquarters, remote, and low-bandwidth or intermittent field locations. Joining a three-person ET delivery team, the Cisco Secure Access Deployment Engineers will report to the ET Engagement Lead / Zero-Trust Security Architect (who owns the architecture, policy design, and client relationship) and collaborate closely with Cisco's delivery team and the client's IT staff.

Key Responsibilities

Tenant Configuration and Identity Integration

  • Configure the Cisco Secure Access tenant and integrate it with Okta (SAML/OIDC, SCIM) so access policies dynamically follow users and groups.
  • Configure SaaS tenant restrictions and documented break-glass access procedures.
  • Export platform configurations or maintain configurations as code to support repeatable administration.

Zero-Trust, Web, and Cloud Security Policy

  • Build and test zero-trust network access (ZTNA) policies for critical SaaS applications (CRM, finance/ERP, HCM/payroll) based on the Engagement Lead's approved policy matrix, then extend policies across additional applications.
  • Build and refine secure web gateway (SWG), DNS-layer security, and cloud firewall policies.
  • Configure CASB discovery and controls to govern shadow IT and risky OAuth grants, alongside DLP rules protecting sensitive personal, payroll, and financial data.

Endpoint Rollout and Performance Optimization

  • Deploy Cisco Secure Client to managed devices via MDM and implement clientless access options for unmanaged or shared devices.
  • Execute phased delivery milestones, including an initial pilot with IT and one business team, organization-wide rollout, and transition of critical applications from monitor-only to enforced mode.
  • Test and tune connectivity and performance across low-bandwidth and high-latency network links.

Observability, Documentation, and Handover

  • Forward Cisco Secure Access telemetry and logs to the client's SIEM or cloud observability platform.
  • Contribute detailed configuration records to operational runbooks and author end-user guides.
  • Partner in training the client's IT team and provide 30 days of post-cutover hypercare support.

Governance and Reporting

  • Adhere strictly to the client's change-approval process, ensuring no production modifications occur without prior written approval.
  • Utilize only client-approved systems for client data with individual, MFA-protected, time-limited access.
  • Provide weekly written status reports to the Engagement Lead and participate in biweekly steering meetings.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Hands-on production deployment experience with Cisco Secure Access or its core components (Umbrella SIG/DNS, Duo, AnyConnect / Secure Client).
  • Proven experience rolling out Cisco Secure Client to managed devices through MDM platforms (such as Intune, Jamf, or Kandji).
  • Practical experience integrating Okta for access policy enforcement (SAML/OIDC, SCIM, and group-based policies).
  • Demonstrated ability to configure ZTNA, secure web gateway, DNS security, cloud firewall, CASB, and DLP policies.
  • Experience troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues on low-bandwidth or high-latency networks.
  • Experience forwarding security logs to a SIEM or cloud observability platform.
  • Strong written documentation skills and comfort supporting end users and training IT staff.
  • Authorized to work in the United States, able to operate as a 1099 independent contractor, and willing to sign an NDA prior to accessing client environment details.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience

  • Prior work supporting nonprofit, humanitarian, or distributed, field-based workforces.
  • Hands-on experience working within Google Workspace, Salesforce, and Cisco Meraki environments.
  • Experience executing phased zero-trust rollouts from monitor-only pilots to full policy enforcement.

Skillset

The AI Engineer Specialist serves as a senior hands-on Subject Matter Expert (SME) within the CHS Enterprise AI Center of Excellence (CoE), operating under a collaborative hub-and-spoke model. Bridging deep machine learning engineering with modern agentic architecture, this role builds reusable "golden-path" blueprints, customizes foundation and domain-specific models on Google Cloud (Vertex AI), and embeds automated safety and observability guardrails into production. You will solve complex, high-stakes healthcare and clinical AI challenges across Generative AI, Agentic workflows, and Predictive/ML patterns while enabling business and technology spoke teams to scale safely across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reference Architectures & "Golden Path" Engineering: Design, build, and harden reusable, pre-secured code templates and component libraries across CHS's three core AI patterns: GenAI (grounded assistants), Agentic workflows, and Predictive/ML pipelines.
  • Model Customization & Clinical NLP Optimization: Evaluate when foundation models (via Vertex AI Model Garden, including Gemini and open-weight models) require domain adaptation. Lead parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA), retrieval/grounding optimization, and clinical terminology integration (SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, ICD-10/11) for high-precision healthcare use cases.
  • Agentic Systems & AI-for-BI Delivery (Spoke Execution): Serve as a lead hands-on builder for CoE-led flagship initiatives—engineering multi-agent orchestration (using Google ADK, Agent Runtime, Sessions/Memory Bank), Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool servers on Cloud Run, and enterprise AI/BI data agents (e.g., Looker Data Agents and master orchestrators).
  • Guardrails as Code & Automated Evaluation: Operationalize AI Governance Committee (AIGC) policies into automated pipeline controls—implementing Model Armor ingress/egress scanning, sensitive-data (PHI/PII) filters, custom Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval workflows, and automated quality/groundedness/drift evaluation suites.
  • AI Economics, Performance & Observability: Optimize latency, throughput, and token efficiency across multi-step agent runs. Instrument all solutions with OpenTelemetry traces, HIPAA/CMS compliance audit logs (capturing prompts, tool calls, and data access), and FinOps cost-per-solution telemetry routed through the Enterprise AI Gateway.
  • Spoke Enablement & Readiness Stewardship: Partner with business and technology spoke teams through design reviews, developer office hours, and structured production-readiness milestones (Design Review, Non-Prod Readiness, Production Promotion, and Post-Deployment Review) to accelerate safe launches.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Biomedical Informatics, or a related quantitative engineering field required; Master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience: 8–10 years of deep Machine Learning, NLP, and AI engineering experience, including hands-on experience designing and shipping production Generative AI, RAG, or multi-agent applications into enterprise cloud environments.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and the Hugging Face ecosystem, paired with hands-on mastery of GCP Vertex AI (Model Garden, Agent Development Kit [ADK], Agent Gateway, Model Armor, Cloud Run) and working familiarity with Azure/Copilot environments.
  • Deep experience engineering production CI/CD pipelines for AI workloads with strict dev/QA/prod environment separation, least-privilege IAM/agent identity controls, and OpenTelemetry-based observability and token cost tracking.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare IT standards and clinical terminologies (FHIR, HL7, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, ICD-10/11), combined with practical experience enforcing HIPAA and CMS data privacy and auditability requirements.
  • Ability to translate abstract clinical or business use cases into well-architected multi-step agent workflows, balancing model accuracy, latency, and unit economics to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions.

This is a fully remote opportunity

jobs.description:
Position Title:Regional Manager

Department:Operations

Classification: Exempt

Reports To:Director of Operations

Installation Made Easy (“IME”) provides software and process management that enable retailers and contractors to offer installed home improvements to homeowners in a convenient, consistent, and affordable manner. IME senior management has over 100 years of retail management and home improvement industry experience.

The Regional Manager is directly accountable for driving revenue growth, maximizing sales opportunities, and delivering measurable business results within their assigned territory. This is a highly visible, performance-driven position that requires a proactive, self-motivated leader who takes full ownership of territory performance and consistently executes strategies that drive growth.

Success in this role requires more than maintaining relationships and overseeing day-to-day operations. The Regional Manager must actively identify opportunities to increase lead generation, improve sales conversion, strengthen Provider performance, and ensure assigned retail locations are appropriately staffed and positioned to achieve business objectives.

The Regional Manager is expected to operate with a strong sense of urgency, make informed decisions, address performance gaps head-on, and take immediate action when results fall below expectations. This individual must be comfortable being held accountable to performance goals, receiving direct and candid feedback, and making the necessary adjustments to continuously improve results.

This role requires an individual who is highly independent, resourceful, competitive, and motivated by achieving measurable outcomes. The successful candidate will not wait for direction to address challenges but will proactively develop solutions, execute action plans, and follow through to completion.

The Regional Manager will work closely with senior leadership, including the Vice President of Operations and CEO, and collaborate with departments such as Compliance, Licensing, Central Processing, Call Center, and Customer Solutions to drive operational excellence and territory growth.

Essential Functions:

Revenue Growth & Territory Performance

  • Take full ownership of revenue generation, lead growth, sales conversion, and overall business performance within the assigned territory.
  • Consistently work toward achieving or exceeding established revenue targets, budgets, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Proactively identify opportunities to increase sales, improve lead generation, expand market penetration, and maximize revenue potential across assigned retail locations.
  • Analyze business performance metrics, identify trends and underperforming areas, and implement actionable strategies to drive measurable improvements.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of territory performance and be prepared to communicate results, challenges, and action plans to senior leadership.

Lead Generation and Retail Store Performance

  • Take ownership of ensuring assigned retail locations have appropriate lead generation staffing and coverage to support sales and revenue objectives.
  • Partner with the appropriate teams to support the recruitment, placement, development, and retention of qualified lead generation personnel.
  • Establish strong working relationships with retail store management and lead generators to drive accountability, engagement, and consistent execution of program expectations.
  • Conduct regular store visits to assess staffing effectiveness, lead generation activity, program execution, and overall sales performance.
  • Identify underperforming locations and implement targeted improvement plans to increase productivity, lead volume, and conversion.
  • Ensure store-level initiatives, promotions, and sales strategies are effectively communicated and executed.

Provider Recruitment, Coverage & Performance

  • Maintain sufficient Provider coverage and capacity throughout the assigned territory to support business growth and customer demand.
  • Proactively recruit qualified Providers across applicable home improvement categories, ensuring alignment with IME's operational, quality, and compliance standards.
  • Own Provider recruitment needs within the territory and coordinate with the Compliance team to facilitate onboarding and activation.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and hold Providers accountable for meeting IME standards, including customer satisfaction, cycle times, close percentages, service issue rates, and overall program compliance.
  • Conduct monthly business reviews with Providers to evaluate results, address performance concerns, establish improvement goals, and reinforce accountability.
  • Build and maintain strong Provider relationships while balancing partnership development with clear performance expectations.

Leadership, Accountability & Execution

  • Demonstrate a high level of personal accountability by taking ownership of challenges, decisions, and outcomes within the assigned territory.
  • Operate independently in a remote environment while maintaining a strong sense of urgency, consistent productivity, and a results-oriented mindset.
  • Establish and execute action plans that directly support revenue growth, operational efficiency, and improved territory performance.
  • Communicate openly and directly regarding business results, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Be receptive to candid, constructive feedback from leadership and demonstrate the ability to quickly translate feedback into meaningful action and improved results.
  • Adapt quickly to shifting business priorities, evolving expectations, and changing market conditions while maintaining focus on key objectives.
  • Demonstrate persistence, resilience, and a solution-oriented approach when faced with setbacks or challenging performance goals.
  • Follow through on commitments, meet established deadlines, and maintain accountability for the successful execution of assigned initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

  • Partner with internal departments to resolve operational challenges, improve customer experiences, and support business growth.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and eliminate barriers to growth.
  • Support the timely resolution of customer and service issues, ensuring appropriate follow-through and accountability.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • 4+ years of experience in retail operations, sales, territory management, business development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth, improve business performance, and achieve measurable results.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret performance metrics, identify opportunities, and execute strategies that improve outcomes.
  • Proven ability to take ownership of responsibilities, work independently, and consistently follow through on commitments.
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with a strong sense of urgency and a willingness to take initiative.
  • Ability to identify and address underperformance directly, establish clear expectations, and drive corrective action.
  • Demonstrated ability to receive and apply direct, constructive feedback while maintaining professionalism and a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to act decisively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to engage effectively with retail partners, Providers, internal teams, and executive leadership.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities without compromising execution or results.
  • Ability to thrive in a high-accountability, performance-driven environment with clearly defined expectations and measurable goals.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn and utilize company-specific systems and reporting tools.
  • Ability and willingness to travel more than 50% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Management, Sales, Operations, or a related discipline.
  • Experience managing multi-location retail operations, sales territories, or field-based teams.
  • Experience driving lead generation, sales conversion, and revenue growth within a retail environment.
  • Knowledge of the home improvement, installation services, or contractor management industries.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.

Additional Expectations

The Regional Manager position requires travel greater than 50% of the time. Responsibilities may evolve based on business needs, and additional duties may be assigned.

This is a results-driven position with a high level of individual accountability. Success will be measured by the Regional Manager's ability to grow revenue, improve lead generation and sales performance, maintain appropriate store staffing and Provider coverage, and consistently execute initiatives that produce measurable business improvements.

jobs.excerpt: About Renaissance When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology!
jobs.description:
About Renaissance

When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.

Job Description

Renaissance Intelligence brings Math, Literacy, Assessment, MTSS and CFA solutions together in one platform, and the administrator experience is what makes them work as a single product for district and school leaders. As Director, Leader Journeys, you will own that experience across the full Renaissance Intelligence portfolio. You will define the end-to-end workflows leaders use to set up, monitor and act on data from every solution, partner with solution owners and Product Management to make those workflows cohere, and own go-to-market readiness for the admin experience. You will collaborate cross-functionally to build consensus and ensure execution, and represent the needs of administrators across the Renaissance organization.

In this role as a Director of Product Management, you will:

  • Develop, maintain, and communicate the leader journey vision and strategy across Renaissance Intelligence, partnering closely with Product Management & Solution Leadership to plan roadmaps, drive strategic integrations, and track key initiatives.
  • Partner with the solution leaders for Math, Literacy, Assessment, MTSS and CFA so each solution's admin capabilities fit one coherent leader experience, and resolve cross-solution gaps and dependencies.
  • Own go-to-market readiness for the admin experience, partnering with Sales, Enablement, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Customer Education to bring it to market and align field messaging.
  • Identify and prioritize gaps in the leader journey that limit the strength of the portfolio, and own living, canonical documentation (journey maps, persona definitions, decisions) so gaps and dependencies are visible to Product, Content, Engineering, GTM, and executive stakeholders, tracked to a decision or resolution.
  • Define and track success metrics for administrator adoption, engagement, and value, and use them to guide roadmap priorities.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for the district and school leader persona in product development and GTM conversations, including demonstrations, training, and integration planning.
  • Build and sustain relationships with district and school leaders, including superintendents, curriculum and assessment directors, and MTSS coordinators; maintain an ongoing presence with customers and synthesize field signals back to Product, Content, Learning Science, and GTM teams.
  • Partner with Government Affairs and Sales on the state and district requirements that shape the admin experience, including accountability reporting, data privacy, accessibility, and procurement.
  • Partner with global teams to cross-pollinate the US-based admin experience to address global markets and needs.
  • Communicate clearly and efficiently with stakeholders about strategy, progress, decisions, risks, and needs at the Director, VP and SVP level, building strong cross-functional relationships that motivate, influence, and represent team accomplishments and needs.

Qualifications

For this role as a Director of Product Management, you should have:

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university
  • 5+ years of product management, product strategy, or related experience at an education or edtech organization, including experience with administrator- or leader-facing products.
  • Deep understanding of how district and school leaders use data to make decisions across curriculum, instruction, assessment, and intervention (MTSS).
  • Experience defining workflows for administrators on a multi-product platform, and taking a platform or solution through launch and adoption.
  • Familiarity with K-12 rostering, student information system integrations, reporting, and data privacy requirements.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Content, Engineering, Learning Science, Data, and GTM teams to translate customer needs into strategy, specifications, and market execution.
  • Excellent writing, research, analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, including with senior stakeholders.
  • Willingness to use AI to accelerate efficiency while maintaining appropriate quality and professional judgment.

Bonus Points:

  • Proficient with PC applications
  • Proficient in MS office applications
  • Virtual meeting software proficiency

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Salary Range: The base range for this position is $132,500 - $182,225. This range is based on national market data and may vary by experience and location.

Benefits for eligible US employees include:

jobs.description:
Own the controls that protect sensitive data across the enterprise, with a primary focus on Microsoft Purview.


As a Senior Security Engineer at Resmed, you will design, implement, and continuously improve data security controls, primarily across Microsoft 365. Your work will strengthen how sensitive information is classified, shared, retained, monitored, and protected, helping Resmed meet business, privacy, audit, and regulatory requirements. You will bring hands-on expertise in Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Information Protection, and data loss prevention, while working hands-on with security controls and collaborating with teams responsible for the Microsoft 365 platform.


This is a highly collaborative role within a global enterprise security team. You will work across IT, Legal, Risk, Security Operations, and platform teams to translate business and security requirements into practical, sustainable controls and progress agreed Data Security initiatives that protect data throughout its lifecycle.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, engineer, configure, and maintain Microsoft Purview controls, working with platform owners where required, including Microsoft Information Protection, sensitivity labels, rights management, encryption, retention, and information governance policies.
  • Implement, test, and tune DLP controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing.
  • Contribute to engineering and implementation activities involving broader Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) controls, including identifying sensitive data exposure risks and implementing appropriate protection measures.
  • Assess Microsoft 365 security baselines and recommend improvements across enterprise collaboration services.
  • Manage and validate external sharing, guest access, and third-party collaboration controls.
  • Monitor compliance posture, investigate trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Support audits and regulatory reviews by gathering evidence, maintaining documentation, and producing accurate reports.
  • Engage with IT, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Security Operations, and platform teams to understand requirements, provide technical guidance, and implement effective data protection controls.
  • Support delivery of assigned Enterprise Security Data Security initiatives under the direction of Security leadership, coordinating stakeholders and completing hands-on engineering deliverables.
  • Translate stakeholder and business requirements into technical security requirements, working with relevant teams to agree practical implementation approaches.
  • Participate in incident response, investigations, and post-incident reviews involving information protection and data exposure.
  • Automate policy deployment, reporting, and repeatable security processes using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API where appropriate.
  • Integrate relevant Microsoft 365 security signals with SIEM capabilities for monitoring and incident correlation.
  • Stay current with Microsoft 365 security and compliance developments, emerging threats, and evolving data protection standards.

What You Bring

  • At least three to five years of hands-on security engineering experience in enterprise environments, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 information protection, DLP, or data governance.
  • Practical experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Microsoft Information Protection policies, sensitivity labels, rights management, and encryption controls.
  • Experience developing, implementing, and refining DLP policies across Microsoft 365 collaboration services and endpoints, with exposure to broader DLP controls desirable.
  • Working knowledge of Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) concepts and capabilities, including sensitive data discovery, exposure risk identification, and remediation.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview capabilities, including Data Lifecycle Management, Insider Risk Management, eDiscovery, Audit, and Information Governance.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Entra governance and conditional access integrations.
  • Experience working with Generative AI technologies, with an understanding of associated Data Security risks, including sensitive data exposure, unauthorized data sharing, and shadow AI.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex security control issues and working with platform owners or technology vendors to resolve implementation challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business and technical stakeholders, communicate technical recommendations, and progress assigned security engineering initiatives.
  • Experience managing external sharing, guest access, and third-party data access controls.
  • Ability to align technical controls with relevant frameworks and regulations, including ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, GDPR, HIPAA, CIS, and the Australian Privacy Act.
  • Experience supporting compliance operations, incident management, or data governance in a regulated or high-assurance environment.
  • SC-401 certification and a bachelor’s degree are preferred.

Nice to have:

  • SC-200 or SC-900 certification.
  • CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certification.

What Sets You Apart

  • Analytical judgment: You turn complex business and compliance requirements into clear, workable security controls.
  • Constructive courage: You challenge ineffective approaches, explain the risk, and make a well-supported case for change.
  • Collaborative influence: You build alignment across technical and non-technical teams without losing sight of security outcomes.
  • Clear communication: You make complex data protection topics understandable and document decisions with care.
  • Continuous improvement: You look for practical ways to strengthen policies, automate repeatable work, and improve the compliance posture.
  • Global mindset: You collaborate effectively across regions and time zones while respecting different perspectives and operating needs.

Location: Halifax, Nova Scotia


Why Join Resmed

At Resmed, security helps protect the information, systems, and collaboration that support our mission to help people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives. This role gives you the opportunity to shape data protection across a global Microsoft 365 environment, contribute specialist expertise in a rapidly evolving area, and work with teams across the business to turn strong security principles into meaningful, practical outcomes.


Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. jobs.description:
Job Summary: Associate Data Inventory Analyst

The Associate Revenue Cycle Analyst - Inventory Analyst is responsible for driving operational excellence and data integrity across revenue cycle inventory for the Payment and Correspondence Posting Teams. This role monitors, reconciles, and reports on the volume, aging, and status of work inventory (e.g., ERA, EOB, correspondence letters…) and the underlying data that supports it. The analyst identifies stagnation, discrepancies, and process variances, and partners with internal teams and vendor partners to ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met. The ideal candidate has working knowledge of RCM, shows initiative, works independently, and proactively identifies and resolves data and inventory variances. This role plays a key part in ensuring data integrity, process compliance, and the accuracy of reporting that supports financial operations.

Job Responsibilities

  • Data Inventory Management: Maintains an accurate, current view of revenue cycle inventory across designated posting workstreams, including inflow, work in progress, aging, and backlog. Validates that inventory data is complete, accurate, and consistent across source systems, and reconciles discrepancies.
  • Industry Knowledge: Demonstrates working knowledge of RCM posting business processes, including the ability to interpret payor remittances, explanation of benefits (EOBs), claim statuses, and related data elements (e.g., CARCs, RARCs, adjustments) as they relate to inventory categorization and reporting.
  • System Proficiency: Demonstrates proficiency in the programs and systems required for the assigned workstream. This includes, but is not limited to: AdvancedMD (AMD), Salesforce, Jira, Snowflake, and Google Workspace.
  • KPI Reporting: Builds, maintains, and distributes recurring reports and dashboards on key metrics, including inventory volumes, aging, production, backlog, SLA adherence, and data quality or error rates.
  • Data Quality & Vendor Partnership: Serves as the operational analyst to identify trends, anomalies, and areas of underperformance in inventory and data quality. Works directly with vendor partners and management to drive improvements, including participating in recurring functional review calls to align on process and resolve roadblocks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partners with colleagues within the department and across departments (e.g., Claims, Audit, Denials) to ensure inventory data is accurate, accessible, and useful to downstream processes.
  • Issue Investigation & Resolution: Performs deep-dive investigations into data discrepancies and inventory anomalies to identify root cause, recommend workflow or data adjustments, and escalate systemic issues to management to drive continuous performance improvement.
  • Subject Matter Expert Competencies: Demonstrates strong critical thinking, initiative, organization, attention to detail, confidentiality, thoroughness, decision making, independent work, data analysis, and a results-driven approach.
  • PHI Protection: This role works with PHI on a regular basis, in both paper and electronic form, and has access to various technologies to access PHI in order to perform the job. Proper PHI-handling actions are required.
  • Natera Trainings: Employee must complete required Natera HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies, Security, and Compliance training no later than the first 30 days of hire and ongoing as assigned.
  • Other duties as assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) OR
  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle, data analysis, or inventory/queue management, with exposure to reporting and data reconciliation.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Inventory Oversight: Ability to track and manage high-volume inventory (posting documents such as ERA, EOB, correspondence) and identify points of failure or stagnation within a process.
  • Technical Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking skills to troubleshoot data discrepancies and logic errors between source systems, payor data, and internal reporting.
  • Data Proficiency: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, Data Visualization). Working knowledge of SQL or BI tools is a plus.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Ability to influence and work effectively across diverse teams.
  • Analytical Communication: Ability to translate complex data into clear, concise reports for stakeholders at all levels.
  • Data Accuracy: Understanding of healthcare terminology and revenue cycle data elements, and the attention to detail needed to maintain data integrity.
  • Discretion: Strict adherence to HIPAA and confidentiality protocols regarding sensitive patient and financial data.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

At ModMed, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

  • Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work

  • 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”

  • 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties

  • Florida Venture Forum: Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

Ready to modernize medicine with us?

Job Description Summary:

ModMed is hiring a SeniorDirector, Demand Generation, responsible for developing and executing the company's integrated demand generation strategy to drive awareness, engagement, qualified leads, and revenue growth. This individual will lead the strategy, planning, execution, and optimization of multi-channel marketing programs designed to generate measurable pipeline and accelerate revenue across the company's target healthcare markets. The role will oversee the full demand generation funnel, from initial prospect engagement through lead conversion, opportunity creation, and pipeline contribution.


Working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, and other cross-functional marketing teams, the Senior Director will build scalable, data-driven programs that reach healthcare decision-makers.


The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on marketing leader with a proven track record of building successful B2B demand generation programs, driving pipeline growth, optimizing marketing performance, and translating marketing investments into measurable business results. They are equally comfortable developing the overall marketing strategy, managing budgets and performance metrics, and working directly with their team to execute campaigns. They are highly analytical, commercially minded, and focused on driving measurable business outcomes rather than simply generating marketing activity. Most importantly, they understand how to build a predictable, scalable demand generation engine that consistently delivers qualified pipeline and supports the company's long-term revenue growth.


Your role:

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Demand Generation Managers, establishing clear goals, performance expectations, and operational accountability to drive scalable execution.
  • Own the company’s overall demand generation strategy and annual/quarterly planning—including budget allocation, channel mix, and campaign priorities—aligned with corporate revenue and growth targets.
  • Direct integrated, multi-channel acquisition programs across paid search, organic search, paid social, email, content syndication, webinars, events, and referrals, tailored by healthcare specialty, organizational size, and buyer persona (physicians, practice owners, administrators, and healthcare executives).
  • Architect full-funnel nurture and account-based marketing (ABM) strategies to engage high-value healthcare organizations, accelerate MQL-to-SQL conversion, and drive closed-won revenue across net-new acquisition and customer expansion (cross-sell and upsell).
  • Partner closely with Sales leadership and Revenue Operations to align campaigns with pipeline priorities and continuously improve lead management, routing, and follow-up processes.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Customer Success to translate product positioning, value propositions, and competitive differentiation into consistent, on-brand demand campaigns.
  • Establish KPIs, dashboards, and testing frameworks to continuously evaluate and optimize the marketing mix, lead quality, conversion rates, and acquisition efficiency.
  • Track and analyze full-funnel performance—including lead volume, cost, pipeline contribution, and marketing-sourced and influenced revenue—delivering regular reporting and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Manage external agencies, marketing technology vendors, and strategic partners to extend team capacity and maximize return on spend.

Skills & Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree; Master's preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, including at least 5 years in people leadership roles.
  • Proven experience developing and executing successful demand generation strategies for a B2B technology or SaaS company.
  • Demonstrated success driving measurable pipeline growth and revenue contribution through integrated marketing programs.
  • Strong understanding of the B2B sales funnel, lead management, marketing attribution, and revenue marketing principles.
  • Experience managing significant marketing budgets and optimizing investment across multiple channels.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing marketing teams.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate marketing data into actionable business strategies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Healthcare and/or healthcare technology experience preferred
  • 15% to 25% domestic travel required

ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

United States

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
  • 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
  • Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
  • Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
  • Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
  • Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
  • Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

THE COLLECTIONS SPECIALIST

SunStrong Management is seeking a Bilingual Collections Specialist with B2C experience within the solar or energy industry. The Collection Specialist is responsible for the maintenance and collection of past due, delinquent, and defaulted accounts. Primarily this will be by contacting customers by phone, email, or automated dialer. Aside from phone calls, a specialist will also perform account research to identify opportunities to maintain the account including skip tracing, entering accounts for disconnect of service, requesting an updated or corrected letter, escalating account issues to the correct departments, etc. B2C experience and bilingual candidates (Spanish) are highly preferred.

  • Minimum of one year of equivalent experience in collecting delinquent accounts

Why Syneos Health

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.
  • Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

We founded Cordial in 2014 on the belief that there should be more humanity and empathy in marketing—both in how brands communicate with their customers and in how technology companies work with brands.   • Communicate better than the rest
  • Own it, every time
  • Solve client problems tenaciously

POSITION SUMMARY

Cordial is hiring an AI GTM Operations Manager (also referred to at times as a GTM Engineer) to own how marketing and sales run: the systems, the data, and the processes that connect them. You’ll own our GTM tech stack, connect our systems and processes to AI tools like Claude, and ship skills, automations, integrations, and mini apps that help sellers and marketers do their jobs better and move faster.

This is a builder role with a strategic lens. You’ll ask the questions most ops teams skip: Do we need to pay for this system? Why is this process so complicated? Should we just do this manually? What will help us hit the number this quarter? You need to understand how GTM systems fit together, how enterprise sales/marketing operates, how to build simple things that work, and how to teach the team to build on their own.

This is a senior individual contributor role that sits on the marketing team, reporting to the VP of Marketing, but you will work very closely with the sales, partnerships, client success, and finance teams. Our marketing team is built around a culture of curiosity, ownership, and care. We like to solve hard problems and look for learn-it-alls over know-it-alls.

  • Own the marketing and sales tech stack. Know every tool, what it costs, who owns it, how it’s integrated, and how it’s used. Recommend what to keep, cut, consolidate, or replace, and lead evaluations of core platforms.
  • Define how marketing and sales operate together. Drive the work, alongside the VP of Marketing and sales leadership, to redefine lead stages and definitions, routing, handoffs, and SLAs, and write the SOPs behind them.
  • Put strategy into the systems. Partner with marketing and sales leadership to keep our ICP, account tiers, and targeting current in Salesforce and our marketing tools.
  • Partner with field and growth marketing. Work closely with field marketing on pre- and post-event tracking and workflows, and with growth marketing on attribution models and campaign performance measurement.
  • Connect our data. Build clean paths from Salesforce, sales tools, and our marketing tools into Claude so the team can get answers, run plays, and build workflows in real-time.
  • Build tools the team uses. Use Claude Code, low-code tools, and APIs to ship skills, automations, and mini apps that the GTM team uses every week.
  • Teach people to fish. Run enablement and office hours so marketers and sellers can build and troubleshoot on their own. If you become the bottleneck or gatekeeper, the system was likely not optimized in the first place.
  • Manage external partners and contractors who support our systems, setting requirements and priorities.
  • Own full-funnel and GTM reporting so leadership has a clear view of pipeline, conversion, and speed-to-lead.

ABOUT YOU

  • 3+ years in revenue operations, marketing operations, sales operations, or GTM systems at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Admin-level depth in Salesforce: objects, flows, validation rules, and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and other marketing automation platforms, such as Pardot or Marketo.
  • You’ve built and shipped AI tools that other people use, such as Claude skills, agents, automations, or small apps built with Claude Code or similar. We’ll ask to see them.
  • A systems thinker that understands systems of record, APIs, integrations, GTM workflows, and the tools that enable these. Hands-on coding experience is not a requirement, but you probably have a GitHub account, like experimenting with new AI tools, and have built custom code or apps with a coding agent.
  • The code word is #becordial
  • A strategic operator who can explain why a process exists, simplify it, and get sales and marketing to agree on it.
  • Cost-conscious. You treat every tool as a decision, not a default. You act like an owner and think in terms of ROI, payback, and full cost of ownership.
  • A clear communicator and patient teacher who can translate between technical and non-technical teams.
  • Experience with Salesloft, Gong, Pardot, HubSpot, Clay, or enrichment tools is a plus.

Duties include:

  • Manage international quantitative and qualitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.

As we move America’s workforce toward the future, Amtrak connects businesses and communities across the country. The safety of our passengers, our employees, the public and our operating environment is our priority, and the success of our railroad is due to our employees.
