jobs.excerpt: Who is Boulevard?  Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses.
jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Boulevard is building a self-serve motion to reach the largest segment of the beauty and wellness industry: sole proprietors — the stylist renting a chair, the solo injector just starting their own book of business.

We're hiring a GM, Commercialization to own this business line end to end. This person sits at the intersection of Product and Go-to-Market, translating what Product ships into how Sales, Support, and Marketing should capture, sell, support, and message it. This role will serve as the connective tissue that makes a self-serve motion actually work across the business.

This is a builder role. Success in year one is measured two ways: hitting the revenue targets set for this business line, and building the foundation — the processes, definitions, and cross-org agreements — that let this motion scale well beyond year one. Expect this role to spend real time in the unglamorous, undefined space between orgs: what does Support need to staff and tool up for this audience, what does a sales-assisted save motion look like when a self-serve trial stalls out, what does Marketing need to build to acquire this audience cost-effectively.

What you’ll do here:

  • Own the revenue target and overall business performance for the sole-proprietor / self-serve segment, and report on it as its own line of the business.
  • Act as the single point of accountability connecting Product roadmap decisions to GTM execution
  • Design the sales-assisted layer that catches self-serve prospects who stall out in trial — defining triggers, handoff criteria, and the lightweight sales motion needed to convert them, in partnership with Sales leadership.
  • Define what Support needs to build or change to serve this audience well — tooling, staffing model, self-service help content — in partnership with Support leadership.
  • Partner with Product and Product Marketing to design and prioritize the self-serve sign-up, onboarding, and purchase experience — identifying what's missing from today's product to support a true self-serve motion (billing, in-product upgrade paths, etc.).
  • Collaborate with Performance and Lifecycle marketing to define the acquisition and conversion strategy for this segment
  • Build the initial instrumentation and reporting to see this segment's funnel clearly: activation, trial conversion, stall points, retention, and expansion.
  • Document the playbook this year's work produces, so it becomes the template if Boulevard expands self-serve to other underserved segments later.
  • Represent this business line in leadership and roadmap conversations, and make the trade-off case when this segment's needs compete with other priorities across Product, Sales, Support, and Marketing.

What you’ll need to thrive:

  • 8–12+ years across GTM strategy, growth, revenue/commercial leadership, or product-led growth, ideally with experience on both the product and go-to-market sides of a business.
  • Direct experience owning a revenue target or P&L, not just contributing to one.
  • Proven experience building or scaling a self-serve or product-led growth motion, ideally for a small-business, prosumer, or sole-proprietor audience.
  • Comfort operating as an individual contributor with no direct team in year one — this role leads through influence, clarity, and cross-org relationships, not headcount.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership: a track record of aligning Product, Sales, Support, and Marketing around a shared plan without formal authority over any of them.
  • Data fluency — able to build and read funnel and cohort analysis well enough to find exactly where self-serve customers stall and why.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and 0-to-1 build work; this is foundation-laying, not motion-optimizing.
  • Experience in vertical SaaS, marketplaces, or products built for micro-businesses/sole proprietors is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with the beauty, wellness, or personal-services industry is a plus, not a requirement.

How we'll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of compensation for this role. For all U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $183,000 – $216,000 per year.

This role participates in a performance-based variable compensation program that makes up a significant portion of On Target Earning. Total target cash compensation (base salary plus variable compensation) is anticipated to range from $257,000 to $302,500 per year. Final compensation will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

  • Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.
  • Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.
  • Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.
  • An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.
  • 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.
  • 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.
  • Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.
  • Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.
  • $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.
  • And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice.

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Outside Employment Disclosure
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. Employees in Tier 1 Restricted Roles may not hold concurrent employment, ownership, or an advisory role with a beauty, wellness, self-care, or med-spa business, or with a company that competes with Boulevard. ABOUT AGELESSRX
Our mission is radical life extension. We’re here to beat death.

At AgelessRx, we’re building the infrastructure to accelerate breakthroughs in longevity and fundamentally change how people approach their health. At the center is a profitable, high-eight-figure telehealth business serving tens of thousands of paying members who want to improve their energy, sleep, strength, hormonal health, and overall quality of life.

We’re building something much bigger than a telehealth company. By helping people achieve their health goals, we’re also creating something researchers rarely have access to: real-world data from people using real interventions, tracked over time, with opportunities to participate in future clinical research.

We’ve intentionally built capabilities that many companies outsource, including our own decentralized clinical trial platform, an in-house clinical network, and an AI-native technology stack. Our research includes PEARL, a clinical trial studying rapamycin, and we’ve been recognized as an XPRIZE Healthspan finalist.

We think big. Growing from eight to nine figures in revenue is an important milestone, but it’s not the end goal. We believe healthcare will look fundamentally different in five years, and we intend to help drive that transformation.

We keep our team small by design. We look for people who take ownership, move quickly, are AI-pilled, pay attention to the details, and aren’t afraid to tackle difficult problems. You’ll have the autonomy, tools, and opportunity to make a meaningful impact without layers of bureaucracy. We’re building a team of people who want to do the work, not just oversee it

OVERVIEW

AgelessRx is seeking an analytical, resourceful Senior Supply Chain & Vendor Operations Specialist to manage and improve the vendor relationships, inventory processes and operational systems supporting our growing telehealth business. You will own day-to-day execution while identifying risks early, turning data into decisions and improving how our teams work together. You will partner with Business Operations, Finance, Clinical Operations, QA and Customer Experience to maintain product availability, strengthen vendor performance and support scalable operations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Vendor Management & Procurement

  • Own day-to-day operational relationships with pharmacy, fulfillment, logistics and other supply chain partners.
  • Support vendor evaluation, onboarding and ongoing management based on cost, quality, capacity and reliability.
  • Track vendor SLAs and maintain scorecards for delivery, pricing, responsiveness and service quality.
  • Partner on vendor negotiations, pricing reviews and renewals; maintain accurate agreements, pricing and quality documentation.
  • Resolve escalations and identify opportunities to improve service and reduce vendor risk.

Supply Chain Planning & Inventory Management

  • Coordinate inventory planning, purchasing and supply availability based on demand, lead times and business growth.
  • Monitor inventory, stockouts, excess supply, disruptions and fulfillment delays; develop contingency plans.
  • Maintain KPIs for availability, forecast accuracy, vendor performance and fulfillment timelines.
  • Coordinate resolutions with internal teams and vendors to minimize patient impact.
  • Support new product launches, changing demand and operational expansion.

Cost Analysis & Operational Reporting

  • Maintain reliable vendor pricing, product cost, shipping and fulfillment data.
  • Partner with Finance on COGS, product margins and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Build reporting that makes supply chain performance, costs and risks actionable.
  • Measure the impact of vendor changes, workflow improvements and cost initiatives.

Cross-Functional Execution & Improvement

  • Communicate proactively about vendor issues, supply constraints and upcoming operational changes.
  • Drive improvements across Business Operations, Finance, Clinical Operations, QA and Customer Experience.
  • Use appropriate AI/automation tools to accelerate analysis and workflows while independently validating results and protecting data.
  • Own issues from identification through resolution, with clear documentation and follow-through.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years in supply chain, procurement, vendor operations, inventory, logistics or related operations.
  • Independent vendor relationship management, performance improvement and issue resolution.
  • Hands-on inventory planning, purchasing, forecasting and supply chain execution.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfortable with operational and financial analysis.
  • Experience building and using KPIs, reporting and process improvements with measurable impact.
  • Clear communication, cross-functional partnership, sound judgment and ownership in ambiguity.
  • Ability to use AI and automation thoughtfully, verify outputs and protect sensitive data

jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Manager of Cisco Customer Success develops and implements strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty, leading a team of professionals to ensure high retention rates. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless customer experience, analyzing feedback to drive improvements, and maintaining strong relationships with key customers. The Manager of Cisco Customer Success oversees onboarding and training, drives customer engagement, and monitors performance metrics to assess the effectiveness of initiatives, staying informed about industry trends to maintain a competitive edge.

Role Description

  • Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty across Cisco solutions and services, ensuring high retention rates and growth of existing customer accounts.

  • Lead a team of customer success professionals focused on Cisco customers, providing guidance, support, and development opportunities to drive both customer experience and business outcomes.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including SHI sales and Cisco partners, to ensure a seamless customer experience, resolve issues promptly, and align on account strategy and growth opportunities.

  • Analyze customer feedback, consumption data, and lifecycle insights to identify trends and areas for improvement, driving continuous enhancement of processes, service delivery, and Cisco solution adoption.

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with key Cisco customers, acting as a trusted advisor by providing guidance on product roadmaps, lifecycle management, and strategic initiatives such as cloud and licensing transitions.

  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as customer retention, renewal rates (including Cisco SmartNet), adoption, and account growth to assess the effectiveness of customer success initiatives.

  • Oversee the onboarding and adoption process for new Cisco customers, ensuring a smooth transition, accelerated time-to-value, and successful integration of Cisco solutions into the customer environment.

  • Drive customer engagement through proactive, strategic communication and tailored solutions, increasing Cisco product usage, service adoption, and overall customer satisfaction.

  • Facilitate structured Customer Success Reviews (CSRs) with customers to review usage, performance, upcoming renewals, and alignment to Cisco product roadmaps, providing strategic recommendations and next steps.

  • Stay informed on Cisco technologies, programs, and industry trends, incorporating best practices into customer success strategies to maintain a competitive edge and support customer outcomes.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can take ownership of customer-centric initiatives, ensuring products and services align with customer needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate customer feedback into product development.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.

  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.

  • Empathy: Can take ownership of fostering an empathetic culture, collaborate with others in resolving conflicts, and drive emotional well-being.

  • Relationship Building: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with diverse groups, and drive results through effective relationship management.

  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, anticipate future trends, and align and integrate strategies across departments or functions.

  • Results Orientation: Can set strategic goals for the organization and lead multiple teams to achieve these goals, demonstrating a strong orientation towards results.

  • Adaptability: Can lead others through change, help teams adapt to new directions, and create a culture open to change.

  • Emotional Intelligence: Can use emotional information to guide thinking and behavior, manage and/or adjust emotions to adapt to environments or achieve one’s goal(s), and help others do the same.

Skill Level Requirements

  • The ability to strategically develop, retain, and optimize employee skills and leadership potential within an organization, ensuring a high-performing workforce aligned with business goals. - Expert

  • Proficiency in utilizing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software to manage and analyze customer interactions and data throughout the customer lifecycle, improving customer service, retention, and sales growth. - Expert

  • The ability to effectively engage with customers and provide personalized service solutions that meet their specific needs and enhance satisfaction. - Expert

  • Comprehension of the inner workings of a company, including its market positioning, competitive dynamics, and operational processes, to inform decision-making and drive sustainable growth. - Expert

  • Skilled in creating engaging presentations with Microsoft PowerPoint, including customizing layouts, incorporating multimedia, and applying transition effects. - Expert

Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience

  • 1+ years of Sales management experience preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in Cisco consulting, delivery and operations

  • Ability to travel 20%

Preferred:

  • Experience with Cisco solutions, programs (e.g., SmartNet), or lifecycle/renewal management

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $150,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.excerpt: Job Description The Product Owner will lead business process definition, backlog ownership, requirements analysis, and stakeholder alignment for a ServiceNow CSM-based CRM implementation in a secure ServiceNow environment.
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Product Owner will lead business process definition, backlog ownership, requirements analysis, and stakeholder alignment for a ServiceNow CSM-based CRM implementation in a secure ServiceNow environment. This role will assist in translating the client's current customer-facing portal, registration, onboarding, migration tracking, dashboards, and support workflows into a secure, governed, and scalable ServiceNow CSM operating model.

This is a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst level position responsible for business process leadership, stakeholder alignment, backlog ownership, requirements governance, and client-facing facilitation.

We need an experienced Product Owner with strong business analysis skills who can jump in with minimal guidance, assess the discovery completed to date, and take ownership of moving requirements forward as we replace the existing Cloud One portal with ServiceNow CSM.

The immediate focus includes registration and onboarding, customer and account relationships, and the workflows, dashboards, and content needed in the consolidated portal. This person must independently lead discussions with government, Leidos, and system owners, work through incomplete documentation and unresolved business rules, and translate findings into prioritized user stories and acceptance criteria. They should also recognize dependencies involving custom portals and Data Transport/CDS and drive the clarification needed to keep development moving.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end business process design for customer onboarding, case management, and CRM workflows in ServiceNow CSM
  • Own and manage the product backlog, including user stories, priorities, and acceptance criteria
  • Conduct stakeholder workshops and translate business needs into clear, implementable requirements
  • Map and transform legacy tools, data, and processes into a unified ServiceNow CSM solution
  • Define workflows, automation, and integrations (e.g., CSM, portals, data sources)
  • Create and maintain process documentation, requirements, and traceability artifacts
  • Support UAT, validation, and release readiness to ensure solutions meet business needs
  • Ensure alignment with client security, CAC access, and compliance requirements
  • Facilitate client-facing requirements sessions, present options and recommendations, and drive stakeholder consensus across business, technical, and government teams.
  • Support technical implementation planning by translating business needs into ServiceNow solution requirements and collaborating with architects, developers, engineers, and program leadership.
  • Experience delivering ServiceNow CSM implementations or enhancements in enterprise environments
  • Proven background in hybrid roles (Business Process Lead / Product Owner / Business Analyst)
  • Strong expertise in customer service/CRM processes (case management, onboarding, portals, workflows)
  • Hands-on experience in Agile delivery (user stories, backlog management, UAT, releases)
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements for ServiceNow solutions
  • Experience working in regulated environments, preferably federal
  • Exposure to data migration, integrations, and legacy system transformation
  • Strong stakeholder management across business, technical, and government teams

Required Experience

  • Minimum 12 years of experience in Business Analysis, Product Ownership, Business Process Improvement, or related disciplines and BS Degree
  • Minimum 5 years of experience supporting ServiceNow implementations.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting federal government programs.
  • Experience serving as Product Owner or backlog owner in Agile delivery environments.
  • Experience managing or supporting technical implementation projects.
  • Technical acumen sufficient to partner effectively with ServiceNow architects, developers, engineers, and government stakeholders.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow CSM modules (accounts, contacts, case management, portals, knowledge, SLAs)
  • Ability to define workflows and automation using Flow Designer, playbooks, and lifecycle stages
  • Understanding of data models and migration (tables, relationships, data mapping, import processes)
  • Experience with integrations (CSM, APIs, IntegrationHub, external systems)
  • Familiarity with CSM/ITSM interaction and case-to-incident workflows
  • Knowledge of reporting and analytics (dashboards, KPIs, Performance Analytics)
  • Ability to define role-based access and security requirements (CAC, data visibility, permissions)
  • Familiarity with Jira and GitLab in Agile delivery environments.

Required Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills across business, technical, and government teams
  • Excellent communication skills (translating complex requirements into clear, actionable outputs)
  • Ability to work effectively in regulated environments with structured processes and compliance needs
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for breaking down complex business processes
  • High-quality documentation and organization skills for audit-ready artifacts
  • Collaborative mindset to work across cross-functional teams (product, engineering, security, data)
  • Ability to drive decision-making, prioritization, and change management
  • Awareness of security and data sensitivity in government environments
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills; business savvy and comfortable in client-facing discussions.
  • Ability to lead requirements workshops, communicate tradeoffs, and align stakeholders around clear decisions and next steps.

Certifications

  • ServiceNow certifications: CSA (preferred), CIS-CSM (strongly preferred), CIS-ITSM (nice to have)
  • Agile certifications: CSPO, PSPO, SAFe, PMI-ACP (preferred for product ownership)
  • Security+ or equivalent (for 8570/8140 compliance, if required)
  • Additional (nice to have): ITIL Foundation, CBAP/PMI-PBA, ServiceNow micro-certifications
  • Candidates without ServiceNow certifications may still be considered if they have strong applicable years of experience and can obtain certification within an agreed timeframe, subject to internal approval.

Security Requirements

  • CAC Eligibility: Must be eligible to obtain and maintain CAC credentials for secure program access.
  • Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance if required by the program.
  • Authentication: Ability to utilize Department of War (DoW) Common Access Card (CAC) primary authentication mechanisms for secure, identity-validated administrative access.
Salary: $150,000-$155,000

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Hospital) (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Über Recare Als eines der führenden deutschen HealthTech-Unternehmen gestalten wir das Entlassmanagement neu – technologiegetrieben, patientenzentriert und frei von Bürokratie.
jobs.description:
Über Recare

Als eines der führenden deutschen HealthTech-Unternehmen gestalten wir das Entlassmanagement neu – technologiegetrieben, patientenzentriert und frei von Bürokratie. Neben unserer marktführenden SaaS-Plattform entwickeln wir KI-Lösungen, die Prozesse in Kliniken und bei Nachversorgern radikal vereinfachen, Fachkräfte entlasten und den Fokus zurück auf die Patientinnen und Patienten legen. Bereits heute vernetzen wir zwei Drittel aller deutschen Krankenhäuser mit über 650 Rehakliniken und 25.000 Pflege- und Homecare-Anbietern. Mit aktuell rund 100 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir weiter – und suchen Menschen mit Haltung, die das Gesundheitssystem mit uns verbessern wollen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Arbeit mit Purpose: Deine Tätigkeit hat positiven Einfluss auf Patientinnen und Patienten, ihre Angehörigen und medizinische Fachkräfte im Gesundheitswesen.

  • Unternehmenskultur: Wir setzen auf flache Hierarchien, die eine hohe Performance und eine starke Teamdynamik fördern. Wir pflegen einen Umgang, der von gegenseitigem Respekt, Loyalität und Anerkennung geprägt ist, streben gemeinsam nach unseren Zielen und erwarten das Gleiche von dir.

  • Flexibilität: Möchtest du dein Kind aus der Kita abholen? Machst du gerne Sport in der Mittagspause? Wir unterstützen dich dabei. Wir sind ein Remote-freundliches Unternehmen mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. Nach Absprache kannst du gerne auch Workations machen.

  • Probonio-Benefit, das du flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen nutzen kannst.

  • Zusatz-Urlaubstag, damit du deinen Geburtstag mit deinen Liebsten feiern kannst.

Deine Rolle als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)

  • Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich ein Portfolio von rund 100 Midmarket-Accounts. Du priorisierst deine Aktivitäten nach ihrem erwarteten Effekt und hältst das Portfolio durch schlanke, standardisierte Kontaktpunkte aktiv in Betreuung.

  • Du planst, führst und bereitest regelmäßige Jour fixes nach – mit klarer Agenda, Protokoll und Maßnahmenplan.

  • Du führst Business Reviews durch, identifizierst und qualifizierst dabei systematisch Upsell- und Cross-Sell-Potenziale und übergibst sie als qualifizierte Leads mit vollständiger CRM-Dokumentation an Sales.

  • Du erstellst einfache Nutzungsanalysen, leitest Aktivierungsmaßnahmen ab und verfolgst relevante Adoption-KPIs.

  • Du entwickelst kundenspezifische Success-Pläne mit klaren Zielen für Adoption, Renewal und Expansion. Außerdem trägst du zu Vertragsverlängerungen, Vertragswerten und Expansionserlösen innerhalb deines Portfolios bei.

  • Du dokumentierst Kontakte, Risiken und Chancen zuverlässig im CRM und unterstützt Sales bei Forecasting und Pipeline-Reporting.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Launch, Integrations, Data und anderen Success Managern zusammen, um das regionale Netzwerk zu aktivieren und die Plattformnutzung zu steigern. Bei strategischen Accounts stellst du eine dokumentierte Übergabe an Key Account CSMs sicher.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, beispielsweise für Analysen, Reporting und die Vorbereitung von Business Reviews, und dokumentierst Wissen in Notion.

Requirements

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder einer vergleichbaren B2B-Rolle.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Betreuung eines breiten Kundenportfolios mit hoher Aktivitätsrate und regelmäßiger Kundenansprache.

  • Du verstehst SaaS-Geschäftsmodelle, Kundenlebenszyklen und die Förderung der Produktnutzung.

  • Du gehst sicher mit CRM-Systemen wie Salesforce oder HubSpot sowie mit Reporting- und BI-Tools wie Looker um.

  • Du kannst aus Daten einfache Maßnahmen ableiten und diese klar und zielgruppengerecht kommunizieren.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Austausch mit Entscheidungsträger:innen auf Abteilungsebene und kommunizierst überzeugend über verschiedene Hierarchieebenen hinweg.

  • Du trittst in Krankenhausstrukturen empathisch und beratend auf und verbindest Durchsetzungsfähigkeit mit Lösungsorientierung.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, organisiert und mit hohem Umsetzungstempo. Dabei denkst du analytisch und pragmatisch und handelst proaktiv mit Blick auf messbaren Kundenerfolg.

  • Du bist offen und neugierig, KI-Tools in deinem Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2).

Das ist ein Plus

  • Erfahrung im eHealth- oder Krankenhausumfeld oder in digitalen Transformationsprojekten im Gesundheitswesen.

  • Erfahrung mit der Skalierung von Betreuungsmodellen oder Customer-Success-Prozessen sowie mit Best Practices, Playbooks oder Templates.

  • Erfahrung im Projekt-, Change- oder Stakeholder-Management sowie Stärke in Präsentation und Moderation.

  • Erfahrung im Wissensaustausch mit Kolleg:innen oder funktionsübergreifenden Teams.

  • Erfahrung in der Leitung von Workshops, Schulungen oder Kundensessions sowie die Fähigkeit, die Stimme der Kund:innen intern zu vertreten.

jobs.title: Brokerage Trading Associate
jobs.excerpt: Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own.
jobs.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


The Brokerage Trading Associate provides trading assistance and customer service support to new and existing Empower retirement and investing customers. This role serves as a primary point of contact for inbound customer inquiries involving trade execution, brokerage account servicing, and investment products, including equities, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), mutual funds, options, and fixed income securities. The associate applies knowledge of financial markets, retirement account operations, and investment concepts to deliver accurate, timely, and customer-focused service while helping customers navigate Empower's brokerage products and financial tools.


The expected start date for this role is January 18th, 2027.


Schedule will vary by time zone.Candidates must be available to work the following Monday - Friday schedule for their location:


Eastern Time (ET): 11:30 a.m. - 8:00 p.m.

Central Time (CT): 10:30 a.m. - 7:00 p.m.

Mountain Time (MT): 9:30 a.m. - 6:00 p.m.

What you will do


  • Serve as a primary point of contact for customers seeking assistance with trading equities, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), mutual funds, options, and fixed income securities in an inbound contact center environment
  • Facilitate customer-directed securities transactions, including trade execution and order entry, in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and company procedures
  • Explain investment concepts, financial products, and brokerage processes clearly and accurately to customers with varying levels of investment knowledge.
  • Provide exceptional customer service and brokerage support to new and existing Empower retail investing and retirement customers
  • Manage customer servicing requests, including brokerage account opening, asset transfers, account maintenance, and transaction-related inquiries
  • Educate customers on Empower's available financial solutions, investment products, educational resources, and self-service tools
  • Resolve customer inquiries and service issues through independent problem-solving, accurate communication, and collaboration with internal business partners when needed
  • Navigate multiple technology platforms, trading systems, internal communication tools, and servicing resources while actively assisting customers
  • Maintain accurate customer information and transaction documentation while following established operational procedures

What you will bring


  • Minimum of 2 years of customer service experience in the financial services industry
  • Minimum of 1 year of direct securities trading experience involving trade execution and order entry
  • Active FINRA Series 7 and Series 63 registrations required
  • FINRA Fingerprinting required
  • Experience handling fixed income securities, corporate actions, and options transactions
  • Understanding of current financial markets, investment products, securities trading, and retirement account operations
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills, with the ability to explain investment concepts and brokerage procedures clearly to customers
  • Ability to independently research, troubleshoot, and resolve customer inquiries while maintaining accuracy and professionalism
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and customer interactions in a fast-paced, high-volume contact center environment
  • Proficiency with PC applications, digital communication tools, and multiple technology platforms
  • Ability to learn and navigate brokerage trading systems, customer servicing applications, and internal operational procedures
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to navigate multiple applications simultaneously during customer interactions
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively to deliver accurate, responsive, and customer-focused service

What will set you apart


  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in business, finance, or a related field
  • Previous experience in a financial services call center or contact center
  • Experience supporting retail brokerage accounts, Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs), or 401(k) retirement accounts
  • Experience using Pershing NetX360 or comparable brokerage custody and clearing platforms
  • Experience supporting customers with complex securities transactions involving multiple investment products
  • Familiarity with brokerage account operations, asset transfers, and securities settlement processes
  • Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) software or financial services recordkeeping platforms


***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$55,300.00 - $76,075.00

Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PCMag, WRS Health provides integrated, cloud-based EHR and practice management solutions to medical practices. We help healthcare providers streamline operations and improve patient care through innovative technology and services.

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly technical, strategic, and results-driven Marketing Lead to turn business objectives into actionable initiatives and measurable results.

The ideal candidate combines strong marketing expertise, business acumen, critical thinking, and technical knowledge. This individual should be able to identify growth opportunities, solve complex business challenges, lead initiatives, and develop innovative solutions independently.

Beyond traditional marketing, this role requires a strong understanding of AI, automation, CRM platforms, and analytics to improve marketing performance and business operations. The successful candidate should be equally comfortable developing strategies, managing teams, and getting directly involved in execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute marketing strategies that support business growth, lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue goals.
  • Analyze competitors, and translate business objectives into actionable marketing initiatives.
  • Manage and optimize HubSpot or similar CRM platforms, marketing tools, and automation workflows.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve content creation, research, campaign management, lead generation, analytics, and reporting.
  • Lead strategic projects, solve business challenges, and identify opportunities to improve existing processes.
  • Manage and develop team members while collaborating with Sales and Product teams to drive results.
  • Monitor campaign and business performance, using data and insights to guide decisions and improve outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Business Management, or a related field. Advanced education is a plus.
  • Significant experience in marketing, business strategy, growth, or a related leadership role.

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is hiring a Senior Identity Management Engineer to architect, build, and run the identity, secrets, and privileged access systems that secure our global workforce, engineering infrastructure, cloud services, and autonomous AI agents. As part of the Operations Security (OpSec) team, you will replace static credentials, over-scoped tokens, and manual ticket queues with automated, self-service paths, partnering with IT, DevInfra, Cloud, and Software Engineering. This is a hands-on role for an identity engineer who also writes software.

This role is remote, based out of the United States or Canada.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • Equal parts enterprise identity architect and software builder, comfortable administering Entra ID, Active Directory, and Vault and writing the CLIs, APIs, and IaC that automate them.
  • AI-native: you use coding agents to build internal tools, MCP servers, and audit reports.
  • A pragmatic partner who replaces manual gatekeeping with self-service and light-touch approval workflows.
  • Ownership-minded and analytical, able to anticipate cross-team impact and respond decisively to identity threats.

What We Need

  • Deep experience running Microsoft Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory, including SAML/OIDC, SCIM, Conditional Access, and phishing-resistant MFA.
  • Production experience with HashiCorp Vault (or equivalent), including workload federation, dynamic short-lived credentials, and removing static secrets from CI/CD.
  • Experience rolling out privileged access management and just-in-time elevation across cloud admin roles and Linux SSH/sudo.
  • Programming skills (Python, TypeScript, Go, or Rust, plus Terraform and Docker) with a track record of building working tools instead of manual ClickOps.
  • Experience with access reviews, identity threat detection and response (such as CrowdStrike Falcon Identity Protection), and auditing service accounts and tokens.

What You Will Learn

  • How to build an agentic identity platform that governs credentials and lifecycle for autonomous AI agents.
  • How to design host-level Linux PAM and just-in-time access across workstations, cloud, and high-performance EDA clusters.
  • How to run code-backed, AI-assisted access audits that produce SOC 2 Type 2 evidence.
  • How to publish security skills so engineering AI agents adopt Vault, OIDC, and least-privilege standards by default.

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. Job Summary:

The Project Manager I (PMI) is responsible for the successful delivery of customer-facing technical projects from initiation through closure. The PMI manages project scope, schedule, financials, resources, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication while ensuring a high-quality customer experience. The PMI also serves as a mentor to Project Coordinators and contributes to the continued improvement of PMO standards and practices.

About our PMO:

At Logically, Project Management is a profession, not simply a job title. Our Project Managers own the full project lifecycle, including scope, schedules, financials, risks, resources, deliverables, and the customer experience. We're looking for someone who wants Project Management to be their career, not simply their current job. Someone who takes pride in the craft, continually develops their skills, shares what they know, and helps make the team around them better.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

Project Ownership & Customer Experience: Take ownership of assigned projects from Sales handoff through successful completion and closure, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring a best-in-class customer delivery experience.

Scope Management: Validate project scope, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, and customer expectations during the transition from Sales to Delivery. Manage scope throughout the project lifecycle and identify, document, and communicate changes or potential scope conflicts.

Schedule Management: Develop and maintain project plans and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), including milestones, dependencies, critical path, resource assignments, and forecast completion dates. Proactively identify and address issues that may impact the project schedule.

Resource Management: Partner with Project Coordinators to coordinate internal and external resources required for successful project delivery, proactively addressing resource constraints, conflicts, or dependencies and escalating when necessary.

Risk & Project Health Management: Continuously evaluate project health and proactively identify, document, mitigate, and escalate risks before they materially impact the customer, schedule, scope, budget, or successful delivery. Support recovery plans for at-risk, stalled, or challenged projects.

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Staff Product Designer

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to lead design for our cash products, the fast, affordable liquidity at the heart of the Tilt user’s financial lives. They help members cover the gap between paychecks, and you’ll own the experience end to end: how members understand their offer, take an advance, and repay.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a designer who has owned the design of a whole product or product area before, not only individual features, and is ready to do the same here. You’ll pair strong product thinking with exceptional craft, and you’ll be accountable for outcomes: the customer and business results the experience drives. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other partners to set direction for the product and raise the quality bar across it.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Lead design for our cash products end to end, from setting the experience direction for the product through launch and iteration.

  • Own outcomes alongside your product and engineering partners: define what success looks like, connect design decisions to measurable customer and business results, and follow the work after launch to see whether it delivered.

  • Set and hold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, and overall product quality, and raise the bar for the wider design team through critique and example.

  • Translate complex financial concepts and flows, such as offers, advances, and repayment timing, into clear, trustworthy experiences.

  • Shape product strategy with your partners: identify the problems that matter most, frame them well, and make tradeoffs explicit.

  • Partner with compliance and legal early, so clarity and trust are built into the experience from the start.

  • Use AI throughout your workflow, from research synthesis and exploration to prototyping and building, and help the team adopt the approaches that work.

  • Help shape the design system and the broader UI patterns that our cash products and the rest of the app rely on.

  • Present work clearly and build alignment among partners and senior leaders with different perspectives and priorities.

  • Mentor other designers and help shape how design operates across product pods.

Why You're a Great Fit

  • Significant experience designing and shipping complex consumer digital products, ideally within fintech, financial services, commerce, transportation, or another multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Experience as the design owner for a whole product or major product area: you set its design direction and were accountable for the result, beyond designing individual features.

  • A portfolio that shows exceptional visual and UI craft alongside strong UX thinking, at a level that raises the bar for the team around you.

  • A track record of outcomes: examples where your design work measurably moved customer or business results, and how you knew.

  • Comfort setting direction in ambiguous product areas without a fully defined path.

  • Strong interaction-design fundamentals and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Experience working closely with product management and engineering throughout development, and influencing decisions beyond your own team.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including presenting to senior leaders and bringing partners along.

  • Good judgment about when to challenge assumptions, when to seek more context, and when to make a decision.

  • Consistent use of AI tools in your day-to-day design workflow (strongly preferred), with an informed point of view on where they help and where they don’t.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing consumer financial products, such as cash advance, banking, payments, or lending

  • Experience prototyping or building in code, including with AI coding tools.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months, you’ll build a deep understanding of our customers, cash products, and business through shipping; build trusted relationships with your design and cross-functional partners; and form a clear point of view on where the experience should go.

Why Join Us

  • Lead design for the products at the center of Tilt’s business, with meaningful customer and business impact.

  • Set both the experience and the visual direction for a critical financial product.

  • Join a team that values strong design judgment, constructive debate, and thoughtful collaboration.

  • Work directly with product-minded partners who care deeply about customers and shipping useful products.

  • Shape how design operates, including how the team builds with AI, as the product organization evolves.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.title: Tech Lead (Investment & Growth)
jobs.excerpt: Tangem is a high-tech company in the blockchain sector was founded in 2017, headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with branches in North America, Eastern Europe, and APAC.
jobs.description:
Tangem is a high-tech company in the blockchain sector was founded in 2017, headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with branches in North America, Eastern Europe, and APAC.

Tangem started with the idea of bringing digital assets to the masses using a unique combination of a smartcard-based hardware wallet and mobile applications. Company owns and promotes the technology of hardware cold-wallet for digital assets with secure and simple UX in 220 countries today. Our customers enjoy setup time within 1 minute with the ultimate security level for digital assets on their wallet. Tangem solutions offer multi-support of a growing number of thousands of tokens by a single wallet. SBI Crypto Investment Ltd., the digital asset venture investment company wholly owned by SBI Holdings Inc., has invested $15 million into Tangem in 2019 for mass adoption of blockchain technology.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to own the technical direction and architecture of our Investment & Growth stream. You’ll work across mobile, backend, and blockchain, ensuring all components work reliably together. You’ll be involved from the start of each feature, making key technical decisions and identifying potential risks.

The role also includes cross-team technical leadership and delivery ownership for swaps, on-ramps, staking and yield, RWA, prediction markets, and trading venue integrations. The stream consists of around 15–25 engineers across five sub-streams, covering iOS, Android, Backend, Blockchain, and QA, with dedicated functional leads for each engineering discipline.

A strong understanding of self-custody, third-party integrations, and reliable money-moving systems is essential.

Responsibilities:

Architecture and Hands-On Work
  • Own technical architecture across mobile, backend, and blockchain components within the Grow stream;
  • Get involved at the start of each major feature to define architecture, identify technical risks, and ensure smooth integration between systems;
  • Review architecture decisions across teams and make sure mobile, backend, and blockchain components work reliably together;
  • Own the provider layer across swap, on-ramp, staking, and venue integrations;
  • Design transaction lifecycle handling for money-moving flows: idempotency, state machines for long-running operations, retries, partial fills, stalled transactions, and reconciliation with partners;
  • Lead technical evaluation and onboarding of aggregators, on-ramp providers, staking providers, exchanges, and perp venues.
Delivery
  • Own end-to-end delivery for all Grow sub-streams: scope, estimates, dependencies, release plan, and launch;
  • Coordinate technical decisions and dependencies across iOS, Android, backend, and blockchain teams;
  • Run one delivery plan across sub-streams competing for shared engineering capacity and negotiate trade-offs;
  • Manage dependencies on shared platform teams and the Store and Spend streams;
  • Report status, risks, and forecasts to the CTO.
Team and Process
  • Provide technical leadership across the stream, working closely with functional engineering leads;
  • Support engineers through technical guidance, feedback, and hiring;
  • Own on-call and incident response wherever user funds are in motion, with severity levels and MTTR targets;
  • Build deeper domain expertise across teams, particularly around execution, settlement, and custody.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in engineering, with 3+ years of technical leadership experience delivering consumer products in production;
  • Strong hands-on architecture experience across mobile and backend systems. Able to design and review technical solutions across all three areas, identify integration risks, and guide implementation;
  • Experience with Kotlin or Node.js. Strong understanding of backend architecture, APIs, microservices, asynchronous communication, and distributed systems;
  • Mobile engineering & delivery: Experience working with iOS/Android teams, understanding mobile architecture, release processes, and platform constraints. Able to identify technical risks and coordinate cross-platform delivery;
  • Still technical. Able to investigate production issues and debug failed transactions end to end. This is not a purely managerial role.
  • Multi-chain in practice: EVM plus at least one of Solana, TON, Bitcoin/UTXO, or Cosmos. Transaction lifecycle, fee and nonce management, re-orgs, token approvals, address derivation, and signing constraints;
  • DeFi integration: has shipped DEX aggregation and routing, staking (delegation, unbonding, reward accounting), or yield vaults. Treats slippage, MEV, and quote decay as engineering problems;
  • Trading-venue integration: experience with exchange APIs in production — REST and WebSocket, rate limits, order lifecycle, deposits and withdrawals, settlement, and custody boundaries. Can explain how a quote becomes a fill and what breaks in between;
  • Money-movement correctness: idempotency, exactly-once semantics, reconciliation, long-running state machines, and observability. Has been on call for systems where a bug costs users money;
  • Experience coordinating architecture and delivery across multiple teams or workstreams;
  • Has managed technical relationships with third-party providers, including holding them accountable.


  • Nice to have:
    • Strong blockchain fundamentals. Understands how smart contracts work and interact with applications, common blockchain standards (including EVM/EIP/ERC concepts), transaction execution, and basic smart contract security risks;
    • Has built systems where settlement, reconciliation, and order lifecycle carried real consequences: brokerage, CFD, payments, or PSP;
    • Derivatives literacy — margin, funding rates, liquidation mechanics. Directly relevant to the Hyperliquid sub-stream;
    • Prediction markets or event contracts. Directly relevant to the Polymarket sub-stream;
    • Regulated delivery: MiCA and CASP, travel rule, geo-restriction design, KYC and AML flows;
    • Security engineering around signing flows, key material, and third-party risk.

What We Offer:

  • Stability, development, participation in the future unicorn's growth;
  • Remote work from anywhere in the world;
  • Competitive salary in EUR/USDT;
  • Unlimited vacation;
  • Birthday presents;
  • Compensation for the purchase of necessary technical devices for the work;
  • Paid sick leaves.

jobs.description:
Senior Director, Client Experience

About the Role

Market My Market is looking for a Senior Director, Client Experience to own the Client Experience department. Today that department serves more than 320 clients and is made up of two Directors, Client Experience, roughly 11 Client Experience Managers, and 7 Client Success Assistants. This is the leader our two Directors report to, and the person the whole department looks to for direction, standards, and accountability.

This is a leadership seat first. It is built for someone who has already run a client-facing organization inside a fast-growing digital marketing agency, who knows what it takes to keep clients for years, and who can set the tone for how an entire department communicates, inspects its own work, and gets ahead of problems before clients feel them.

You will also keep your feet wet by managing a small portfolio of approximately five accounts of your own, so you are living the same client conversations, reports, and results your team is accountable for. You will own retention, the client messaging standard, and the department's operating rhythm. You will look at the KPIs every week, ask the questions no one else is asking, and teach your directors and their teams to do the same. When something is off, you will propose the fix, not just flag the issue. The Senior Director, Client Experience reports to the CEO and sits on the leadership team.

What You Will Own

Department Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable Client Experience Managers a team of roughly 11 Client Experience Managers and 7 Client Success Assistants serving 320+ clients. This role will have a handful of direct reports, and will also monitor the success of Client Experience Managers and Client Success Assistants that report to other Directors of Client Experience
  • Set clear expectations and scoreboards for every seat in the department, then inspect against them consistently. Praise in public, correct in private, and never let a miss go unaddressed.
  • Own the department's operating cadence: weekly KPI reviews, portfolio health reviews, one-on-ones, and quarterly rocks that ladder up to company goals.
  • Build the bench. Identify and develop the next generation of CX leaders and make sure every director and manager has a growth plan.
  • Represent Client Experience on the leadership team and partner with the SEO, Content, Paid, Creative, and Business Development leaders so clients experience one company, not five departments.

Client Retention & Portfolio Health

  • Own client retention and lifetime value across every account the department manages. Retention is the number this role is measured on first.
  • Build and run an early-warning system for at-risk clients: know which accounts are drifting before they tell us, and make sure there is a documented save plan and an owner on every one.
  • Personally get involved in the accounts that matter most and the escalations that could cost us a client, then turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook for the team.
  • Drive renewals, upsell, and cross-sell as a natural outcome of well-run accounts, working closely with Business Development.
  • Set the standard for onboarding, the first 90 days, and QBRs so every client understands what we are doing, why, and what it is producing.
  • Manage approximately five client accounts of your own to the same standard you hold the team to, and use that hands-on experience to keep your coaching, playbooks, and expectations grounded in reality.

Messaging & Value Communication

  • Own the messaging standard for the entire department: how we talk about results, how we explain what happened in a month, how we deliver hard news, and how we frame the next recommendation.
  • Build the frameworks, templates, and talk tracks that turn rankings, traffic, calls, and leads into a clear ROI story a practice or business owner cares about.
  • Review client-facing communication, reports, and meeting recaps regularly and coach to the standard. If a client is confused about the value they are getting, that is on us.
  • Make sure every CXM can explain the full MMM offering, including SEO, paid ads, content, web, and Google Business Profile, and position it in a way that fits each client's goals.

KPIs, Inspection & Proactive Operations

  • Define the department's KPIs, including retention, NPS, response time, meeting cadence, upsell, and portfolio health, and report on them to the CEO and leadership team every week.
  • Look at the numbers before anyone asks. Spot the trend, dig into the cause, and show up with a point of view and a recommendation.
  • Teach the team to be proactive, not reactive. Build the habits and checklists that mean clients hear from us with the answer, not the other way around.
  • Audit the work: sit in on client calls, read the reports, review the Asana boards, listen to CallRail calls, and use what you find to raise the bar.
  • Get the most out of the tools we have already invested in, including Zoom Revenue Accelerator, HubSpot, Claude, Replit, and our internal apps, then push them further. Use call intelligence to coach, CRM data to spot risk, and AI to take manual work off the team's plate.
  • Champion automation and AI inside the department so the team spends its time on strategy and relationships instead of manual work, and hold the team to actually adopting what we build.

Solutions & Opportunities

  • Come to the table with solutions. When a process breaks, a client churns, or a report misses the mark, own the root cause and bring a proposed fix with a plan to roll it out.
  • Look for opportunities others miss: new service lines clients are asking for, packaging that would retain better, processes that would free up capacity, and gaps between what we sell and what we deliver.
  • Partner with the SEO Director, Content Director, and PPC Manager on delivery issues that show up in client conversations, and push for fixes that stick.
  • Contribute to case studies, webinars, and thought leadership that show clients and prospects what great looks like.

What Success Looks Like

  • In the first year: Retention is up and churn is predictable, with every at-risk account identified early and worked to a plan.
  • Across the department: Every director and manager knows their numbers, owns their scoreboard, and can explain the story behind it without prompting.
  • With clients: Clients can articulate the value they get from Market My Market because the team has been trained to communicate it clearly and consistently.
  • With leadership: The CEO and leadership team can trust that Client Experience is run, inspected, and improving without needing to step in.

Requirements

  • Rapid-growth agency experience (required): You have been part of a digital marketing agency that grew rapidly, ideally from roughly $15 million to $30 million or more in annual revenue, and you understand what that growth does to a client-facing team and how to lead through it.
  • SEO and digital marketing background (required): You have worked in SEO-led digital marketing and are fluent in paid ads, content, web, and local search as part of an integrated offering. You can hold your own in a strategy conversation with a client or an SEO director.
  • Local professional services clients (required): Your client experience has been with local professional services businesses. Direct experience with legal, dental, medical, or veterinary clients is a strong plus.
  • Proven leadership (required): You have led leaders. You have managed managers or directors, built teams, set KPIs, held people accountable, and developed people into bigger roles. Ten or more years in client-facing roles with at least five in leadership is typical.
  • Retention track record: You have owned retention numbers for a book of business and can talk specifically about how you moved them.
  • Analytical, hands-on with systems, and tech-forward: You live in the data and you are an early adopter. You are comfortable with CRMs (HubSpot preferred), conversation intelligence such as Zoom Revenue Accelerator, AI tools like Claude, low-code platforms like Replit, call tracking, and project management tools, and you use them to inspect and improve rather than just report.
  • Exceptional communicator: You write and speak clearly, coach others to do the same, and can deliver a hard message to a client or a teammate with directness and care.
  • Ownership mindset: You are proactive, solutions-focused, and comfortable owning outcomes. You bring answers, not just questions.

Our Core Values

Market My Market specializes in tailored marketing solutions for law firms, medical and dental offices. Our mission is to deliver measurable results while fostering team growth, accountability, and innovation. We prioritize a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

jobs.excerpt: Join the Tilt team At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss.
jobs.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Head of Growth, Tilt Mexico

Mexico was Tilt's first market outside the US. Since 2022, our mobile-first personal loan has helped over 1 million customers access short-term credit on transparent, affordable terms. We now offer a 3-month installment loan and are rolling out a credit card in beta. As Head of Growth, you'll own how Tilt Mexico finds, activates and keeps customers across all three products, with real budget accountability and the mandate to drive profitable growth.

Acquisition works today but is concentrated in a few paid channels. Lifecycle and cross-sell are early, and the brand is under-measured. This is a chance to build an AI-native growth function in one of Latin America's largest and fastest-moving consumer credit markets.

This is a remote role based in Mexico. Travel for company onsites is expected at least four times a year.

How you'll make an impact

  • Own the full growth funnel: Lead acquisition, activation, retention and cross-sell as one strategy, measured on profitable customers rather than installs or approvals. Paid acquisition stays the engine; you'll bring lifecycle and brand up to parity over time.

  • Drive performance marketing sophistication: Allocate the acquisition budget across channels with rigour: proper attribution, event-based optimisation, and payback and CAC (customer acquisition cost) discipline tied to credit outcomes. Push beyond the current channel mix into new paid, partnership, referral and app store channels, backed by steady creative testing.

  • Make growth and credit work together: Use the unit economics model with Credit and Data Science to decide which customers to acquire, at what cost and through which channels. Make sure growth targets account for approval rates and losses, not just volume.

  • Build the brand and its measurement: Define how Tilt shows up in Mexico, in voice, visual identity and awareness strategy, and put in place the measurement it lacks today: brand tracking, organic search and app store visibility, and social listening.

  • Grow customer value through lifecycle and cross-sell: Build triggered campaigns across push, SMS, WhatsApp, email and in-app that move customers from first loan to repeat loans, installment loans and the credit card. Partner with Product and Engineering to define what the lifecycle stack needs, and own the strategy that runs on it.

  • Run a small, leveraged team: Lead a tight, high-output team that uses AI for creative production, budget allocation and analytics rather than defaulting to headcount growth. Share what works with the growth teams in our other markets: the US, Brazil, India and the Philippines.

Why you're a great fit

  • 8+ years in growth or marketing, with hands-on performance marketing experience earlier in your career. You've personally run campaigns, not just overseen them.

  • You've had real budget accountability: your name on spend decisions, not just advisory input.

  • Consumer fintech or digital lending experience in Mexico or Latin America. You understand how acquisition cost, approval rates and credit losses shape what growth is worth.

  • Strong quantitative fluency. CAC, LTV (lifetime value), payback, attribution models and A/B test design (sample size, statistical significance) are second nature.

  • Familiarity with CRM and lifecycle tooling (Iterable or equivalent). You know what good looks like, even if you weren't the one building it.

  • You hold both halves of growth at once, analytical rigour and creative judgment, and you're honest about where your edge sits.

  • An AI-native mindset. You use agentic AI tools to raise your team's speed and quality, and you see AI as a force multiplier, not a threat to headcount.

  • Native or fluent Spanish and professional fluency in English.

  • Bonus: Hands-on experience with AppsFlyer (or a comparable mobile attribution platform) for install and event measurement.

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper discussion about your experience.

  3. Skills Panel: Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach.

  4. Leadership Conversation: A final conversation with a leader to discuss how you'll contribute to Tilt's mission, and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.
