jobs.excerpt: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO.  At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients.
jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.

Precision for Medicine is looking for Senior Clinical Research Associate.

Position Summary:

The Senior CRA has wide-ranging and broad experience and typically handles the most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management.
Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected.
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
• Independently oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports.
• Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
• Establishes, updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports.
• Manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager.
• If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee.
• Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
• Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Performs Monitoring Oversight Visits to assess other CRA team members. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote).
• Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
• Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
• Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues.
• Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision high quality and professional image.
• Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. • Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
• Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies.
• Identifies and processes Serious Adverse Events according to the procedures defined by the study team. Also demonstrates a full understanding of the SAE reporting process.
• Identifies site risks and escalates those to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager with suggested contingencies. Owns the timely and appropriate resolution of the risk with oversight from project team.
• Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face-to-face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements. May prepare or assist in preparation of study-specific presentations/training materials and tools.
• Assists the team managers in the preparation and review of protocols and other study documentation.
• Supports the design and development of CRFs and clinical trial documents as they pertain to clinical monitoring activities (i.e. operating manuals, monitoring guidelines, etc.).
• Assists with review of clinical study reports.
• Functions as a mentor, assisting with the training and developing of new employees and junior monitors.
• Interacts with client, participates in proposal activities, including development and client presentations.
• Initiates payment requests for investigators.
• Travels as necessary according to project needs.
• Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor's degree / international equivalent or equivalent combination of education and experience ideally in a business, scientific or healthcare discipline.
  • Minimum of 3.5 years of on-site monitoring experience; Oncology experience；
  • Global Clinical Trial experience

Other required:

  • High in proficiency in the Microsoft Office package of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
  • Customer service demeanour; demonstrate flexibility and teamwork.
  • Ability to focus on detail for extended periods of time, high attention to accuracy.
  • Fluency in English communication, verbally and in writing.
  • Working knowledge of the drug development process.
  • Travelling required (60-70%)

Preferred:

  • Solid experience in clinical research or related experience.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a remote work environment.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.excerpt: Position Overview Storable is seeking a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead the organization's information security strategy, program, and culture at a pivotal moment in our growth.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Storable is seeking a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead the organization's information security strategy, program, and culture at a pivotal moment in our growth. As a multi-vertical SaaS company serving tens of thousands of businesses across self-storage and adjacent industries, Storable operates complex, high-availability platforms on AWS that handle sensitive customer and payment data.

This is not a compliance-only role. The CISO Storable needs a business-minded security leader who can translate risk into language executives and boards understand, build a security organization that enables speed rather than slows it, and establish Storable as a trusted partner to customers who care deeply about data protection.

The CISO will own the full security program: strategy, governance, architecture, operations, compliance, and culture. They will serve as the primary security voice to the executive team, the board, and customers — and will inherit a security organization with strong foundations that is ready to mature.

Critically, this leader must be equipped to govern AI at enterprise scale. Storable is an active and growing user of AI and is committed to both accelerating AI adoption and governing it responsibly. The CISO will be a key partner, driving AI security strategy, Shadow AI monitoring, and alignment to emerging AI regulatory frameworks.

Scope and Strategic Impact

The CISO operates at the intersection of security, technology strategy, compliance, and business enablement. Key areas of impact include:

  • Owning and maturing Storable's enterprise security program across a distributed AWS-native SaaS environment spanning multiple product verticals.
  • Driving AI security governance — including Shadow AI detection, AI risk tiering, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 alignment, and OWASP LLM/Agentic AI security integration into the SDLC.
  • Ensuring continuous SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS compliance
  • Maturing the monitoring and detection stack — SIEM, DLP, EDR, and CASB (Cloudflare Zero Trust/Gateway), to provide full visibility across cloud, SaaS, and AI surfaces.
  • Serving as the executive-level security partner to our team and enterprise customers who conduct security due diligence.
  • Building a security culture that treats AI as both an asset to leverage and a risk surface to govern, enabling velocity without creating exposure.

Key Responsibilities

Security Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute a multi-year information security strategy aligned to Storable's business objectives, growth trajectory, and AI adoption roadmap.
  • Own the enterprise risk management framework, including threat modeling, risk appetite definition, and risk reporting to the executive team and board.
  • Lead, grow, and mentor the security team; build a high-performing organization that scales with the business.
  • Serve as the primary security spokesperson to customers, prospects, auditors, regulators, and executive leadership.

AI Security & Governance

  • Govern AI security at enterprise scale, including policy enforcement, Shadow AI detection via Cloudflare Zero Trust, and DLP controls for AI prompt content.
  • Lead AI risk tiering and formal use case risk assessments aligned to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act's four-tier risk classification.
  • Partner with the AI Tools Committee to formalize AI governance charters, coordinate cross-committee escalation paths, and produce unified AI governance reporting.
  • Integrate OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP Agentic AI controls into the secure development lifecycle for engineering teams building AI-powered features.
  • Oversee AI vendor risk assessments vendors against Storable's AI vendor risk framework covering training data practices, data retention, and sub-processor disclosures.

Compliance & Regulatory

  • Own SOC 2 Type II compliance program — including control design, evidence collection, and auditor relationships across all Trust Services Criteria.
  • Ensure PCI DSS compliance across applicable product verticals handling payment card data.
  • Maintain alignment and evaluate the business case and timeline for any compliance requirements.
  • Own enterprise privacy governance across Storable’s digital assets, including consent banner and preference framework oversight, alignment with applicable privacy regulations, integration with website and marketing technologies, and controls for consent logging, script/category enforcement, and coordination with Legal, Product, Marketing, and Engineering.
  • Implement and govern enterprise data lifecycle management policies and controls across collection, classification, retention, archival, and secure disposal, ensuring alignment with legal, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • Architect and enforce security controls across Storable's AWS environment, including IAM, VPC design, encryption key management (KMS), GuardDuty, Security Hub, and CloudTrail.
  • Drive Zero Trust adoption through Cloudflare WARP and Gateway, completing org-wide enforcement, configuring AI-specific monitoring policies, and transitioning Shadow AI detection from monitoring to enforcement mode.
  • Oversee vulnerability management lifecycle, including SAST integration in CI/CD pipelines, DAST/SAST coverage, penetration testing cadence, and SLA-driven remediation.
  • Govern secrets management, certificate lifecycle, and API key hygiene across engineering teams using AI tooling and AWS services.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Own the Security Operations function — including SIEM, detection engineering, and alert triage.
  • Develop and maintain AI-specific incident response playbooks for: data exposure via AI prompt, Shadow AI with data exposure, AI output-caused harm, and prompt injection / AI system compromise.
  • Lead tabletop exercises, including AI-specific scenarios, to validate response readiness and cross-functional coordination.
  • Drive continuous improvement of MTTD and MTTR metrics; report security operations KPIs to executive leadership quarterly.

Secure Development & Application Security

  • Partner with Engineering leadership to embed security into the SDLC, threat modeling, security design review, code scanning, and OWASP LLM controls for AI-powered features.
  • Define secure coding standards and security acceptance criteria for AI-assisted development.
  • Evaluate and mature the application security testing program, including LLM-specific red team exercises targeting prompt injection, output manipulation, and data extraction vectors.

Vendor, Third-Party & Supply Chain Risk

  • Own the AI and SaaS vendor risk management program, applying Storable's AI vendor risk assessment framework to new and existing tools, with priority on AI providers.
  • Ensure contractual security requirements are enforced with third parties, including AI vendors, data processors, and technology partners.
  • Manage security requirements in M&A due diligence, integration, and post-close remediation activities.

Security Culture & Awareness

  • Build and operationalize a role-based AI security training program: general AI awareness for all employees, responsible AI use for power users, and secure AI development for engineers.
  • Drive a security culture where engineering teams view security as an enabler — not a gate — and where AI governance is understood and practiced, not merely documented.
  • Establish quarterly AI governance metrics reporting across four dimensions: adoption, security, compliance, and value.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in information security, with at least 3–5 years in a CISO, Deputy CISO, or equivalent senior security leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience securing multi-tenant SaaS platforms on AWS, including IAM, encryption, network segmentation, cloud-native security services, and AWS-native detection and monitoring.
  • Deep expertise in AI security governance: familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and practical experience managing Shadow AI risk, AI prompt data protection, and agentic AI security.
  • Hands-on compliance ownership across SOC 2 Type II and at least one of PCI DSS or ISO 27001; proven ability to manage auditor relationships and sustain continuous compliance programs.
  • Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, including high-risk AI classification criteria and upcoming enforcement timelines.
  • Experience operating a Security Operations function — including SIEM, EDR, CASB/secure web gateway, and DLP — in a cloud-first, distributed environment.
  • Proven ability to build and lead security teams, drive cross-functional alignment, and communicate risk to executive and board audiences.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, capable of translating technical security risk into business terms for the executive leadership team and enterprise customers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience governing AI security in a company that is both a consumer and developer of AI-powered products.
  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare Zero Trust (WARP, Gateway, CASB) as a primary security enforcement layer.
  • Familiarity with static code analysis in a DevSecOps context, including integration with CI/CD pipelines, SLA-based remediation workflows, and AI-generated code scanning.
  • Experience with AI governance tooling.
  • Background in SaaS companies that have grown through acquisition, with experience harmonizing security programs across multiple product lines and legacy environments.
  • Relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent.

Why This Role Matters

Storable operates at the intersection of two forces that define the next chapter of enterprise security: the rapid adoption of AI across the development and business organization, and the accelerating regulatory landscape governing both data and AI. The CISO Storable needs someone who sees both of these not as constraints, but as strategic opportunities, to build trust with customers, to differentiate in the market, and to make Storable's security posture a competitive advantage rather than a cost center.

This leader will step into an organization that has strong security instincts and meaningful infrastructure already in place, an active Security Committee, and an AI governance action plan already underway. The work is to operationalize, mature, and accelerate: to close the gap between strong policy intentions and a fully enforced, metrics-driven, auditable security program.

If you are a security leader who has governed AI at scale, who understands what it means to secure a cloud-native SaaS company in 2026, and who can build a security culture that earns the trust of engineers, customers, and the board alike, this role was built for you.

All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Storable is a fully distributed company and currently employs individuals residing in all U.S. states except Alaska, Hawaii, and New Hampshire.

About Us:

At Storable, we're redefining property management for specialty real estate. Powered by AI, our end-to-end platform seamlessly integrates management software with marketplace listings, websites, CRM, insurance, payments and more. Tailored for self-storage, marine, and RV & camping operators, Storable helps you Win More every day.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Generous health coverage for you and your family, including fully paid short- and long-term disability coverage and two-times base salary life insurance.
  • 401(k) match after 60 days, 100% vested after 1 year.
  • Employer contribution to your HSA, plus an HRA to help offset your deductible.
  • Instant access to flexible vacation. We trust you, so we have a ‘take what you need’ vacation policy.
  • Be More – company rewards and recognition that add up and can be redeemed for personalized gifts and experiences! Storriors have been able to enroll in SCUBA certification classes, travel overseas, and redo their back patio, among many other things.
  • 8 hours of Volunteer Time Off each year and the opportunity to get active in the community by joining one of our offsite volunteer and community service events.
  • 8 hours of Rest, Relax, Recharge time to care for your mental health.
  • Access a range of mental well-being resources for yourself and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness workshops
  • Fully paid parental leave: 12 and 6 weeks for primary and secondary caregivers, respectively.
  • ’Paw’ternity Leave and Pet Bereavement - we understand that pets are a part of the family and have generous time-off policies, which honor that commitment.
  • Caregiver Leave: four weeks of fully paid time away from work to care for aging dependents or family members, if needed.
  • $50 monthly home data stipend, plus a home office sign-on bonus of $250.
  • Fertility care support options to help in your journey towards parenthood.
  • Access to financial experts to help you make informed decisions and achieve your financial goals.
  • Direct Student Loan Payment Program, some qualifications and eligibility rules apply.

Storable is committed to providing equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Storable will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Important Notice: To protect yourself from fraudulent activities, please consider the following:

- Official Communication: All genuine communication from Storable will come from official email addresses, ending in “@storable.com.” Be cautious of any communication that doesn’t match this criteria.
- No Unsolicited Offers: We do not extend job offers without a formal interview process. If you receive an unsolicited job offer claiming to be from Storable or any of its representatives, it’s a red flag.
- Verification: If you’re uncertain about the legitimacy of any job offer or communication claiming to be from Storable, please contact our HR department directly at for verification.

Your security and trust are paramount to us. If you suspect you’ve been contacted by someone falsely claiming to be from Storable or using our company's name for any dubious purpose, please immediately report the incident to

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Designer to shape intuitive, high-quality product experiences across BJAK's financial products.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving product problems through thoughtful interface design. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to simplify complex financial workflows into experiences that feel fast, intuitive and trustworthy.

What You'll Own

  • Design end-to-end product experiences from concept to production.

  • Transform product requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.

  • Design intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial products.

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable UI components.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Improve usability through rapid iteration using product data and user feedback.

  • Maintain consistency across mobile and web experiences.

  • Continuously refine interactions, accessibility and overall product quality.


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience designing digital products.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking and excellent visual design.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Strong understanding of design systems, component libraries and responsive design.

  • Strong understanding of information architecture and user flows.

  • Excellent visual design skills including typography, spacing, layout and interaction design.

  • Ability to simplify complex workflows into intuitive experiences.

Design Stack

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout

  • Component Libraries


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks about solving customer problems, not just designing screens.

  • Balances business goals with user experience.

This Role Is Not For

STATUS: Full-Time, Exempt

WORK AUTHORIZATION: This role is open to candidates who are authorized to work in their country of residence and do not require sponsorship of employment.

TRAVEL: This role requires approximately 20 - 30 days of travel each year, both within the United States and abroad.

OVERVIEW

Global Fund for Women envisions a world where movements for gender justice have transformed power and privilege for a few into equity and equality for all. We fund bold, ambitious, and expansive gender justice movements to create meaningful change that will last beyond our lifetimes.

SUMMARY

The Vice President of Communications is a key executive leader responsible for Global Fund for Women’s communications. Reporting to the CEO and serving on the Executive Team, this role sets the organization’s strategic approach to positioning our work and communicating with core audiences.

The Vice President of Communications is responsible for leading and developing a high-performing team that oversees narrative and messaging, storytelling and editorial, donor communications, digital and creative strategy, internal communications, thought leadership, and crisis communications. This leader partners closely across Programs, Development, and Learning, Evaluation & Analytics; advises senior leadership on reputational opportunities and risks; and builds the systems, metrics, and team culture needed to strengthen Global Fund for Women’s voice and advance its mission and goals.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and drive the Communications function’s strategic goals, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with leadership to ensure our communications strategy effectively supports Global Fund for Women’s overall objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and Executive Team, offering sound judgement and thoughtful guidance on reputational risks, brand positioning, and strategic opportunities.
  • Lead thought leadership that centers grassroots, feminist knowledge and leverages evidence and storytelling to shape philanthropic narratives, norms, and funding.
  • Monitor, analyze, and translate key trends in philanthropy, nonprofit communications, and the broader social impact landscape to inform strategic decisions and communications priorities.

Narrative, Messaging & Storytelling Leadership

  • Embed refreshed narratives and messaging frameworks, develop an aligned content and channel strategy, and build strong systems that ensure consistent, high-quality communications across the organization.
  • Drive a strong executive visibility program for the CEO and other leaders to elevate the organization’s external brand and reputation.
  • Develop and maintain crisis communication plans, including risk mitigation, rapid response protocols, and preparedness.
  • Lead and strengthen internal communications across the organization to drive alignment, clarity, and engagement.
  • Ensure consistency of tone and voice across donor communications, program storytelling, thought leadership, and external communications.
  • Provides strategic leadership to ensure our messaging, storytelling, and media engagement practices align with our organizational safeguarding commitments.

Cross-Organizational Collaboration

  • Partner with Programs, Development, and Learning, Evaluation, and Analytics leadership to develop fundraising messaging, partner-centered storytelling, and organizational priorities.
  • Anticipate organizational needs, proactively coordinate teams and resources, and provide structure and communications direction to senior leadership.
  • Establish and implement clear workflows, standards, and measurements that support a best-in-class communications function.

Brand, Digital, and Media Strategy

  • Oversee Global Fund for Women’s brand identity, digital and social presence, and multi-channel engagement strategy to grow reach, deepen engagement, and advance organizational goals.
  • Develop a thought leadership roadmap that translates across channels and reaches key audiences aligned to core themes and organizational goals.
  • Guide proactive media strategy to build visibility and influence, enhance brand recognition, and build meaningful relationships with prospective donors and partners.
  • Provide strategic oversight of external partners, vendors and contractors, including media agencies, designers, and other consultants.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Cultivate a team culture grounded in collaboration, care, accountability, and excellence.

  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and strategic direction to strengthen team performance and impact.
  • Ensure strong systems, workflows, and tools that enable cross-team collaboration, high-quality content generation, and clear visibility into performance.

KEY TALENTS / WAYS OF BEING

  • Demonstrated sensitivity to political, digital, and physical safety considerations—especially for partners operating under repression, surveillance, or criminalization.
  • Proven ability to apply an intersectional feminist lens to narrative and communications work, situating gender justice in relation to race, class, sexuality, disability, migration status, geography, and local context.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including empathy, deep listening, emotional intelligence, and clarity in communication.
  • Skilled at building trust, securing cross-functional alignment, and making thoughtful decisions across a dynamic organization.
  • Ability to balance visionary leadership with practical, hands-on execution.
  • Values-driven leader who serves as a role model to others across the organization and leads with integrity and sound judgement.
  • Proven ability to lead safeguarding-aligned communications practices, ensuring all storytelling, imagery, and media engagement upholds dignity, consent, and do-no-harm principles.

KEY SKILLS / WAYS OF DOING

  • Experience living and/or working outside of the US, with demonstrated ability to work across cultures, languages, and time zones, strongly preferred.

  • Experience leading and developing ​high-performing ​teams​, preferably in a global, remote setting​.
  • Experience partnering with development, programs, and learning teams at a similar mission-driven, non-profit organization.
  • Exceptional writing, content development, and editorial skills.
  • Deep understanding of digital and social media, media strategy, and programmatic thought leadership.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional alignment experience.

jobs.description:
Description

Projects Managers with experience in Rheumatology is crucial for this specific need and for the success of Clinical Trials managed by Indero. They are the main point of contact internally as well as externally, ensuring all activities and deliverables are completed on time, on budget, and as expected.

Great project managers go further than creating project plans and following up on tasks. They show leadership to help project teams focus on objectives and deliver results.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has at least 7 years of Global clinical project management experience (including but not limited to European regions), including management of all project’s phases from start-up to closure, management of all functional services, vendor management.
  • Wishes to work for a mid-sized CRO that works on significant multisite trials, including Global Phase III projects.
  • Is looking to position themselves in an environment where you can grow your career alongside of a growing company.
  • Experience in Rheumatology from a PM perspective

IMPACT AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Client interactions

  • Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor
  • Provide efficient and timely updates on trial progress
  • Lead client calls effectively

Project planning

  • Oversee and actively participates in the preparation of project deliverables such as; study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report.
  • Participate in the planning and conduct of the Investigator’s Meeting.
  • Ensure that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).

Quality and risk management

  • Ensure assigned studies are “audit ready” at all times.
  • Monitor the quality of study deliverables, (including vendor and SubCRO deliverables) and address issues as they arise.
  • Manage risk and control measures to assure project quality.
  • Analyze discrepancies between planned and actual results.
  • Review and approve responses to quality assurance audits.

Project budget and timelines

  • Control the project budget, with particular attention to internal hours allocated to all activities.
  • Identify out of scope activities for change orders.
  • Proactively manage operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinate tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.
  • Communicate effectively with study team members, functional departments, and senior management.
  • Manage and report on recruitment status and highlight initiatives needed to meet recruitment timelines.

Project team leadership

  • Lead the core project team which may include: Associate Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Project Assistants.
  • Ensure all team members have adequate training on the project.
  • Work closely with vendors and the following internal teams to ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed on time, according to plans and according to applicable standards: Site Selection, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management, Clinical Monitoring, Biostatistics, Scientific Affairs.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • B.Sc. in a related field of study to clinical research;
  • PMP or PRINCE2 certification is an asset

﻿Experience

  • At least 10 years industry experience including a minimum of 3 years in a CRO;
  • At least 7 years of clinical project management experience, including management of all projects phases from start up to closure, management of all functional services, vendor management. Experience with mid-size and large studies (>10-15 countries) in multiple regions (NA, SA, APAC, MENA, Europe)
  • Experience leading multi-centered, multinational phase III clinical trials including project budget financial tracking and forecasting
  • Experience in one or more of the following considered an asset: study start up, regulatory submission, resource management, supervisory experience, CRA, data management, medical writing, or vendor management;
  • Therapeutic experience managing dermatology, onco-dermatology, rheumatoid arthritis or oncology trials an asset

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, local country regulations;
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite;
  • Fluency in English with excellent oral and written skills, required
  • Bilingualism (English and local language) is an asset
  • Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors;
  • Good problem-solving abilities;
  • Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines;

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Company benefits package
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology and rheumatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

das sind wir.

We're not here to maintain the status quo.

Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland haben keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig verändern KI, Automatisierung und neue Technologien unsere Arbeitswelt rasant. Die Herausforderung ist riesig. Die Chance, etwas zu verändern, auch.

Wir sind die Talentspring Academy Group. Wir machen Menschen fit für die Arbeitswelt von morgen - mit digitalen, praxisnahen Weiterbildungen in KI, Marketing, Sales, HR und Future of Work. Für Menschen, die beruflich neue Wege gehen, sich weiterentwickeln oder noch einmal ganz neu durchstarten wollen. Dabei denken wir Bildung neu: mit der Geschwindigkeit eines EdTechs, AI-first Technologien und der Reichweite von über 900 Standorten durch unsere strategischen Partnerschaften.

„Die Zukunft gehört denen, die bereit sind zu lernen. Weiterbildung ist nicht nur ein Karrierebooster – sie ist eine wirtschaftliche Notwendigkeit.“ - Karim Suhm, Gründer der Talentspring Academy Group

deine mission.

Unsere Academies wachsen, und wir suchen gleich mehrere Teaching Assistants (m/w/d):

  • Marketing Academy
  • Sales Academy
  • AI Academy
  • Tech Academy

Gemeinsam mit unseren Dozent:innen sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Teilnehmenden neues Wissen nicht nur lernen, sondern auch erfolgreich in die Praxis umsetzen. Du unterrichtest dabei nicht selbst, sondern unterstützt, motivierst und hilfst bei individuellen Herausforderungen.

  • Teilzeit: Du bist nicht (mehr) eingeschrieben? Dann steig in Teilzeit bei uns ein.
  • Deine Zeiten: Unsere Kurse laufen zu festen Zeiten. Deshalb suchen wir Dich, wenn Du an mindestens 3, besser 4 Nachmittagen zwischen 14:00 und 18:00 Uhr Zeit hast. Du kannst an 5 Nachmittagen? Dann bist Du unser absoluter Volltreffer!

Für beide Varianten gilt: 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands, 16 € pro Stunde, zunächst befristet auf 6 bis 12 Monate mit Option auf Verlängerung.

hier machst du den unterschied.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, Technology Transformation


Position Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Forward Deployed Engineer to deliver technology transformation across the CORA Banking portfolio. This individual combines strong architectural judgment with the ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, write production code, and turn modernization opportunities into measurable results.

The role operates through focused, time-bound engagements in existing and newly acquired businesses. It provides technical direction when an engagement requires it, but does not replace local architecture or product ownership. The engineer must be equally comfortable leading complex modernization and collaborating with local teams on incremental improvements.

AI-native engineering is a core capability, not a separate advisory function. The engineer uses practical AI workflows, testing automation, and code analysis to accelerate safe modernization and improve how teams build and maintain software. International travel may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Application Modernization

  • Assess application and database architecture, APIs, dependencies, technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and customer-specific customization.
  • Evaluate when to retain, refactor, rearchitect, or replace systems based on business value, implementation effort, operational risk, and time to benefit.
  • Design and implement incremental modernization, including API decoupling, shared services, database optimization, and appropriate multi-tenancy approaches while preserving customer isolation.
  • Evaluate database-per-customer, shared compute, shared application services, and shared data models as distinct architectural choices rather than assuming a single tenancy pattern.
  • Contribute directly to production code, reviews, automated tests, and deployment changes; validate architecture through working implementation.

AI-Native Engineering & Productivity

  • Implement agentic and AI-assisted workflows for code discovery, refactoring, testing, documentation, and defect investigation.
  • Integrate approved automation into repositories, developer workflows, CI/CD, and quality gates with human review and secure handling of proprietary data.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce maintenance effort, delivery lead time, change failure, and repetitive engineering work; measure results against a credible baseline.

Post-Acquisition Validation & Engagement Leadership

  • Validate technology diligence assumptions through source-code, architecture, engineering-practice, and operational investigation after access is available.
  • Prioritize transformation opportunities with local leadership using expected value, cost, feasibility, and production risk.
  • Set technical direction and coordinate complex workstreams where needed, while allowing senior engineers to lead independently scoped engagements.
  • Distinguish realized savings from projected benefits and document technical evidence, remaining risks, and handover criteria.

Cost & Operational Optimization

  • Identify and implement application, database, licensing, and infrastructure changes that reduce total operating cost without compromising resilience.
  • Partner with platform and operations teams on resource utilization, hosting architecture, observability, and release efficiency.

Forward Deployed Engagements

  • Deploy into existing and newly acquired businesses for scoped engagements with agreed outcomes, timelines, local counterparts, and exit criteria.
  • Investigate unfamiliar, poorly documented systems; reconstruct behavior, dependencies, and operational constraints through code and production evidence.
  • Work within local product ownership, architecture, security, and release controls; avoid becoming a permanent backlog delivery resource.
  • Build trust with skeptical engineering teams through practical demonstrations, constructive challenge, and shared ownership.

Production Safety & Knowledge Transfer

  • Protect customer commitments through automated validation, observability, staged rollout, rollback planning, and security review appropriate to each change.
  • Pair with local engineers and provide maintainable code, documentation, and operational guidance; confirm local ownership before exit.
  • Capture reusable assessment scripts, automation, migration playbooks, and lessons that improve subsequent engagements.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated principal-level ownership of complex production software modernization, including substantial hands-on engineering.
  • Strong architecture fundamentals across APIs, databases, distributed systems, cloud/hybrid environments, testing, and operations.
  • Ability to evaluate multi-tenancy, customer isolation, migration sequencing, and legacy integration tradeoffs.
  • Practical AI-native engineering experience with agentic workflows, code analysis, automation, and validation controls.
  • Ability to assess unfamiliar, poorly documented systems and safely deliver changes without extended onboarding.
  • Commercial judgment in prioritizing opportunities and substantiating productivity or cost improvements.
  • Ability to influence experienced technical leaders without direct management authority and work across global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, or comparable enterprise stacks.
  • Experience in financial services, banking, loyalty, collections, or other regulated software.
  • Experience with acquisitions, diligence validation, private-equity portfolios, or multi-business modernization.

About Americans United

Americans United for Separation of Church and State is a nonpartisan educational and advocacy organization dedicated to advancing the constitutional principle of church-state separation as the only way to ensure freedom of religion, including the right to believe or not believe, for all of us. Founded in 1947, Americans United is a diverse and dynamic organization composed of people from all walks of life: lawyers and lobbyists, students and activists, religious leaders and impassioned Americans. AU includes people of faith and people who don’t profess any particular faith. It is a community that welcomes people of all genders, races, ethnicities, religions or beliefs, sexual orientations, ages, socioeconomic backgrounds, and abilities. A typical client relationship starts with finding out what's actually on the OT network and where it's exposed. From there we design segmentation and controls that don't interrupt operations, and many clients stay with us for ongoing OT vulnerability management. The work in between includes OT risk assessments against ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NERC CIP, and the TSA security directives; OT penetration tests scoped for live environments; and deployment and tuning of OT visibility and secure remote access platforms.

OT has problems you won't find in IT security, like hunting for an attacker on a network that can't handle an active scan, or explaining a firewall change to someone who has to keep a turbine running. Every site is different, and that's a big part of why we stay.

  • Author comprehensive services deliverables that are proficiently tailored to both technical and managerial audiences and fully detail the technical execution, core deficiencies, business impact, and realistic remediation strategies

Overview

Ocean Bank is seeking a High Risk Analyst to conduct complex, risk-based investigations of customer relationships and transactional activity. This role’s responsibility is to evaluate alerts and referrals, identify potential money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other financial crime, and develop clear, well-supported investigative conclusions. Recommends Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filings or other risk-mitigation actions and support ongoing monitoring of higher-risk customer relationships.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate unusual or potentially suspicious activity identified through transaction-monitoring alerts, internal and fraud referrals, customer activity reviews, subpoenas, law-enforcement inquiries, Section 314(b) information sharing, and negative news.
  • Conduct enhanced reviews of higher-risk or sensitive customer relationships, including those involving complex ownership structures, higher-risk geographies or products, and specialized monitoring requirements.
  • Analyze customer and transaction data using internal systems, account records, public sources, and input from Bank colleagues to assess whether activity is consistent with the customer’s profile and expected account activity.
  • Document findings and recommend appropriate investigative outcomes and risk-mitigation actions to BSA management.
  • Prepare SARs through the AML monitoring system for management approval and filing with FinCEN.
  • Monitor accounts that remain open after a SAR filing within 90 days of filing, and conduct ongoing monitoring of accounts exhibiting unusual activity, patterns, or trends.
  • Partner with Relationship Managers and other stakeholders to address customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, expected activity, and documentation gaps; escalate unresolved or material deficiencies under Bank procedures.
  • Manage assigned investigations independently from start to finish, including due diligence requests, supporting documentation reviews, and SAR preparation, while maintaining complete, accurate, audit-ready case files.
  • Provide cross-functional support to the AML and High Risk units based on workload, emerging risks, regulatory priorities, and operational needs.

Qualifications

Education/Experience:

Requirements

  • Associate’s Degree in Business Administration, Criminal Justice, or Finance.
  • 4+ years of BSA/AML Analyst experience with strong focus on monitoring and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Knowledge of banking laws and regulations, Bank Secrecy Act and Patriot Act.

    • Combination of education and experience will be considered.

    Skills & Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large volumes of transactional and customer data, recognize patterns and anomalies, connect related parties or activity across accounts, assess information from multiple sources, exercise sound judgment with incomplete information, and produce clear, fact-based investigative narratives and recommendations.
  • Ability to understand and implement job related policies and procedures.
  • Must be comfortable in shifting priorities.
  • Ability to sustain effectiveness in varying environments and with different tasks, responsibilities and people.
  • Ability to resolve problems and adjust tactics in response to changing circumstances.
  • Capability to prioritize, budget time and maintain work priorities; must be adept at performing two or more parallel assignments.
  • Must possess strong organizational, interpersonal, time management, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be able to work under strict deadlines.
  • Computer proficient in MS Office Software (e.g. Excel, Word, and Outlook).

    • Preferred Experience

    • Bilingual (English/Spanish) is highly preferred.

    Licenses/Certifications

    • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) and/or Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM) certifications preferred.

    Job Posting Locations

    In this role you can work remote from Miami, Florida, United States

jobs.description:
About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is looking for a highly driven, strategic operator to join the Revenue Operations team for our B2C go-to-market teams. This role owns one of our four Consumer product families end-to-end and sets the standard other RevOps team members build toward. Beyond your own product family, you participate meaningfully in and influence the operations of the other three, and you're expected to take the lead on daily operations across the broader business unit during certain operating windows as needed - coverage, launches, escalations, or other moments where the business needs a single owner across all four families.

Your job is to keep the revenue engine running correctly, interpret the data, and continuously evolve the sales motion - with a 6+ month horizon, not just the current quarter. You translate quantitative and qualitative signal into recommendations that shape decisions at the channel and company level, while independently driving the longer-term projects behind rapid revenue growth and scalability. That takes the judgment to know what should change, the rigor to get it built and adopted at scale, and the ability to influence - not just execute - the strategy that governs your area.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Strategy & Processes

  • Own the sales motion end-to-end for your assigned product family: document the motion at the business-logic level, define pipeline stage definitions, specify what happens on key events, and maintain outreach targets, call cadences, and follow-up sequences
  • Participate meaningfully in and influence the sales motion of the other three product families, and take the lead on daily operations across the broader business unit during certain operating windows as needed
  • Build, coach, and mentor a small team of Revenue Operations Analysts within your first several months on the job - delegate meaningfully and use them as leverage to extend your reach
  • Proactively monitor and maintain high levels of data quality, accuracy, and process consistency across Revenue Operations; catch and resolve system errors before they impact reporting or revenue
  • Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures for Salesforce and other systems, built with a 6+ month scaling horizon in mind
  • Continuously optimize processes and system configuration to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of our sales programs across multiple business lines at once
  • Partner with Sales Managers and Directors as a peer - you own the motion design, documentation, and system changes for your product family, and meaningfully influence them for the other three. Coordinate changes across multiple Sales Managers simultaneously to ensure adoption
  • Drive end-to-end initiatives aligned with the quarterly strategic goals of the Revenue Org, and increasingly inform those goals - coordinate cross-functionally with direct visibility to VPs

Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics

  • Own the narrative for your product family's weekly performance deck, and contribute meaningfully to the broader business unit's view: key metrics, trend commentary, and forward-looking implications, presented in a form senior leadership can act on directly
  • Own creation of analytical models - not just reports - that forecast capacity and conversion through the funnel for your product family, with visibility into how the other three are trending
  • Drive data cleanliness initiatives and support reporting needs for Executive and GTM teams, including monthly revenue dashboards and Quarterly Business Reviews
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for data requests from Sales Managers and the Director/VP layer - fulfill directly or route to Analytics with a clear written requirement
  • Lead the quarterly OKR and goal-setting process for your product family; meaningfully influence the OKRs of the other three and how they roll up to the broader Revenue Org's goals
  • Turn quantitative analysis and qualitative feedback into recommendations that inform decisions at the business-unit or company level, not just process-level fixes

Systems & Tools

  • Own - end to end - the marketing-to-sales funnel process, data, systems, and workflows for your product family, and meaningfully influence how the other three run theirs
  • Own cross-team shared infrastructure for the Consumer Sales system stack, including Salesforce and other tools, while continuously evaluating what's next for the business unit as a whole
  • For systems you have direct access to: write a clear PRD, implement the change - including workflows that require logic or automation (e.g., Apex) - audit the output, and validate it's working
  • For systems you don't have direct access to: write a clear PRD, coordinate with the appropriate technical partner, and track larger, more complex initiatives to completion
  • Monitor system health across the business unit's shared infrastructure; resolve data errors and workflow breaks quickly with a documented root cause and a prevention plan that holds up over multiple quarters

Experimentation & Iteration

  • Design, run, and analyze experiments that test improvements to the sales motion - outreach cadence, scripting and SMS tests, lead routing based on conversion patterns - coordinated as a testing roadmap across business lines rather than one line at a time
  • Proactively bring iteration ideas to Directors and VPs, and partner cross-functionally with Product, Finance, and Marketing to bring new experiments to life at business-unit scale
  • Own a documented experiment and iteration trail for the business unit, forecasting how KPIs should move based on historical data and trend lines

Enablement & Training

  • Define the enablement standard for the team: produce training documentation for any new motion, system change, or process update, and mentor other RevOps team members on how to do the same
  • Deliver materials to multiple Sales Managers in a format that lets them educate their agents and hold them accountable for adoption
  • Keep documentation clear, current, and actionable, and model the bar you expect from others on the team

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 10+ years of overall experience, preferably in Revenue/Sales Operations, P&L, Ops & Strategy, or related fields
  • Must have: 2+ years of direct experience in revenue/sales operations with decision-making authority over daily activities
  • Highly preferred: Salesforce system admin experience; experience configuring and using sales technologies (CRM, telephony tools, dialer platforms, etc.), including building workflows that require logic or automation
  • Proficient in analytical tools including Excel and SQL; demonstrated ability to build forecasting or capacity models, not just descriptive reports
  • Demonstrated ability to own a product line end-to-end without a playbook, while meaningfully influencing adjacent lines you don't directly own
  • Strong project management discipline: can independently drive cross-functional work to completion across a 6+ month horizon without continuous check-ins
  • Comfort with ambiguity at the business-unit level, a positive attitude, and a drive to manage projects to completion in a fast-moving startup environment
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills; able to write clearly for diverse audiences, and comfortable presenting directly to senior leadership
  • High standards of accuracy and strong attention to detail — you get things right, and you hold others to that same bar
  • Ready to build, coach, and manage a small team of analysts shortly after joining
  • Demonstrated experience in high-growth, ambiguous startup environments; B2C/D2C experience preferred

jobs.excerpt: The Senior Hybrid Cloud Engineer independently designs, implements, automates, and improves complex infrastructure and platform services across on-premises, private-cloud, public-cloud, and hybrid-cloud environments.
jobs.description:
The Senior Hybrid Cloud Engineer independently designs, implements, automates, and improves complex infrastructure and platform services across on-premises, private-cloud, public-cloud, and hybrid-cloud environments. This position combines advanced cloud engineering expertise with Infrastructure as Code, automation, networking, security, observability, and platform engineering to deliver reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions. The Senior Hybrid Cloud Engineer proactively identifies engineering needs, independently owns technical work from planning through production delivery, and resolves complex infrastructure challenges without routinely requiring escalation to more senior resources.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Independently design, implement, and improve complex infrastructure and platform services across AWS, private-cloud, and hybrid-cloud environments. Own technical delivery from requirements analysis and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, validation, documentation, and operational handoff. Design and implement secure, highly available, scalable, and resilient IaaS, PaaS, and cloud-native solutions. Develop, maintain, and improve Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or comparable technologies. Independently design and troubleshoot hybrid-cloud networking and connectivity, including VPC/VNet architecture, routing, peering, VPN, private connectivity, DNS, segmentation, and firewalls. Implement security and identity solutions involving IAM, least privilege, secrets management, encryption, key management, vulnerability remediation, and secure infrastructure design. Design and support virtualization, containerized, and cloud-native environments. Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, APIs, and related technologies. Design and improve CI/CD pipelines, source-control workflows, testing, configuration management, and deployment automation using GitHub Actions and Spacelift, or comparable platforms. Implement and improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, or comparable technologies. Apply DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, automation, reliability, and operational readiness practices. Independently troubleshoot complex infrastructure incidents and contribute to recovery, root-cause analysis, and preventive improvements. Identify technical debt, recurring incidents, security risks, performance limitations, and opportunities for automation. Evaluate dependencies, implementation risks, testing requirements, validation procedures, and rollback strategies before production changes. Participate in cloud financial management, cost optimization, capacity planning, and infrastructure lifecycle activities. Review infrastructure designs, automation, and technical changes made by other engineers. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Hybrid Cloud Engineers. Create and maintain architecture documentation, implementation plans, runbooks, technical standards, and operating procedures.

NONESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead technical portions of cloud migrations, modernization initiatives, upgrades, and proofs of concept. Assist with technology evaluations, capacity planning, lifecycle planning, and solution design. Contribute to engineering standards, reusable automation, and knowledge-sharing activities. Perform other duties as assigned.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Advanced knowledge of hybrid-cloud infrastructure, networking, security, identity, automation, containers, observability, and reliability. Ability to independently design, implement, troubleshoot, and support complex infrastructure and platform solutions. Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, high availability, disaster recovery, and resilient infrastructure design. Advanced ability to develop, troubleshoot, and safely deploy Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or comparable tools. Ability to independently design and troubleshoot hybrid-cloud networking, DNS, routing, and security configurations. Strong knowledge of IAM, least privilege, secrets management, encryption, vulnerability management, and secure-by-design practices. Experience with virtualization, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and related platform technologies. Strong understanding of CI/CD, source control, automated testing, and release-management practices. Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or comparable scripting and programming languages. Ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues using monitoring, logs, metrics, and technical diagnostics. Ability to independently own technical delivery while exercising sound escalation judgment. Strong analytical, documentation, communication, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE, AND/OR EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical discipline. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent professional work experience, technical training, certifications, or a combination thereof may be considered in lieu of formal education. Demonstrated experience independently designing, implementing, and supporting complex production infrastructure. Advanced experience with one or more major cloud platforms, preferably AWS. Experience with private-cloud and virtualization technologies. Experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or comparable technologies. Experience with hybrid-cloud networking, IAM, security, high availability, and disaster recovery. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, or comparable container technologies. Experience implementing CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions and Spacelift, or comparable platforms. Experience with monitoring and observability using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, or comparable tools. Experience developing infrastructure automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or comparable languages. Experience independently troubleshooting complex production incidents and implementing sustainable improvements. Experience in regulated, audited, healthcare, financial services, or benefits-related environments is preferred. Familiarity with SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, or comparable frameworks is preferred. Relevant professional cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps, security, or networking certifications are preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

On-Call and After-Hours Support: Must participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support as required, including responding to production incidents, service disruptions, critical escalations, scheduled maintenance, deployments, upgrades, and recovery activities. Travel: Travel of up to 10% may be required, depending on employee location and business needs, including travel to data centers, offices, or other company locations for infrastructure support, installations, maintenance, incident response, and other operational activities. Travel may occasionally occur outside normal business hours. Must appropriately handle privileged credentials, production data, and sensitive infrastructure information. Must maintain appropriate security, change-management, documentation, source-control, and infrastructure engineering standards. Must communicate technical risks, decisions, dependencies, and recommendations effectively to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
  • You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
  • Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
  • Running observability for a production platform at scale
  • Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is €121,128 - €145,354. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law.
