jobs.title: Lead Hybrid Cloud Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The Lead Hybrid Cloud Engineer provides technical ownership for an assigned platform, Line of Business (LoB), or technical focus area within Hybrid Cloud Engineering, such as cloud networking, identity and security, infrastructure automation, virtualization, container platforms, or platform services.
jobs.description:
The Lead Hybrid Cloud Engineer provides technical ownership for an assigned platform, Line of Business (LoB), or technical focus area within Hybrid Cloud Engineering, such as cloud networking, identity and security, infrastructure automation, virtualization, container platforms, or platform services. This position is responsible for the architecture, reliability, security, automation, lifecycle, technical standards, and successful delivery of the assigned area. The Lead Hybrid Cloud Engineer provides technical direction to other engineers, leads complex initiatives, and ensures solutions align with enterprise architecture and operational requirements while remaining a hands-on individual contributor.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the architecture, technical standards, reliability, security, automation, lifecycle, capacity, monitoring, and operational health of an assigned hybrid-cloud engineering domain or platform. Establish and maintain technical patterns, reference architectures, engineering standards, roadmaps, and priorities for the assigned area. Lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, highly available, resilient, and cost-effective IaaS, PaaS, and cloud-native solutions. Provide technical leadership for AWS, private-cloud, virtualization, and hybrid-cloud technologies within the assigned domain. Lead Infrastructure as Code design and automation using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or comparable technologies. Establish and improve DevOps, SRE, CI/CD, configuration-management, and platform engineering practices within the assigned technical area. Provide technical direction for hybrid-cloud networking and connectivity, including VPC/VNet architecture, routing, peering, VPN, private connectivity, DNS, network segmentation, and firewalls. Establish security and identity practices involving IAM, least privilege, secrets management, encryption, key management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements. Design and support virtualization, containerized, and cloud-native environments. Guide automation and deployment practices using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, APIs, GitHub Actions and Spacelift, or comparable tools. Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability practices using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, or comparable technologies. Lead complex infrastructure implementations, migrations, upgrades, modernization efforts, and technical improvements within the assigned domain. Identify and drive remediation of technical debt, reliability concerns, security risks, performance limitations, and operational inefficiencies. Serve as a primary technical escalation point for complex incidents and problems within the assigned area. Review significant technical designs and infrastructure changes to ensure appropriate architecture, testing, validation, rollback, documentation, and operational readiness. Coordinate and provide technical direction for work performed by Hybrid Cloud Engineers and Senior Hybrid Cloud Engineers. Partner with other technical owners and enterprise teams to manage dependencies and ensure integration across hybrid-cloud environments. Participate in Architecture Review Board activities and other governance forums as appropriate. Lead cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, resource utilization, and lifecycle management within the assigned area. Mentor engineers and develop technical capability, reusable engineering patterns, and operational standards. Maintain architecture diagrams, technical standards, roadmaps, design records, and operating procedures.

NONESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead technology evaluations, proofs of concept, platform lifecycle planning, and strategic improvements within the assigned domain. Participate in broader cloud architecture, security, reliability, and modernization initiatives. Represent the assigned technical area in cross-functional projects and planning. Perform other duties as assigned.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Advanced expertise within an assigned hybrid-cloud engineering domain and broad knowledge of related technologies. Ability to own the technical health, architecture, lifecycle, and successful delivery of a major infrastructure or platform capability. Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, high availability, disaster recovery, resiliency, and failure-domain planning. Advanced ability to design, review, troubleshoot, and govern Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or comparable tools. Strong knowledge of hybrid-cloud networking, virtualization, IAM, security, containers, observability, and reliability. Ability to establish technical standards, automation patterns, and engineering practices within an assigned domain. Ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple engineers, platforms, and dependencies. Ability to review technical designs, identify risks, and establish appropriate implementation and validation strategies. Advanced troubleshooting, incident-response, and technical escalation capabilities. Strong architecture, communication, mentoring, risk-management, and technical-leadership skills.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE, AND/OR EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum of 7 years of relevant professional experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical discipline, including demonstrated technical ownership of a significant platform, domain, or technical focus area. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent professional work experience, technical training, certifications, or a combination thereof may be considered in lieu of formal education. Advanced experience with one or more major cloud platforms, preferably AWS. Demonstrated ownership of architecture, technical standards, reliability, security, automation, and operational readiness within an assigned technical domain. Experience with private-cloud and virtualization technologies. Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, OpenTofu, or comparable technologies. Experience with hybrid-cloud networking, IAM, cloud security, high availability, disaster recovery, and resilient architecture. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and related cloud-native technologies. Experience implementing CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions and Spacelift, or comparable technologies. Experience with monitoring and observability using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, or comparable platforms. Experience developing infrastructure automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or comparable languages. Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives and providing technical direction to other engineers. Experience in regulated, audited, healthcare, financial services, or benefits-related environments is preferred. Familiarity with SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, or comparable frameworks is preferred. Professional cloud architecture, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps, security, or networking certifications are preferred.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

On-Call and After-Hours Support: Must participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support as required, including responding to production incidents, service disruptions, critical escalations, scheduled maintenance, deployments, upgrades, and recovery activities. Travel: Travel of up to 10% may be required, depending on employee location and business needs, including travel to data centers, offices, or other company locations for infrastructure support, installations, maintenance, incident response, and other operational activities. Travel may occasionally occur outside normal business hours. Must appropriately handle privileged credentials, production data, and sensitive infrastructure information. Must maintain appropriate security, change-management, documentation, source-control, and infrastructure engineering standards. Must communicate technical risks, decisions, dependencies, and recommendations effectively to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Disclaimer: This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the job. Management reserves the right to modify or reassign job duties as business needs evolve.

Preferred qualifications

jobs.description:
Please note - this role will be remote or hybrid working, subject to the successful applicant's location in line with company policy

Our Business Intelligence Developer/Consultants work as part of the Business Insights team, providing specialist knowledge and expertise in Business Intelligence solutions for the NEC Housing product.

The team is involved throughout the full product lifecycle, including pre-sales activities, customer consultancy and support, product development, implementation and the ongoing development of our Business Intelligence solutions. The role provides an opportunity to work across the full end-to-end lifecycle of Business Intelligence projects, from understanding business and data requirements through to solution design, development, implementation and support.

The Housing Business Intelligence Roadmap covers a broad range of reporting and analytics capabilities. The BI team is responsible for supporting and developing this roadmap, including:

  • Power BI reporting, dashboards and analytics
  • Machine Learning and Data Science
  • Operational and strategic reporting
  • Data Warehouse ETL design and development
  • Customer bespoke development

A key focus of this role will be the design and development of Power BI solutions. We are looking for someone who can work beyond report visualisation and has strong experience in the more complex technical aspects of Power BI development.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Developing end-to-end Power BI solutions, from source data through to published reports and dashboards.
  • Preparing, cleansing and transforming data using Power Query and M.
  • Designing robust and reusable semantic models using dimensional modelling and star-schema principles.
  • Designing fact and dimension structures and managing complex data relationships, cardinality and filter behaviour.
  • Developing advanced DAX measures and business logic.
  • Working with complex modelling scenarios, including multiple fact tables, many-to-many relationships and bridge tables.
  • Developing professional, intuitive and accessible Power BI reports and dashboards.
  • Optimising data transformations, semantic models, DAX and reports for performance and maintainability.
  • Working with Import, DirectQuery and composite model approaches where appropriate.
  • Implementing appropriate data and report security, including Row-Level Security.
  • Configuring and supporting Power BI Service, including workspaces, Apps, gateways, data connections and scheduled refresh.
  • Supporting controlled deployment of Power BI solutions across development, test and production environments.
  • Troubleshooting data, modelling, refresh, security and performance issues within production solutions.
  • Producing and maintaining appropriate technical documentation.
  • Working with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate these into effective Business Intelligence solutions.
  • Supporting customers and internal teams with Business Intelligence consultancy, technical advice and problem resolution.

Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced Business Intelligence professional with a strong technical background and demonstrable experience delivering Power BI and data solutions within a commercial environment.

Essential qualifications and experience

  • Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or another relevant technical or analytical subject, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Previous relevant commercial experience working within Business Intelligence, data, analytics or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Strong practical experience developing solutions using Microsoft Power BI.
  • Advanced experience with Power Query and M for complex data preparation and transformation.
  • Strong DAX skills, including a good understanding of filter context, evaluation context and DAX performance.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional data modelling, including fact tables, dimensions and star schemas.
  • Experience designing and developing complex Power BI semantic models.
  • Experience managing complex relationships, including cardinality, filter direction, bridge tables and many-to-many scenarios.

  • Good understanding of Power BI performance optimisation across data preparation, semantic models, DAX and report design.
  • Practical experience with Power BI Service, including workspaces, Apps, gateways, data connections and scheduled refresh.
  • Experience implementing Power BI security, including workspace permissions and Row-Level Security.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex data and reporting issues.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Useful skills and knowledge

Experience or knowledge in any of the following areas would be advantageous:

  • WhereScape RED Data Warehouse ETL development
  • Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Data Warehouse design and dimensional modelling
  • Jaspersoft Studio report development

  • Power BI REST APIs and automation

jobs.title: 🇫🇷 Senior Social Media Manager - French Fluent
jobs.excerpt: Are you obsessed with turning a blank feed into a growth engine?
jobs.description:
Are you obsessed with turning a blank feed into a growth engine?

What if your content didn't just get likes, but shaped how millions of people grow, learn, and act on their potential?

This isn't a "post and pray" social media job.

We're not looking for someone who plans a content calendar and briefs a designer. We're looking for someone who builds and ships the content themselves, using AI to do the work that used to take a whole content team.

And you deserve it because you are…

  • 🛠️ You're not "a social media manager who schedules posts." You're a builder. You see a trend and your hands itch to cut the hook, write the caption, and post it before the trend dies.

  • 🤖 You don't fear AI, you leverage it. Claude Code and AI creative tools are your daily drivers. You treat AI as a team of interns that lets you do the work of five people: editing, captioning, repurposing, ideating.

  • ⚡️ You'd rather post a scrappy v1 today than a perfect campaign next month. Bias to action is your default setting.

  • 📊 You make decisions with data. You know the difference between vanity reach and a hook that actually converts into followers/leads.

2–3 years under your belt, hungry, ready to walk into a startup and own the feed.

Full-time, remote or Dubai office. French and English fluency required.

About Paradox

WHAT WE DO

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals),

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

OUR BELIEFS

We believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At Paradox, we believe people deserve more.

More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that every human learns differently, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.
It can translate insight into transformation, through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create.

OUR VISION

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing.

And that’s where you come in.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

Be the hands-on builder behind Paradox's social presence across Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube Shorts. You don't wait for assets from the video team, you cut, caption, and ship content yourself, using AI to multiply your output.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Build & ship content daily : You cut shorts/reels from long-form footage, write hooks and captions, and post directly. You don't wait on a report or a brief, you spot the moment and ship it.

  2. Own the channels end to end : Content calendar, posting, community replies, and performance tracking across all platforms are yours.

  3. Hunt what works : You proactively test hooks, formats, and posting times. If a format underperforms, you kill it fast and move to the next test.

  4. AI leverage : You leverage Claude Code daily to automate repurposing (long-form → shorts), generate caption/hook variations, and build lightweight pipelines that let you ship at the pace of a small team, alone.

  5. Read the data : You live in native platform analytics + GA4. You double down on what compounds and kill vanity metrics.

  6. Contribute to growth loops : You work with Growth and Content to spot winning angles and feed them back into new formats.

You'll own KPIs: Follower growth rate, engagement rate, views-to-follow conversion, X posts shipped per week.

Desired outcomes: Consistent daily output without external agencies. A social presence that compounds instead of resetting every month.

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF?

Experience

  • 2–3 years in social media management/content creation, ideally in a fast-moving brand or creator context. Or self-taught with a portfolio that proves it.

  • You can show us what you've shipped: reels, shorts, growth numbers. Portfolio > pedigree.

  • You already use Claude (or equivalent AI tools) weekly to edit, caption, or automate, not just to brainstorm ideas.

  • Comfortable being on camera or directing talent if needed is a plus.

Personality

  • Curiosity: You relentlessly dig into why users behave the way they do until you uncover the insight behind the data.

  • Hands-On Execution : you build, you don't just brief.

  • Precision: You care about clarity in hypotheses, clean data, and unambiguous results.

  • Agility: You move fast, adapt instantly to new findings, and turn insights into tests within hours, not weeks.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  1. You want a strict separation between work and life. Execution speed is our biggest advantage right now. A 9-to-5 mindset guarantees you'll fall behind.

  2. You need clarity, stability, and established process before you can act. We're still building the machine. If you need everything defined before you move, wrong place.

  3. You want to be told exactly what to do. We hire people who bring solutions, not people who wait for instructions.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the 100 000 Dreams Wall,

Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:

“I ran a marathon.”

“I started my company.”

“I found peace with my father.”

You will play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product.

Growth & Ambition

-> 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Impact & Meaning

->Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people

->Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!
We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reach a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

-> ❤️ Contributing to the Paradox Foundation (our non-profit), dedicated to empower teenagers

But that's not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

-> 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

-> 🗽Flexible working hours

-> 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

-> 💻Work on Mac, for us it counts :)

HIRING PROCESS 📃

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey.

💻 A 15-30 minutes video call, to assess the fit between the position, the company, and your own career path.
💻 A video-call focused on your career to review your background & see how we can match your desires with our needs.
💻 Aculture-fit video call to check in depth the alignment between you and our values and culture.
💼 Reference calls to get in-depth insights about how you work in different environments, make your onboarding easier, and give everybody on the team the insurance to be surrounded by A-Players.

If you’re not joining to tweak posts.

If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

The Senior IAM Advisor - Identity Transformation turns identity strategy into programs a client can execute. The advisor works alongside the client's identity program leader and provides expert advice and recommendations. They convert the customer's business requirements, workstreams and roadmaps into people, process and technology execution plans and detailed requirements, using GuidePoint IAM assessments where they exist. This work prepares GuidePoint Engineers and client teams to successfully deploy a secure Identity fabric across the organization. The role covers IAM governance, identity governance and administration (IGA), privileged access management (PAM), access management (AM), identity verification (IDV), non-human identity (NHI) and AI.

About the IAM Advisory practice

The IAM Advisory practice helps organizations build identity and access management programs that are secure, measurable and sustainable. We assess current-state maturity, identify gaps and risks, and deliver practical recommendations and roadmaps across people, process and technology in our clients’ organizations. Our team of IAM Senior Security Advisors and dedicated assessment Project Managers focuses on IAM governance, identity governance and administration (IGA), access management (AM), privileged access management (PAM), identity verification (IDV), non-human identity (NHI) and AI. We use a CMMI-based maturity methodology aligned with industry standards such as NIST, OWASP and PCI-DSS. We partner with CISOs, identity program leaders, security and IT teams, business stakeholders and GuidePoint’s engineering teams to turn identity strategy into executed programs that reduce risk and measurably improve maturity. Above all, we work to be a trusted partner to our customers, building long-term relationships based on candid advice, deep expertise and a shared commitment to their success.

  • Trusted partnership: We focus on our customers’ business outcomes, not just deliverables. That means giving honest, independent guidance and building their ability to measure progress and sustain their programs on their own.
  • Strategic assessments and roadmaps: Current-state maturity assessments that produce clear observations, prioritized recommendations, sequenced workstreams and multi-year roadmaps backed by business value and cost.
  • Expanding into strategy-to-execution: The practice is growing to work alongside client leaders, turning roadmaps and business requirements into detailed requirements and execution plans, so the IAM fabric is ready to deploy.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Strategy to execution

  • Take the customer's business requirements, strategic objectives, workstreams and roadmaps, and turn them into delivery plans with milestones, owners, dependencies and measurable outcomes.
  • Where a GuidePoint IAM assessment exists, use its observations, recommendations, workstreams and CMMI maturity targets to speed up planning and track maturity gains.
  • Where no assessment exists, quickly validate the customer's current state and roadmap, flag gaps or risks, and recommend adjustments before execution begins.
  • Help the client lead keep an integrated identity roadmap across several concurrent initiatives driving to business case development, platform selection, high-level architecture and program controls.

People

  • Advise the client on the design or refinement of the identity operating model, org structure, RACI and steering committee.
  • Plan stakeholder alignment, adoption and change management across Security, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, the business and third parties.
  • Identify skills gaps and staffing needs, and plan knowledge transfer so the client can run the program on its own.

Process

  • Review current-state processes and recommend target-state processes, such as identity lifecycle, access request, account recovery and exception handling.
  • Define operational readiness, support models, and metrics, reporting and telemetry requirements.
  • Recommend governance, including stage gates, Go/No-Go criteria and decision rights.

Deployment Readiness

  • Run working sessions with client and GuidePoint engineering and architecture teams. Turn the outcomes into clear, testable, traceable requirements: business, functional, technical/integration, security/control, UX and migration.
  • Write acceptance criteria and implementation readiness assessments so engineering teams (GuidePoint or the client's) can deploy the Identity fabric with no ambiguity.

Executive engagement

  • Prepare executive decision materials and outcome-focused status reports covering risk, decisions and blockers, not activity.
  • Move easily between executive briefings and technical working sessions.

Required Experience and Education:

  • 10+ years in IAM or identity security, including leading complex enterprise identity programs from strategy through deployment.
  • Deep expertise in at least two of IGA, PAM or AM, and working knowledge across the remaining domains.
  • Proven ability to turn business requirements and strategy into detailed requirements, traceability matrices and success criteria.
  • Experience designing identity operating models, RACI and governance, not just technology.

  • Familiarity with NIST 800-63, NIST CSF, Zero Trust, CMMI-style maturity models and OWASP NHI guidance.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CIMP/IAM, PMP or PgMP, or vendor certifications.

The Associate Director supports the identification, design, and advancement of donor-aligned concepts, fosters relationships with public, private, and institutional stakeholders, and helps position Habitat as a credible partner in housing recovery, basic services, and longer-term systems change.

The remaining 40% of the role contributes to the advancement of the CEE regional strategic program pillar focused on adaptive reuse and the "Empty Spaces to Homes" approach, ensuring strong linkages between Ukraine programming and broader regional affordable housing priorities. The role is expected to generate cross-regional synergies, support innovation in program design, and contribute to the development of partnership and funding pathways that reinforce Habitat's regional strategic objectives.

In addition, the position serves as the Europe and Middle East (EME) regional focal point for Habitability and Basic Services, providing thought leadership, technical input, and coordination support to strengthen program quality, regional learning, and strategic coherence.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Planning and Program Support for HFHI's program in Ukraine and CEE region


UKRAINE FOCUS

  • Support HFHI Ukraine and its partners in developing, implementing, and aligning national and subnational

housing strategies with HFHI’s vision for a strengthened housing ecosystem

  • Lead analysis and integration of market systems, policy frameworks, and partnership opportunities

across the housing value chain

  • Conduct research and provide technical recommendations on innovative, inclusive, and climate-resilient

housing solutions, including integration of energy systems, green construction practices, and circular

economy approaches relevant to Ukraine’s recovery context


CEE REGIONAL FOCUS

  • Act as focal point for technical construction and spatial aspects of the regional ‘empty space to homes’

i.e. HFHI's "50 Cities strategy" development, implemention and drive project-level initiatives with cities across the CEE region;

  • Liaise with demonstration project donors and partners in the NOs, CEE region and western/southern

Europe on promoting ‘empty space to homes’ initiatives, research and funding.

  • Conduct contextual research and provide technical recommendations on appropriate, innovative, and

climate-resilient basic services solutions for housing projects.


2. Support HFHI's Housing. Construction and adaptive reuse technical capabilities across the CEE region (Housing Systems Strengthening and Adaptive Reuse)


UKRAINE FOCUS

  • Provide technical and strategic support to local partners, municipalities, and selected private-sector actors in Ukraine to integrate sustainable, inclusive, and resilient housing solutions into wider housing ecosystem development, local governance frameworks, and recovery planning.
  • Support the design and delivery of targeted capacity-building initiatives, technical guidance, and knowledge products, including manuals, toolkits, policy briefs, and practical methodologies, to strengthen national and local capacities for housing systems development, partnership-based delivery, and scalable implementation in Ukraine.
  • Provide ongoing technical assistance on project oversight, quality assurance, and performance monitoring for housing, neighborhood, and habitability interventions in Ukraine, ensuring alignment with national standards, sustainability objectives, donor expectations, and HFHI’s resilience, inclusion, and people-centered housing principles.
  • Lead or support the documentation, synthesis, and dissemination of lessons learned, promising practices, and operational models emerging from Ukraine programming, with particular attention to housing ecosystem development, public-private collaboration, post-disaster and recovery settings, and the integration of energy-efficient and climate-resilient construction approaches.

CEE REGIONAL – Empty Spaces to Homes

  • Provide technical and strategic advice to the regional program team and National Organizations engaged in Empty Spaces to Homes demonstration projects, including support on feasibility assessments, adaptive reuse options, life-cycle thinking, renovation pathways, and delivery models suited to local housing markets.
  • Serve as a regional focal point for technical guidance and quality support to demonstration projects under the Empty Spaces to Homes agenda, helping ensure that practical pilots contribute to scalable models and evidence generation for Habitat’s 50 Cities by 2030 strategy.
  • Support the development of tools, technical guidance, training modules, manuals, and reference materials that strengthen internal and partner capacities to design, implement, and scale adaptive reuse interventions under the Empty Spaces to Homes approach.
  • Contribute to the strategic positioning of Empty Spaces to Homes within the wider CEE affordable housing agenda by helping connect demonstration projects to the 50 Cities by 2030 vision, city-level partnerships, municipal engagement, and broader housing ecosystem opportunities.
  • Support the CEE program team and National Organizations in identifying and leveraging construction product donations, technical partnerships, and in-kind contributions that can strengthen the implementation, visibility, and replicability of Empty Spaces to Homes demonstration projects.

3. Serve as Habitatibility and Basic Services contact point for EME regions


  • Ensure regional housing programs incorporate habitability, accessibility, and safety standards in

alignment with HFHI housing quality frameworks.

  • Provide guidance related to basic services provision in renovation projects (heating, ventilation,

WASH, fire safety, digital readiness).

  • Capture and disseminate knowledge on habitability and service integration within HFHI.

4.Coordination, Representation, and Learning


UKRAINE FOCUS

  • Actively engage in HFHI’s regional and global communities of practice and represent HFHI in Ukraine in

technical and policy forums

  • Represent HFHI in Ukraine in national and international coordination platforms, working groups, and

forums related to housing, social infrastructure, and energy efficiency.

  • Promote HFHI’s technical leadership and facilitate learning exchanges with donors, ministries, and

industry partners

  • Provide a technical support to the Ukraine team in leading the development and nurturing of strategic

partnerships with government, financial institutions, private sector, and NGOs to advance affordable

housing, housing finance, and resilient urban development in Ukraine


CEE Regional Focus

  • Represent the Area Office in regional and sub-regional technical forums, working groups, and

stakeholder engagements related to 'empty space to homes’ initiatives.

  • Build partnerships with external organizations, donors, and networks engaged in housing technology,

climate change adaptation, and disaster risk reduction.

  • Participate in relevant HFHI communities of practice, technical initiatives, and cross-departmental

coordination.


5.Supporting Fundraising


  • Collaborate closely with Fundraising, Partnership, and Program team of Ukraine Program to position

Habitat’s housing ecosystem and partnership agenda to donors

  • Contribute to proposal design, donor engagement, and project development processes, ensuring

technical quality, strategic alignment, and compliance with HFHI and donor standards

  • Support in reviewing technical proposals, promoting donor compliance and the implementation of

technical standards in relation to ‘empty space to homes’ demonstration projects.


Minimum Requirements

  • Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in housing, architecture, urban development,

civil/environmental engineering, economics, or related field. Strong background in housing systems,

market-based approaches, and/or policy reform preferred.

  • Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible experience in housing, shelter, urban development,

market systems, or development programming, including at least 5 years in partnership management or

ecosystem development

  • Proven experience in affordable housing, incremental housing processes, or climate/disaster-resilient

housing solutions.

  • Background in humanitarian assistance, development sector, shelter or energy related projects
  • Familiarity with humanitarian and development sector trends, principles, standards (e.g., Sphere, Core

Humanitarian Standard, WHO guidelines), and country specific standards.

  • Strong analytical, facilitation, and advisory/consultancy skills.
  • Proficient in MS Office; familiarity with GIS software and construction management tools preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a matrix organization and multicultural

environments required.

• Active support of HFHI Values:

Humility - We are part of something bigger than ourselvses

Courage - We do what's right, even when it is difficult or unpopular

Accountability - We take personal responsibility for Habitat's mission

• Safeguarding

Managers at all levels have responsibilities to support and develop systems that create and maintain an environment that prevents harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, safeguards the rights of beneficiaries and community members (especially children), and promotes the implementation of Habitat for Humanity’s code of conduct.

Habitat for Humanity, founded in 1976, is a global, Christian-based nonprofit organization that grew out of an intentionally multi-racial community in rural Georgia. jobs.description:
Position Title: Senior Software Engineer

Reports To: Engineering Director

Location: Remote (UK)

Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About BibliU

BibliU is an award-winning, technology-led B2B company transforming the $65bn educational content industry. With a 90% CAGR the past 5 years, we are just getting started. We've cracked the code on Day 1 access to affordable digital course materials for students, while delivering comprehensive campus store solutions that foster human relationships, and increase our stickiness in the world of AI.

The result? Measurable impact: 10% higher student retention, 1-point GPA increases, and partnerships with 170 universities serving 600,000 students each year.

We've fundamentally changed how universities procure, distribute, and manage learning content. We partner with 4,000+ publishers, including Pearson, Oxford University Press, and Wiley to deliver content to universities, and provide rich engagement data and interactive tools like quizzes that help students actually learn.

Here's what makes our story compelling:

Founded in late 2015 as an Oxford University spin out, we've grown explosively with 90% CAGR over the last five years, including 65% in FY25, reaching $100m in annual revenue. Our Series B raised $23m led by Nesta Impact Investments (with Guinness Asset Management, Stonehage Fleming, and Oxford Sciences Enterprises). In late 2023, we acquired Texas Book Company (now 'BibliU Campus') to become the only fully vertically integrated player in the market, driving US organic growth which now represents 90% of our business.

We're hungry for more. We're actively building our M&A pipeline as we compete head-to-head against legacy bricks-and-mortar providers to improve the faculty and student experience while boosting the financial sustainability of universities.

Our culture is collaborative, high-growth, and agile. You’ll join an experienced and motivated executive team with backgrounds from Instructure (Canvas) and other successful edtech companies with exit experience. We operate as a distributed team across the UK and US, with offices in London.

Position Overview

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own hard problems across our platform end to end: from an ambiguous problem to a shipped, reliable outcome, without waiting to be handed tickets. You'll work directly with product, customers and the wider business, and shape what gets built as well as how.

How we build software is changing fast. AI-assisted development is our default way of working, and we expect it to keep changing under us. We want someone who finds that energising rather than tolerating it: who uses AI agents to move dramatically faster, stays rigorous about what ships, and helps define how the rest of the team works.

The work isn't simple CRUD. Some of our hardest problems:

  • Content at scale: ingesting, normalising and delivering content from 4,000+ publishers with inconsistent formats, metadata and licensing rules.
  • Day 1 load: hundreds of thousands of students hitting the platform in the same few days at the start of term. It has to work first time.
  • Institutional integrations: LMSs (Canvas, D2L, Blackboard, Moodle), student information systems, SSO and campus store systems, as well as Point of Sale (POS) each configured differently at each institution.
  • Money and compliance: inclusive access billing, opt-outs and charges to student accounts must be correct, auditable and PCI/GDPR-safe.
  • Evolving a growing estate: modernising older services and integrating acquired systems without stopping the business.
  • AI in the product: building learning features on top of licensed content, where accuracy, cost and rights all matter.

What you will be doing

  • Own complex features and services end to end: scoping, design, delivery, operation and iteration
  • Use AI coding agents as a core part of how you work, and build the specs, tests, evals and guardrails that make their output trustworthy
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical plans, and push back when the problem is wrong
  • Design for reliability under seasonal load: observability, graceful degradation, and knowing what breaks first
  • Modernise legacy areas safely (characterisation tests, incremental migration, strangler patterns) rather than big-bang rewrites
  • Take part in incident response and post-incident reviews, and fix causes rather than symptoms
  • Review code with a risk-based eye: deep on core systems, fast at the edges
  • Raise the bar for those around you: mentor engineers, and help non-engineers building internal tools with AI do it safely
  • Partner with security on threat modelling and secure-by-design patterns

What we are looking for

Must have:

  • Several years building and running production systems (typically 5+), with clear examples of things you owned end to end
  • Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to pick up new languages and tools quickly
  • Solid cloud experience (we run on AWS) and sound data modelling across relational and NoSQL stores
  • Experience with distributed or event-driven systems and their failure modes
  • Hands-on, opinionated use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex): you can tell us what works, what doesn't, and how you verify AI-written code
  • High agency: you find the important problem, act without waiting to be asked, and follow through
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and frequent change in tools, priorities and ways of working
  • Clear written communication, especially for remote, async work across UK and US time zones

Good to have:

  • Experience integrating with LMS/SIS platforms, LTI 1.3, or SAML/OIDC SSO
  • Payments, billing or other correctness-critical systems (PCI DSS a plus)
  • Shipping LLM features in production: retrieval, evals, cost and latency trade-offs
  • Content pipelines (EPUB, PDF, metadata normalisation, DRM)
  • Leading a migration or modernisation of a legacy system
  • Infrastructure-as-code and containers
  • High-growth SaaS or EdTech experience

What you'll get

  • Real ownership of meaningful parts of the platform, with scope that grows as you do
  • A team actively reinventing how it builds software with AI, and a say in how that goes
  • Close work with our Engineering Director, VP of Technology, product and our AI practice

Benefits

Our benefits are all aimed at supporting a healthy work-life balance and cultivating a company culture where you can bring your whole, human self to work.

Here's what we offer:

  • 🌴 35 days holiday per year (excluding public holidays!) - yep, that’s not a typo!
  • 🎂 Your birthday off
  • 🌱 12 scheduled company wellness Fridays off per year
  • ❤️ Enhanced maternity & paternity allowance
  • ⏰ Flexible working hours - we’re a remote team spread across the US and UK
  • 💻 Work-from-home allowance to help you set up your dream WFH station
  • 🚴 Cycle-to-work scheme (UK)
  • 🛟 Life Insurance up to 4 x salary
  • ❤️ Private health insurance
  • 👁️ Annual eye test and up to £100 towards frames for glasses required for DSE work

We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds, experiences and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective and BibliU is committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone can do rewarding work.

Please note: We do not work with external recruiters/recruitment agencies. This position will be filled directly by BibliU and we kindly request that external recruiters/recruitment agencies refrain from submitting candidates for this role.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior IT Systems Engineer, Migration, you will be tasked with leading the technical migration and separation of internal IT systems, applications, infrastructure, and user environments associated with strategic partnerships. You will ensure secure, reliable migration of technology assets, identities, access, and data while minimizing business disruption and maintaining operational continuity. You will also provide exceptional technical assistance, resolve customer issues, and ensure optimal system performance.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Plan and execute IT migrations, including application and infrastructure dependency mapping, cutover and rollback plans, and post-migration stabilization and documentation.
  • Lead identity and access transitions, along with data migration and validation, to ensure the secure, reliable migration of technology assets, identities, access, and data.
  • Deliver migration milestones on time with minimal business disruption, successful data and access validation, zero critical security gaps, and timely resolution of post-migration issues.
  • Manage, secure, and support the production Google Workspace and O365 environments with other adjacent applications.
  • Manage SSO integrations with multiple platforms and applications; configure and support application integrations with IAM and collaboration tools.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

  • Bachelor's Degree in a technical domain and 5 or more years of relevant professional experience (or equivalent overall experience in lieu of a degree).
  • Extensive experience in configuring, securing, and managing the production Google Workspace (certifications preferred), and in configuring and troubleshooting collaboration and productivity software including Google Workspace Suite and Microsoft Office365.

  • Experience with Endpoint Management tools such as Jamf, Intune, and Jumpcloud.
  • Working knowledge of AWS cloud services.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL and change management, and the ability to write detailed documentation based on regulatory requirements.
  • Experience in managing Linux and VMware is a plus.
  • Experience working with NIST controls is a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. jobs.excerpt: Full-Cycle Account Executive New Business Development: find the buying moment, build the case, close the deal The Opportunity Most infrastructure decisions don’t happen because a salesperson called.
jobs.description:
Full-Cycle Account Executive
New Business Development: find the buying moment, build the case, close the deal

The Opportunity

Most infrastructure decisions don’t happen because a salesperson called. They happen because something forced them: a server fleet hitting end of life, a hypervisor renewal that jumped overnight, a colocation contract running out, an audit that didn’t go well. The best sellers in our industry spot those moments before anyone else, and show up with the right answer.

That’s the job. We’re looking for a true hunter who builds their own pipeline, sells a smart comparison instead of a canned pitch, and closes new business from first conversation to signature. No inherited accounts to babysit and no waiting on marketing leads, just a real market, a flexible portfolio, and room to build something that’s yours.

Why This Role Is Different

  • You’re not stuck selling one product. Public cloud, private cloud, Dell hardware, colocation—you recommend what actually fits the workload, even when the honest answer is “keep that one in Azure.” Customers notice. So do their referrals.
  • You stay a hunter. Client Success owns renewals and account management, so your time—and your commission plan, stay focused on winning new logos.
  • You don’t hunt alone. We co-sell with leading technology advisors including Intelisys, Telarus, Upstack, and Avant, so your reach goes well beyond your own list.
  • Your impact is visible. You’ll work directly with the VP of Sales and company leadership, and what you build will shape how Dynascale grows.

About Dynascale

Dynascale provides cloud solutions, colocation, infrastructure modernization, AI sovereignty, cybersecurity, and managed IT services. We help organizations with demanding performance, cost, and compliance requirements put every workload in the right place—and run it reliably once it’s there.

What You’ll Do

Find the buying moment

  • Build your own territory map and hit list, ranked by real timing signals: hardware end-of-life dates, contract and lease expirations, licensing changes, funding, acquisitions, and audit cycles.
  • Reach out when it matters—by phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and referrals—using HubSpot, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo.
  • Turn technology advisors and brokers into a second pipeline engine through smart co-selling.

Build the case

  • Run sharp discovery with IT managers and directors, find the event driving the decision, and qualify with discipline using MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or a similar method.
  • Own the first technical conversation, virtualization, backup, bandwidth, compliance—and bring in Solutions Engineers when the design gets deep.
  • Arm your champion with a one-page business case that wins the room you’re not in: why now, the cost of doing nothing, and why this is the right move.

Close and hand off

  • Negotiate and close new-logo deals that make sense for the customer and for Dynascale, no buying revenue with discounts.
  • Run a forecast you’d put your name on, with HubSpot kept clean and current.
  • Hand off to Client Success with a complete, accurate service order—then get back to hunting.

What You Bring

  • 3–7 years selling recurring infrastructure or managed services: colocation, IaaS, private cloud, MSP/MSSP, DRaaS, or managed network.
  • A track record of sourcing at least half of your own closed business—and a method you can walk us through in detail.
  • Experience selling to IT managers and directors at companies with roughly 50–1,000 employees.
  • Quota attainment earned without a big marketing engine, an SDR team, or a sales engineer on every call.
  • The patience for four- to seven-month cycles and the fluency to talk about deals in recurring revenue and margin, not just contract value.
  • Real CRM and forecasting discipline, ideally in HubSpot.

Bonus Points

  • You have beaten AWS or Azure on cost predictability and control.
  • You have closed deals alongside technology advisors or brokers such as Intelisys, Telarus, Upstack, or Avant.
  • You have quoted hardware and a recurring service in the same deal.
  • You know compliance-driven industries such as healthcare, financial services, entertainment and post-production, or the public sector.
  • You sell with MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, or a similar methodology.

How We Measure Winning

New monthly recurring revenue closed against an annual quota of roughly $20K in net-new MRR. Along the way, we look at self-sourced pipeline, qualified opportunities with a clear buying event, deal progression, win rate, margin, forecast accuracy, and clean handoffs to Client Success. Bottom line: new customers and recurring revenue that last.

This Is Your Role If…

  • You’ve built a book from nothing and can tell us exactly how you did it.
  • Spotting a hardware refresh nine months early excites you more than a warm inbound lead.
  • You’d rather recommend the option that pays you less than lose a customer’s trust.
  • You can walk through the economics of every deal you’ve closed.
  • You don’t need a playbook handed to you—you’d rather write one.

It’s probably not the right fit if you’re looking for a steady stream of inbound leads, a dedicated SDR, or a sales engineer on every first call.

Compensation

Base salary: $75,000 – $85,000 plus OTE.

Ready to Hunt?

If you know how to find the buying moment, build the case, and close—and you want a role where that skill is the whole job—we want to hear from you. When you apply, tell us about the best deal you ever sourced yourself.

Dynascale Technologies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. jobs.excerpt: Why This Role?  At Lukka, accurate and comprehensive data is fundamental to making the digital asset ecosystem more transparent, reliable and accountable.
jobs.description:
Why This Role?

At Lukka, accurate and comprehensive data is fundamental to making the digital asset ecosystem more transparent, reliable and accountable. As a Blockchain Reference Data Analyst, you will help build and maintain the structured reference data that enables Lukka's products to identify, classify, connect and interpret blockchain networks, digital assets, tokens, protocols and entities.

You will combine blockchain research, data analysis, Data Science and automation to transform information from disparate sources into reliable, standardized and continuously maintained reference datasets. You will investigate complex data discrepancies, develop analytical methods to improve data quality, identify patterns and anomalies, and build intelligent workflows that make reference data management more scalable.

This is not a traditional data-entry or data-processing role. We are looking for an analytical thinker who can combine research expertise with Python, SQL, statistical methods and AI-assisted tools to improve the accuracy, completeness and usability of blockchain reference data.

You will work closely with Blockchain Engineers, Blockchain Data Analysts & Researchers, Product and Operations teams to establish trusted data foundations for Lukka's digital asset products.

What You'll Do

  • Build Blockchain Reference Data: Research, identify, classify and maintain structured information about blockchain networks, digital assets, tokens, smart contracts, protocols, wallets, exchanges and related entities.
  • Develop Data Models and Taxonomies: Create and maintain standardized schemas, classifications, attributes and relationships that enable consistent interpretation of reference data across blockchain ecosystems.
  • Apply Data Science to Data Quality: Use statistical analysis, anomaly detection, clustering, similarity matching and other analytical techniques to identify inconsistencies, duplicates, missing attributes and potentially incorrect classifications.
  • Automate Research and Validation: Develop Python-based workflows that collect, normalize, validate and enrich reference data from public APIs, blockchain explorers, project documentation, registries and other credible sources.
  • Build Intelligent Entity Resolution: Apply rule-based and machine-learning approaches to match entities, detect duplicates, resolve naming variations and establish relationships between assets, networks, protocols and organizations.
  • Establish Data Quality Frameworks: Define measurable quality dimensions, validation rules, confidence scores and exception thresholds for reference data accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness and freshness.
  • Investigate Complex Data Discrepancies: Research conflicting or incomplete information across multiple sources, assess source reliability and document evidence supporting data decisions.
  • Leverage AI and LLMs: Use AI-assisted research, information extraction and classification to accelerate data enrichment, while applying appropriate validation and human review to maintain reliability.
  • Build Monitoring and Analytical Dashboards: Track coverage, data-quality trends, unresolved exceptions, source freshness and enrichment performance to identify gaps and prioritize improvements. Maintain accuracy of Lukka’s data products. Assess various sources of crypto reference data and determine data quality. Monitor daily processes to ensure complete and accurate data throughout our entire ecosystem. Define new process improvement opportunities
  • Collaborate with Engineering: Translate data requirements and analytical findings into implementable specifications, validation rules, automated workflows and API or pipeline requirements.
  • Support Product and Customer Needs: Investigate reference-data issues, assess their downstream impact and contribute to enhancements that improve the usability and reliability of Lukka's products. Proactively work with clients to understand their problems and develop solutions to ensure their data needs are met. Integrate customer feedback into the Lukka Product development lifecycle. Leverage business knowledge of the crypto asset ecosystem to support clients who are new to the space. Troubleshoot customer issues.
  • Continuously Improve Processes: Identify repetitive manual work, recommend automation opportunities and develop reproducible research methods, documentation and standard operating procedures. Define requirements with technology teams to enhance the platform and data delivery mechanisms. Research new crypto trends and events for product expansion.

What You'll Need

Experience

  • 2–5 years of experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Reference Data, Financial Data or a related analytical role.
  • Strong experience working with structured and semi-structured datasets, data validation and analytical problem-solving.
  • Experience developing data-driven solutions using Python and SQL.
  • Blockchain or digital asset experience is preferred; a strong interest in blockchain technology and the ability to learn new protocols are essential.

Data Science & Programming

  • Proficiency in Python for data analysis, transformation, validation and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Pandas or Polars and libraries such as NumPy and SciPy.
  • Working knowledge of statistical methods, exploratory data analysis, outlier detection and data-quality measurement.
  • Familiarity with machine-learning techniques for classification, clustering, entity resolution or similarity matching.
  • Experience with scikit-learn is an advantage.
  • Ability to write SQL queries for data profiling, reconciliation, analysis and quality monitoring.

Data Engineering & Integration

  • Experience consuming REST APIs and working with JSON and other semi-structured data formats.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data normalization, schema design and data validation.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and cloud data platforms such as AWS S3 and RDS.
  • Experience with automated data pipelines, scheduled workflows or orchestration tools is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with dashboards and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar platforms is a plus.

Blockchain & Reference Data

  • Understanding of blockchain fundamentals, including networks, addresses, transactions, tokens, smart contracts and consensus mechanisms.
  • Ability to research and validate digital asset information using blockchain explorers, project documentation, public APIs and other authoritative sources.
  • Familiarity with EVM-compatible networks, Bitcoin, Solana or other blockchain ecosystems is an advantage.
  • Understanding of entity master data, asset classification, identifiers, taxonomies and relationship mapping is desirable.
  • Knowledge of financial markets, securities reference data, market data or digital asset classification is a plus.

Data Quality & Analytical Thinking

  • Strong investigative skills and attention to detail, combined with the ability to explain findings quantitatively.
  • Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from conflicting, incomplete or low-confidence information.
  • A structured approach to defining validation rules, measuring quality and investigating root causes.
  • Ability to turn analytical findings into actionable recommendations and repeatable processes.

AI-Native Mindset

  • Willingness to use AI tools for research, data extraction, classification, coding and documentation.
  • Ability to validate AI-generated outputs independently and identify hallucinations, unsupported claims and incorrect classifications.
  • Interest in combining AI with deterministic rules, statistical methods and human review to improve data quality and productivity.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Ability to work with Engineering, Product, Research and Operations teams across geographies.
  • Clear documentation and communication skills.
  • A proactive approach to identifying problems, proposing improvements and taking ownership through resolution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Reference datasets achieve agreed targets for accuracy, completeness, consistency and freshness.
  • Coverage of blockchain networks, digital assets and related entities expands in line with product requirements.
  • Manual research and repetitive validation are reduced through automation and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Data discrepancies are detected earlier, investigated systematically and resolved with documented evidence.
  • Entity matching, classification and enrichment become more consistent, measurable and scalable.
  • Product and Engineering teams receive reliable, well-documented reference data and actionable analytical insights.

Why Join Lukka?

Lukka solves complex data and technology challenges in an industry that continues to evolve rapidly. Since 2014, we have anticipated the needs of the digital asset ecosystem and developed products that help make crypto more accountable.

As part of the team, you will help establish the trusted data foundations on which digital asset products depend. You will have the opportunity to combine Data Science, blockchain research and automation to solve real-world problems, influence data standards and create measurable value for customers.

Of Course, Let's Discuss Some Perks

  • Work directly with digital asset data supporting products used by established clients.
  • Apply Data Science and AI to complex, real-world data challenges.
  • Gain exposure to multiple blockchain ecosystems and evolving data standards.
  • Collaborate with global teams and influence the development of data products.
  • Work in a startup-style environment where your contribution and impact are visible.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position

The Opportunity


AAPC seeks a distinctive type of software engineer: someone who blends strong technical skills with curiosity, initiative, product insight, and a rare passion for delivering value. You will join an engineering team in AAPC’s Technology and Engineering organization that is focused on the marketing domain: our website, digital products, e-commerce, and the systems that take people from discovery through membership, certification, and renewal. You will work closely with Marketing, who will clarify the customer problem, its importance, and the business rules that guide the solution. You will be responsible for translating that guidance into functional technology that reaches users and delivers measurable benefits.

We want engineers who can move from understanding the “what” and “why” to figuring out the “how.” Analyze the problem, manage ambiguity, make sound technical choices, and execute effectively. You need to work quickly, exercise judgment, and own the process end to end.

You don’t need a marketing background. What matters is that you can connect systems reliably, build custom software where purchased tools fall short, and hold everything to the same production standard as the rest of our platform. You will partner with our platform engineering team on infrastructure, deployment, and observability, and with our data engineering team so member and customer data arrives complete and ready to use.

Modern tooling has fundamentally changed what an exceptional engineer can accomplish. In this role, you will treat AI as an extension of your engineering team. By leveraging agentic coding tools, reusable skills, agentic engineering practices, established components, and internal frameworks, you will orchestrate work that historically required a much larger team.

This is a hands-on lead role. You will be the most senior engineer on the team, setting standards, reviewing designs and code, and helping engineers with strong front-end and CMS skills grow into well-rounded engineers. From time to time, you will also step into interim team leadership to keep work moving.

What You’ll Do

  • Turn clearly articulated customer problems, business needs, and business rules into production-ready technology.
  • Own delivery of the software you build, from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, observability, support, and continuous improvement.
  • Break complex outcomes into executable work and coordinate agents toward a common goal.
  • Connect the platforms the business already uses through reliable integrations, and build custom services and customer-facing applications where those platforms fall short.
  • Work with platform engineering and data engineering so what you build runs on our standard infrastructure and member and customer data flows reliably into our data platform.
  • Investigate and resolve ambiguity independently when you can determine the answer through technical judgment, research, customer context, or existing standards.
  • Identify genuine business questions early and return them to Marketing or the responsible stakeholder quickly enough that answers don’t delay delivery.
  • Make technical decisions autonomously while remaining aligned with shared architectural principles, platforms, and standards.
  • Deliver valuable increments early, learn from real usage, and iterate rapidly.
  • Set standards, review designs and code, and mentor the engineers on your team.
  • Create and improve reusable skills, components, frameworks, workflows, and automation that increase the effectiveness of future engineering work.
  • Strengthen testing, code review, security analysis, accessibility, quality assurance, monitoring, and incident diagnosis.
  • Measure success by customer and business outcomes, not by the number of stories completed or the amount of code produced.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a recent record of writing and shipping production code yourself.
  • Demonstrated experience taking software from an initial idea through production delivery.
  • Practical experience across the broader technology lifecycle, including software development, deployment, DevOps, observability, monitoring, and production support.
  • Ability to work across technical boundaries rather than staying limited to one narrow layer of a system.
  • Experience integrating with third-party systems through APIs, webhooks, or events, and designing for the ways they fail.
  • Strong judgment about when to act independently, when to investigate further, and when a decision must return to the business or another responsible stakeholder.
  • Experience using agentic coding tools, or compelling evidence that you are actively developing an agentic engineering practice.
  • The ability to direct, evaluate, and integrate AI-generated work while retaining full accountability for its correctness and quality.
  • Experience leading technically: setting standards, reviewing code, and mentoring other engineers.
  • A history of learning unfamiliar technologies and applying them to real problems.
  • Clear, concise communication, especially when raising questions, explaining tradeoffs, or working asynchronously.
  • A customer-oriented mindset and an understanding that successful engineering creates customer and business value.
  • The initiative to improve the systems and processes around you rather than repeatedly working around the same problems.
Experience with marketing automation, CRM, headless CMS, customer data, or e-commerce platforms is helpful but not required.

We value demonstrated capability, judgment, and personal drive more than a particular title or traditional seniority level. We will level this role based on demonstrated capability, from senior through principal.

Show Us What Drives You

We want to know what you chose to build, not just what an employer assigned to you. We encourage you to share something that demonstrates your curiosity, initiative, and passion for the craft. The subject matter does not need to align with AAPC’s products. We are interested in what you chose to learn, the problems you encountered, the decisions you made, and whether you cared enough to bring the idea to life.

AAPC (www.aapc.com) is the world’s largest and fastest-growing healthcare training, certification, and solutions association.

AAPC Values:

DRIVEN | Self-starts and stays highly motivated to achieve ambitious goals. Shares contagious energy and enthusiasm liberally. Takes initiative without always being directed. Demonstrates confidence in decision-making and effectively balances autonomy and authority with accountability.

HUMBLE | Learns, adapts, and improves relentlessly. Seeks feedback without insecurity and implements coaching. Recognizes others' contributions gratefully. Approaches work and relationships with an abundance mentality. Places the needs of others above self.

TRANSPARENT| Integrity-centered, honest, truthful, and trustworthy in all aspects of work. Keeps commitments to external and internal parties. Holds self strictly accountable, valuing the trust placed in them by others.

SUPPORTIVE | Empowers and uplifts others. Listens actively and responds with empathy and understanding. Prioritizes well-being and growth of team members and customers ahead of own interest. Faces challenges together, believing in collective strength and unity.

INNOVATIVE | Entrepreneurial spirit with a scrappy mentality. Dreams big, sees opportunity, pursues full potential, and finds ways to accomplish the impossible. Rolls up sleeves and does real work. Works quickly, intelligently, and flexibly.

What we Offer:
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account
  • Generous PTO and Holiday Pay
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Remote/virtual-office consideration

AAPC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This company is committed to fairness and equal opportunity in our hiring practices. We do not discriminate on grounds unrelated to a candidate's ability to perform the duties of the job. Our focus is on finding the best person for each role, based on merit and fit, to ensure success both for our company and for the individual's professional growth.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. This company does not and will not discriminate in employment and personnel practices on the basis of race, sex, age, disability, religion, national origin, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. Hiring, transferring and promotion practices are performed without regard to the above-listed items.
