jobs.description:
Join a company that’s leading the way in AI and automation consulting. Our portfolio spans 10+ top technologies across business applications, data, process, cloud, and AI. At Bits In Glass, you’ll do meaningful work with a supportive, driven team that loves to collaborate and celebrate wins together. Whether you’re coding, consulting, or bringing bold ideas to the table, you’ll tackle real business challenges, grow your skills, and make a BIG impact.

Our growing team has earned global recognition as a Great Place to Work and received multiple industry partner awards—while keeping things fun and people-focused. If you’re looking to deepen your expertise and solve real-world problems, Bits In Glass could be the place for you.

Role Overview A Creatio Solution Architect owns the technical design of a Creatio solution end-to-end: translating business requirements into a cohesive architecture, staying client-facing throughout discovery and design, and remaining engaged with the delivery team through implementation, UAT, and release. Sitting above the Creatio Developer profile on the full-stack skill set, this role adds strategic client-facing, architectural, and delivery-oversight responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales & Scoping: Support the sales cycle by contributing architecture concepts, feasibility input, effort estimates, and technical credibility; plan POC/phase splits and support staffing conversations with delivery leadership.
  • Discovery & Workshop Facilitation: Run client-facing discovery workshops, lead or co-lead solution design sessions, manage stakeholder expectations, and facilitate decisions when requirements conflict or are incomplete.
  • End-to-End Solution Architecture: Translate business requirements, discovery notes, and RFP/RFI content into a coherent solution architecture and requirements traceability matrix, prioritizing no-code/out-of-the-box configurations over custom development whenever appropriate.
  • Integration & Security Design: Define integration architectures (connected systems, methods, data flows, error handling) and set architecture, security, and quality standards for the delivery team.
  • Technical Documentation: Produce and maintain comprehensive solution design documentation—including architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, and technical design documents—for both clients and internal teams.
  • Delivery & Build Oversight: Stay engaged with developers throughout the build phase to review designs, unblock technical questions, catch architectural drift early, and proactively identify risks or technical debt before UAT.
  • UAT, Release & Go-Live Readiness: Act as the primary technical point of contact for the client; support UAT planning and defect triage, own technical go-live readiness (data migration validation, environment promotion, rollback planning, cutover sequencing), and lead post-release stabilization.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance: Collaborate closely across sales, business analysis, development, QA, and project management, confidently pushing back on scope or approaches that conflict with platform best practices, data security, or long-term maintainability.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience delivering Creatio projects as an implementer, developer, or Solution Architect.
  • Proven track record in a client-facing delivery role (e.g., consultant, technical lead) with experience carrying a solution from initial design through to a live production release.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Creatio platform, including the BPM/process designer, business rules, data model (section wizard, object designer), configuration, and packaging/deployment model.
  • Strong grasp of integration patterns (REST, OData, WCF, webhooks, middleware/ETL) and connecting Creatio with ERPs, marketing platforms, telephony, and third-party systems.
  • Solid understanding of Creatio’s security model (operation and object permissions, row-level security, SSO) and how it maps to client governance and compliance requirements.
  • Working knowledge of full-stack development layers (C#, JavaScript, T-SQL/PL-SQL) sufficient to review technical designs and code-level decisions.
  • Experience with relational databases (MS SQL, PostgreSQL), including schema design, performance tuning, and data migration planning.
  • Knowledge of cloud vs. on-site deployment models (environment provisioning, scaling, backup/restore) as well as source control (Git) and branching/release practices for Creatio package development.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex architecture to both business and technical stakeholders in plain language.

Desirable Skills

  • Strong familiarity with core Creatio products (Sales, Service, Marketing) and how their out-of-the-box capabilities map to standard business processes.
  • Active familiarity with Creatio Academy guidance, current platform updates, and the Creatio Marketplace (evaluating pre-built applications and connectors versus custom builds).

jobs.description:
Description

Ledgebrook is an AI-native specialty insurance platform. When a business needs coverage that is custom and complex, its broker comes to us, and our underwriters give them an answer, often in hours rather than weeks.

We built our technology from scratch, with AI in it from the first line of code. The technology helps price the risk; the underwriter uses their judgment to decide. There are always two hands on the wheel.

We are insurance industry insiders, and we eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through our own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.

Our vision: to make the wheels of insurance spin faster.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star—fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages—we play as a team, we win as a team. Everyone benefits handsomely from Ledgebrook’s success.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Staff Accountant to join our growing Accounting team who will report directly to the Senior Accountant.

As Ledgebrook continues to scale, our Finance function is also scaling - we are building a team of professionals that have deep insurance and finance expertise, are passionate about leveraging AI and high-tech systems, and are excited to support a company that is building from the ground up.

This role will be responsible for key areas of the monthly and quarterly close, balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting support across multiple legal entities.

The Staff Accountant will work closely with the Senior Accountant and broader Finance team to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting while helping strengthen accounting processes, controls, and scalability as the organization grows.

This position is well suited for an accountant who is comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, enjoys taking ownership of accounting processes, and is interested in expanding their knowledge of insurance accounting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own key components of the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes, including preparation of journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Maintain general ledger accuracy and ensure transactions are properly recorded in accordance with US GAAP and company accounting policies.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and investigate and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Leverage modern finance tools and AI-based solutions to improve efficiency, accuracy, and reporting insights.
  • Support external audit processes and preparation of supporting schedules and documentation.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (operations, product, tech & data) to support ad hoc projects and new business initiatives, as required in a scaling environment.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn and genuinely excited about the busy but rewarding process of ground-up development

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field required.
  • 2-4 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in the insurance industry.
  • Knowledge of GAAP and financial reporting.
  • Familiarity with accounting software and proficient in Microsoft Excel. Workday experience is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience of using AI tools to improve or automate financial processes.
  • Excellent analytical, problem solving and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and work independently in a collaborative and fast-paced setting.

Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture.
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.

Compensation

Compensation:

  • The base salary range for this position is $100k-$120k.
  • This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.
  • Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.

About Us

Dutch Vet is transforming veterinary care by making expert treatment accessible anytime, anywhere. Our mission is simple: help every pet live their happiest, healthiest life by connecting pet parents with licensed vets through seamless virtual visits.

We’re the only veterinary telemedicine service that can diagnose, prescribe, and ship medications directly to customers in most states. For less than $100 per year, Dutch offers real relief and convenience for pets and their families.

As one customer put it: “Dutch was the only site that would diagnose and prescribe meds as well as ship the meds.”

Here’s what other customers have said about Dutch Vet:

"The easiest vet visit you'll ever have.”

"More thorough than my in-person vet.”

"No nonsense, quick, easy and friendly veterinarian. Much cheaper than our regular local vet that couldn’t get us in. So glad I found Dutch!"

Backed by world-class investors including Forerunner Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and Bling Capital, our team is made-up of successful startup founders (Hims, PlushCare, Nasty Gal) with expertise in scaling enterprises (TripAdvisor, Walmart, BARK). Featured in TechCrunch, Forbes, Wired, and Axios, Dutch is setting the standard for quality, accessibility, and compassion in pet care.

The opportunity

    Dutch is hiring a Chief Product Officer to set the product vision, strategy and execution for our next phase of scale and our path to the public markets. As a member of the executive leadership team, the CPO will lead the product and design organization and work closely with the CEO, the board and executive peers. Above all, the CPO will drive business transformation, making sure every product investment produces lasting growth in member value.

    We're looking for an executive who is just as comfortable in the weeds building as they are setting company level direction with conviction. The right leader will stay extremely close enough to the data, the members and the work to shape outcomes directly.

Key responsibilities

  • Vision and strategy: Set clear near term and long term product vision and strategy tied to company objectives, and align the company, investors, and the exec team around these north stars

  • Business transformation: Lead the organizational and operating changes that improve how Dutch builds, prioritizes and measures product, at the pace our growth demands, including leading several new business lines that Dutch will launch in 2027

  • Member lifetime value: Own the product levers of acquisition, conversion, engagement and retention across the membership, and drive steady LTV improvement.

  • Growth partnership: Work closely with marketing leadership on the full-funnel growth agenda, including conversion, lifecycle and marketing technology.

  • Customer insight: Champion the voice of the member. Bring research, feedback and behavioral data together into one view that guides decisions across the company.

  • Investment discipline: Hold the portfolio to rigorous business cases, and put resources behind high-confidence, high-return initiatives.

  • Company planning and prioritization: Design the company's planning cadence, including OKRs and company-level priorities. Weigh diverse inputs, make clear trade-offs and set a roadmap the whole organization can commit to.

  • Organizational leadership: Build, scale and inspire a high-performing product and design organization that is accountable for business outcomes.

  • Executive partnership: Be a trusted partner to Marketing, Operations, Engineering, Data, Finance and our clinical teams.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years in product, including significant time leading product organizations at the VP or C-level.

  • A proven record of leading business transformation, with measurable results in growth, retention or profitability.

  • Experience scaling a high-growth company from early stage to meaningful scale. IPO readiness or public-company experience is a strong plus.

  • Deep subscription expertise and a record of improving lifetime value, ideally in models more complex than ecommerce, such as services, healthcare or insurance.

  • A strong record of partnering with marketing on growth, with working knowledge of conversion optimization and marketing technology.

  • Strong analytical skills. You dig into data and customer insight yourself to form an independent point of view.

  • A history of building product and design organizations that deliver business results.

  • The strategic clarity to align executive leadership and the board around a focused set of priorities.

  • Sound commercial judgment and the confidence to challenge assumptions and say no.

  • A forward-looking view on how AI can transform product development and experimentation.

  • A collaborative leadership style, with a strong sense of urgency and high standards.

PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:

    We’re building the future of pet healthcare. That takes passion, urgency, resilience, and accountability. Dutch is a fast-moving, high-performance environment where we challenge assumptions, embrace AI, and deliver results. This isn’t a traditional 9-to-5 job. We work hard, move quickly, and step up when needed.

    Who Thrives Here
  • Builders, not caretakers. Challenge the status quo.
  • Owners, not passengers. Take accountability for results.
  • Problem-solvers, not problem-reporters. Bring solutions.
  • Doers, not spectators. Act with urgency and purpose.
  • Team players, not empire builders. Put the mission first.
  • AI-forward thinkers. Work smarter, faster, and better.

    • Who May Not Thrive Here
    If you prefer predictable routines, rigid responsibilities, extensive direction, or maintaining the status quo, Dutch may not be the right fit. We offer trust and flexibility in exchange for ownership, accountability, and results.

    Our Guiding Principles
  • Pets First: Put pets’ best interests first.
  • Agile Like a Cat: Move with speed and precision.
  • Creativity Is Our Catnip: Challenge conventions.
  • Be the Human Your Dog Thinks You Are: Lead with kindness and care.

jobs.description:
Empire: Four Kingdoms launched in January 2013 and is the world’s all-time highest-grossing app produced by a German company. It is part of our Empire brand, which has passed €1 billion in revenue and 220 million registered players. Now we are moving the game from Adobe AIR to Unity. Quality is the heart of that move: the Unity client has to behave exactly like today’s client, 1:1, including its known quirks, while the live team keeps shipping new content every month.

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer, Mobile Games - Freelance who builds that proof as an automated, AI-assisted test setup: automation first, AI agents for the legwork, people for the judgement calls, and no endless manual passes.

This is a senior freelance role where you work autonomously, full-time from February 2027 until the end of 2027 including handover. It is fully remote within ±3 hours of CET, with the option to meet as a team in one of our Hamburg offices.

YOUR MISSION

  • Design the test strategy and test plans for the port based on the live game, game design documents and the list of features to migrate. Prioritise by risk and agree the standards with the game’s QA lead.

  • Build automated tests that run the AIR client and the Unity client side by side: same input, same result. Think replayed server traffic, state comparison and pixel diffs, where pass or fail is deterministic, not a judgement call.

  • Use AI tools like Claude as a real part of your work: to generate and maintain test scripts, explore the game, cluster crashes and draft bug reports, with a human checking the result. Build tooling where it pays off, and measure whether it does.

  • Perform smoke tests, sanity checks and full regression testing for every port build, and turn each new live feature and content release into regression cases for the Unity client.

  • Test what players feel: payments and in-app purchases, store builds, login, push notifications, localisation, and the analytics events the business relies on, checked event by event with the data team.

  • Run a device matrix on real devices, including low-end Android phones and older iPhones, and track load time, memory, frame rate, heat and battery against the live client.

  • Identify, document and report defects in Jira, manage tickets and coordinate with the port team so that release deadlines are met.

  • Support the release in a first market and then on all stores: release candidates, store certification, a tested rollback path and clear go or no-go input.

  • Hand over a test suite and documentation that the live QA team can run and extend after the port.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You join the port team of Empire: Four Kingdoms and report to the project lead.

  • Project lead: the owner of the port, who sets priorities and is your day-to-day contact.

  • The game’s QA lead: reviews your test approach and signs off quality for the Empire team.

  • The port team: the Lead Unity Engineer, the Unity developers and a second QA Engineer joining later. You share test plans, review each other’s work and keep one testing standard.

  • The Empire team: producers, game designers, client and server developers who know the game inside out. You involve them early and learn from them.

  • Data team: to check that the tracking events from the Unity client mean the same as today.

  • External QA partners: where we use them, you help coordinate their testing.

YOUR BACKSTORY

  • 6+ years of hands-on QA experience in games, with a focus on test automation and a solid understanding of the bug life cycle and testing methodologies.

  • You have tested at least one live mobile game with a significant user base, through store release and live updates. This is a hard requirement.

  • Hands-on mobile and game test automation, for example Appium, AltTester, GameDriver, Unity Test Framework or comparable tools, and scripting in Python, C# or a similar language, including running tests in CI.

  • You work autonomously: you own your test approach, set priorities with the project lead and raise risks early, without needing day-to-day direction.

  • Practical experience using AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in QA: generating and maintaining tests, triaging failures, writing tooling. You know where they help and where they don’t.

  • Understanding of client-server games: you can read network traffic and tell a client bug from a server bug.

  • Experience testing payments and in-app purchases on iOS and Android.

  • Fluent English; you can explain complex technical issues to cross-functional teams.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience testing a port, migration or major rewrite against the original

  • Automated visual regression testing or replay-based testing

  • Building agentic tooling for QA teams. This is a real differentiator for us.

  • Adobe AIR, Flash or Unity client testing

  • Live mobile F2P and strategy games (live ops cadence, events, A/B tests)

  • Analytics and tracking validation

  • German

WHY JOIN US?

  • A classic at a turning point. You work on one of Europe’s most successful mobile strategy games at the moment it moves to a modern engine, and millions of players will feel the result.

  • Work your way. Fully remote within ±3 hours of CET, with the option to meet the team in our Hamburg offices for kick-offs and key milestones.

  • AI in daily work. We use AI tools like Claude every day and give you room to build the QA tooling you always wanted, judged by results.

  • A team that knows the game. You build on more than a decade of knowledge in the Empire team and leave behind a test setup that lasts.

HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW

Heads up: we will ask you to show your AI testing workflow live in the interview. Bring your real setup, your real prompts, your real failures. We care more about how you actually work than about a polished demo.

ABOUT GOODGAME STUDIOS

Goodgame Studios is known for data-driven game development and successful live-service strategy titles. We self-publish our games in-house with all relevant disciplines under one roof. Our studio is based in Hamburg, Germany, and we welcome applications from international candidates. English is our working language. As part of Stillfront Group, one of Europe’s leading game publishers, we work on long-term IP growth with a strong focus on execution.

The Technical Account Manager will act as a technical subject matter expert supporting Motive's commercial organisation, working closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Support teams.The role combines technical consultation, product demonstrations, customer onboarding support, troubleshooting, and solution validation. The successful candidate will help prospective and existing customers understand Motive's device management solutions, assess technical compatibility, and ensure the platform meets their business and operational requirements.Unlike a traditional Pre-Sales Engineer, this position will have a stronger emphasis on hands-on technical support, issue investigation, product configuration, and ongoing customer engagement, while maintaining close alignment with commercial objectives.

Key responsibilities

Commercial and pre-sales technical support

  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales teams to understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate technical solutions.
  • Deliver product demonstrations and technical presentations to prospective customers.
  • Explain software capabilities, device functionality, integrations, and technical specifications.
  • Support proof-of-concept (PoC) activities, product evaluations, and technical validation.
  • Respond to customer questionnaires, technical queries, and requests for information (RFIs) or proposals (RFPs).
  • Identify technical gaps and work with Product and Engineering teams to assess feasibility.
  • Help the commercial team communicate the technical value and differentiation of Motive's solutions.

Device management and technical support

  • Provide technical guidance on device configuration, connectivity, compatibility, and software functionality.
  • Investigate technical issues involving devices, firmware, data transmission, integrations, and platform performance.
  • Troubleshoot customer issues and coordinate with internal support teams for complex escalations.
  • Assist with device setup, deployment planning, testing, and validation.
  • Identify recurring technical issues and recommend corrective actions and improvements.
  • Provide clear technical explanations and practical workarounds to customers and commercial stakeholders.

Customer engagement and solution implementation

  • Act as a technical point of contact during customer onboarding, deployment, and early adoption.
  • Gather customer requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.
  • Support configuration, integration, and implementation discussions.
  • Work with Customer Success and Technical Support to ensure a smooth transition from sales to ongoing service.
  • Provide technical training and guidance to customers where required.
  • Maintain customer confidence through proactive communication and effective issue management.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Support teams.
  • Provide feedback on product functionality, customer requirements, and competitive positioning.
  • Escalate product defects and technical limitations with clear supporting evidence.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases, troubleshooting guides, and sales enablement materials.
  • Share insights from customer interactions to improve product adoption and the commercial process.

Required skills and experience

  • Experience in technical support, solutions engineering, technical account management, or a customer-facing software role.
  • Strong understanding of software platforms, device management, connected devices, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience supporting product demonstrations, customer evaluations, or proof-of-concept projects.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, device configuration, firmware, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Strong customer relationship management and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to balance technical problem-solving with commercial priorities.
  • A proactive, customer-focused approach and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.

Key performance indicators

  • Quality and timeliness of technical support provided to commercial teams.
  • Successful completion of technical demonstrations and customer evaluations.
  • Customer satisfaction and resolution of technical queries.
  • Contribution to sales opportunities through technical validation and solution design.
  • Effective management of escalations and customer issues.
  • Successful handover from sales to implementation and customer success.
  • Quality of technical documentation and feedback provided to Product and Engineering.

Location: Remote, Turkey


Eligibility Requirements

Willingness to travel 75% of the time, both locally and internationally, sometimes on short notice

Motive will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in Country for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a background investigation (where legally permissible).

All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their manager.

Vice President, Finance – Corporate Services Location: Remote with regular travel to Lancaster, PA Compensation: $225,000 - $270,000+ DOE Drive Enterprise Financial Performance at Ecore At Ecore, we transform reclaimed materials into high-performance products that improve safety, wellness, and sustainability in the built environment. As we continue to grow and execute our strategic vision, we are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Vice President, Finance – Corporate Services to play a critical leadership role in shaping the company's financial future. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, this executive will lead enterprise financial planning and analysis, treasury and liquidity management, strategic finance initiatives, and financial governance across Ecore's multi-business-unit organization. This role is highly visible, partnering closely with executive leadership, business unit leaders, lenders, investors, and the Board to drive performance, improve forecasting accuracy, strengthen financial discipline, and create enterprise value. What You'll Do Lead Enterprise FP&A and Business Performance

Drive annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, long-range planning, and scenario analysis across the enterprise. Consolidate and evaluate business unit financial performance, risks, and opportunities. Develop sophisticated financial models supporting EBITDA growth, cash flow optimization, capital investments, and strategic decisions. Establish enterprise planning standards, reporting cadences, and performance metrics. Deliver actionable financial insights to executives that improve decision-making and accountability.

Manage Treasury, Liquidity, and Working Capital

Lead enterprise cash-flow forecasting and liquidity planning, including 13-week cash forecasts. Monitor working capital performance across accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and cash conversion cycles. Support banking relationships, debt compliance, covenant reporting, and financing analyses. Partner across the organization to identify and execute cash-flow improvement opportunities.

Deliver Executive and Investor Reporting

Develop executive dashboards, KPI reporting, and performance analyses. Prepare financial materials for leadership, Board, lender, and investor reviews. Evaluate corporate overhead, shared services costs, and enterprise functional spending. Improve financial visibility and reporting consistency across the organization.

Support Strategic Finance and M&A Activity

Build financial models and business cases for strategic investments and transformation initiatives. Lead financial due diligence for acquisitions, divestitures, and strategic transactions. Evaluate transaction economics, valuation scenarios, synergies, and integration risks. Support post-acquisition integration planning and synergy realization tracking.

Drive Finance Transformation

Standardize planning, forecasting, and management reporting processes. Improve financial systems, automation, reporting capabilities, and business intelligence tools. Strengthen financial governance, transparency, and forecast reliability. Partner closely with Accounting and Technology teams to enhance data quality and reporting accuracy.

Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

Lead and develop Corporate Finance and enterprise FP&A talent. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Build advanced analytical, modeling, and business partnership capabilities across the finance organization.

What We're Looking For Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. 12+ years of progressive finance leadership experience in FP&A, treasury, strategic finance, or related disciplines. Experience in manufacturing, industrial, distribution, or other complex multi-business-unit organizations. Demonstrated success leading budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management, and financial modeling activities. Strong understanding of working capital management, capital allocation, debt structures, and performance management. Knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting, internal controls, and financial governance. Experience presenting financial insights and recommendations to senior executives. Proven track record leading finance transformation initiatives and developing high-performing teams. Experience working within a private-equity-backed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

MBA, CPA, and/or CFA designation. Experience supporting Board, lender, and investor reporting. M&A, transaction diligence, and integration experience. Strong ERP, financial systems, and business intelligence expertise.

Why Join Ecore? This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-wide strategy and financial performance within a growing, private-equity-backed manufacturing organization. You will work directly with executive leadership to shape investment decisions, strengthen financial operations, support growth initiatives, and help build the next chapter of Ecore's success. If you're a strategic finance leader who thrives in complex environments and enjoys turning financial insights into business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you. Ecore is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About AgelessRx AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component.
jobs.description:
About AgelessRx

AgelessRx is a first-of-its-kind, longevity-focused telehealth platform with an e-commerce component. Our mission is to collectively give people millions of extra healthy years, so everyone can enjoy more of what they love in a world where people are empowered to live as long as they want. We believe aging should no longer be treated as a dreadful inevitability, but instead, as a puzzle that can be solved, a fight that can be fought – just as a disease with a cure. Through our free-to-use platform, we offer trusted, data-driven longevity solutions and scientifically backed prescription therapies to help safely lower the risk of age-related diseases.

About the role

AgelessRx is seeking a hands-on, highly capable Senior Security Engineer to serve as the technical owner of information security across our growing telehealth environment. As a healthcare company, protected health information (PHI) flows through much of what we build and operate, making security, privacy, and regulatory compliance fundamental to our products, infrastructure, and internal systems.

This is a broad security engineering role with meaningful ownership across application and product security, cloud infrastructure, identity and access management, vulnerability management, security operations, and technical security governance. This person will help define AgelessRx's security roadmap, build and operate the recurring programs that keep the company secure and audit-ready, and partner directly with Engineering to identify and mitigate risk throughout the development lifecycle.

The Senior Security Engineer will also serve as a key technical partner in AgelessRx's approach to AI security and governance. As AI becomes increasingly embedded across our products and internal operations, this person will help ensure AI tools and systems are deployed responsibly, securely, and in accordance with AgelessRx's obligations as a healthcare organization.

This is not a compliance-only role. We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: reviewing a sensitive code path or investigating a vulnerability one day, establishing an access-control standard or evaluating an AI vendor the next, and translating technical and regulatory risk into clear recommendations for leadership.

What you'll do

Security Program & Risk Management

  • Own and continuously evolve AgelessRx's technical security roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on risk, business impact, regulatory requirements, and company growth.
  • Establish and operate repeatable security programs, controls, reporting, and documentation across the organization.
  • Conduct and document security and architecture reviews for new systems, vendors, integrations, and significant technology changes.
  • Maintain visibility into security risks, vulnerabilities, remediation priorities, owners, and timelines.
  • Conduct and support security risk assessments, including those required under the HIPAA Security Rule.
  • Maintain audit-ready evidence and documentation supporting AgelessRx's technical security controls.
  • Plan and facilitate recurring security and incident-response exercises, including scenarios involving PHI exposure or other material security events.
  • Provide leadership with a clear, actionable view of the company's security posture, priorities, open risks, and remediation progress.

Identity, Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • Define security requirements and technical standards for identity, authentication, authorization, and privileged access across AgelessRx.
  • Partner with the IT Administrator to implement and maintain SSO, MFA, privileged access management, endpoint controls, and other workforce security requirements.
  • Assess and strengthen cloud infrastructure, IAM configurations, external attack surfaces, and administrative access.
  • Own the vulnerability-management program across cloud infrastructure, endpoints, applications, and other relevant technology, including prioritization and remediation SLAs.
  • Maintain and strengthen email security and authentication controls, including DMARC, SPF, and DKIM.
  • Partner with IT on recurring access reviews and ensure identified exceptions or inappropriate access are remediated.
  • Establish security requirements for company devices and endpoints while partnering with IT on implementation and ongoing administration.

Application & Product Security

  • Embed security into AgelessRx's software development lifecycle and engineering practices.
  • Conduct security reviews of architecture, authentication flows, sensitive data handling, payments, and other security-sensitive areas of the product.
  • Develop threat models for new products, features, services, and integrations, particularly those involving PHI or other sensitive information.
  • Deploy, configure, and continuously improve application-security tooling, including SAST, SCA, dependency scanning, and software supply-chain controls.
  • Establish clear processes for reviewing, prioritizing, and remediating application-security findings.
  • Develop and maintain secure development standards, guardrails, and practical guidance for engineers.
  • Scope and coordinate third-party penetration testing and drive identified findings through remediation and closure.
  • Establish and operate an appropriate vulnerability disclosure and triage process.
  • Partner with Engineering early in the development process so security risks are identified before they reach production without unnecessarily slowing engineering velocity.

Healthcare Security & Compliance

  • Maintain technical security documentation and evidence required to demonstrate the effectiveness of AgelessRx's safeguards.
  • Support HIPAA risk analyses, audits, investigations, incident response, and other regulatory or compliance activities requiring technical security expertise.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, HR, Engineering, and other stakeholders to ensure security requirements are appropriately incorporated into company systems and processes.
  • Evaluate security considerations associated with vendors and partners handling PHI or other sensitive company information, including technical security posture and BAA-related requirements.
  • Monitor changes to security and technology requirements affecting AgelessRx and help translate them into actionable technical controls.

AI Security & Governance

  • Serve as the technical security owner for AgelessRx's AI governance program in partnership with Legal, Compliance, HR, Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain visibility into AI systems and tools that access PHI, patient information, proprietary company information, or other sensitive data.
  • Establish and maintain technical security requirements for the use of AI across AgelessRx, including controls designed to prevent PHI or sensitive information from reaching unapproved AI systems.
  • Conduct security and risk assessments of AI tools and vendors before deployment, including data flows, retention, model-training practices, access controls, subprocessors, and other relevant risks.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance on AI vendor requirements, including BAAs and AI-specific data protection considerations.
  • Extend security review and threat modeling to AI-enabled products and features, including risks such as prompt injection, inappropriate model access, data leakage, output handling, and exposure of PHI through prompts, logs, or model outputs.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance to monitor evolving AI requirements affecting healthcare, patient-facing technology, privacy, accessibility, and security and translate applicable requirements into technical controls.
  • Help align AgelessRx's AI risk-management practices with an appropriate recognized framework and maintain supporting evidence.
  • Review and implement approved MCPs and other AI-related integrations in accordance with company security and technology policies.
  • Partner with HR, Compliance, and other stakeholders on the implementation and enforcement of company policies governing employee use of AI tools.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, cybersecurity, or a related technical security role.
  • Hands-on depth across at least two major security domains, such as application/product security, cloud and identity security, vulnerability management, security operations, or security governance.
  • Experience securing environments subject to HIPAA or comparable regulatory requirements and translating regulatory obligations into technical controls.
  • Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider and associated IAM and security practices.
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, MFA, privileged access, and least-privilege principles.
  • Experience with application-security tooling and practices, including SAST, SCA, dependency management, threat modeling, and secure software development.
  • Experience establishing or operating recurring security programs such as vulnerability management, access reviews, penetration testing, security assessments, or incident-response exercises.
  • Experience assessing and prioritizing vulnerabilities based on exploitability, business impact, sensitive-data exposure, and practical risk - not simply severity scores.
  • Working understanding of AI/LLM security risks and the challenges associated with governing AI systems in regulated environments.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills, particularly for audiences that may include engineers, executives, auditors, regulators, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate autonomously and establish structure in an environment where security processes and infrastructure are still evolving.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience conducting HIPAA Security Rule risk analyses, preparing for OCR audits, or supporting healthcare security investigations or breach response.
  • Experience securing healthcare technology, telehealth platforms, EHR integrations, or HL7/FHIR-based systems.
  • Experience building or significantly maturing a security program as an early or first dedicated security hire.
  • Experience implementing AI governance or AI risk-management programs, including familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience evaluating AI vendors or systems that process PHI or other regulated data.
  • Familiarity with emerging healthcare and AI regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with containerization platforms such as Docker.
  • Relevant security certifications such as OSCP, HCISPP, CISSP, or cloud-security certifications are valued but not required.

jobs.title: Inbound Appointment Setter
jobs.excerpt: Why WarriorBabe?  At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth.
jobs.description:
Why WarriorBabe?

At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant team that shares your passion for fitness and helping women flourish. Together, we are on a mission to transform lives and create a community that thrives on empowerment.

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one-on-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.

Our Mission

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.

About the Role

At WarriorBabe, we hire only the best of the best.

As an Inbound Appointment Setter, reporting to WarriorBabe's Sales Leadership, you play a pivotal role in driving the success of our high-ticket VIP Program. This is a fast-paced, high-volume, performance-driven sales opportunity that demands strong communication, exceptional work ethic, sales acumen, deep belief in the WarriorBabe methodology, and an unwavering passion for helping women transform their health and lives.

Your primary responsibility is to connect with women who have purchased a low-ticket WarriorBabe product, conduct an initial Implementation Call, understand their goals and needs, determine whether they may be a qualified fit for additional support, and ascend qualified prospects into a one-on-one enrollment call with an Enrollment Advisor.

This role serves as a critical bridge between a prospective client's initial experience with WarriorBabe and the opportunity to receive deeper, personalized support through our high-ticket VIP Program.

What You'll Do

Drive Qualified Appointments

Conduct high-volume Implementation Calls and consistently identify, qualify, and book appropriate prospects for one-on-one enrollment calls with an Enrollment Advisor.

You'll conduct scheduled 15-to-30-minute Implementation Calls over Zoom, often in back-to-back blocks throughout the workday, and manage a high daily volume of scheduled calls, typically upwards of 12 or more calls per day.

Deliver an Exceptional Client Experience

Provide a world-class first point of human connection with WarriorBabe, ensuring every woman feels seen, heard, supported, and confident in her next step.

You'll lead focused conversations to understand each prospect's goals, challenges, history, needs, and desired outcomes while identifying opportunities for deeper support.

Qualify and Set Appointments

Effectively vet and qualify prospective clients based on established WarriorBabe criteria.

You'll identify qualified opportunities and confidently ascend appropriate prospects into a one-on-one enrollment call with an Enrollment Advisor, clearly communicate the purpose and value of the conversation, and set accurate expectations for the next step in the sales process.

You'll ensure qualified appointments are booked accurately and with appropriate urgency while maintaining a high standard of appointment quality at significant call volume.

Own Your Pipeline

Take full ownership of assigned prospects and follow-up opportunities.

You'll complete timely and consistent follow-up through assigned communication channels, maintain accurate and up-to-date records within HubSpot, and keep pipeline stages, notes, tasks, follow-up dates, and prospect information current and organized.

We expect our Inbound Appointment Setters to proactively manage opportunities without requiring ongoing reminders or oversight from leadership and ensure qualified opportunities do not fall through the cracks.

Maintain Accurate Reporting

Complete all required End-of-Day and End-of-Week reporting accurately and on time, maintain all assigned manual sales trackers, and ensure CRM documentation and pipeline data remain accurate and current.

Be an Active Part of the Team

Attend and actively participate in daily Sales Team Huddles Monday through Friday and remain actively engaged in Slack and other designated communication channels throughout the workweek.

You'll communicate proactively with Sales Leadership regarding pipeline opportunities, challenges, prospect concerns, and performance and collaborate closely with Enrollment Advisors and Sales Leadership to ensure appointment quality and a seamless prospect experience.

You'll also attend WarriorBabe's monthly All Hands Meeting and other required company or departmental meetings.

Schedule & Availability Expectations

This is a full-time, highly competitive sales opportunity requiring significant flexibility and commitment.

Inbound Appointment Setters should anticipate:

  • Working upwards of 40 to 50 hours per week based on call volume, pipeline needs, and performance expectations.
  • Maintaining a flexible schedule based on business and team coverage needs.
  • Availability during priority sales windows, including early mornings EST, late afternoons and evenings EST, and weekends.
  • Working extended blocks of back-to-back 15-to-30-minute Zoom calls.
  • Managing a high volume of scheduled calls, typically upwards of 12 or more per day.
  • Spending significant portions of the workday at a computer conducting calls, managing follow-up, completing administrative responsibilities, and maintaining their pipeline.
  • Active engagement with the Sales Team and leadership Monday through Friday.
  • Managing follow-up and pipeline responsibilities outside of scheduled live calls as needed.

Schedules may evolve based on business needs, lead volume, team coverage, and performance. Inbound Appointment Setters are expected to demonstrate the flexibility, ownership, stamina, and work ethic required to succeed in a high-volume, high-performance remote sales environment.

Systems & Technology

Inbound Appointment Setters are expected to become proficient in and consistently utilize WarriorBabe's primary sales and communication systems, including:

  • HubSpot
  • Aloware
  • Zoom
  • Slack
  • Google Workspace, including Google Docs and Sheets

Inbound Appointment Setters are responsible for maintaining accurate and timely information across all required systems.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 1+ year of appointment-setting experience in a remote sales environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in a high-volume, performance-driven sales role.
  • Strong understanding of the sales process and the ability to identify and qualify legitimate sales opportunities.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to quickly build trust and lead meaningful conversations.
  • Highly motivated, competitive, resilient, assertive, and performance-driven.
  • Comfortable working at significant volume and maintaining a high level of energy across back-to-back calls.
  • Strong work ethic and willingness to work the schedule and call volume required to succeed in a competitive sales environment.
  • Strong organizational skills, follow-through, and administrative discipline.
  • Experience working with CRM systems and digital communication tools; HubSpot experience is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to independently manage a high-volume pipeline.
  • Commitment to coaching, feedback, continuous learning, and skill development.
  • Ability to adapt quickly based on prospective-client needs, leadership feedback, performance data, and evolving business needs.
  • Knowledge of or strong interest in women's health, fitness, and nutrition is preferred.

Growth Opportunity

The Inbound Appointment Setter role is an opportunity to build and sharpen the skills required to succeed in high-ticket sales.

We are looking for individuals who understand the game of sales, are hungry to perform, and want to continue developing their ability to lead conversations, qualify opportunities, create urgency, and drive results.

For high-performing Inbound Appointment Setters, this role may provide a potential development path toward future opportunities within the WarriorBabe Sales Team, including the Enrollment Advisor position. Advancement is not guaranteed and is based on individual performance, skill development, business needs, and available opportunities.

Compensation & Benefits

This is a performance-driven sales opportunity with significant earning potential. Top performers have the opportunity to earn over $100,000 annually, with compensation designed to reward production, consistency, and performance.

Benefits include:

  • 100% remote work environment.
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits following the applicable eligibility period.
  • Employer contribution to the company's 401(k) program.
  • PTO accrual program.

This Opportunity Is for You If...

You are hungry, competitive, coachable, comfortable with volume, and ready to take full ownership of your results.

Success requires consistency, flexibility, strong communication, active pipeline management, team participation, resilience, and the ability to maintain a high level of performance across a demanding schedule.

For the right individual, this role can serve as an opportunity to develop the experience, skill, and sales maturity required to take the next step in a high-ticket sales career.

The opportunity is significant and so are the expectations.

At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.

What We Offer:

  • Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401K, 401K Match

  • Evaluate expansion opportunities within commercial marine, ocean marine, inland marine, and specialty yacht segments.
  • Support carrier negotiations and capacity discussions.
  • Contribute to overall business planning and growth strategy.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of underwriting leadership or management experience.
  • Proven expertise underwriting:
    • Marinas
    • Yacht clubs
    • Boat dealers
    • Charter and excursion vessels
    • Commercial fishing vessels
    • Marine operators
    • Waterfront risks and related marine exposures
  • Demonstrated success managing profitable marine insurance portfolios.
  • Strong broker and distribution relationships within the marine insurance marketplace.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with specialty yacht or inland marine products.
  • Experience leading underwriting teams in an MGA, carrier, program administrator, or specialty insurance environment.
  • Existing marine insurance carrier relationships.

Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Financial acumen
  • Portfolio management
  • Relationship building
  • Negotiation and influence
  • Talent development
  • Risk assessment and pricing expertise

Education & Certifications

  • Insurance designations preferred:
    • CPCU
    • AMIM
    • ARM
    • AU

Why Join Seafarer Marine?

  • Lead a growing and highly specialized marine insurance platform.
  • Shape the future of a nationally recognized marine underwriting organization.

Additional Information

Job Description: Hematology/Oncology Physician

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – United States

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Hematology/Oncology Physicians to contribute their clinical expertise to an AI healthcare project. You will review AI-generated outpatient clinical transcripts and documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with real-world clinical practices. Recent outpatient experience following fellowship is particularly valuable.

Scope of Work

  • Review and annotate AI-generated transcripts of outpatient hematology/oncology consultations for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
  • Evaluate AI-generated documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment & Plans (A&Ps).
  • Assess documentation of chemotherapy cycles, treatment toxicities, laboratory results, and clinical decision-making.
  • Evaluate how accurately AI-generated transcripts reflect real-world clinical reasoning and patient interactions, particularly during follow-up visits.
  • Provide feedback to improve AI scribe outputs and EHR documentation templates.

Required Qualifications

  • MD, DO, or equivalent degree with board certification or eligibility in Hematology and/or Oncology.
  • At least 2 years of recent outpatient clinical experience following fellowship.
  • Experience with patient follow-up visits, chemotherapy management, and longitudinal care.
  • Ability to independently prepare detailed HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment & Plans.
  • Strong understanding of chemotherapy cycles, side-effect management, and laboratory result interpretation.
  • Familiarity with outpatient hematology-oncology workflows and patient-centered clinical communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ambient AI scribe solutions or EHR note templates.
  • Background in medical annotation, clinical documentation, or medical chart review.

jobs.description:
About us:

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Our purpose:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren’t just purchases, they’re the physical embodiment of the life you’ve worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, and now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

About the role:

Our next chapter is about growing from 5M to 50M customers by 2030. This year alone, we launched 5 new products, including home insurance, motorcycle insurance, and roadside assistance. Every new product, state, and marketing channel expansion requires regulatory and compliance adherence, as we operate in a highly regulated consumer industry.

That’s where our legal team comes in. We make sure Jerry can move fast without putting our customers, our partners, or our licenses at risk, and as Jerry grows tenfold, that work has to keep pace.

We are looking for a Legal Analyst, Operations & Automation to own the system that makes this possible. Reporting to our Legal Counsel, you will be responsible for Jerry’s compliance programs end to end, from marketing compliance audits and consumer escalations to tracking new regulations. Once you are very familiar with our current regulatory and compliance system, you will work on designing V2 using AI and automation, so that our legal team has more time to work on building new products and expanding into new markets.

This role is perfect for someone who wants to get hands-on legal operations experience before going to law school or someone who wants to eventually own compliance programs end-to-end and lead the people who run them.

Your day-to-day:

  • Compliance operations: Run, review, and quality-check the recurring compliance work, including entity maintenance, privacy requests, and licensing support, as the first point of contact for the teammates who run licensing and audit execution.

  • Marketing compliance and audits: Run TCPA and Do Not Call audits, monitor opt-outs, and keep marketing guidelines current. Check the accuracy of AI-powered audits, and design new audit programs with sampling plans and scoring rubrics.

  • Consumer escalations: Investigate complex escalations to their root cause, work with Product, Operations, and Engineering on the fix, and turn recurring issues into compliance training for teams across the company.

  • Regulatory change and readiness: Track regulatory changes, along with issues surfaced by complaints and audits, and see each one through to action. Keep Jerry ready to answer regulator inquiries, carrier audits, and partner diligence quickly.

  • Legal team support: Support contract reviews, legal research, and product reviews with intake, fact gathering, trackers, and follow-up.

  • Automation and AI: Replace manual legal tasks with AI and low-code workflows, and own the reliability of every script, report, and AI tool the team depends on.

Who we get excited about:

  • Proactive communicator: You flag problems early, send updates before anyone asks, and bring a recommendation when something needs a decision.

  • Meticulous: You catch the error everyone else missed, nothing gets past you.

  • AI Builder: You are an avid AI tool builder. You already automate most of your own recurring work, or you learn fast enough to start, and you always check what it produces before anyone relies on it.

  • Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside your swim lane.

  • Insatiable learner: You are constantly seeking to deepen your knowledge, sharpen your skills, and master whatever you’ve set your mind to.

What you bring:

  • No law degree required.

  • Experience in legal operations, compliance, paralegal work, insurance operations, audit, or related. Recent grads with an exceptionally exacting academic or project record are welcome.

  • Familiarity with insurance regulation, TCPA, or consumer privacy rules is a plus.

  • Clear, concise writing. You’ll draft responses that go to regulators.

  • Something you built with AI or automation to remove recurring work, which you can show us.

Compensation:

This position offers base salary and stock options. The base salary for this position is $65,000—$90,000, but we can be flexible based on your prior experience and appropriate job levelling. We also offer comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with 4% employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. jobs.description:
About Voyis:

Voyis designs and manufactures high performance underwater optical sensors (lasers, cameras, lights) for autonomous underwater vehicles that expand capability and enhance understanding in underwater surveys and ocean exploration. Our products have enabled our customers to survey more than 10,000km of ocean floor across all 7 continents, helping people better understand those remote, challenging environments. Our mission is to push the limits of what’s possible subsea and enable every subsea vehicle to see the depths like we see the surface.

Our underwater laser scanners, cameras and lights are proudly designed, engineered, and built in Waterloo, Canada. Voyis operates under ownership of Kraken Robotics Group.

What you’ll do:

In the role of Technical Sales Associate - Offshore Energy at Voyis, you will be working closely with the Head of Market to perform both inbound and outbound sales for the organization. In most cases, you will be the customer’s first point of contact and the driving force in developing a solution to solve their inspection requirements using Voyis’ products and capabilities.

Responsibilities include the identification of new sales opportunities, communication with prospective customers to understand all project requirements, and manage coordination with partner organizations or sales channels and internal stakeholders to effectively solve the customer’s inspection needs. Solving our customer’s challenges will require you to follow our internal sales process and generate proposals, presentations, or other collateral to effectively convey the solution on behalf of Voyis. In the Technical Sales Associate role, you will report to our Heads of Market and will support identifying/engaging with targeted accounts, and expanding revenue generated within a designated market.

You will interface with marketing and product teams to develop a strong understanding of the product offering and how Voyis’ capabilities can support your customers. A significant level of international travel is expected with the role to attend industry events, customers, and tradeshows on behalf of Voyis.

We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, takes initiative, and works hard to deliver results, while fully taking ownership of driving new sales for the organization. Prior sales experience is not required for the role, however, we are looking for a candidate who is open to engaging in a collaborative, education based sales approach with a strong technical foundation. We are a small team with many exciting opportunities. Everyone is encouraged to step outside of their defined role to help us achieve our goals together.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Become the central point of contact for all external stakeholders in new sales opportunities, helping customers solve their inspection requirements with Voyis’ capabilities.
  • Work with the Heads of Market to execute the industry’s sales strategy in conjunction with marketing and product teams.
  • Identify and engage with the key industry targeted accounts and partners in an effort to expand sales growth.
  • Generate bespoke quotations, proposals, presentations, and other sales collateral to effectively educate and communicate how Voyis’ solution meets our customer’s project requirements.
  • Diligently maintain CRM customer details and deal funnel for adequate sales forecasting.
  • Work closely with Voyis’ marketing and Heads of Markets to identify gaps in industry content, and to support creation of engaging market specific materials.
  • Travel internationally and domestically to attend industry events, trade shows, and visit customer facilities in order to build a strong presence in the market and to further strengthen customer/partner relationships.
  • Continuously engage with customers, post sale, to ensure the customer is satisfied with Voyis’ delivery and to identify expansion opportunities for repeat sales.

Skills you will bring to the table:

  • Post-secondary education in Engineering, Science, or a related technical field
  • 1–3 years of experience in a technical sales or business development role, preferably in underwater industries

jobs.description:
About Continuity

At Continuity, we’re building AI-native solutions that are redefining how insurers assess, monitor, and act on risk in the €1T+ commercial insurance industry.

In today’s world, insurers are expected to make complex, high-stakes decisions, often with outdated tools and fragmented data. We're rewriting that reality. Our platform combines specialized AI, structured data, and underwriting expertise to empower insurers with the clarity, speed, and confidence they need to take smarter risks, faster.

As the trusted partner of leading commercial P&C insurers, Continuity enables underwriting teams to:

  • Instantly detect and qualify risks

  • Keep portfolios up to date in real-time

  • Automate and accelerate decision-making from quote to bind

Our SaaS platform turns complex and scattered data into a clear, actionable interface, allowing underwriters to focus on what matters most: client relationships, portfolio profitability, and precision at scale.

Backed by a €10M Series A round in 2024, we are now scaling internationally and doubling down on innovation. With more than 50% of our team dedicated to R&D, we’re exploring the frontiers of AI in insurance, from intelligent agents to adaptive underwriting workflows, to fundamentally transform how insurance operates.

Joining Continuity means joining a high-impact, fast-growing team where your work shapes the future of risk intelligence. We’re not just building better tools, we’re helping the industry operate with a new level of intelligence.

Explore more atContinuity

What do we promote?

Our strong commitments include to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. Our cultural drivers {empathy, impact, innovation, and collaboration} guide us as we work together to create meaningful change. This is why we focus on the skills and potential you bring, rather than just your academic background or past experiences.

We believe that talent is shaped by diverse life journeys, and we’re excited to see how yours can contribute to our team while uncovering new perspectives and opportunities for growth together!

Role overview:

Germany is not a test. It's a commitment.

Our pipeline is live. Our first clients are onboard. The commercial momentum is real and we are now looking for the person who will turn that momentum into lasting, measurable client success.

This is not a support role. This is a builder position. You will work in close partnership with our Head of BD DACH, owning everything that happens from the first client handshake through to long-term value delivery. You will be the operational backbone of our DACH expansion, the person who makes sure that what we promise, we deliver.

If you thrive at the intersection of client trust, structured execution, and commercial impact, this role was designed for you.

⟟ Location: Germany or France (flexible) ✈︎ Regular travel required across Europe and France

Start by listening, then make it happen

One of our core beliefs at Continuity is that the best outcomes start with the deepest understanding. In this role, that means genuinely listening to what our clients need, not just what they say, and translating it into action that creates real value.
You will engage directly with senior decision-makers at leading insurers: CUOs, COOs, Heads of Underwriting. You will run workshops, challenge assumptions, and earn the kind of trust that turns a first contract into a long-term partnership. Your ability to hold the narrative in front of a room, and to listen carefully before you do, will define your impact.

Responsibilities:

Client Delivery & Deployment: Own the full client journey from needs assessment to operational go-live. You lead setup, coordinate with underwriters, facilitate workshops, and manage the client-facing narrative at every stage, with the rigour of a consultant and the energy of a builder.

POV Process Management: Drive Proof of Value processes for prospects not yet signed. You structure the deliverables, challenge the risk alerts, and make sure every POV builds a compelling, data-backed business case.

Paris / DACH Communication Bridge: You are the connective tissue between our German clients and our Paris delivery and product teams. Information flows clearly and nothing falls through the cracks - because you made sure of it.

Legal & Admin Coordination: Handle the contractual volume that comes with opening a new market - NDAs, DPAs, GDPR - with rigor and efficiency.

Commercial Expansion: Work alongside the Head of BD DACH to identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts. Every successful deployment is a potential success story, and you know how to build one.

Product Feedback Loop: Collaborate with our technical team on platform configuration and bring client insights back into the product roadmap. You are the voice of the DACH market internally.

Value Analysis: Turn platform data into high-impact business recommendations that demonstrate ROI, deepen relationships, and make clients want to expand.

Make a measurable impact, from day one
We don't hire for potential and then put people in a corner. We hire people who are wired to execute, to deliver, and to raise the bar.
At 3 months, you will have full platform fluency, ownership of existing DACH accounts, and be fully embedded in our Paris workflows. At 6–9 months, you will be running deployments autonomously, driving a structured POV process, and identifying the first expansion opportunities in your accounts.
We care about results. We also care about how you get there, with rigour, ownership, and the kind of positive energy that makes hard things look manageable.

What you bring:

3 to 7 years of experience from a high-performance environment: Strategy, Ops, M&A, Consulting, or equivalent. We care about the standard you've held yourself to, not the logo on your CV.

Strong quantitative skills: Excel and data analytics proficiency are non-negotiable. A data-crunch case study is part of our selection process - come prepared.

Native or near-native German and fluent English are essential. French is a bonus.

A Trusted Advisor posture: equally comfortable running a client workshop, analysing a dataset, and challenging a C-level assumption in the same afternoon.

Startup appetite: you don't need a playbook to get started. You write your own.

Output orientation: you take ownership, move fast, and close the loop, every time.

Insurance experience is a bonus but not required. A structured 3-month onboarding will get you fluent in our industry, our platform, and our clients.

We are one team, even across borders
At Continuity, "We Are One Team" is not a value we put on a slide and forget. It is the operating principle that makes everything else possible.
In this role, you will be the living proof of that principle across two geographies. You will bridge cultures, languages, and working styles, between Paris and Frankfurt/Munich, between product and client, between what was promised and what gets delivered. The ability to connect people, share context, and keep everyone moving in the same direction is not a soft skill here. It is a core competency.
You will not be alone. You will have the full support of our Head of BD DACH, our Paris delivery teams, and our leadership, all of whom are invested in making the DACH market work.

Build the future, with us
Germany is the beginning of something larger. As the DACH market scales, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your impact within the Revenue organisation.
We are not looking for someone to hold the fort. We are looking for someone who sees what this market could become and has the drive, the rigour, and the entrepreneurial instinct to help us get there.

Interview process

➀ Introduction video call with (45')

➁ Meet your future leader (60')

➂ Prepare & present a Business Case ; meet cross team members (150')
➃ Meet cross team members & executive leaders (90')

🎉WELCOME TO =>CONTINUITY🙌

What we offer

We're here to support you in finding balance, no matter your personal circumstances.

We’re committed to providing you with the resources, opportunities, and support you need to develop your skills and achieve your full potential.
