jobs.excerpt: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa's fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 24 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of naira in transactions monthly.
jobs.description:
About us

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa's fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 24 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About this role

The Head, Operations & Compliance Audit is responsible for leading, managing, and executing comprehensive, risk-based internal audit engagements across operational, financial, compliance, and corporate support functions of Moniepoint Microfinance Bank. Grounded in professional standards (IIA, CBN Guidelines), you will provide independent, objective assurance and consulting services to Executive Management and the Board Finance, Audit & Risk Committee (FARCO). The primary mandate is to evaluate and enhance the effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, financial reporting integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency across all assigned domains.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, execute, and continuously update the annual risk-based internal audit plan for all assigned business units and supporting functions, aligning with the Bank's risk assessment framework.
  • Provide strategic insights to senior management and the Board Audit Committee on material risks, control weaknesses, and emerging exposures.
  • Drive continuous auditing, data analytics, and automation to improve audit coverage, detect revenue leakage, and identify duplicate or unauthorized ledger postings.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of auditors overseeing finance, fraud management, regulatory compliance, and branch operations.
  • Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) across core banking and ERP modules, as well as bank-wide cost optimization frameworks.
  • Oversee fraud risk screens, assess anti-fraud controls and whistle-blowing mechanisms, and ensure immediate escalation of established fraud cases.
  • Evaluate compliance with Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) regulations, the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA), and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CFT) frameworks.
  • Manage routine and unannounced audits across the branch network, vendor lifecycle, corporate governance processes, and enterprise marketing spend.
  • Ensure all working papers, audit programs, compliance tests, and draft reports adhere strictly to IIA Standards.

Experience & background

  • Minimum of 12-15 years progressive internal audit, control, or risk management experience within Financial Services (Fintech, Microfinance Banking, Deposit Money Banks).
  • Minimum of 5 years in a senior supervisory or managerial role leading internal audit teams.
  • Proven track record in revenue assurance, financial controls, branch operations audit, and regulatory compliance.
  • Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc. / HND) in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields (Master's Degree is an added advantage).

Skills & competencies

  • Mandatory professional qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent; specialized certifications (CIA, CISA, CFE, or CRISC) are highly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of CBN regulations, MFB Prudential Guidelines, Consumer Protection Framework, AML/CFT Regulations, NDPA, and IIA International Standards.
  • Advanced expertise in exploratory, predictive, and prescriptive data analytics and automated audit working paper tools.
  • Sound knowledge of core banking systems, general ledger integrity, financial statements, and payment workflows.
  • Uncompromising integrity, unwavering commitment to independence, and exceptional executive communication skills for board-level (FARCO) reporting.

What success looks like in the role

  • A comprehensively executed annual risk-based internal audit plan that aligns perfectly with the Bank's risk framework.
  • Quality assurance, working papers, and draft reports that adhere strictly to IIA Standards.
  • Proactive assessment of risks and accurate immediate escalation of material exposures and fraud cases to the CAO and Management.
  • High-performing and continuously developing internal audit teams delivering cross-functional process audits that successfully identify control gaps and bottlenecks.

Why join us

  • Shape the governance, risk management, and operational efficiency of one of Africa's fastest-growing fintechs.
  • Provide strategic, board-level impact by directly advising the Board Finance, Audit & Risk Committee (FARCO) and Executive Management.
  • Lead diverse audit portfolios ranging from financial and regulatory compliance to enterprise marketing and branch operations.

Our OT Security practice works at the intersection of operational technology and cybersecurity—helping critical infrastructure owners across energy, utilities, oil & gas, manufacturing, water, and life sciences defend what matters most.

The Work

As an OT Cybersecurity Consultant, you will lead and support hands-on security engagements across industrial environments. You will assess, design, and help implement security solutions across OT/ICS ecosystems—working directly with client engineers, operators, and security teams to reduce risk without disrupting operations. You are equally comfortable in a substation, a control room, and a boardroom. Beyond client delivery, you will contribute as a subject matter expert on active pursuits—helping Accenture win new OT security work while maintaining excellence on your own engagements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Conduct OT/ICS security assessments against frameworks including NERC CIP, IEC 62443/ISA-99, NIST CSF, DOE C2M2, and client-specific requirements

  • Evaluate client security posture across the Purdue Model layers—identifying gaps in network segmentation, remote access, asset inventory, and detection coverage

  • Deploy and configure OT-native security tooling including network security monitoring platforms (e.g., Dragos, Claroty, Nozomi) and asset discovery tools (e.g., Dragos, RunZero, NetRise)

  • Perform OT-specific threat hunting, indicator of compromise analysis, and incident response support in ICS/SCADA environments

  • Develop detailed security assessment reports, risk registers, and remediation roadmaps tailored to operational and business context

  • Support OT security program development including governance frameworks, policies, and procedures aligned to client maturity goals

  • Collaborate with client IT/OT teams, system integrators, and OEM vendors to drive practical security outcomes

  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on active OT security pursuits—contributing to RFP responses, solution reviews, and proposal content while balancing client delivery commitments

  • Contribute to Accenture's OT Security practice through reusable assets, methods, and delivery excellence across engagements

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need

  • Minimum 5 years of cybersecurity experience
  • 1 year of experience in OT/ICS environments (e.g., electric utilities, oil & gas, manufacturing, water/wastewater, power generation, natural gas, life sciences, data center OT)
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus points if you have

  • Hands-on experience with ICS technologies including SCADA, DCS, EMS/ADMS, RTUs, PLCs, HMIs, and industrial communications protocols
  • Experience with common ICS/OT protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850, PROFINET, OPC, EtherNet/IP, etc.)
  • Experience deploying and operating OT security sensor platforms (Dragos, Claroty, Nozomi, Armis) in live operational environments
  • Experience producing and presenting security deliverables, assessment reports, and findings to technical and executive audiences
  • Experience consulting to Fortune/Global 1000 clients or within utilities, oil & gas, manufacturing, or other critical infrastructure verticals
  • Experience assessing against NERC CIP, IEC 62443, NIST CSF, DOE C2M2, or sector-specific OT security frameworks
  • Experience with asset discovery and OT network visibility tools (RunZero, NetRise, Dragos Platform)
  • OT/ICS network infrastructure experience (industrial firewalls, data diodes, switches, Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell, etc.)

  • Experience with MITRE ATT&CK for ICS and applying TTPs to detection engineering or threat modeling

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.

Role overview

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to own the administration and security of our core tools, from Okta and Google Workspace to Slack, ClickUp and the AI tools our teams use every day. Our team is fully remote and works with a Bring Your Own Device policy, which makes for some interesting security challenges.

In your first months, you’ll take part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company. You’ll then help us harden our infrastructure, automate onboarding and offboarding, and keep a close eye on security as we scale.

You’ll have opportunity to drive your own initiatives, and you’ll also be the first point of contact when colleagues need help with access or tools. If you have strong foundations in at least one area and enjoy learning the rest, you’ll have a lot of independence, a budget for state-of-the-art tooling, and room to grow into a team lead role as the team scales.

Responsibilities

Security Tool Rollout

  • Take key part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company
  • Evaluate tools and present recommendations to the CTO and IT Director
  • Apply security baselines across tools and devices

Identity & Access Management

  • Own the administration of Okta, including SSO, MFA and integrations with our tools
  • Manage access to new software and AI tools through Okta
  • Run regular access reviews and fix permissions that don’t match current roles

As a People Safety & Resilience Manager at GitLab, you'll help protect team members working from home, in Labs, and in coworking spaces. What you’ll do

  • Run the occupational health and safety management system in line with ISO 45001. Put the global policy into practice through hazard identification, risk and ergonomic assessments, incident reporting and investigation, performance measurement, internal audits, and management reviews.

  • Coordinate crisis response and disaster relief. Keep the crisis plan and records current, with a lead and alternate for every role. During on-call shifts, follow escalation procedures and support the crisis team until the response ends. Work with the relief partner to track the Team Member Disaster Relief fund balance and handle communications and reporting.
  • Maintain continuity plans for the People Group, assess the impact of disruptions, and prioritize recovery of essential services. Keep records for auditors and insurers, run crisis and continuity exercises, lead required reviews after incidents, and track follow-up actions until they're complete.
  • Assess each requirement in ISO 45001, ISO 22361, and ISO 22301. Each week, review the scores produced by AI agents and correct any errors. Set deadlines for improvements and report quarterly on the safety and resilience measures in the People Safety & Security scorecard.
  • Lead people safety and crisis response on site at major company events alongside security operations. Confirm emergency procedures and medical arrangements are in place, serve as the crisis team's on-site contact, and lead a review after each event.

What you’ll bring

  • Ability to apply ISO 45001, ISO 22361, ISO 22301, the ANSI/ASIS workplace violence prevention standard, and the European Union framework directive on safety and health at work when drafting policies and procedures with legal and compliance partners and external advisers.
  • Experience managing programs across teams, including assigning owners and deadlines, tracking regulatory changes, and preparing records for audits.
  • Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) agents to draft materials, score assessments, and update records, and checking their results against the standards. Ability to keep that work repeatable by tracking changes to prompts and workflows in GitLab.
  • Ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time to support company events, run exercises, and attend health and safety committee meetings in person. These commitments can fall in the evenings or on weekends.
  • Availability outside standard working hours as part of a scheduled on-call duty rotation and when the crisis management plan is activated, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Experience managing consultations across Germany, the Netherlands, and France is strongly preferred because you'll work under each country's rules. Safety or business continuity credentials, ISO 45001 or ISO 22301 lead implementer or auditor qualifications, and works council or labor relations training are also helpful.

We work with Employment Law, People Compliance, Benefits, the crisis management team, team member representatives, and external partners. jobs.title: Solutions Architect, AI Infrastructure (SF/NYC, Hybrid)
jobs.excerpt: Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent.
jobs.description:
Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company

Our client builds cloud infrastructure that helps AI teams run open models in production. Developers can call models through a serverless API, deploy them on dedicated endpoints, or run their own inference containers on GPU infrastructure. The same platform supports fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and large-scale pre-training when teams need to adapt a model or build one of their own.

That breadth matters when a customer has to decide whether an open model can handle a production workload. The platform gives engineering teams several ways to test and deploy a model, and the company’s AI systems researchers turn performance improvements into tools customers can use.

The Mission

Make it practical for engineering teams to run, adapt, and own the models behind their products. Help customers take an open-model workload from a technical idea to something they can deploy and operate at scale.

The Opportunity

As a Solutions Architect, you’ll own the technical side of pre-sales and stay involved as customers move toward production. Inference is the main focus, with opportunities to work on post-training and GPU infrastructure. One engagement might have you diagnosing a bottleneck on a dedicated endpoint; another might have you helping a customer move an application from a closed model to an open one.

You’ll work with a group of Account Executives across qualified opportunities. They lead the commercial process; you own technical discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept execution, and the technical recommendation.

What You'll Do

  • Work directly with customers’ technical and business stakeholders to understand their workloads and design solutions around open models.

  • Build and run hands-on proofs of concept across software and hardware. Benchmark workloads, find bottlenecks, tune deployments, and present the measured results.

  • Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities and guide customers through architecture, security, and deployment decisions.

  • Stay involved through early production. Lead some customers through launch and collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on larger accounts.

  • Bring customer feedback to Product, Engineering, and Research. Create useful technical content, demos, playbooks, and tooling.

What You Bring

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles, including at least 2 years in pre-sales, such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, or sales engineering.

  • Experience personally building, running, and presenting technical proofs of concept, with an example of what you built or tuned and what changed as a result.

  • Hands-on benchmarking, bottleneck analysis, and performance tuning in inference, databases, or distributed systems.

  • Working knowledge of open-source LLMs across inference, fine-tuning, and deployment.

  • Direct experience working with digital-native or startup customers.

  • Ability to work four days per week in the San Francisco or New York City office.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at an AI inference, GPU cloud, or data infrastructure company, or on a startup- or generative AI-focused team at a hyperscaler.

  • Experience building agents or tuning retrieval-augmented generation pipelines or coding harnesses, including model selection and deployment.

  • A technical degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work or technical bootcamp experience.

  • Technical writing or public speaking experience.

Key Success Drivers

  • Technical ownership: You can take a customer problem from a first conversation to a working POC and explain which decisions and changes were yours.

  • Performance judgment: You know what to measure, how to isolate a bottleneck, and how to make a recommendation based on the results.

  • Customer communication: You can work through implementation details with engineers and explain the tradeoffs to the people making the decision.

Why Join?

  • Work directly on production inference problems with AI-native teams, from model migration to performance tuning.

  • Stay with customers beyond the technical win and see how your recommendations hold up in production.

  • Work alongside Product, Engineering, and Research, with a direct path to share what customers need.

  • Earn $175,000-$210,000 in base salary, with $250,000-$300,000 in on-target earnings and competitive equity. Final compensation depends on experience and interview performance.

  • Take advantage of employer benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, flexible time off, parental leave, pre-tax health and flexible spending accounts, 401(k) matching, and life and disability coverage. Benefits are subject to plan eligibility and terms.

Interviewing Process

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager screen (30 min)

  3. Team interviews (60 min)

  4. Sales presentation / case study (45 min)

  5. Leadership interview (30 min)

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $250K - $300K

jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Role

We're hiring a Principal Cloud Platform Engineer to join the Cloud Platform organization, which owns JumpCloud's cloud infrastructure, developer experience, and edge and traffic engineering.

This is a hands-on principal role. You'll write production code and you'll run what you build. You'll set the technical direction for the platform that keeps JumpCloud available at 99.99% across regions, and you'll raise the engineering bar for everyone around you. We want someone who is as comfortable designing and shipping a platform service as they are leading a major incident at 2 a.m.

What You'll Be Doing :

  • Set the technical direction and multi-year architecture for JumpCloud's cloud platform across AWS and GCP, covering compute, networking, Kubernetes, data stores, and edge.

  • Write production-grade Go or Python as a regular part of the job: platform services, Kubernetes controllers and operators, internal APIs, CLIs, and automation that removes manual work.

  • Build and evolve our internal developer platform, including golden paths, self-service provisioning, and CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (Argo CD), so product teams can ship safely without filing tickets.

  • Own the design of multi-region architecture, failover automation, and disaster recovery, with RTO and RPO targets we actually test.

  • Operate what you build. Take part in on-call, act as the senior escalation point during major incidents, and turn blameless post-incident reviews into lasting fixes.

  • Define the reliability standards for the platform: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, production readiness reviews, and capacity planning that hold a 99.99% SLA as we grow.

  • Find and remove scalability bottlenecks across services, databases, queues, and network paths before customers feel them.

  • Shape edge and traffic engineering, including ingress, load balancing, DNS, CDN, WAF, and service mesh.

  • Lead our Infrastructure-as-Code architecture in Terraform across multi-account, multi-region environments, with policy-as-code guardrails for security and compliance.

  • Treat cost as a design input. Partner on FinOps, unit economics, and right-sizing so we scale efficiently.

  • Bring AI-assisted engineering (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) into platform work to speed up tooling, runbooks, and incident triage.

  • Write RFCs and architecture decision records, review designs across engineering, and mentor senior and staff engineers.

We're Looking For :

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE, or DevOps roles running 24/7 SaaS systems at scale.

  • Real development depth: You've designed, built, and shipped production services in Go, Python, or Java, not just scripts. You're strong in distributed systems design, APIs, concurrency, and testing.

  • Real operations depth: You've carried a pager for business-critical systems, led incident response, and debugged hard problems across the application, OS, network, and cloud layers.

  • Deep AWS expertise (GCP a plus): IAM, VPC design, Transit Gateway, ALB/NLB, Route 53, EKS, and managed data stores.

  • Production Kubernetes at scale: cluster lifecycle, networking, autoscaling, RBAC, operators and controllers, and GitOps with Argo CD.

  • Terraform mastery: module design, state management and refactoring, and multi-account patterns.

  • Observability and reliability: hands-on with Datadog, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; you've defined SLOs and cut MTTD and MTTR in a measurable way.

  • Principal-level influence: You've set direction across multiple teams without direct authority, written design docs that got adopted, and led large migrations to completion.

  • Clear writing and speaking, with engineers and with leadership. You can explain trade-offs in cost, risk, and time.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A strong team player who lives our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day.

Preferred Qualifications :

  • You've built an internal developer platform or developer portal (Backstage or similar) that teams chose to use.

  • Experience with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and proxies (Envoy, HAProxy, NGINX), plus CDN, WAF, and DDoS protection.

  • Experience scaling data layers such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or Kafka, including multi-region or active-active designs.

  • Chaos engineering or regular game days in staging and production.

  • Security depth: secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, External Secrets Operator), DevSecOps, zero-trust networking, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

  • Background in identity, IAM, directory services, or security-focused SaaS.

  • Open-source contributions, published writing, or conference talks on platform or reliability topics.

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.
Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.

Role overview

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to own the administration and security of our core tools, from Okta and Google Workspace to Slack, ClickUp and the AI tools our teams use every day. Our team is fully remote and works with a Bring Your Own Device policy, which makes for some interesting security challenges.

In your first months, you’ll take part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company. You’ll then help us harden our infrastructure, automate onboarding and offboarding, and keep a close eye on security as we scale.

You’ll have opportunity to drive your own initiatives, and you’ll also be the first point of contact when colleagues need help with access or tools. If you have strong foundations in at least one area and enjoy learning the rest, you’ll have a lot of independence, a budget for state-of-the-art tooling, and room to grow into a team lead role as the team scales.

Responsibilities

Security Tool Rollout

  • Take key part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company
  • Evaluate tools and present recommendations to the CTO and IT Director
  • Apply security baselines across tools and devices

Identity & Access Management

  • Own the administration of Okta, including SSO, MFA and integrations with our tools
  • Manage access to new software and AI tools through Okta
  • Run regular access reviews and fix permissions that don’t match current roles

Tool Administration

  • Administer Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp and AI assistant tools, including users, permissions and security settings
  • Track licences and flag unused or underused accounts
  • Maintain an up-to-date inventory of tools, accounts and admin roles

Automation

  • Automate onboarding so new joiners get the right access on day one
  • Automate offboarding so leavers lose access promptly and their data is handled correctly
  • Build integrations and workflows between tools using automation platforms or scripting

Security Monitoring & Support

  • Monitor security alerts, sign-in activity and admin logs, and act on issues
  • Work with our security and DevOps colleagues on infrastructure hardening
  • Handle first-line access requests and support tickets from colleagues
  • Investigate incidents, then record causes and fixes

Documentation

  • Document every tool, automation and process so others can understand and run it
  • Write clear guides for colleagues on access and security practices
  • Share regular progress updates and agree priorities with your manager

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering tools for organisations of 50+ people
  • Hands-on experience administering Okta (or equivalent IAM solution) and Google Workspace
  • A track record of driving IT or security initiatives, not only handling tickets
  • Willingness to handle requests from the team, helping keep tools and infrastructure running smoothly

Technical Skills

  • Solid understanding of identity and access management, including SSO, MFA and role-based access
  • Working knowledge of device management and endpoint protection
  • Ability to build workflows with automation platforms, APIs or scripting
  • Understanding of security good practice for SaaS tools and BYOD environments
  • Cybersecurity experience is a strong plus
  • An engineering degree is a plus
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills

  • Takes ownership and works independently in a less structured environment
  • Coachable and open to feedback
  • Explains technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues
  • Organised, prioritises well and follows through
  • Collaborative and low-ego team player

What we offer

  • Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid Vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office -We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff.

jobs.title: Director of Sales & Marketing
jobs.excerpt: Swimtopia supports every corner of competitive swimming, helping teams, leagues, clubs and meet hosts run their seasons and their meets.
jobs.description:
Swimtopia supports every corner of competitive swimming, helping teams, leagues, clubs and meet hosts run their seasons and their meets. We're a close-knit team with deep industry experience, known for best-in-class product quality and responsive, caring support. We're in growth mode and looking for an entrepreneurial, hands-on leader to scale our sales and marketing engine.

Our Vision: Own Swim: the undisputed technology market leader.

Our Purpose: Strengthening community through shared experiences.

The Role

The Director of Sales & Marketing owns revenue growth at Swimtopia: go-to-market strategy, positioning, new-logo pipeline and bookings, and demand generation. You'll build and lead both an enterprise-led sales motion (leagues, governing bodies and teams) and a marketing-led lead generation motion. Over time you'll make both far more repeatable, predictable and automated than they are today.

This is a leadership role, not a player-coach seat. You'll step into deals when that's the highest-leverage move and stay out when it isn't. You choose where your time moves the number most: the funnel, hands-on league deals, or deal structure. You'll also drive product adoption from the point of sale.

You'll report to the President and join the company's leadership team. You'll lead a tight-knit team with additional headcount additions planned as revenue grows.

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months

  • Growth: You've led the team to deliver our new revenue goals and built a go-to-market engine that scales with growth.
  • Pipeline and a plan to close it: You've defined and maintained adequate pipeline coverage quarter over quarter, with a documented, forward-looking 12-month sales and marketing plan and 2-3 quarters of forecasting visibility for when and how we'll generate pipeline and close opportunities.
  • Adoption at the sale: Bundles and premium tiers are sold at the time of sale, not bolted on afterward, and drive measurable revenue uplift.
  • Selling on value: One clear narrative is used across sales, customer success and product. We win on differentiation and product quality.
  • Proactive and automated: A seasonal campaign calendar is published a full quarter ahead, every product release has a launch campaign planned well before ship, and automated outbound and nurture are live for each primary segment.

What You'll Do

  • Set GTM strategy. Pressure-test our segments (B2B buyers plus the B2B2C audience of athletes and families) against real customer data. Recommend where to focus, split or stop, and drive execution once the call is made.
  • Own positioning. Define why we're different and better in the swim market, and get our own sales, customer success, product to use that story consistently. You'll partner with our brand and marketing counterparts, who own brand identity.
  • Build the sales engine. Create a repeatable, increasingly automated process for multi-stakeholder deals: qualification, stages, proposals, forecasting and multi-year agreements. Define the pipeline coverage needed to hit revenue targets, maintain it quarter over quarter, and build a 12-month sales and marketing plan that makes clear how we'll generate and close the pipeline. Hire, coach and ramp sellers, plan around our seasonal peak, and own the pipeline and forecast numbers.
  • Build the demand engine. Run lead generation, segment-specific content, outbound and nurture, and consumer-side acquisition that grows the mobile app and strengthens the B2B sale. Know which metrics predict revenue and move budget based on evidence.
  • Make adoption part of the sale. Package and price bundles, attach additional products where they fit, and structure multi-year agreements that hold price. Work with Product and Customer Success so adoption sticks after close.
  • Run the GTM systems. Own the CRM, marketing automation, outbound tooling and data definitions, with one source of truth from lead to conversion. Redesign work around automation and AI where it replaces manual effort.
  • Lead across the company. Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Support, and hold peers accountable in ways that strengthen the relationship.
  • Lead the team. Hire, develop and, when needed, move people out. Empower experienced team members to own their work.

Decision Rights

  • You decide: how your time and team capacity are split across motions; campaign and channel mix within budget; sales process, stages and qualification rules; tools within the approved GTM stack budget; and day-to-day management and hiring within approved headcount.
  • You'll align with leadership on: segment and ICP decisions; pricing, packaging and multi-year terms outside agreed guardrails; spend above budget and new headcount; changes to the sales comp plan; and brand identity and portfolio decisions.
  • Not in scope: the product roadmap, support, and brand identity and portfolio architecture. Account management and renewals may sit with you during a transition period but are expected to move over time.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • Track record owning a number: revenue, pipeline, or a quantified funnel component. You can explain exactly how it was created and what you personally did to influence it.
  • Experience making a prioritization call with data and defending it to peers who disagreed.
  • Experience leading or coaching people, and a specific example of challenging a boss or peer.
  • Growth mindset with a track record of learning fast and acting on hard feedback.
  • Experience selling or marketing to multi-stakeholder buyers, ideally in B2B vertical SaaS or community-oriented software.
  • Comfort building with a thin team and budget.
  • Strength in either sales or marketing, and at least a solid working ability in the other.

Nice to have

  • B2B2C experience: marketing or selling to both a business buyer and their end users, including growing a mobile app or subscription product.
  • Experience selling to governing bodies, associations or other volunteer-led, community-driven buyers.
  • Seasonal business experience, planning pipeline and campaigns around a peak.
  • Pricing and packaging experience, including multi-year agreements and bundles.
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience and experience hiring or ramping an AE, BDR or SDR.
  • Knowledge of swim, youth sports or camps.

We care about evidence, not pedigree or company size. If you've built something repeatable under real constraints, we want to hear from you.

How We Work

We're a tight-knit team with a big opportunity. You'll have real ownership and a seat at the leadership table, and we expect you to speak up, challenge ideas, and act on context nobody spelled out. We trust capable people to own their work, and we measure success as a team.

Location and Compensation

  • Role status: Exempt
  • Location: Remote within the U.S. Candidates in Denver/Boulder or Austin are preferred but not required.
  • Compensation: $150-175k on target earnings
  • Benfits: Medical, dental and vision coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 4%; five weeks of accrued PTO including flexible holidays, plus sick leave; paid parental leave for eligible employees; company-provided long-term disability coverage; and an annual technology and home office stipend.

Interview Process

Our process typically includes an initial screen, structured interviews with the hiring manager and cross-functional peers, a case study presentation, reference checks, and a final in-person day in Boulder, CO for finalists (all expenses paid).

About the Role

A Series A/B aerospace company is seeking a Senior Aerothermal Engineer to lead thermal and aerothermal design for spacecraft and hypersonic reentry vehicles. You will own thermal systems from early design through testing and qualification, helping ensure hardware performs reliably in extreme environments.

What You'll Do

  • Design and analyze thermal management systems for satellite components, spacecraft subsystems, payloads, and hypersonic reentry vehicles.

  • Own CAD assemblies, heat and mass transfer analyses, material selection, thermal budgets, and component layouts.

  • Model high-enthalpy, chemically reacting hypersonic flows using CFD tools.

  • Work with systems architects and design engineers to balance thermal requirements with vehicle-level needs, cost, and design constraints.

  • Develop thermal management solutions such as radiators, coolant loops, heaters, heat exchangers, and insulation systems, and evaluate suitable materials and suppliers.

  • Design thermal protection systems, heat shields, and advanced materials for high-temperature applications.

  • Lead assembly, integration, and testing of thermally sensitive hardware.

  • Manage thermal vacuum chambers and testing, and support arc jet and other environmental test activities.

  • Contribute to new spacecraft, engineering processes, and testing capabilities.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 7 years of experience designing and analyzing spacecraft thermal management systems or hypersonic reentry vehicle heat shields.

  • At least 3 years of hands-on thermal vacuum testing experience, including planning, setup, execution, and hardware qualification.

  • Expertise in heat and mass transfer analysis and thermal-fluid analysis tools, including CFD.

  • Experience designing radiators, coolant plates, heaters, heat exchangers, and insulation systems.

  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes for vacuum insulation, ablative materials, heaters, and heat exchangers.

  • Demonstrated ownership of technical projects from concept through implementation; experience with phase-change materials, vacuum-jacketed systems, or arc jet testing is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is $170,000 to $220,000 annually, plus equity. Benefits include health, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 401(k), and paid time off. Visa sponsorship policy was not provided.

Location

On-site in Los Angeles, California. Candidates must be based locally or willing to relocate.

Compensation Range: $170K - $220K

The mission of Shorthand is to create a beautifully informed world. To do that, we need to simplify professional visual storytelling for the web, otherwise it will remain prohibitively complex for iconic brands and institutions to elegantly inform and inspire their discerning audiences.

Our Account Managers are a big part of the Shorthand magic.

This role owns the commercial relationship for a Book of Business of existing customers across North America. About the role

Talkdesk partners sell and design Customer Experience Automation (CXA) solutions. This role makes sure they can deliver them. As the Applied AI Architect for EMEA, you are the design authority for partner-led paid pilots and production deployments of AI agents on the Talkdesk platform across the region.

You set the architecture, define what success looks like, and review the work at each gate. Where a use case or product area is new, you build it hands-on, then hand it to the partner. Your measure of success is a pilot that proves its value, reaches production, and leaves the partner able to deliver the next one alone.

This is a post-sales role on a new team. You will be the first senior Partner Delivery lead in EMEA, so you will work with a high degree of autonomy and help shape how Talkdesk works with partners on delivery.

What you'll do

Lead paid pilots

  • Scope each pilot with the partner and customer: use cases, success criteria, evaluation plan and the exit criteria for production.
  • Design the agent architecture: multi-agent orchestration, knowledge and retrieval, tools and integrations, guardrails and human handoff.
  • Account for data residency, GDPR and EU AI Act requirements in every design.
  • Build the hard parts hands-on when the pattern is new, then transfer the work to the partner team.
  • Report results against the success criteria and give a clear go or no-go recommendation for production.

Guide delivery to production

  • Run design reviews at discovery and pre-go-live gates across about 10 active partner projects, working hands-on in two or three at a time.
  • Review partner configurations, test results and evaluation results before go-live.
  • Act as the regional technical escalation point. Resolve what you can, and route the rest to Voice Engineering, Product and Engineering, or Professional Services.
  • Recognize when a project has outgrown partner-led scope and move it to Talkdesk delivery teams under agreed rules of engagement.

Make partners self-sufficient

  • Launch the partner certification program in EMEA, certify partner architects, and run onsite and virtual workshops.
  • Build reference architectures, design patterns and delivery playbooks from what works in the field.
  • Work closely with the EMEA Partner Solutions Engineering team so partners get a consistent handover from pre-sales to delivery.
  • Bring recurring patterns and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.
  • Support partners in other regions, such as APAC, when needed.

  • 8+ years in solution architecture, professional services or technical delivery for CCaaS or customer experience platforms, including leading enterprise implementations to go-live.

Dragonfli Group is a cybersecurity and IT consulting firm providing services to federal agencies and Fortune 100 enterprises. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Dragonfli supports clients in securing mission-critical systems across on-site, hybrid, and fully remote environments.

You will also support validation of CISA WAS and FAST findings, KEV exposure items, and coordinate retesting to confirm closure, using approved AI-enabled tools to improve reconnaissance and ATT&CK/ATLAS mapping while maintaining human oversight. This role calls for approximately 5 to 8 years of relevant experience leading or independently executing penetration testing engagements.

You’ll partner with leaders across the company to define roles before they open, set the bar, and push back when a search needs a different approach.

This role starts as a three-month contract with a direct path to permanent employment. During the contract, you and the team get to see how you work together before making a longer-term commitment.

Why You Will (Or Won’t) Like Working Here

  • True ownership: You’ll report to our Director of Talent and own full-cycle recruiting for mid-to-senior and leadership searches. You won’t hand searches off or wait for a committee to approve your outreach. The search is yours.

  • A high bar: The wrong hire can set a function back by a year. You’ll be expected to push back on hiring leaders, challenge weak slates, and hold the standard when there’s pressure to fill quickly.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to build the trading platform our clients use every day. The team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust, from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who takes on the hardest problems and delivers them under their own steam. You'll own complex, ambiguous, performance-critical work end-to-end — designed, built, tested, deployed, and supported in production. You lead through code, craft, and mentoring, setting the technical example the rest of the team calibrates to. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Complex full-stack features in TypeScript and Rust — from trader-facing interfaces to the application services behind them

  • Real-time market-data presentation and high-throughput, low-latency application code across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency

  • React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar) for demanding, data-dense trading interfaces

  • Distributed systems and real-time data over REST, WebSockets, and network protocols

  • Architecture and solution design for the hardest technical problems the team faces

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make frontend behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong full-stack engineering ability with deep TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+) (5+ years)

  • Solid experience with React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of Rust, or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack

  • Strong grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols such as TCP/UDP and binary protocols)

  • Comfortable reasoning about architecture and making defensible technical trade-offs

  • Python for scripting, automation, and tooling is a bonus

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You run with things. Give you an ambiguous, complex problem and you drive it to done without being managed through it. Senior here means trusted, not just experienced

  • You have range. You're not just strong in the familiar parts of the stack — you pick up the unfamiliar and hold your own on the hardest work

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You review peers' work thoughtfully, mentor the engineers around you through the craft, and set a standard others calibrate to

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

  • Experience with Handlebars

  • Experience with Sales Cloud / Service Cloud

  • Experience with Agentforce

The project focuses on developing and maintaining a Salesforce-based marketing technology ecosystem that connects customer data, marketing automation, and personalized multi-channel communication.

  • Configure and manage Salesforce Data Cloud, including data streams, data model objects, identity resolution, calculated insights, and segments

  • Develop and maintain Salesforce Flow automations

  • Enhance existing solutions built with Visualforce and Apex

  • Build and maintain multi-channel campaigns and customer journeys in Marketing Cloud

  • Develop dynamic and personalized marketing content using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and/or Handlebars

  • Integrate Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud with Sales Cloud, Google Analytics, and external systems

  • Support consent, preference management, and marketing compliance requirements

  • Apply and maintain email deliverability best practices

  • Build reporting solutions and dashboards

  • Troubleshoot issues related to customer data, Salesforce Flows, integrations, campaigns, and email sending

  • Collaborate with marketing, IT, and business teams to translate requirements into reliable technical solutions

jobs.title: Director, Finance Systems & ERP
jobs.excerpt: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter.
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. The team is responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, and supporting technologies such as Avalara, along with the integrations, data, automation, and engineering capabilities that connect these platforms across the enterprise.

As Director, Finance Systems & ERP, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Smartsheet’s financial technology ecosystem and define the long-term technical strategy for how these platforms evolve. You will own the architecture, engineering maturity, technical health, and delivery of systems supporting core financial operations, procurement, planning, payments, billing, revenue processes, and emerging monetization models.

This is a strategic and highly visible technology leadership role. You will lead major transformation initiatives including ERP modernization, billing transformation, and the evolution toward usage-based and consumption-based monetization. You will represent Corporate Systems in executive steering committees and major transformation programs, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, and other technology leaders.

You will partner closely with Product Managers across Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to combine business and product strategy with a forward-looking technical strategy. You will be expected to challenge legacy architectures and operating models, identify opportunities to simplify and automate financial processes, and determine how modern software engineering, enterprise data, automation, and AI can improve how Finance technology operates.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leaders across the organization.

You Will:

  • Own the technical strategy and long-term architecture for Smartsheet’s financial systems ecosystem across ERP, procurement, financial planning, payments, billing, tax, revenue processes, integrations, data, automation, and AI
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Financial Systems Engineering organization responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, and associated technologies
  • Serve as the senior technology leader for NetSuite and ERP, ensuring the platform and surrounding architecture remain scalable, maintainable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the long-term needs of a complex SaaS business
  • Provide technology leadership for major Finance transformation programs, including ERP reimplementation and modernization, establishing architecture, engineering standards, technical governance, delivery practices, and long-term platform direction
  • Partner with Product Managers for Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to translate product strategy and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture, investment decisions, and executable engineering plans
  • Shape the technology architecture required to support evolving SaaS monetization models, including subscription, multi-year, usage-based, consumption-based, and AI-related pricing and billing models
  • Partner across Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Corporate Systems to ensure pricing and packaging strategies can be represented reliably from quote and entitlement through provisioning, usage, billing, accounting, and revenue processes
  • Establish clear architectural boundaries and systems of record across CRM, product, billing, ERP, payments, tax, planning, and downstream data platforms, reducing ambiguity, duplication, and unnecessary coupling
  • Define the strategy for Finance systems data, including authoritative sources, data models, data contracts, quality, lineage, reconciliation, historical integrity, and reliable consumption by the enterprise data platform
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to integrate Financial Systems with the enterprise data lake and ensure Finance data is timely, trustworthy, well-defined, and usable for financial reporting, operational analytics, reconciliation, and AI
  • Drive stronger data quality and observability across Quote-to-Cash and Finance workflows, moving the organization from reactive reconciliation toward proactive detection and prevention of data integrity issues
  • Establish an AI strategy for Financial Systems Engineering, identifying practical opportunities to improve engineering productivity, financial operations, controls, testing, support, reconciliation, and employee experiences
  • Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted and agentic capabilities where appropriate, while ensuring financial integrity, security, auditability, human oversight, and appropriate controls for higher-risk processes
  • Develop a strategy for automated testing and quality engineering across the Finance technology stack, including regression testing, integration testing, data validation, reconciliation, and AI-assisted test generation and analysis
  • Establish modern engineering practices across enterprise platforms, including source control, peer review, CI/CD, environment management, automated testing, observability, documentation, release engineering, and operational readiness where supported by the underlying technologies
  • Determine appropriate boundaries between native SaaS configuration, platform extensibility, APIs, integrations, automation, and custom software, avoiding unnecessary customization while enabling capabilities the business requires
  • Partner with Integration Engineering to ensure critical Finance and Quote-to-Cash integrations use scalable patterns, explicit contracts, appropriate observability, resilient error handling, and well-defined operational ownership
  • Own the technical health and lifecycle of the Financial Systems portfolio, proactively addressing architectural debt, platform limitations, fragile integrations, unnecessary customization, manual processes, and recurring operational problems
  • Establish architecture reviews, technical standards, engineering metrics, platform health reviews, and other mechanisms that continuously improve the maturity of Financial Systems Engineering
  • Represent Financial Systems Engineering on executive steering committees, transformation governance forums, and major program reviews, clearly communicating architecture decisions, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and tradeoffs
  • Provide technical leadership across implementation partners and strategic vendors, ensuring system integrators and software providers operate within Smartsheet’s architecture, engineering, security, and delivery expectations rather than allowing vendors to define the long-term architecture
  • Partner with Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Tax, Revenue, and other stakeholders to understand business strategy while maintaining clear technology ownership of architecture and engineering decisions
  • Balance delivery of major transformation programs with operational reliability, roadmap commitments, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, security, controls, and long-term engineering investments
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, Security, AI & Automation, and Corporate Systems to ensure Financial Systems operate as part of a coherent enterprise architecture
  • Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent with a combination of Finance platform expertise, software engineering capability, systems thinking, and curiosity about the future of financial technology

You Have:

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across financial systems, enterprise application engineering, ERP, software engineering, systems architecture, or related technical disciplines
  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams, including experience managing managers, senior engineers, architects, or other technical leaders
  • Deep experience with NetSuite or comparable enterprise ERP platforms, with sufficient technical depth to lead architecture, challenge implementation decisions, and establish long-term platform strategy
  • Demonstrated experience leading a major ERP implementation, reimplementation, or transformation program from architecture and design through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing evolution
  • Strong understanding of financial business processes including record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, billing, payments, financial planning, accounting, and revenue-related workflows
  • Experience with financial platforms such as Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, or comparable ERP, procurement, planning, payments, billing, tax, or monetization technologies
  • Experience with SaaS billing and monetization architectures, including subscription and usage-based or consumption-based business models
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason across ERP, CRM, product, billing, payments, integrations, data platforms, APIs, automation, and financial controls as a connected architecture
  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy and architecture, rather than solely managing enterprise application delivery, configuration, implementation partners, or support
  • Experience designing or evolving enterprise data architecture, including systems of record, data models, interfaces, contracts, quality, reconciliation, governance, lineage, and downstream consumption
  • Experience partnering with enterprise Data Engineering or Analytics organizations and integrating operational systems with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise data technologies
  • Experience establishing modern engineering practices within enterprise application environments, including automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, release management, documentation, and operational readiness
  • Understanding of modern AI capabilities and the ability to identify practical applications of LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation while appropriately managing financial, security, and compliance risk
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, auditability, security, data integrity, and compliance considerations associated with business-critical financial platforms
  • Experience governing system integrators and technology vendors during large transformation programs, including the ability to challenge proposed architectures and hold partners accountable for engineering quality
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and senior business leaders to combine business strategy, product strategy, and technical strategy into coherent roadmaps and investment decisions
  • Ability to operate comfortably from executive steering committee discussions to detailed architecture reviews, translating effectively between business executives, Finance leaders, Product Managers, engineers, architects, and implementation partners
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge legacy processes and architectures constructively and lead organizations through significant technology and operating-model change
  • Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills, with demonstrated executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technology decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

$175,000—$290,000 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

jobs.excerpt: About this role: Our clients, General Counsel/Chief Legal Officers or the senior-most individuals responsible for Legal responsibilities, amongst others e.
jobs.description:
About this role:

Our clients, General Counsel/Chief Legal Officers or the senior-most individuals responsible for Legal responsibilities, amongst others e.g. compliance, audit, and enterprise risk management, find themselves challenged with the pace of change within the Legal function and their respective organizations as companies continue to focus on developing digital dexterity, managing shifting business models and serving evolving customer and workforce expectations. With the support of their Executive Partner, our Gartner for General Counsel (GC) clients more adeptly assess the changes needed within their organization, manage legal and related risks more effectively, achieve their goals more quickly, and operate with a higher assurance of success. As an Executive Partner, you will have the opportunity to deliver solutions for the most critical legal, governance, and risk management challenges facing companies across all industries.

Partnering with our clients means that no two days are the same; you could be supporting the development of the overall legal department strategy and long-term vision, providing recommendations on assessing legal department workload and creating legal metrics and budgets, advising in building or growing the legal operations team to support critical transformation objectives, managing legal talent or restructuring compliance, privacy, enterprise risk or other programs. Clients will also look to you for advice and support on working with the Board, CEO, and the rest of the management team on critical business goals and risks, communicating the value of the legal function, establishing effective governance and oversight processes, as well as staying on top of emerging and top risks to the enterprise. Other emerging priorities include robust third party risk management strategies, coordinated approaches to cyber and information governance, legal technology and AI adoption, and effective reporting and disclosure processes. Gartner for GC Executive Partners (EPs) serve as accountability partners through delivery of Gartner research insights and personal experiences/expertise on key initiatives, priorities, and strategies of their GC clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide executive advisory services to GC members who work across all industries and business models.

  • Synthesize Gartner insights and data to deliver world class advisory support through ongoing bi-weekly client engagement and periodic client working sessions. The ability and willingness to operate independently to adapt materials fit for client use is required.

  • Host, facilitate, and/or participate in periodic member activities, including working sessions to develop strategy, peer roundtables, sessions and client meetings at the annual conference and virtual webinars. These activities may be delivered virtually or on-site depending on circumstance.

  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Executive Program strategy and product deliverables.

  • Facilitate member interaction and peer collaboration through the Gartner for GC member community portal and assisted member connections.

  • Work as a collaborative Gartner team member serving members in conjunction with Client Support Professionals and Account Executives.

  • Participate in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review, and renewal.

  • Whilst you will not be responsible for creating content, you will be partnering with Research Analysts to help identify potential gaps in material that is relevant and valuable to our members.

  • There will be a considerable focus on sales enablement in this role. You are responsible for member retention and for contributing to account growth through direct support of Gartner Sales Associates:

    • Working with the sales teams to help them understand the true value of the Guided Product to the member vs the Self-Directed product.

    • Building their confidence and ability to effectively engage with and sell to this level of C-suite prospect.

    • Through the creation of Value Stories, enable the sales associates to bring the service to life.

    • You will be partnering with sales on account planning / development activities as well as being present in proof-of-concept (POC) engagements with prospective clients.

What You’ll Need

  • The Executive Partner will be an accomplished Corporate General Counsel, working with the C-suite, the Board of Directors and a host of stakeholders, with a broad base of expertise who has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels. Seeking candidates that have been the GC of public organizations with at least $1B in annual revenue.

  • At least 5+ years of experience working as a GC (or the top most Legal role within an organization) and at least 15+ years of experience in Corporate Legal environments.

  • An in-depth understanding of the Legal function and other adjacent functions, e.g., Compliance, Audit & Risk etc.

  • Ideally with a background across multiple industries to be able to support a wide variety of member organizations.

  • Law Firm experience, including client relationship management and revenue generation activities, is also highly beneficial.

  • Technologically savvy; our model is lean, and you’ll need to handle your own administrative tasks.

  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office suite of tools to adapt Power Points, leverage Excel Spreadsheets, and to use Word to draft client-ready materials.

  • Consulting background a plus.

Who You Are

  • Critical thinker and problem solver demonstrating the ability to assess our Member’s situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business/technical advice as well as the ability to leverage appropriate Gartner resources to help Members achieve results.

  • Ability to build strategic internal partnerships with key roles across the organization and positively impact change
