Job Description: Quantitative Rates Researcher

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Quantitative Rates Researchers to contribute to an AI-driven project focused on a leading investment bank's algorithmic trading platform.

In this role, you will apply your expertise in quantitative research, fixed income, and rates markets to evaluate AI-generated research and trading strategies. Your insights will help improve model accuracy, research quality, and real-world applicability. Prior AI experience is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and evaluate AI-generated quantitative research and trading strategies focused on fixed income and rates markets.
  • Identify methodological issues, including lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions.
  • Assess backtesting frameworks, particularly rates-specific mechanics such as carry, roll-down, and contract roll conventions.
  • Evaluate the statistical rigor of signal construction, factor modeling, and alpha research.
  • Provide detailed written feedback on model assumptions, implementation accuracy, and research quality.
  • Collaborate with project coordinators to clarify findings and recommendations through clear written and verbal communication.
  • Help improve research evaluation processes to ensure greater accuracy and relevance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a quantitative researcher, analyst, or consultant specializing in fixed income or rates markets.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and backtesting systematic rates strategies at a hedge fund, asset manager, or investment bank.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) or R for quantitative research and data analysis.
  • Strong understanding of yield curve modeling, carry and roll-down analytics, relative value trading, SOFR/Eurodollar instruments, and Treasury futures.
  • Ability to evaluate research under real-world trading conditions, including transaction costs and liquidity constraints.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to communicate complex quantitative findings clearly and concisely.
  • Experience reviewing quantitative models for compliance with financial research best practices is a plus.

We are looking for aStaff Frontend Engineer to own the frontend of our brand-protection platform. This is a senior individual-contributor role with real technical authority: you set the frontend architecture and standards, have the final say in code review, and mentor the engineers around you. There are no direct reports. Engineering management sits with our backend lead, so your time goes into the codebase and the people building it with you. You report to the Head of Product Engineering.

What you'll own

  • The frontend codebase, end to end. A mature TypeScript monorepo powering a product customers rely on every day: the main React app, our design system, a typed API layer generated from the backend's OpenAPI spec, the Express server in front of the app, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships it.   • Observability: Sentry, OpenTelemetry

Data Center - SOC Analyst L2

Location: Remote (United States)
Reporting to: Director of Cybersecurity

At STN, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.

Overview
STN One is seeking a Data Center SOC Analyst L2 to perform advanced security investigations and coordinate technical escalations in remote data-center command-and-control operations. You will correlate signals across security and infrastructure telemetry, distinguish environmental problems from malicious activity, and support incident containment decisions through established authorization and escalation processes. The role supports both managed-services customers and internal STN operations.

Key Responsibilities

Security Incident Investigation & Analysis
  • Own escalated SOC investigations spanning endpoint, firewall, network, identity, server, hypervisor, and cloud telemetry where available.
  • Correlate alerts and raw logs to reconstruct events, identify affected assets, establish severity, and determine credible next investigative steps.
  • Investigate suspicious authentication, privileged access, lateral movement, endpoint detection, outbound traffic, and monitoring failures in data-center environments.
Incident Response & Threat Hunting
  • Coordinate with DFIR, infrastructure, network, cloud, and customer teams on containment options and evidence needs; execute changes only within approved authority.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting for STN and customer environments using indicators, hypotheses, and correlated security telemetry; share findings with incident response and engineering teams.
  • Analyze monitoring and response signals from Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Cortex XSIAM/XDR, SentinelOne, Illumio, identity systems such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID, and network telemetry where deployed.
Security Operations & Risk Mitigation
  • Work with infrastructure, architecture, database, application, and operations teams to investigate incidents, perform root-cause analysis, close visibility gaps, and verify mitigation.
  • Review vulnerability findings, suspicious access activity, firewall and segmentation changes, and control-health alerts to identify threats and recommend corrective security measures.
  • Support customer security improvement initiatives, incident readiness exercises, playbook development, and training for less experienced analysts.
Detection Engineering & Process Improvement
  • Validate indicators, tune detections, reduce recurring false positives, and identify log-source gaps that impair visibility.
  • Develop and update L1/L2 investigation runbooks, escalation thresholds, case templates, and post-incident findings.
  • Mentor L1 analysts through case review and technical coaching, ensuring handoffs and severity assignments are consistent.
Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Prepare concise technical and stakeholder updates, including timelines, confidence statements, impact estimates, and recommended actions.
  • Partner with automation and implementation teams to test new integrations and improve operational response quality.

Experience & Qualifications

Required
  • 3+ years of hands-on SOC, incident response, security monitoring, or closely related operations experience, including independent incident triage.
  • Strong knowledge of network protocols, Windows/Linux telemetry, identity events, SIEM querying, EDR investigation, and common attacker techniques.
  • Experience correlating multiple data sources and distinguishing false positives, configuration issues, and credible security threats.
  • Ability to write high-quality incident notes, technical assessments, runbooks, and actionable escalation guidance.
  • At least one current analyst/incident-response certification such as CompTIA CySA+, GCIH, GCIA, SSCP, or a comparable recognized credential.
  • Ability to support an assigned monitoring schedule and participate in structured cross-shift handoffs; exact coverage expectations will be confirmed during hiring.
Preferred
  • MSSP or data-center monitoring experience involving complex networks, cloud services, virtualization, or compute clusters.
  • Familiarity with Cortex XSIAM/XDR, SentinelOne, advanced SIEM queries, EDR live response, and security orchestration.
  • Python/PowerShell scripting, detection engineering, and experience coaching junior analysts.

Compensation

  • Full-Time, Exempt
  • $70,000-$90,000/year, DOE

Benefits

  • FSA Health and Dependent Care available
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Observed Holidays Paid
  • Cell Phone Allowance
  • Collaborative, growth-driven culture
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US. STN is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description:
Senior Engineer, SaaS Security Integrations

About AppOmni

AppOmni is redefining SaaS security for the age of agentic security operations. As AI transforms the way security teams build, operate, and defend their environments, AppOmni is pioneering a new approach to securing the world’s most critical SaaS ecosystems.

From its roots as a leader in SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), AppOmni is driving the next evolution of SaaS security - bringing intelligence, automation, and agentic capabilities into security operations. AppOmni empowers organizations to move beyond traditional visibility and posture management toward more intelligent, proactive, and autonomous security.

Recognized as aFrost Radar™ 2025 Leaderand Great Place To Work®, AppOmni continues to set the standard for innovation and customer value in SaaS security.

About the Role

This position in a rapidly growing security engineering company is an opportunity to become AppOmni's expert on how the world's most widely used enterprise SaaS platforms are configured, administered and secured. AppOmni's SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) platform connects to applications such as Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday through their APIs, collects their settings and permissions, and tells customers which configurations put their data at risk.

As a Senior Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will build and maintain those integrations, and you will decide what they should look for. You know these platforms the way an experienced administrator does: which settings matter, how permissions are really granted, which APIs expose what, and where vendors change behavior between releases. You will turn that knowledge into integrations, posture checks and insights that our customers rely on. These are challenging problems in a part of the security industry without defined solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain integrations with flagship enterprise SaaS platforms, including
  • Microsoft 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday and others in AppOmni's catalog.
  • Determine which configuration settings, permissions, roles and sharing models matter for security posture in each platform, and translate them into posture rules and risk logic.
  • Map each platform's admin settings to the APIs that expose them, find gaps in API coverage, and design ways to collect the data reliably.
  • Track vendor release cycles, API deprecations and new security features, and update integrations and posture content before they affect customers.
  • Define the least-privilege permissions and OAuth scopes AppOmni needs in each platform, and document why each one is required.
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert on these platforms for Product, Detection
  • Engineering, AppOmni Labs, Customer Success and Sales, and help answer complex customer questions.
  • Write clear guidance on secure configuration for each platform, for customers and for internal teams.
  • Mentor engineers on SaaS platform internals and review integration designs and code.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of combined experience in software engineering, application security, or SaaS platform implementation and administration.
  • Deep, hands-on administration experience with at least two of Microsoft 365 (including Entra ID), Salesforce, ServiceNow or Workday, and working familiarity with others.
  • Strong understanding of each platform's security model: identity and authentication settings, roles and permission sets, sharing and data access controls, connected apps and third-party integrations, and audit logging.
  • Experience working with SaaS platform APIs such as Microsoft Graph, Salesforce Metadata and Tooling APIs, ServiceNow Table API or Workday web services, including authentication, rate limits and pagination.
  • Professional software development experience in Python, with the ability to write production-quality, tested code.
  • Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML as used by enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Ability to explain why a configuration is risky in terms both engineers and customer security teams understand.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

You Might Also Have

  • Platform certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform Developer,
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, Microsoft 365 or Azure security certifications or Workday Integrations or Security certifications.
  • Experience as an implementation consultant or architect for one or more of these platforms.
  • Experience with PowerShell for Microsoft 365 and Exchange administration.
  • Familiarity with security benchmarks and guidance for SaaS platforms, such as CIS
  • Benchmarks or vendor security guides.
  • Experience with Go.
  • Prior experience at an SSPM, CASB, identity security or other SaaS security vendor.
  • Experience with additional platforms such as Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, GitHub, Atlassian, Box or Zoom.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Learn how AppOmni's integrations and posture engine work and how data flows from a SaaS platform to a customer finding. Take ownership of the integration for at least one flagship platform. Deliver a review of that platform's posture coverage, identifying missing settings and rules that should change.

The Technology You'll Work With

  • Python (Django, FastAPI, Celery) and Go
  • Microsoft Graph, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday APIs, and PowerShell
  • Google Cloud Platform: GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, BigQuery
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse
  • Kubernetes

Culture

Our talented team is collaborative and supportive as we move quickly to research and develop new ideas, deliver new features to our customers, and iterate on ideas and innovations. We accomplish this by focusing on our five core values: Trust, Transparency, Quality, Customer Focus, and Delivery. Our team is determined to make a difference to positively impact our way of life by securing the technology that is changing the world.

AppOmni is proud to be Certified by Great Place to WorkⓇ, as we seek to build a culture where all employees feel appreciated and supported, especially with clear and honest leadership, employee recognition, and an environment that fosters innovation and collaboration.

We believe diversity fuels innovation and drives growth by bringing a wealth of different perspectives and skills. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels valued, heard, and empowered to reach their full potential. Join us in building a workplace where we can all thrive.

Compensation & Benefits

AppOmni is committed to supporting our employees' financial, professional, and personal well-being. To do this, we take a holistic view of compensation, one that values not just the immediate financial package but also the long-term growth of both our employees and our company. We're committed to pay equity and transparency and encourage all candidates to discuss their salary expectations with us early in the application process.

Our total rewards package includes the following:

  • Base Salary: The annual base salary compensation range in the U.S. for this role is: $200,000 - $250,000 USD. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as the final candidate’s location, skills, qualifications, and experience, as well as business considerations and peer compensation.
  • Stock Options: Our vision is to not just grow as a company but to grow together. By offering stock options, we are inviting you to be an integral part of our journey forward.
  • Benefits: Generous paid time off, paid company holidays, paid floating holidays, paid parental leave, paid sick time and paid family leave for applicable states, health insurance - medical, dental, and vision with HSA option, LifeWorks Employee Assistance Program, company-provided life insurance, AD&D, STD/LTD and additional supplemental life insurance options, 401(k) and Roth retirement saving accounts, and a monthly wellness benefit reimbursement. All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and plan details.

The Role We Need

PadSplit is hiring a Host Account Manager to serve as the dedicated strategic partner and primary point of contact for a portfolio of PadSplit hosts. This is a newly created role at the heart of our Host Success model, designed to shift how we support all hosts from reactive problem-solving to proactive, relationship-driven account management.

You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards. It means being atrusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot. You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention.

This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it. You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews.

You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call.

You believe in PadSplit’s mission and understand what it means to work in the affordable housing space, where the stakes for both hosts and members are real.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

    ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT AND RELATIONSHIP OWNERSHIP
  • Own and manage a dedicated portfolio of PadSplit hosts, serving as their primary named point of contact for support ticket escalation and resolution, policy adherence and understanding, and overall portfolio direction
  • Provide the right information at the right time,becoming a partner and strategic advisor of PadSplit
  • Build proactive, trust-based relationships that reduce churn and increase host lifetime value.
  • Conduct regular performance check-ins, including structured reviews aligned to host goals and PadSplit benchmarks.
  • Drive host accountability on key metrics including attainable occupancy, bookability flags, rejection rates, move-in ratings, and member retention.
  • Partner with hosts on portfolio growth, including conversations about adding new properties and expanding their PadSplit footprint.
  • Serve as the host’s internal advocate, surfacing feedback and trends to product, operations, and leadership.
    • PLATFORM, POLICY, AND FINANCIAL FLUENCY
  • Maintain deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s platform, fee structures, payout mechanics, and host-facing policies, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and confidently.
  • Serve as a knowledgeable, trusted point of contact for hosts navigating financial questions, policy inquiries, and operational challenges.
  • Apply PadSplit policies thoughtfully, explaining both the “what” and the “why” in a way that builds understanding and trust rather than resentment.
  • Guide hosts on pricing strategy, occupancy optimization, listing quality, rejection rate management, and platform best practices using both data and platform knowledge.
  • Monitor host and property performance using PadSplit’s data tools, identifying risks and opportunities before they become problems.
    • NEW HOST ACTIVATION
  • Lead an intro call for every new host in your portfolio, establishing the relationship and setting expectations from day one.
  • Guide new hosts from the beginning, covering pricing, room standards, rejection rate drivers, and mission-critical success requirements.
  • Prepare hosts for their first members: responsiveness standards, room readiness expectations, and move-in experience requirements.
  • Educate new hosts on member outcome drivers including safety compliance, pricing discipline, and platform behaviors that directly improve member, host and company outcomes.
    • ISSUE RESOLUTION AND ESCALATION
  • Navigate complex, nuanced host situations that require investigation, sound judgment, and fair resolution.
  • Escalate and coordinate resolution of issues that require cross-functional support, working with member support, trust and safety, payments, and legal teams where appropriate.
  • Manage emotionally charged conversations with empathy, composure, and directness, holding firm on policy while maintaining the relationship.
  • Document ticket details and resolutions accurately, maintaining clear records across all host interactions.
  • Identify patterns in host concerns and flag systemic issues to inform process, policy, or product improvements.
    • TEAM AND PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT
  • Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, talk tracks, macro responses, and best practices as this function matures.
  • Participate in weekly team syncs to share what is working, surface friction points, and iterate on the program in real time.

    • Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful

    • Account Management or Customer Success Background: 3+ years of account management, customer success, or high-touch client relationship experience. Background in real estate, property management, hospitality, or a platform-based marketplace is strongly preferred.
    • Platform and Policy Fluency: Ability and willingness to develop deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s product, fee structures, and policies, and to use that knowledge in live host conversations.
    • Proactive Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a large book of relationships with a proactive, not reactive, approach. You spot the problem before the host calls.
    • Data-Driven Communication: Comfortable using data to tell a story and drive a conversation. You can translate performance metrics into clear, actionable guidance a host can act on today.
    • Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment: Ability to analyze incomplete or conflicting information, apply policies thoughtfully in nuanced scenarios, and arrive at fair, defensible decisions.
    • Empathetic Directness: Skill in balancing compassion with clarity, especially when delivering difficult or unpopular outcomes. You hold firm on policy while making the host feel heard.
    • Strong Communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication tailored to diverse audiences. You build trust quickly and handle difficult conversations without escalating unnecessarily.
    • Organization and Follow-Through: Highly organized with the ability to prioritize across a large portfolio without dropping the ball on high-value or high-risk relationships.
    • Mission Alignment: Genuine belief in PadSplit’s mission and an understanding of what it means to operate in the affordable housing space.
    • Growth Mindset: Motivated by the idea of building something new and improving it as you go. This function is being built from the ground up and you will help shape it.

    The Interview Process:

    • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team.
    • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
    • If warranted, the next stage is a video interview and meeting with our Senior Host Experience Manager for about forty-five (45) minutes, where the candidate will participate in a live case interview.
    • If warranted, the final step would be a video interview with our Regional Host Experience Manager for thirty minutes (30)
    • If warranted, we move to an offer!

    Notice to Applicants:

    PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.
    PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Junior Analyst (India)
jobs.excerpt: Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose.
jobs.description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Junior Analyst at Worldwide


Help strengthen and support the cybersecurity governance and assurance program that protects critical business operations. In this role, you'll work across risk, compliance, audit, and security activities, helping ensure that cybersecurity requirements are translated into practical, well-documented actions and outcomes.

You'll partner with stakeholders across Information Security, Information Technology, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, and business teams to support assessments, control monitoring, audits, policy governance, and reporting. Your work will help drive informed risk decisions, improve compliance processes, and maintain confidence in the organization's security posture.

This is an excellent opportunity to build broad exposure across Governance, Risk, and Compliance functions while developing your technical, analytical, and stakeholder management skills in a collaborative global environment.


Where You'll Work


This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do


  • Manage and prioritize incoming GRC requests, ensuring timely responses, appropriate ownership, and successful resolution.
  • Coordinate security questionnaires, third-party reviews, policy inquiries, risk exceptions, and audit-related requests while maintaining accurate documentation.
  • Conduct security risk assessments for applications, vendors, projects, and business processes to identify risks and evaluate control effectiveness.
  • Document risk findings, recommend mitigation actions, track remediation activities, and monitor progress through resolution or formal risk acceptance.
  • Support internal audits, customer assessments, regulatory reviews, and assurance activities by collecting, reviewing, and coordinating evidence.
  • Perform control testing activities and maintain clear, audit-ready records of work performed, evidence reviewed, and conclusions reached.
  • Support the governance lifecycle of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, control mappings, exceptions, and risk records.
  • Develop and maintain GRC metrics, dashboards, and management reports to track risks, controls, audits, remediation efforts, and program performance.
  • Analyze trends, identify opportunities for process improvement, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen governance and compliance practices.

What You'll Bring


  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Information Systems, Audit, Risk Management, or a related discipline; equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and relevant experience will be considered.
  • 1-3 years of experience in cybersecurity, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), technology risk, information technology audit, security operations, or compliance.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity domains including access control, vulnerability management, data protection, cloud security, logging and monitoring, incident response, change management, and third-party risk management.
  • Familiarity with industry-recognized frameworks such as ISO 27001/27002, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, or SOC 2.
  • Experience reviewing policies, procedures, technical documentation, system information, and supporting evidence to assess compliance and control effectiveness.
  • Strong data analysis and reporting skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Power BI or similar dashboarding tools is preferred.
  • Experience using ticketing, workflow, collaboration, or GRC platforms is preferred, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical and risk concepts in clear business language. Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity, or similar foundational certifications are preferred; progress toward CISA, CRISC, or related certifications is advantageous.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

jobs.excerpt: Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care.
jobs.description:
Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.

Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.

The Research Nurse Coordinator (in-house screening) will assist in screening activities for a global, multi-centre pivotal trial and will play a critical role in patient case planning and eligibility screening, collaborating closely with the clinical team to identify and prepare potential trial participants. This role will work closely with HCPs and the field clinical organization and will consult with cross-functional team members as needed.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Clinical Science, this individual will work collaboratively with the broader clinical science and field therapy teams to assist in subject preparation for screening activities. This is a remote position based in Europe with minimal (10%) travel required.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end‑to‑end screening process, ensuring all pre‑procedure assessments (e.g. CT, echo, labs, risk scoring) are completed accurately and on time across participating sites.
  • Lead scientific and operational evaluation of inclusion/exclusion criteria, providing clear, defensible decisions on subject eligibility in alignment with the protocol and regulatory expectations.
  • Partner with investigators, coordinators, and field teams to drive screening performance, troubleshoot barriers, and ensure consistent application of screening criteria.
  • Collaborate with cardiologists, study coordinators, and clinical teams to prioritize potential participants.
  • Provide clinical insights to support case planning and feasibility discussions.
  • Ensure compliance with GCP, FDA, and trial protocols during all screening activities.
  • Lead live screening meetings to review cases and discuss patient eligibility trends.
  • Ensure completeness, accuracy, and protocol compliance of all screening‑related data; identify trends, gaps, and risks requiring corrective action.

Required Skills, Knowledge, Experience & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing or Registered Nurse (RN) with current licensure, compliant with Directive 2005/36/EC training standards.
  • Minimum of 10 years of direct cardiovascular nursing experience, preferably in CCU, CICU, or structural heart programs.
  • Proven experience in patient assessment, heart failure management, and critical care.
  • Strong understanding of cardiology terminology and trial endpoints.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities for cross-functional teamwork.
  • Proficiency with electronic medical records (EMR) systems and clinical documentation.
  • Familiarity with EU hospital systems and screening workflows.

Preferred Skills, Knowledge, Experience & Qualifications

  • Prior involvement in clinical trials or research-focused nursing
  • Fluency in English is required; multilingual capability (e.g. French or German) is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunity to make a significant impact on the healthcare industry by advancing groundbreaking therapies.
  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment with a culture of innovation and excellence.
  • Competitive compensation package, including salary and performance-based bonus
  • Career development opportunities and a chance to be part of a growing company that values its employees.

Note: We may require proof of COVID-19 vaccination to comply with health institutions, state, local municipality, and/or travel regulations.

Anteris Technologies recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We have a clear vision: to be a place of belonging for all humans by promoting diversity, multiculturism and inclusion, as a goal and reflection across the organization. Diversity is more than a commitment - it is part of our mission to deliver the best structural heart products on a global scale.

jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Cassie Alexander, your Recruiter and guide to joining CSG! We are excited to learn more about you and your unique background.

We are seeking an Information Security Analyst II to support the implementation and administration of information security policies, practices, procedures, and technologies to protect networks, systems, applications, and data. In this role, you will serve as an information security resource within the organization, helping ensure compliance with all security policies and standards, as well as applicable industry regulations and laws. You will also support day-to-day security operations by responding to security events, investigating potential threats, and recommending corrective actions in collaboration with IT and non-IT team members.

We are looking for an Information Security Analyst II who will:

  • Monitor security alerts, respond to events, and work toward resolution using tools such as endpoint detection and response (EDR), email security, firewalls, security information and event management (SIEM), IPS/IDS, web application firewalls, malware detection, file integrity monitoring (FIM), user behavior analytics, rogue wireless network detection, and security system health monitoring.
  • Participate in the organization's incident response plan and perform incident reporting as needed. Support incident response activities, including evidence collection and preservation, timeline development, and technical interviews.
  • Collaborate with team members to develop and implement Security Operations Center (SOC) incident response strategies, refine and test incident response playbooks and procedures, and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders during incidents. Stay current on emerging cybersecurity threats and trends.
  • Perform security engineering tasks as needed, including alert tuning, system maintenance, and identifying and capturing key information feeds.
  • Support audit, compliance, and regulatory requests, including, but not limited to, Payment Card Industry (PCI) Data Security Standard (DSS), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), emerging state and federal privacy laws, and general security audits.
  • Work outside normal business hours as needed to diagnose issues and implement product releases or changes without disrupting normal business operations.
  • Travel up to 5% domestically and/or internationally.

Is this opportunity right for you? We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, related field, or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of experience working in information security or highly technical IT fields.
  • Experience across the incident response lifecycle, including security system engineering, alert monitoring, triage, incident analysis (host and network forensics, malware analysis, etc.), and incident management.
  • Experience working with information security technologies, such as IDS/IPS, malware prevention, database activity monitoring, secure password repositories, multi-factor authentication, SIEM, spam prevention, web content filtering, identity and access management (IdM/IAM), encryption and encryption key management, data loss prevention (DLP), file integrity monitoring, and vulnerability scanners.
  • Knowledge of TCP/IP and the ability to demonstrate a technical understanding of all layers of the TCP/IP stack. Familiarity with major application-layer protocols, including HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, FTPS, SMTP, and DNS. Ability to read and understand packet traces and interpret network access control lists.
  • Understanding of network and application attacks, including DoS/DDoS, buffer overflows, SQL injection, reconnaissance scanning, and techniques attackers use to evade detection. Familiarity with well-known vulnerabilities and exploits.
  • Working knowledge of IT security, compliance, and regulatory requirements, such as Payment Card Industry (PCI) Data Security Standard (DSS), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and state and federal privacy laws.
  • Ability to read, write, speak and understand the English language in a business environment

Digital Marketing Account Manager – Local SEO & Client Success | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Mountain Time
Location: Remote — LATAM, Philippines, or Pakistan
Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
Function: Digital Marketing / Account Management / Local SEO

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing Account Manager to manage relationships and marketing performance for a portfolio of local business clients.

This role combines client account management, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, performance reporting, and AI-assisted execution. You’ll be the primary point of contact for your clients, helping them understand their results while proactively identifying opportunities, resolving issues, and keeping their accounts moving forward.

The ideal candidate understands both sides of the role: strong client communication and hands-on digital marketing execution.

What You’ll Own

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of local business clients
  • Build trust through consistent and proactive communication
  • Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business, market, and goals
  • Provide regular, specific updates on performance and ongoing work
  • Track commitments and follow through on client requests
  • Identify concerns early rather than waiting for clients to raise them
  • Translate technical marketing information into clear, client-friendly language

Local SEO & Google Business Profile

  • Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles
  • Maintain accurate business information and local listings
  • Support review-management workflows
  • Monitor local search visibility and ranking performance
  • Implement appropriate on-page and off-page SEO tactics for local markets
  • Identify opportunities to improve local organic visibility
  • Monitor performance changes and investigate ranking declines
  • Ensure Local SEO execution aligns with each client’s business objectives

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Monitor performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics
  • Review search visibility, traffic, rankings, and other relevant performance indicators
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and potential issues
  • Turn data into clear and actionable recommendations
  • Prepare client-facing performance reports
  • Explain results to non-technical clients in a straightforward way
  • Use reporting to keep clients informed and engaged with their progress

AI-Assisted Marketing Execution

  • Use Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate day-to-day marketing workflows
  • Draft client-facing and marketing content with AI assistance
  • Conduct research and streamline recurring deliverables
  • Review, edit, and quality-check AI-generated work before delivery
  • Adapt outputs to each client’s brand, context, and objectives
  • Apply independent judgment rather than relying on AI-generated output without review

Issue Resolution & Account Ownership

  • Identify performance dips or account concerns early
  • Diagnose potential causes using available SEO and analytics data
  • Coordinate internally to resolve client issues
  • Communicate clearly with clients when problems arise
  • Track issues through resolution
  • Take end-to-end ownership of assigned accounts

Growth & Upsell Opportunities

  • Identify opportunities where additional marketing services could meaningfully benefit clients
  • Recognize when services such as Google Ads may complement existing Local SEO efforts
  • Communicate recommendations clearly and consultatively
  • Focus on genuine client value rather than aggressive selling
  • Coordinate internally when additional services are appropriate

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, account management, or a related role
  • Experience working with local businesses or SMB clients preferred
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Business Profiles
  • Experience with review management and local listing accuracy
  • Working proficiency with Google Search Console
  • Working proficiency with Google Analytics
  • Ability to interpret marketing data and explain findings to non-technical clients
  • Professional experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude
  • Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated content
  • Excellent client communication and relationship-management skills
  • Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities
  • Ability to independently manage multiple client accounts
  • Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team
  • Availability to work full-time U.S. Mountain Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Google Ads
  • Local SEO agency experience
  • Experience managing multiple SMB or local-business accounts simultaneously
  • Familiarity with local search ranking factors and optimization workflows
  • Experience diagnosing organic search performance issues
  • Experience identifying cross-sell or upsell opportunities
  • Strong understanding of AI-assisted marketing workflows

Tools & Platforms

Google Business Profile | Google Search Console | Google Analytics | ChatGPT | Claude | Local SEO Tools | Google Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Communicate proactively so clients don’t need to chase you for updates
  • Take ownership of accounts from start to finish
  • Understand Local SEO beyond simply updating a Google Business Profile
  • Can look at Search Console or Analytics data and identify what actually matters
  • Explain technical marketing information clearly to business owners
  • Flag performance issues early and take action
  • Use AI as a productivity tool without sacrificing judgment or quality
  • Know when AI-generated content needs significant rewriting
  • Are organized enough to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deliverables
  • Can work independently while staying aligned with a remote team
  • Look for growth opportunities based on genuine client needs rather than pushing unnecessary services

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day will operate on U.S. Mountain Time and balance proactive client management with hands-on marketing execution.

You may start by reviewing overnight client messages and identifying anything requiring immediate attention. From there, you could optimize Google Business Profiles, review Search Console for ranking changes or crawl issues, and analyze Google Analytics data for upcoming client reports.

You may use Claude or ChatGPT to accelerate content, research, or recommendations before applying your own judgment and editing the final output. Afternoons may include client check-ins or internal meetings to align on priorities and resolve outstanding issues.

In short: you’ll own client relationships while ensuring their Local SEO work is executed, measured, communicated, and continuously improved.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Client retention and satisfaction
  • Quality and consistency of client communication
  • Google Business Profile optimization and accuracy
  • Local search visibility and performance
  • Organic traffic and search trends
  • Accuracy and usefulness of client reporting
  • Timeliness of deliverables and follow-ups
  • Speed of issue identification and resolution
  • Account organization and ownership
  • Appropriate identification of growth opportunities
  • Quality and efficiency of AI-assisted workflows

Compensation, Hours & Location

Compensation: USD $1,500–$3,500/month
Schedule: Full-Time, aligned with U.S. Mountain Time
Location: Remote — open to candidates in LATAM, the Philippines, or Pakistan

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application & AI Rating
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screen
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Placement

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Qualifying Questions

  1. Walk me through how you currently manage a Google Business Profile for a local business client. What does your optimization process look like?
  2. How do you use Claude or ChatGPT in your day-to-day work? Give a specific example of a task you handled with AI assistance and how you quality-checked the output.
  3. Describe a time when a client’s local search performance dropped. How did you diagnose the issue, and what steps did you take?
  4. How do you structure your client communication cadence? What do clients typically hear from you, and how often?
  5. Are you available to work full-time on U.S. Mountain Time hours, and what does your current schedule look like?

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Digital Marketing Account Manager with hands-on expertise in Local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and AI-assisted marketing workflows, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who combines strong digital marketing execution with proactive, dependable client communication.

We’re looking for our next Channel Champion to join the team as an Enterprise Account Executive.

Channelscaler is transforming how companies scale through their partners. Our AI-powered platform automates and simplifies partner engagement, from onboarding and incentives to performance tracking, helping vendors and partners grow faster together.

With one unified system, companies manage their entire partner lifecycle with ease and clarity. We’re building a category-defining company rooted in expertise, empathy, and innovation, and we’re just getting started.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to the SVP of Sales, you’ll drive new business growth by bringing Channelscaler’s partner relationship management (PRM) platform to large enterprise organisations. You’ll own a new business territory end to end, building strategic relationships with channel and partner leaders and helping them prove and grow the revenue impact of their partner programmes.

Partner ecosystems are becoming one of the most important routes to revenue for B2B companies, yet many channel leaders still lack the data and tooling to measure partner ROI and scale their programmes. Our partner orchestration and intelligence platform helps them change that.

We’re looking for an experienced enterprise seller who brings strong ownership, discipline across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and a consultative, customer-first approach. Working closely with our solutions, marketing, product and customer success teams, you’ll play a key role in expanding our enterprise customer base and shaping how we go to market as we scale.

  • Partner with our human and AI BDRs and marketing to build consistent pipeline, while creating your own.

jobs.excerpt: Get to know us better CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms.
jobs.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join a team co-developing a unified, cloud-based network security management platform from a leading cybersecurity vendor. You will be building and maintaining the User Interfaces for specialized automation software running within that platform.

As the software keeps expanding and becoming a fully-fledged product, we're looking for another Senior Frontend Engineer to help build what's next. It is as much a product engineering challenge as a technical one.

Other things to know:

  • The team consists of Software and DevOps engineers who share strong ownership of code and product quality

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow

  • This is a frontend-focused role

  • We are a distributed, fully remote team

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we'll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Wrapping complex enterprise network security configuration converters into clear, fast and reliable interactive workflows, with validated forms and editable mapping tables

  • Designing and building multi-step micro-apps and shared UI libraries in a React and TypeScript monorepo

  • Modelling long-running, asynchronous workflows in the UI: progress, polling, cancel, retry and recovery after a page reload

  • Evolving shared frontend foundations: pure TypeScript workflow state machines, micro-frontend boundaries and reusable accessible components

  • Keeping the application fast on very large datasets (100k+ items), including profiling, virtualisation and performance budgets

  • Writing unit, reducer, component and browser/E2E tests (Vitest, React Testing Library, Storybook, Playwright) running in CI (GitLab CI)

  • Applying AI-assisted engineering practices and setting the standard for how they are used - across the entire SDLC, not only in code generation

  • Contributing to architecture and design decisions as the solution scales in different dimensions

  • Proposing and helping ship your own ideas for improving the product, beyond your core delivery work

Do we have a match?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Strong, 7+ years professional experience in similar roles

  • Experience building and maintaining software products for external customers

  • Languages / Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React (micro-frontends)

  • Build & monorepo tooling: Vite, pnpm, Turborepo, Storybook, Oxlint

  • State management, forms & data fetching: TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Context API, state machines / reducers

  • Styling & UI: TailwindCSS, an enterprise design system, accessible headless primitives (React Aria)

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools in your engineering workflow, with a considered view of where they earn their keep and where they do not

  • CI/CD experience

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities are set as much by customers as by the backlog

  • Open for technical challenges

  • Open-mindedly looking for technical solutions to business problems

  • Very good command of English - spoken and written

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following:

  • Experience with micro-frontend architectures

  • Experience with Connect-RPC, gRPC-Web or Protobuf

  • Experience with client-side observability

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

jobs.title: Microsoft 365 Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Vollzeit | 100 % Remote Ein Kunde nutzt Microsoft 365, möchte seine Umgebung sicherer aufstellen und mit Copilot oder Automatisierungen mehr aus den vorhandenen Lösungen machen.
jobs.description:
Vollzeit | 100 % Remote

Ein Kunde nutzt Microsoft 365, möchte seine Umgebung sicherer aufstellen und mit Copilot oder Automatisierungen mehr aus den vorhandenen Lösungen machen. Du findest heraus, was dafür nötig ist, erklärst die Möglichkeiten und setzt die vereinbarten Lösungen technisch um.

Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen im deutschsprachigen Raum bei der Digitalisierung, Prozessautomatisierung und beim Einsatz von KI. Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Kunden und unserem Entwicklungsteam zusammen. Dabei verbindest du verständliche Beratung mit der technischen Umsetzung in Microsoft 365.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du berätst Kunden zu Microsoft 365 und ordnest ihre Anforderungen den passenden Lösungen zu – von Teams, SharePoint und Exchange Online bis zu Microsoft 365 Copilot und der Power Platform.

  • Du analysierst bestehende Tenants, erkennst Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und setzt sichere Konfigurationen nach Microsoft-365-Best-Practices um.

  • Du richtest Identitäten und Zugriffe mit Microsoft Entra ID ein und arbeitest mit Rollen, Berechtigungen, Multifaktor-Authentifizierung und Conditional Access.

  • Du berücksichtigst Security, Governance und Compliance bei der Einführung: etwa externe Freigaben, den Schutz vertraulicher Daten und nachvollziehbare Verantwortlichkeiten.

  • Du begleitest die Einführung von Microsoft 365 Copilot, prüfst technische Voraussetzungen und Berechtigungen und unterstützt Kunden bei der sinnvollen Nutzung.

  • Du setzt passende Automatisierungen mit Power Automate und Anwendungen mit Power Apps um und stimmst Schnittstellen sowie weitergehende Entwicklungen mit unserem Team ab.

  • Du führst Kundenworkshops und Schulungen durch, dokumentierst Konfigurationen und prüfst mit den Kunden, ob die Lösung im Alltag funktioniert.

Requirements

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Administration, Einführung oder Beratung von Microsoft 365 und hast Konfigurationen bereits selbst umgesetzt.

  • Du kennst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive und Exchange Online und kannst dich sicher in einer Microsoft-365-Umgebung orientieren.

  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in Microsoft Entra ID, Identity & Access sowie sicheren Tenant-Konfigurationen mit. Security, Governance und Compliance denkst du bei deinen Lösungen mit.

  • Du hast erste praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 Copilot sowie Power Automate oder Power Apps und möchtest dieses Wissen weiter ausbauen.

  • Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären, Anforderungen hinterfragen und Kunden zu einer praktikablen Lösung führen.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch, dokumentierst verständlich und organisierst deine Arbeit auch remote eigenständig.

Kenntnisse in Microsoft Intune, Defender oder Purview sowie PowerShell und Microsoft Graph sind hilfreich. Du musst nicht in jedem Produkt Spezialist sein; wichtig sind ein breites Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, Lösungen sauber umzusetzen.

Das erwartet dich

  • Eine vollständig remote ausgeübte Stelle in Vollzeit; unser Unternehmensstandort ist Grevenbroich.

  • Direkten Austausch mit Kunden und kurze Wege zu den Entwicklern.

  • Eigene Verantwortung und Raum, unsere Vorgehensweisen und technischen Standards mitzugestalten.

  • Projekte, die du von der ersten Bestandsaufnahme über die Einführung bis zur Übergabe begleitest.

  • Du arbeitest mit moderner Apple-Hardware.

  • Wir streben gemeinsam mit dir passende Microsoft-Zertifizierungen an, übernehmen die Kosten und unterstützen dich bei der Vorbereitung.

Du möchtest Kunden ganzheitlich zu Microsoft 365 beraten und die Lösungen auch selbst einführen? Dann bewirb dich über das Bewerbungsformular. Besonders interessiert uns ein Projekt, in dem du Beratung und technische Umsetzung verbunden hast.

jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer – Capacity Planning & Forecasting

Type: Remote | Brazil, Mexico, Chile, or Colombia
Coverage: Pacific Hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST)

Experience: 10+ years

Organization: Data Platform / Infrastructure Engineering

Job Description:

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our Data Platform organization, focusing on infrastructure capacity planning, forecasting, utilization analytics, and cost optimization.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and analytical data models that integrate infrastructure telemetry, cloud consumption, workload demand, and financial data.

This role will play a critical part in enabling data-driven infrastructure investment decisions by providing visibility into compute, GPU, TPU, storage, and cloud resource utilization, forecasting future capacity requirements, and identifying cost optimization opportunities.

The candidate will collaborate closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Procurement, and Business Operations teams to build reliable data products that support strategic capacity planning.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Engineering & Pipeline Development:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines to ingest, process, and transform large volumes of infrastructure and cloud consumption data.

Integrate data from multiple sources, including cloud billing systems, infrastructure telemetry, workload management platforms, and financial systems.

Develop optimized data models and analytical datasets for infrastructure utilization, capacity tracking, and cost reporting.

Implement data validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and quality checks to ensure data accuracy and reliability.

Optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Capacity Planning & Forecasting:

Develop data-driven solutions to monitor and forecast infrastructure capacity requirements.

Analyze historical and current utilization trends across GPU, TPU, CPU, memory, and storage resources.

Build forecasting models to predict future compute demand based on workload growth and business requirements.

Identify capacity constraints, resource bottlenecks, underutilization, and potential infrastructure risks.

Support capacity planning through demand forecasting, scenario analysis, and capacity optimization.

Develop dashboards and reporting solutions to track available capacity, committed capacity, utilization, and projected demand.

Cloud Cost & Infrastructure Analytics:

Analyze cloud infrastructure consumption and billing data across AWS, GCP, Azure, or other cloud platforms.

Develop cost attribution models to understand infrastructure spending across workloads, teams, and business units.

Calculate key infrastructure cost metrics, including:

Cost per GPU hour

Cost per CPU hour

Cost per workload/job

Cost per inference request

Cost per million tokens

Identify cost optimization opportunities, including idle resources, underutilized infrastructure, and inefficient capacity commitments.

Partner with Finance and Procurement teams to reconcile infrastructure costs and support financial planning.

Data Modeling & Analytics:

Design and maintain dimensional and analytical data models for infrastructure capacity and financial reporting.

Develop reusable datasets and metrics to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Perform root-cause analysis of utilization anomalies, cost fluctuations, and capacity deviations.

Build automated reports and dashboards to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.

Ensure consistency between operational telemetry, consumption records, and financial reporting.

Stakeholder Collaboration:

Work closely with Infrastructure Engineering teams to understand workload patterns, infrastructure architecture, and capacity requirements.

Collaborate with Finance and Procurement teams on infrastructure budgeting, cloud commitments, and cost forecasting.

Partner with Data Science and Machine Learning teams to understand AI/ML workload requirements and compute consumption patterns.

Translate complex technical and financial data into meaningful insights and recommendations for leadership.

Qualifications:

Required Technical Skills:

Programming & Data Processing

Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, joins, window functions, and query optimization.

Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and analytical workflows.

Experience with Pandas, PySpark, or similar data processing frameworks.

Data Engineering

Hands-on experience building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.

Strong understanding of data warehousing, data modeling, and distributed data processing.

Experience with Apache Spark, Airflow, Kafka, Trino, or similar technologies.

Knowledge of data quality frameworks, pipeline monitoring, and data governance.

Cloud & Infrastructure

Experience working with AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure.

Understanding of cloud billing, resource utilization, and consumption datasets.

Knowledge of compute, storage, networking, and infrastructure resource metrics.

Familiarity with GPU/TPU infrastructure and AI/ML workload consumption is desirable.

Capacity Planning & Forecasting

Understanding of capacity management, resource utilization, and demand forecasting.

Experience analyzing historical trends and predicting future resource requirements.

Knowledge of time-series forecasting, statistical modeling, and scenario analysis.

Ability to identify infrastructure bottlenecks and resource optimization opportunities.

Visualization & Reporting

Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar visualization tools.

Ability to develop operational dashboards and executive-level reporting.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in cloud infrastructure analytics or FinOps.

Exposure to GPU/TPU capacity planning and AI/ML infrastructure.

Understanding of machine learning inference workloads and compute economics.

Experience working with large-scale infrastructure telemetry datasets.

Knowledge of infrastructure cost allocation and unit economics.

Experience supporting financial forecasting, budgeting, or procurement decisions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

Data pipeline reliability and successful execution rates.

Accuracy and completeness of infrastructure utilization data.

Accuracy of capacity demand forecasts.

Visibility into infrastructure capacity and resource consumption.

Identification of cloud cost optimization opportunities.

Reduction in manual reporting and reconciliation efforts.

Timeliness and accuracy of capacity and financial reporting.

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.

Equivalent practical experience in Data Engineering, Infrastructure Analytics, or Capacity Planning will also be considered.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate is a technically strong Data Engineer with an analytical mindset and an understanding of infrastructure economics. They should be comfortable working with large-scale datasets, developing reliable data pipelines, analyzing resource utilization, and translating complex data into actionable capacity and cost optimization insights.

The candidate should demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across engineering and business teams.

Core Competencies: Data Engineering | SQL | Python | Cloud Analytics | Capacity Planning | Demand Forecasting | Infrastructure Optimization | FinOps | Data Modeling | Business Analytics

jobs.description:
About Widewail:

Solving a key problem for many businesses -how to efficiently and effectively deliver the very best customer service experience while simultaneously influencing prospective customers to choose their business. By integrating with our client’s business management systems, Widewail invites our client’s customers to review their recent experience, then monitors and responds to reviews on behalf of the businesses. These responses are expertly crafted to include key content that attracts new customers and improves overall local search rankings. By further collaborating with our clients, Widewail ensures that responses to negative reviews successfully address the customer’s feedback while encapsulating the client’s voice. Our client base is growing fast, and we are looking for additional team members to help us meet our growing demand by expanding our current product offerings and bringing new products to market.

Review Response Specialist

Position Title

Review Response Specialist

Immediate Supervisor

Review Response manager OR VP of Customer Success

Direct Reports

None

Department

Customer Success

Level

Specialist L1

Status

Full-time, non-exempt

Location

Remote (US)

Travel

Minimal

Compensation

$19.50–$25.00 per hour, depending on experience

Last Reviewed

October 2026

Hiring in the following states: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Texas, Vermont.

Position summary

The Review Response Specialist writes the replies that local businesses across the United States put in front of their customers. You respond to online reviews and social comments on our clients’ behalf — thoughtfully, professionally, and with search visibility in mind — protecting and strengthening their reputation with every response.

This is a production seat with a craft standard: real volume, real deadlines, and no room for a careless sentence. You are writing in someone else’s voice, in public, about their business.

You are part of a team, but most of the day-to-day work is self-directed. You will also work directly with clients by email and phone on negative reviews and difficult situations. Standard working hours are 8:30-5 pm EST, with some rotating weekend coverage expected, not exceeding 40 hours per week.

Responsibilities

Accountable for:

  • Response quality: every reply must be accurate, on-brand, correctly toned, and free of grammar and spelling errors. It publishes under the client’s name, not ours.
  • Turnaround: responses delivered within the standard, every day, without a backlog building behind you.
  • Negative review handling: difficult feedback addressed in a way that resolves the situation for the customer and protects the client.

Lane 1: Response production

OWNS:

  • The quality and search-consciousness of every response you publish.
  • Your daily throughput against the turnaround standard.

RUNS:

  • Writing responses to reviews and social comments across Google, Facebook, DealerRater, Cars.com, Edmunds, Yelp, CarGurus, and other platforms.
  • Applying each client’s voice, guidelines, and content priorities.
  • Incorporating SEO best practices into response content.

Lane 2: Negative reviews and client partnership

OWNS:

  • The handling of negative reviews and comments, in direct partnership with the client.
  • The confidentiality of the client and customer information you handle, in line with Widewail’s data handling standards.

RUNS:

  • Email and phone communication with clients in support of their online reputation.
  • Recommending how a client could or should manage a difficult situation online.
  • Escalating situations that need a manager or a client decision before they escalate on their own.

Performance measures

The Review Response Specialist is evaluated primarily on:

  1. Response volume against the daily or shift standard.
  2. Quality and audit score, measured through review of published responses.
  3. Turnaround-time adherence and backlog age.
  4. Revision and correction rate.
  5. Handling of escalated negative reviews, measured through resolution and client feedback.

Specific standards and targets are set with your supervisor at hire and reviewed during the performance cycle.

First 90 days

By 30 days

  • You are writing publishable responses for a defined set of clients, with review before publication.
  • You know each of your clients’ voices, guidelines, and content priorities.

By 60 days

  • You are working independently at the turnaround standard for your assigned book.
  • You are handling routine negative reviews without escalation.

By 90 days

  • You are at full volume, replying to 4000-4500 reviews per month , working difficult reviews with direct client contact.
  • You have a point of view on what makes a response work, and you contribute it to the team.

Core competencies

  • Writing judgment — you know the difference between a reply that closes a situation and one that inflames it, and you can tell which one you have just written.
  • Voice discipline — you can hold someone else’s voice consistently across hundreds of responses, without letting your own leak through.
  • Composure — you can read hostile, unfair, or upsetting feedback all day and still write something measured.
  • Self-direction — you manage your own queue and your own deadlines without anyone checking on you.
  • Attention to detail — grammar and spelling are not negotiable, because the client’s name is on it.
  • Customer-service instinct — you default to resolving the problem rather than winning the argument.

Qualifications

Required

  • 1+ years of copywriting or content writing experience.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Proper use of grammar and spelling is an absolute must.
  • Familiarity with SEO and best practices for web content development.
  • Understanding of online reputation management and common review platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage deadlines.

Preferred

  • Associate’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
  • Automotive retail or dealer group experience.
  • Experience writing in a brand-governed or regulated environment.

Tools and systems

  • Slack, Google Business Profile, Facebook, DealerRater, Cars.com, Edmunds, and Cargurus, plus the Widewail platform.

Compensation and benefits

$19.50–$25.00 per hour, depending on experience. Widewail benefits include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage, with HSA, FSA, and dependent care account options
  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account

  • Remote-first working environment

jobs.title: Independent Prescriber
jobs.excerpt: You’ve already done the hard part.  Now do it without the noise.
jobs.description:
You’ve already done the hard part. Now do it without the noise.
If you’ve prescribed digitally, you know the difference. There’s no waiting room, no running late, just the consultation in front of you and the time to get the decision right. We’re looking for an Independent Prescriber who wants that every day, and if you’ve done it before, you’ll be well ahead of the field.

About Evaro
Evaro is a licensed, regulated online healthcare service. Patients complete a detailed digital health assessment, and qualified clinicians like you decide what’s safe to prescribe. Approved prescriptions are delivered the next day. Our technology handles the routine, so you can concentrate on clinical judgement.

Why digital prescribing
Prescribing from a consultation form is a different skill from prescribing face to face. You make safe calls without seeing the patient. You spot what’s missing and know when to hold or reject. You explain your decision in plain English to people who never speak to you.

If you’ve done that before, you’ll find your feet quickly here. That’s why we’d rather hear from you than from someone who hasn’t, and why it’s the one thing we’ll weigh most heavily.

About the role

  • You’ll review online consultations in our prescriber app and approve, hold or reject each request, with a clear written reason every time.

  • You’ll write short, jargon-free messages that our customer service team passes on to patients.

  • You’ll work with our customer service and pharmacy teams to sort out queries quickly and politely.

  • You’ll take part in clinical audits, help improve our SOPs and guidelines, and join a weekly team meeting and a monthly patient incident review.

  • You’ll escalate anything outside your scope, such as safeguarding concerns or incidents, to your Team Lead.

  • You’ll work Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. That’s 37.5 hours a week with a 30-minute unpaid break.

  • The role is fully remote and starts as soon as possible.

  • You’ll be paid £30 an hour, as either a locum or PAYE. You choose.

This is a screen-based role with set hours. There are no patient appointments, and you’ll work independently with a team behind you.

Requirements
Essential

  • GPhC-registered Pharmacist with a Postgraduate Certificate in Independent Prescribing, annotated on the register

  • Sound clinical judgement when information is limited

  • Clear written communication

  • Confident working independently and remotely

  • Available to start straight away

Desired

  • Experience in digital prescribing, online pharmacy or remote prescribing (our strongest preference)

  • Experience with audits or writing SOPs

Application process

  1. Apply through our careers page.

  2. Have a 30-minute video call with our recruiter.

  3. Have a 60-minute interview with our Clinical Lead.

  4. Do a taster session of up to 3 hours.

  5. Complete 60 hours of paid training at £30 an hour, finished within 4 weeks. Your job offer follows.

Independent Pharmacist Prescriber | Remote (UK) | £30 per hour
