Title: Director, Event-Led Growth

Location: Remote (US); travel up to 25%

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Role type: Full-time employee, director, builder of a new function and partner to the Commercial Team

Role focus: Event strategy and execution that turn industry engagements and target-account meetings into pipeline and bookings; owner of the client advocacy and reference program

About VisiQuate:

VisiQuate helps healthcare organizations capture the full value of the care they deliver. Through AI-driven process mining and automation, advanced analytics, purpose-built agents, and intelligent workflows, VisiQuate turns complex revenue cycle data into actionable intelligence. Backed by more than 15 years of award-winning revenue cycle expertise, VisiQuate helps teams identify recoverable revenue, uncover the root causes of denials and payment delays, and prioritize the work that matters most.

2027 is an exciting year that provides exponential opportunity for VisiQuate, our clients, and our marketing organization. Following the VisiQuate and Artiva HCx acquisition announcement, we are building a modern marketing team to support growth.

Summary:

The Director, Event-Led Growth turns VisiQuate's events into a revenue engine. You choose the shows and programs that reach health system and revenue cycle leaders, partner with our commercial teams to fill them with target-account meetings, and create post-event nurture that drives those engagements to become pipeline and bookings.

This is a functional build. In 2027 VisiQuate takes a refreshed brand position to market, and events will serve as one of our largest pipeline generating tactics. The aligned candidate will take events from logistics to a revenue-accountable program, with the playbooks, data and sales partnership to prove it. The role also owns the client advocacy and reference program. Reports to the CMO; measured on event-sourced pipeline and bookings, target-account meetings and client reference coverage.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and own the annual event strategy and calendar: national and regional trade shows, hosted and sponsored small-scale events, customer events and digital events.
  • Set goals for every event (target-account meetings, sourced pipeline, bookings, ROI) and report results after each one.
  • Partner with Sales before each event to ensure messaging coordination, optimal at-event target account meetings, and post-event SLA adherence on follow-up plays so every lead is captured and worked.
  • Own lead capture at events; work with Marketing Operations on routing, follow-up service levels and campaign tracking in CRM and MAP (Marketing Automation Platform).
  • Build repeatable event playbooks with Integrated Marketing (campaigns, content) and Brand & Creative (booth, signage, collateral).
  • Own event logistics, vendors and the events budget and define the support model that fits (internal associate or an event services firm).
  • Grow regional and customer events that drive expansion across the combined VisiQuate and Artiva customer base.
  • Own the client advocacy and reference program: build a roster of reference clients with Customer Success, manage reference requests from Sales, place client speakers at events and panels, and build toward a client advisory board. Work the Communications Specialist on case studies and press quotes.

What success looks like in the first year:

  • A 2027 event calendar with goals for every event (target-account meetings, sourced pipeline, bookings, ROI), agreed with Sales before show season.
  • Event-sourced pipeline and bookings on target, reported after every event and rolled up each quarter.
  • Pre-show outreach and post-show follow-up plays run with Sales at every major show, with every lead captured and routed within the agreed service level.
  • Repeatable playbooks for trade shows, hosted events and customer events, built with Integrated Marketing and Brand & Creative.
  • A client reference roster in place and tracked in the CRM, with Sales reference requests filled on time and client speakers at major events.
  • A 2028 recommendation on which events to keep, add and cut, based on ROI and bookings.

Core Competencies:

  • Revenue focus: plans every event backward from pipeline and bookings, and cuts what does not pay back.
  • Builder mindset: creates process, playbooks and measurement where none exist.
  • Sales partnership: earns sellers' trust and turns conversations into qualified opportunities.
  • Operational rigor: runs a full calendar with no dropped handoffs, before, during or after the show.
  • Data fluency: reads funnel data and explains ROI plainly to executives.
  • Executive presence: comfortable hosting CFOs and revenue cycle leaders.
  • Client relationships: earns the trust of client executives to speak, host and serve as references.

Education & Skills:

  • 7+ years of B2B event or field marketing, including at least 3 years owning an event program and budget.
  • A track record of tying events to sourced pipeline and bookings.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and a marketing automation platform.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Remote in the US; travel up to 25%.

Preferred / Plus:

  • Healthcare technology experience, ideally selling to health system finance and revenue cycle leaders.
  • Experience hosting executive events for CFOs and revenue cycle leaders.
  • Experience running a client reference or advocacy program.
Salary: $150k - $170 DOE

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role:

Alpaca is building a differentiated position in primary markets: connecting issuers and lead underwriters to high-quality global retail demand through our brokerage infrastructure and broker-dealer partner network; Equity Capital Markets is a strategic growth engine for Alpaca.

We're looking for a Director, Equity Capital Markets to own Alpaca's ECM franchise: win issuer-selected allocations, deepen relationships with syndicate and ECM desks at major underwriters, and originate the next wave of investment banking opportunities across IPOs, follow-ons, and other primary offerings.

This person will operate at the intersection of capital markets, issuer coverage, and distribution strategy. You will package Alpaca's global retail reach—especially international and partner-driven demand—into a proposition that issuers and banks choose for retail tranches. You will run live-deal execution end to end, from selling-group readiness through allocation quality and post-deal reporting, while building a durable pipeline of future IB opportunities for Alpaca.

This is not a pure coverage or relationship role. You're building Alpaca's seat at the syndicate table and turning distribution into repeatable primary-market wins that compound into broader investment banking relationships.

What you'll do:

  • Build and own senior relationships with issuers, sponsors, CFOs, IR teams, and bankers to get Alpaca into retail-platform selection processes, data packs, and management conversations—securing meaningful allocations.
  • Develop and deepen coverage of lead underwriters and ECM / syndicate desks across bulge-bracket and select boutique banks; drive selling-group / select-dealer agreements from introduction through execution and operational readiness
  • Position Alpaca's distribution story—global retail reach, broker-dealer partner network, geo / demographic targeting, customer quality, and anti-flipping controls—so issuers and banks prefer Alpaca for retail participation
  • Originate and grow future investment banking opportunities for Alpaca across IPOs, follow-ons, and related primary offerings, with focus on retail-friendly and high-conviction sectors
  • Run live-deal execution: qualify offerings, mobilize partner and end-client demand, coordinate legal / selling restrictions and jurisdictional readiness, manage IOI / order flow, and deliver clean post-deal reporting
  • Build a repeatable ECM operating rhythm—pipeline reviews, banker coverage maps, issuer outreach cadence, and deal retrospectives—that scales with deal volume
  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Product, Brokerage Ops, Partnerships, and Finance to keep Alpaca deal-ready across agreements, marketing materials, restricted jurisdictions, and allocation methodology
  • Represent Alpaca in issuer pitches, banker meetings, exchange / PE channels, and industry conferences; convert introductions into active coverage and signed pathways to allocation

Overview

INTERNAL OPPORTUNITY: CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COORDINATOR

LOCATION: RPE – REMOTE

SHIFT: DAY(8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST)

REPORTS TO: DIRECTOR OF BUSINESS PROCESS & CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

About the Opportunity:

Grimmway Produce Group is seeking a Customer Experience Coordinator to support sales operations by managing customer orders, procurement coordination, transportation logistics, and accounts receivable activities within the company's ERP system, while assuring accurate and timely fulfillment of potato and onion orders for nationwide retail and foodservice accounts. Whether you are a current GPG team member looking to grow your career or a professional seeking a rewarding opportunity in agriculture, this position offers the chance to contribute to one of the world’s largest carrot and organic vegetable grower, packer, and shippers. At GPG, we take pride in delivering fresh, healthy, and safe products to communities while caring for the earth’s natural resources and investing in our family of employees—come grow with us!

CLICK HERE TO VIEW THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION

Additional Info

What You Will Need:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of high-volume customer service, sales support, order management, or logistics experience required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Working knowledge of order processing, transportation coordination, invoicing, and basic accounts receivable practices.
  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills to accurately review pricing, quantities, invoices, and financial discrepancies.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to develop effective working relationships with customers, growers, carriers, vendors, and internal departments.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills to investigate discrepancies, anticipate challenges, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail, accountability, adaptability, and commitment to customer service.
  • Ability to learn new technologies, analyze business information, and identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening consistent with applicable state and federal law.

What Will Set You Apart:

  • Experience in produce, agriculture, or food distribution.
  • Experience with ERP systems, order management software, and customer sales portals.

Benefits

Starting Wage: $26.00 – 33.00 / Hour

Filling Deadline: November 24th, 2026 (Internal Candidates)

  • Actual compensation paid within the range will be determined by factors such as the education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

      • Vacation, sick, holiday pay, medical, dental, vision, 401k matching, FSA, tuition reimbursement, scholarship program, subsidized gym membership, discounted tickets to major theme parks throughout California, continued learning and development, family events, work life balance.

jobs.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Tagalog-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Tagalog Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $15 - $17 per hour

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.
    • For Colorado applicants, the expected pay range is $15.16 - $19.29 per hour.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Tagalog Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Tagalog and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inTagalog and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Fourteen (14) days from the posting date of November 20, 2026.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Specialist to join our team. This is a Remote role, based in the USA, reporting to the Director, Product Specialist in the PM - Security AI department. Drive product strategy and cross-functional execution for a Principal-level area within Zscaler’s Security AI portfolio, shaping how enterprise customers securely adopt AI agents and agentic workflows. The role owns outcomes end-to-end: identifying the highest-leverage bets, aligning Engineering, Design, Security Research, and GTM on them, and shipping capabilities that measurably improve customer security posture.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Run structured discovery with enterprise customers, partners, and the field; translate qualitative insight and product telemetry into crisp requirements and measurable outcomes
  • Shape portfolio-level decisions: frame product bets, contribute to platform and architecture direction, and align adjacent PM teams around a coherent Security AI narrative
  • Drive clarity at every altitude—write sharp PRDs and launch narratives, brief executives and stakeholders, and represent the product to customers, analysts, and partners

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • Familiarity with agentic systems or emerging AI/agent protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A), prior PM experience on AI or Workloads platform, data protection, or SASE/Zero Trust products

jobs.title: Creative Lead
jobs.excerpt: Koala is a global furniture brand bringing Australian design and innovation to the world.
jobs.description:
Koala is a global furniture brand bringing Australian design and innovation to the world. We create forward-thinking products that solve problems for people and homes everywhere, driven by our purpose to make the world a more comfortable place.

We’ve always believed in doing things differently, whether in the way we develop products, how we do people and culture, or the way we bring the brand to life. That mindset has fuelled our growth, helping us disrupt categories in ways that are creative, bold and often unexpected. While we’re a household name in Australia, our journey on the global stage is only just beginning.

Since launching in 2015, our furniture has reached homes across Australia, Japan, the US and the UK. As a B Corp-certified, customer-obsessed, and data-led company, we’re committed to revolutionising furniture for generations to come through design, innovation, and meaningful sustainability.

Role Description

The Creative Lead runs Koala's US creative function day to day. The role exists to turn global brand direction and US commercial priorities into a steady flow of strong, on-brand ideas — and to build the processes that keep that flow under control as the team and the business grow.

The role splits roughly in half. Around 50% is performance creative: leading the concepts for paid social and CRM in partnership with the Paid Creative Strategist, while the designers and editors execute. The other 50% is brand work: retail, events, art direction on photo and video shoots, complex production, and stewardship of the brand identity in the US.

This is a creative leadership role with real operational weight. The Creative Lead owns the idea, the brief response, the process and the stakeholder relationships. The Lead Designer owns the craft, the design system and the final quality gate. Brand expression and campaign platforms sit with the Global ECD and Global Brand team; the Creative Lead is their counterpart in the US, adapting that direction to US channels, moments and spaces without diluting it.

Key Responsibilities

Performance creative: Paid & CRM (~50%)

  • Lead the creative concepts for paid social and CRM. Turn strategy and insight into ideas, scripts, hooks and formats the designers and editors can execute.

  • Partner with the Paid Creative Strategist as an equal. The strategist owns audience insight, testing hypotheses and the performance read; the Creative Lead owns the creative idea and how it is expressed. Both are expected to challenge each other.

  • Brief designers, editors, creators and freelancers on concept and intent, and review work against the idea before it goes to the Lead Designer's quality gate.

  • Lead US creative development on higher-investment paid concepts with the Global ECD, treating them as brand work as much as performance work.

  • Balance a testing roadmap of iterative, proven formats with a steady share of bigger, distinctive ideas. Don't let what performed last month set the ceiling.

  • Know what every piece is being asked to achieve and follow how it performs. Use results supplied by the performance team to sharpen the next idea.

  • Set the creative direction for lifecycle and CRM moments, working with the CRM owner on light-touch campaigns and templates.

Brand, production and retail (~50%)

  • Lead US brand work: seasonal campaigns, launches, partnerships and moments that sit above day-to-day performance.

  • Art direct photo and video shoots: build the treatment, shot lists, casting, styling and set direction, and lead on set.

  • Lead creative for retail and physical experiences, including pop-ups, events and our first retail footprint in the US. Work with retail, architects, fit-out partners and the Global team to bring the brand into physical space.

  • Plan complex production. Scope large shot lists across products, configurations and colourways, prioritise coverage against budget, and make trade-offs early rather than on the day.

  • Hold production to Koala's governance framework: clear deadlines, agreed coverage, and sign-off that doesn't slip.

  • Maintain and develop the brand identity in the US with the Global Brand team. Ensure it shows up consistently in stores, events, partnerships and content.

Process and operations

  • Design, run and improve the US creative process: intake, briefing, review rounds, approvals and handover. Make it simple enough that people follow it.

  • Own the creative calendar and pipeline. Keep a clear view of what is in flight, what is at risk and what is coming.

  • Set clear boundaries between strategy, creative and craft so each person knows what they own and where to push back.

  • Push back on briefs that are unclear, unrealistic or asking for the wrong thing, and help stakeholders rewrite them.

  • Protect the team's capacity. Flag conflicts early and agree priorities with the Head of US Marketing.

  • Manage freelance and agency partners on creative scope, brief and quality. Commercial engagement decisions sit with the Head of US Marketing.

Working with the global team

  • Be the US creative team's main point of contact for the Global ECD and Global Brand & Creative teams.

  • Bring US market, channel and customer insight into global creative development early, while it can still shape the work.

  • Represent global direction to US stakeholders accurately, including when it constrains a local request.

  • Present concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, including the leadership team.

  • Manage expectations across paid, ecommerce, CRM, retail and leadership, so feedback is consolidated, timely and final.

Team leadership

  • Line-manage the Lead Designer and Designer: goals, development, feedback and performance, with the Global ECD and Head of US Marketing.

  • Work with the Lead Designer as a partner: the Creative Lead sets the idea and direction, the Lead Designer owns craft, systems and ship-readiness.

  • Input into hiring as the team grows, and help shape the structure of the US creative function.

  • Build a culture of honest critique, generous credit and disagreement handled in the room.

  • Model Koala's values in how the work gets made, not only in what gets delivered.

Ideal background

  • 8+ years in creative roles, with at least 3 leading creative teams or programs. In-house experience at a consumer, DTC or retail brand strongly preferred.

  • A track record of building and running creative processes that stuck: intake, briefing, review and approvals across multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong conceptual thinking across performance and brand. Able to show paid social and CRM work that performed and still looked like the brand.

  • Hands-on art direction for photo and video, including complex productions with large shot lists, multiple products or variants, and tight budgets.

  • Experience in retail, experiential or events creative. Flagship, pop-up or store environment work is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working inside a global brand system and with a global creative team across time zones.

  • Confident presenting to senior and non-creative stakeholders, and calm when managing competing feedback.

  • Experience managing designers and editors, and briefing freelancers, creators and agencies.

  • Working fluency in Figma and Adobe CC, and enough craft to make a layout, script or rough edit when needed.

  • Home furnishings, interiors or lifestyle category experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Perks and Privileges

Koala is only great when its employees are happy — and we’re one happy bunch!

  • Work From SofaBed (WFB) - Most of our team is located in LA and surrounding areas, but also happy for you to be fully remote.

  • Take a break - Generous time off - Koala life leave, volunteer, parental, and more to help keep your work-life balance, balanced.

  • Surprise & delight - The two-word combo at the core of everything we do. All Koalas can expect to enjoy free Koala products with ‘mates rates’ for your friends and fam.

  • Support & wellbeing - Our employee experience respects and embraces all families, formed, found, and evolving. You’ll have access to our Employee Assistance Program, which includes unlimited sessions for financial, work, relationship, family or wellbeing support.

  • Competitive 401k matching and comprehensive Anthem private health insurance plans.

  • Accelerate your career - via our Learning Management platform, as well as individual and team growth budgets and dedicated days.

  • Community & connection - We believe that simply doing ‘no harm’ isn’t good enough So, how are we doing our part? We believe that simply doing ‘no harm’ isn’t good enough So, how are we doing our part? BCorp Certified, WWF Partnership, volunteer days, a member of SoftLanding, and so much more.

  • All in all, the Koala Community is a great place to hang out and belong to!

Koalities We Look For

At Koala, we do things a little differently and we don’t shy away from the fact that we expect a lot from our employees! We are ambitious. We are curious. We are selfless. We want you to challenge expectations, always look to make a difference and give us something different from the norm. We want people that bring great energy, that have a long-game focus and are always trying to find new angles and approaches to the way we work. We're a team full of entrepreneurial spirit and have a relentless focus on 'what's next' but while always reviewing 'what's been done' and learning, growing and adapting. Honesty and empathy drive everything we do, as well as a total focus on exceeding our customers’ expectations. So if you feel like this could be you... well what the bloody hell are you waiting for? Drop us a line, and let's see what you've got! ;)

There’s no such thing as a ‘perfect’ candidate, Koala is a place where everyone has opportunity. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that a diverse workforce is crucial to our success as a business.

To read more, check out our careers, LinkedIn, or the great work we do with Work180.

This is a hands-on position requiring a solid understanding of various security domains and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implementing, monitoring, and maintaining security controls across our corporate and cloud environments.

Role overview

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to own the administration and security of our core tools, from Okta and Google Workspace to Slack, ClickUp and the AI tools our teams use every day. Our team is fully remote and works with a Bring Your Own Device policy, which makes for some interesting security challenges.

In your first months, you’ll take part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company. You’ll then help us harden our infrastructure, automate onboarding and offboarding, and keep a close eye on security as we scale.

You’ll have opportunity to drive your own initiatives, and you’ll also be the first point of contact when colleagues need help with access or tools. If you have strong foundations in at least one area and enjoy learning the rest, you’ll have a lot of independence, a budget for state-of-the-art tooling, and room to grow into a team lead role as the team scales.

Responsibilities

Security Tool Rollout

  • Take key part in the rollout of Okta, 1Password and an endpoint security solution across the company
  • Evaluate tools and present recommendations to the CTO and IT Director
  • Apply security baselines across tools and devices

Identity & Access Management

  • Own the administration of Okta, including SSO, MFA and integrations with our tools
  • Manage access to new software and AI tools through Okta
  • Run regular access reviews and fix permissions that don’t match current roles

Tool Administration

  • Administer Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp and AI assistant tools, including users, permissions and security settings
  • Track licences and flag unused or underused accounts
  • Maintain an up-to-date inventory of tools, accounts and admin roles

Automation

  • Automate onboarding so new joiners get the right access on day one
  • Automate offboarding so leavers lose access promptly and their data is handled correctly
  • Build integrations and workflows between tools using automation platforms or scripting

Security Monitoring & Support

  • Work with our security and DevOps colleagues on infrastructure hardening
  • Handle first-line access requests and support tickets from colleagues
  • Investigate incidents, then record causes and fixes

Documentation

  • Write clear guides for colleagues on access and security practices

Must-Have Skills

jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
  • You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
  • Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
  • Running observability for a production platform at scale
  • Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is €96,846 - €116,215. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. jobs.excerpt: Kyivstar. Tech is looking for a Product Designer to help shape and develop innovative AI-powered products and experiences.
jobs.description:
Kyivstar.Tech is looking for a Product Designer to help shape and develop innovative AI-powered products and experiences.

We are looking for a designer who goes beyond traditional interface design and takes a proactive, entrepreneurial approach to product development. Someone who deeply understands AI technologies, recognizes opportunities emerging from their capabilities, and can independently turn those opportunities into meaningful product concepts and user experiences.

This is not a role focused on simply translating predefined requirements into interfaces. We expect a designer who actively contributes to product discovery, challenges assumptions, explores emerging technologies, and proposes new ways AI can create value for users and businesses.

A strong understanding of how modern AI systems work is essential. You should be comfortable discussing LLMs, AI agents, orchestration, integrations, and technical constraints with engineers, while keeping your primary focus on product thinking and user experience.

You’ll work closely with Product Owners, engineers, Business Analysts, and other team members, contributing to product direction, exploring new opportunities, and delivering innovative AI-powered experiences.

About us

Kyivstar.Tech is a Ukrainian hybrid IT company and a resident of Diia.City. We are a subsidiary of Kyivstar, one of Ukraine’s largest telecom operators.

Our mission is to transform lives in Ukraine and beyond by creating innovative technological solutions that unleash the potential of businesses while meeting the evolving needs of users.

With over 700 specialists working across diverse domains—from mobile and web solutions to the design, development, support, and maintenance of high-performance systems—we are committed to driving meaningful change.

We embrace an entrepreneurial culture that fosters continuous growth, challenges conventional thinking, and inspires the creation of transformative products.

What you will do

  • Drive AI-powered product innovation: Proactively identify new product opportunities, explore emerging AI capabilities, and propose innovative use cases and experiences that create value for users and businesses.
  • Contribute to product direction: Collaborate with Product Owners, engineers, and stakeholders to shape product concepts, challenge assumptions, and influence product decisions rather than simply executing predefined requirements.
  • Apply technology-driven product thinking: Explore what becomes possible through AI technologies, translating their capabilities and limitations into meaningful product solutions without relying exclusively on established user problems or conventional UX patterns.
  • Understand the technology behind the product: Work closely with engineers to understand LLM capabilities, AI orchestration, agent workflows, APIs, system integrations, and architectural constraints, using this knowledge to inform product and design decisions.
  • Design AI platform experiences: Create intuitive interfaces for configuring, managing, monitoring, and interacting with AI-powered systems, agents, and workflows.
  • Explore new human-AI interaction models: Design conversational experiences, intelligent assistants, embedded AI functionality, and innovative interaction patterns that go beyond traditional graphical interfaces.
  • Develop functional AI prototypes: Independently create working prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar solutions, integrating AI models and APIs when necessary to demonstrate and validate product concepts.
  • Lead proactive product discovery: Independently formulate hypotheses, investigate potential use cases, explore alternative solutions, and identify opportunities even when established user workflows, detailed requirements, or historical analytics are unavailable.
  • Validate ideas through experimentation: Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on product concepts using user research, usability testing, technical experimentation, and qualitative or quantitative feedback.
  • Apply systems thinking: Design coherent, scalable experiences across interconnected products, services, and AI components, considering system behavior, user roles, integrations, and evolving requirements.
  • Integrate AI into everyday design work: Actively use AI-powered tools for research, ideation, analysis, prototyping, documentation, and design-to-development workflows, continuously exploring more effective approaches.
  • Deliver high-quality product experiences: Produce thoughtful UX solutions, polished interfaces, interactive prototypes, and clear design specifications, applying and extending the corporate design system where appropriate.
  • Collaborate throughout implementation: Work closely with developers to ensure product concepts are technically feasible, appropriately implemented, and consistent with the intended user experience.
  • Evaluate and improve product effectiveness: Define meaningful success criteria, analyze user feedback and product performance, and continuously refine solutions based on evidence and emerging opportunities

Qualifications and experience needed

  • Product Design Experience: Proven Product Designer with a strong track record of independently designing and delivering complex digital products and contributing to product-level decisions.
  • Personal AI Projects: Demonstrable experience independently creating AI-powered prototypes, experimental applications, micro-products, or functional product concepts. Candidates must be able to present concrete examples of their own work, demonstrate how AI is used within these solutions, and explain their personal contribution to their design and implementation.
  • Entrepreneurial Product Mindset: Demonstrated ability to proactively identify opportunities, generate product ideas, challenge established approaches, and take initiative without waiting for predefined requirements or detailed instructions.
  • Deep AI Understanding: Strong practical understanding of LLMs, AI agents, AI-powered tools, and the principles behind modern AI applications, including their capabilities, limitations, and potential product applications.
  • Technical Literacy: Ability to understand and discuss AI system architecture, orchestration, APIs, integrations, data flows, and technical dependencies with engineering teams. Software engineering experience is not required.
  • Technology-Driven Innovation: Ability to translate emerging technological capabilities into valuable product concepts, use cases, and user experiences, supported by practical experimentation rather than theoretical knowledge alone.
  • Functional AI Prototyping — Required: Practical ability to build working interactive prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar solutions. Experience connecting prototypes to AI models or APIs and experimenting with actual AI behavior is expected. Professional programming skills are not required.
  • AI-Integrated Design Workflow: Confident, everyday use of AI-powered tools across research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and design production—ability to structure effective AI-assisted workflows and critically evaluate generated outputs.
  • AI Experience Design: Understanding of the distinctive challenges of AI-powered interfaces, including non-deterministic behavior, user control, transparency, error handling, and building trust in AI-assisted interactions.
  • Systems Thinking: Ability to understand complex products holistically, identify relationships between components and processes, and design scalable experiences across interconnected systems.
  • Product Discovery & Validation: Experience independently identifying opportunities, framing hypotheses, conducting research, validating concepts, and iterating based on user feedback and experimental results.
  • UX/UI Design Expertise: Strong skills in information architecture, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping, with the ability to deliver polished, intuitive experiences for complex digital products.
  • Design Systems & Tools: Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, variables, and interactive prototyping, alongside experience working with and extending established design systems.
  • Mindset: Curious, analytical, experimental, and comfortable with ambiguity. Motivated to explore unfamiliar technologies, challenge assumptions, continuously learn, and independently turn ideas into tangible results.
  • Team Fit: Strong communication and collaboration skills, experience working in cross-functional Agile/Scrum teams, and Intermediate+ proficiency in English and Ukrainian.

A plus would be

  • Commercial AI Product Experience: Previous experience designing and delivering AI-powered products, intelligent assistants, AI agents, conversational interfaces, or enterprise AI platforms.
  • Advanced AI Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with agent orchestration, tool calling, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, and other architectural approaches used in modern AI applications.
  • Enterprise Integration Experience: Experience working with enterprise platforms, customer support systems, CRM solutions, or products that integrate with multiple internal and external services.
  • Advanced AI Development Workflows: Experience building more sophisticated AI applications, implementing multi-step agentic workflows, integrating multiple AI services, or using AI-assisted development tools to automate complex tasks.
  • B2B SaaS & Platform Design: Experience designing configurable, modular, or API-driven platforms intended for integration into third-party products and services.
  • AI Evaluation & Observability: Familiarity with approaches to evaluating AI behavior, monitoring system performance, and designing interfaces that help users understand and control AI-powered processes.
  • Accessibility & Inclusive Design: Knowledge of WCAG accessibility standards and experience applying inclusive design principles to complex digital experiences.

What we offer

  • Office or remote — it’s up to you
  • Remote onboarding
  • Performance bonuses for everyone (annual or quarterly — depends on the role)
  • We train employees, with the opportunity to learn through the company’s library, internal resources, and programs from partners
  • Health and life insurance
  • Wellbeing program and corporate psychologist
  • Reimbursement of expenses for Kyivstar mobile communication

  • Income Protection: Company-provided short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Analyze NAV objects and C/AL code to understand existing business logic, identify root causes, and resolve system issues.
  • Data Management & Configuration: Maintain customer account structures, business codes, tax configurations, and other critical system data.
  • Inventory & Transaction Processing: Support scan-based trading (SBT), inventory reporting, and electronic transaction processing.
  • Process Improvement & Automation: Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, automate manual processes, and improve system efficiency.
  • Reporting & Issue Prevention: Develop exception reports and automated alerts to proactively identify transaction errors and reconciliation discrepancies.
  • Vendor & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams and third-party technology partners to troubleshoot issues and support system enhancements.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and system records while following SOX IT controls and established change management processes.

  • Strong SQL Server skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, views, SQL Server Agent jobs, and performance troubleshooting.

  • Experience troubleshooting data integrations, reconciling information across systems, and resolving transaction discrepancies.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with NAV 2009 R2, including the ability to read and interpret C/AL code and NAV objects, preferred.
  • Experience with electronic data interchange (EDI), including X12 standards, preferred.
  • Familiarity with SOX IT general controls, change management, and user access procedures preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, document technical processes, and communicate solutions effectively.
  • Must be a Citizen or National of the United States, a lawful permanent resident, or have authorization to work in the United States.
  • Applicants must not now, or at any time in the future, require sponsorship for an employment visa.

Work Environment

Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Set the Foundation for Time-Critical Order Execution

Airspace moves the shipments that can't be late — for hospitals waiting on an organ, a grounded aircraft waiting on a part, or a production line waiting on a component. As an Operations Specialist I, you're one of the first people to touch a new order, and how well you set it up determines whether everything downstream goes smoothly.

This is where every Airspace Operations career starts. You'll learn the platform, the players (customers, Commanders, and agent service providers), and the judgment calls that come with time-critical logistics. The role is deliberately structured to build your foundation fast, so that by the time you're ready to advance, the fundamentals are second nature.

What You'll Do

Operate the Airspace Platform

  • Set up new orders by adhering to standard work practices and client-specific SOP instructions
  • Apply transit accessorials (e.g., wait time, parking, tolls) in PT as reported — for charges that are not auto-generated by the system
  • Navigate and interpret carrier booking and tracking systems relevant to the order
  • Accurately confirm job milestones are completed correctly and on time
  • Rapidly move between competing priorities without losing accuracy

Solve Problems as They Arise

  • Source driver coverage for any segment of an order
  • Use situational awareness to request or deny additional driver incentives when necessary
  • Update, manage, and/or change shipment documentation as needed
  • Apply training and tenured knowledge to find solutions to common or uncommon issues
  • Follow escalation procedures and guidance from senior team members when a situation exceeds your judgment

Keep Customers Informed

  • Professionally relay delays, issues, and updates through verbal and written communication
  • Anticipate disruptions (weather, traffic, carrier delays) and proactively offer alternatives to meet or beat required delivery times
  • Place orders on behalf of customers who are unable to use the online portal

Stay Responsive Across Channels

  • Timely acknowledgment and action on all email, phone, and text requests
  • Consistently meet minimum metric expectations for phone availability and acceptance
  • Proper use of phone statuses; adherence to All Hands on Deck and Off-Phones guidelines
  • Stay independently informed by reviewing all communications provided throughout company platforms

Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance

As an OS I, you'll be expected to meet minimum metric requirements and customer service standards appropriate for an entry-level position. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor. Expectations increase with each advancement.

Requirements

  • Prior logistics experience preferred, but not required — we'll train you on the platform, the workflows, and the judgment calls
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable on the phone with customers under time pressure
  • High attention to detail — small errors in time-critical logistics have outsized consequences
  • Ability to multitask and shift rapidly between competing priorities
  • Comfortable following structured processes while also using judgment when a situation falls outside the standard playbook
  • Willingness to obtain any certifications required for your assigned sector (e.g., Dangerous Goods handling, where applicable)
  • Available to work the shift pattern required by your team, including some evenings, weekends, or holidays as the network requires
  • Available for 2 weeks of training in person on-site in our Carlsbad, CA headquarters

Advancement to Operations Specialist II

Advancement is a gate, not a timeline — tenure alone doesn't move you forward. To advance to OS II, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

  • Minimum of 6 months in the OS I role
  • Consistently meeting or exceeding OS I performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed at your first structured Semi-Annual Review (SAR)
  • Demonstrated proficiency across all OS I responsibilities with minimal supervision
  • Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to independently own the additional judgment calls required at OS II

Your First 90 Days

Get fluent in the Airspace platform, order lifecycle, and the standard work practices that keep time-critical shipments on track. Build working relationships with your team, your supervisor, and the Commanders and agent partners you'll coordinate with daily. By day 90, you should be handling the full OS I workload independently, with escalation as your safety net rather than your default.

Compensation

  • Hourly pay range: $20-23/hr
  • High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options
  • 401K company contribution program
  • Professional learning and training reimbursements

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

jobs.excerpt: Sprout Social is looking to hire a Billing Specialist to join the Finance team, to be based in the Philippines.
jobs.description:
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Billing Specialist to join the Finance team, to be based in the Philippines.

Why join Sprout’s Finance team?

At Sprout Social, our Finance team powers the strategy behind helping leading brands unlock the value of social intelligence. We act as the company’s fiscal backbone—equipping leaders with insights to make smart decisions while delivering a seamless experience for customers and meeting the demands of a dynamic public company.

You'll join a collaborative team grounded in accuracy and operational excellence, where your work directly impacts Sprout's success. We foster a culture of high standards and continuous learning, giving you the opportunity to grow your expertise while making meaningful contributions.

What you’ll do

  • Coordinate collection efforts for past due invoices documenting communications, discussions, and resolutions to ensure information is available for the broader finance team.
  • Manage customer inquiries and resolve billing issues.
  • Complete vendor set up forms and onboarding in customer billing portals.
  • Work with customers to bring accounts current, collaborating with Sprout team members throughout the organization.
  • Work with the Collections team and Billing leadership to resolve customer questions, concerns, or billing requirements that may prevent timely collection.
  • Report on collections activity and customer account updates to provide greater visibility to progress and challenges.
  • Identify, investigate,and resolve any discrepancies within historical cash applications.
  • Keep accurate records and reporting on collections and cash applications.
  • Liaise with Sales, Success, and Support teams by investigating and resolving invoice/payment disputes or errors and develop improvements to facilitate seamless and continuous service moving forward.
  • Align practices and procedures with Billing team standards and Audit compliance.

What you’ll bring

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 1+ years collection and cash application experience - proven experience utilizing collections tools and strategies.
  • 1-3+ years experience in a customer service or operational role, using several different software systems in tandem.
  • Strong oral & written communication skills, plus the ability to summarize complex situations for understanding and alignment.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Experience with Netsuite, Salesforce and similar software.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and seek support to resolve issues quickly and accurately.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Attend and complete Sprout Social’s two-week new hire training and onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. In these sessions, you will gain a broad understanding of our products and how your role directly impacts the product, overall organization, and our customers.
  • Make a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, align on expectations for your role, and learn about Sprout’s collections and billing processes.
  • Have a deep understanding of the Finance team’s goals and key objectives and the impact our work has on Sprout’s overall business objectives
  • Get to know your team and begin to build working relationships with co-workers and customers.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Reaching out to customers that are 60+ days past due.
  • Begin learning portal management.
  • Understand the invoicing process and participate in generating new, renewal, and amendment invoices to ensure an organized and timely cash collection process.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Ensuring successful portal billing for customers.
  • Assisting with collections on accounts that need additional attention or require prioritization.
  • Foster rapport and communication across Sprout teams and customers.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Organizing and maintaining billing portal management processes and procedures.
  • Maintaining collections on accounts that do not exceed 60+ days past due and assisting in our overall cash collection goals.
  • Be a go-to Collections contact for all areas of the organization.
  • Continuously improve and maintain the various processes, adapting to changing requirements and ensuring accurate documentation.
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: A 23,299 PHP monthly allowance to cover your health insurance (HMO) needs.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including free coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 24 days of paid leave, 5 sick days, plus regular holidays, special non-working holidays, and company-wide Rest & Recharge days.
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): An annual $500 USD fund to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being—from gym memberships to hobbies.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet expenses.
  • Standard Compensation & Pay: We provide a 13th-month salary and adhere to all government-mandated pay premiums, including Night Shift Differential (NSD) and holiday/overtime pay.
  • Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible charitable organizations.
  • High-Quality Equipment: A 13" MacBook and other high-quality equipment to ensure you can do your best work.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: PHP 524,000–PHP 655,000 annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth opportunities available as you progress in your role.

The full base pay range for this role is PHP 524,000 – PHP 786.000.

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

Candidates for this remote work opportunity must be based in the Philippines. If you are based in another location within APAC, we aren’t able to hire in your location at this time.
