jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Vice President, Global Medical Affairs Engagement, Analytics and Capabilities will build and lead the capabilities that enable a forward-looking, globally connected Medical Affairs organization. Reporting to the Head of Global Medical Affairs, this leader will establish new functions, introduce innovative approaches to medical engagement and execution, and develop the insights and measurement systems needed to understand and amplify Medical Affairs’ impact.

The role will connect external engagement, medical insights, analytics, digital capabilities, congress execution and launch excellence into an integrated operating model that serves Global, Regional and Country Medical Affairs and cross-functional stakeholders. This individual will help the organization anticipate stakeholder needs, make informed decisions, improve execution and demonstrate its contribution to scientific understanding, clinical practice and patient care.

As a member of the Global Medical Affairs leadership team, the Vice President will be accountable for building teams, processes, technology and governance that can scale with the company’s portfolio and geographic expansion. Success will require translating emerging capabilities into practical improvements in how Medical Affairs works.

This role will partner closely across global, regional and country medical and commercial leaders, Research and Development teams to assess internal and external stakeholder needs and provide meaningful metrics that help Revolution Medicines understand and deliver impact to patients, health care providers, payers and health systems. The individual will also partner closely with Information Systems teams to support optimal design and deployment of tools and systems that make medical teams more effective at delivering impact.

Key Responsibilities

Capability Strategy and Organizational Development

  • Define and execute a multiyear capability roadmap aligned with global medical strategy, regional and country needs, portfolio priorities and geographic expansion.

  • Build the five reporting functions, establishing leadership, staffing, responsibilities, operating models and investment priorities.

  • Assess current capabilities and anticipate future needs across Global, Regional and Country Medical Affairs.

  • Prioritize capabilities that improve scientific engagement, decision-making, medical readiness and execution.

  • Establish scalable global frameworks with flexibility for regional and country requirements.

  • Lead organizational adoption through practical implementation, training, change management and ongoing support.

  • Evaluate emerging approaches and technologies, moving successful pilots into sustained operational use.

Global Medical Analytics and Insights

  • Establish a global analytics and insights function that brings together medical engagement data, stakeholder feedback, medical information inquiries, congress intelligence and other relevant sources.

  • Build a consistent approach to insight collection, synthesis, prioritization and interpretation across Medical Affairs.

  • Distinguish actionable insights from individual observations and activity reporting, identifying implications for medical strategy and execution.

  • Create mechanisms to route insights to accountable decision-makers and track resulting actions.

  • Deliver timely analyses of unmet needs, evidence gaps, stakeholder perspectives and changes in the scientific and treatment landscape.

  • Develop dashboards and decision-support tools tailored to global leadership, therapeutic area teams, regions and countries.

  • Establish data definitions, quality standards and analytical methods in partnership with enterprise data and technology teams.

  • Enable feedback to the teams contributing insights so they can see how their input informs decisions.

Medical Impact and Performance Measurement

  • Develop a measurement framework that connects medical objectives, activities, stakeholder outcomes and organizational impact.

  • Establish meaningful measures of engagement quality, educational effectiveness, launch readiness, capability adoption and operational performance.

  • Complement activity measures with evidence of changes in scientific understanding, identified needs and decisions informed by Medical Affairs.

  • Define baselines, targets and review processes that support learning and improvement.

  • Help leadership interpret results, including limitations in attribution and the time needed for medical activities to produce outcomes.

  • Use analytics to guide resource allocation, identify effective approaches and scale practices that deliver value.

  • Communicate Medical Affairs’ contribution through clear, evidence-based impact reports.

Digital Medical Capabilities and AI Deployment

  • Lead the digital medical capability strategy, identifying opportunities to improve external engagement, insight generation, scientific information access and internal productivity.

  • Partner with Medical Affairs teams to design engagement journeys and channel approaches informed by stakeholder needs and preferences.

  • Work closely with Information Systems teams to establish an AI deployment roadmap with prioritized use cases, accountable owners and measurable benefits.

  • Evaluate and deploy capabilities such as assisted insight synthesis, scientific information retrieval, engagement planning and workflow automation.

  • Partner with Information Systems, data science, information security, privacy, legal and compliance teams to establish appropriate controls.

  • Ensure AI-enabled workflows include validation, human oversight, monitoring and clear accountability for scientific accuracy.

  • Build digital and AI literacy across Medical Affairs and support sustained adoption.

  • Measure realized benefits and refine or discontinue capabilities that do not meet their intended objectives.

External Engagement

  • Establish the global framework for identifying, mapping and engaging scientific experts, investigators, emerging leaders and other relevant external stakeholders.

  • Build a dynamic approach to global KOL mapping that considers scientific expertise, research activity, clinical practice, professional networks and emerging areas of influence.

  • Support coordinated engagement planning across Global, Regional and Country teams while preserving local relationships and accountability.

  • Lead global advisory board planning and execution frameworks, ensuring each engagement has a clear scientific purpose, appropriate participants and a defined plan for using the insights.

  • Establish standards for capturing and synthesizing insights from external engagements.

  • Connect stakeholder insights to medical strategy, evidence planning, scientific content and education priorities.

  • Improve visibility into engagement across teams to strengthen continuity and reduce unnecessary duplication.

  • Assess engagement quality and relevance using measures beyond interaction volume.

Global Congress Planning and Execution

  • Lead the global congress medical operating model, including portfolio planning, resource allocation, logistics, vendor coordination and execution.

  • Develop integrated congress plans with Research and Development, global and regional commercial teams, corporate communications, patient advocacy, global scientific communications, medical information, medical training, and regional and country field teams.

  • Coordinate planning milestones, stakeholder engagement, meeting support and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Establish and coordinate a Congress Steering Committee bringing together senior leaders across the organization to unify our vision and strategy and optimize its delivery

  • Work cross-functionally to establish and deliver consistent processes for pre-congress preparation, onsite execution and post-congress follow-through.

  • Enable systematic capture and synthesis of congress insights and scientific intelligence.

  • Assess congress effectiveness against defined medical objectives, including engagement quality, insights generated and execution performance.

  • Build repeatable processes that improve efficiency and allow teams to scale congress participation as the organization grows.

Medical Launch Excellence

  • Establish a global medical launch excellence framework spanning prelaunch planning, readiness assessment, launch execution and post-launch learning.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. jobs.excerpt: Digital Infrastructure Project Manager About the Role AECOM is seeking a motivated Digital Infrastructure Project Manager to support the planning, design, and delivery of complex digital infrastructure and connectivity projects across the United States and globally.
jobs.description:
Digital Infrastructure Project Manager

About the Role

AECOM is seeking a motivated Digital Infrastructure Project Manager to support the planning, design, and delivery of complex digital infrastructure and connectivity projects across the United States and globally.

This is a mid-level project management position intended for an individual who has demonstrated experience managing engineering, design, construction, or infrastructure projects and is ready to take greater ownership of multidisciplinary project delivery.

The Project Manager will coordinate teams supporting fiber optic networks, telecommunications infrastructure, hyperscale infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, network and communications facilities, utility infrastructure, and other technology-driven infrastructure programs.

The successful candidate does not need to be the technical expert in every discipline. The role requires the ability to organize and lead multidisciplinary teams, understand project dependencies, communicate effectively with clients and technical staff, and maintain accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and deliverables.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

  • Manage digital infrastructure projects and individual project workstreams from planning and design through construction and closeout.
  • Develop and maintain project scope, schedule, budget, staffing plans, and deliverable requirements.
  • Track project performance and proactively identify schedule, cost, resource, quality, and coordination risks.
  • Coordinate project deliverables and ensure milestones are achieved in accordance with client commitments.
  • Manage project documentation, action registers, decision logs, meeting records, and change management activities.
  • Support project financial management, including forecasting, earned revenue, invoicing, and monitoring performance against budget.
  • Coordinate RFIs, submittals, design changes, field issues, and construction-phase activities as required.

Multidisciplinary Coordination

Coordinate internal and external teams across disciplines that may include:

  • Telecommunications and fiber infrastructure
  • Civil and site development
  • Electrical and utility infrastructure
  • Architecture
  • Structural engineering
  • Mechanical systems
  • Security and technology systems
  • Environmental and permitting
  • GIS and geospatial teams
  • Construction and commissioning

Facilitate project meetings and multidisciplinary coordination sessions to identify dependencies, resolve issues, assign actions, and maintain project momentum.

Work closely with technical leads and design managers to ensure designs are coordinated, constructible, and aligned with client requirements.

Digital Infrastructure

Support projects involving infrastructure such as:

  • Campus, metro, regional, and long-haul fiber networks
  • Inside plant (ISP) and outside plant (OSP) telecommunications infrastructure
  • Hyperscale infrastructure and technology campuses
  • Mission-critical facilities
  • Cable landing stations and terrestrial backhaul
  • Network operations and communications facilities
  • Carrier and broadband infrastructure
  • Utility and power infrastructure supporting telecommunications systems
  • Technology and industrial campuses

Direct experience in every technology area is not required. Candidates should have sufficient technical understanding to effectively manage specialists and recognize project interfaces, risks, and dependencies.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for clients and project stakeholders.
  • Prepare and lead project status meetings, coordination meetings, and client presentations.
  • Communicate schedule, budget, risk, decisions, and outstanding actions clearly and consistently.
  • Coordinate among clients, design teams, contractors, utilities, authorities having jurisdiction, and other project stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships with clients while identifying opportunities to improve delivery and provide additional value.

Project Controls & Risk

  • Maintain project schedules and milestone tracking.
  • Monitor budgets, forecasts, staffing, and project financial performance.
  • Manage scope changes and support preparation of amendments and additional-service requests.
  • Maintain project risk and issue registers.
  • Escalate significant technical, commercial, schedule, or resource concerns appropriately.
  • Support QA/QC processes and ensure required reviews are completed before deliverables are issued.
  • Help establish consistent project delivery processes, reporting, and documentation across programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Telecommunications, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related field.
  • 4 years of relevant professional experience in engineering, infrastructure, telecommunications, construction, utilities, mission-critical facilities, technology infrastructure, or a related project environment.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering, design, or construction teams.
  • Experience managing or supporting project scope, schedule, budget, staffing, and deliverables.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities and project stakeholders.
  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of relevant project delivery experience.
  • Experience managing telecommunications, fiber, utility, technology, mission-critical, industrial, or other complex infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with ISP/OSP fiber infrastructure, telecom pathways, utility coordination, or network infrastructure.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary architecture and engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting projects through design and construction.
  • Familiarity with project financial management and forecasting.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, ArcGIS, Revit/BIM, Bluebeam, or similar project delivery platforms.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or progress toward certification.
  • Professional Engineer (PE), Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD), or other relevant professional certification is a plus but not required.

What Success Looks Like

The successful Digital Infrastructure Project Manager will be able to take ownership of a project or defined program workstream and drive it forward with limited day-to-day supervision.

This individual will know what needs to happen next, understand who is responsible for it, recognize when something is becoming a project risk, and communicate clearly enough to keep multidisciplinary teams and clients aligned.

The position offers an opportunity to develop deeper expertise in digital infrastructure while progressing toward larger project, program, and client leadership responsibilities within AECOM.

  • Relocation is not available for this role
  • Sponsorship for US Employment Authorization is not available for this role now or in the future
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY February 22, 2027.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Our Benefits:

In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

jobs.excerpt: Remote-based in the US Overview GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology.
jobs.description:
Remote-based in the US

Overview

GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

GoodPower’s Creator Collective is a network of creators producing short-form video on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube. They make the case for affordable, reliable, and secure clean energy to the audiences who already trust them. Their content explains what the energy transition means for people’s bills, jobs, and communities, in terms people can relate to.

The Creator Marketing Manager will plan, run, and report on creator campaigns through the Collective. That covers recruitment and briefing through publication, paid amplification, and measurement. The role sits where communications meets research. The Creator Marketing Manager will work with GoodPower’s campaign, ads, and research teams to test which content changes public attitudes, and turn what works into programs that can repeat and scale.

This is a full time remote position based in the United States. Occasional travel is required, including for in-person all-staff meetings and other organizational events or work-related needs. Work outside regular business hours, including some evenings and weekends, may be required as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage creator campaigns from start to finish: recruitment, contracting, briefing, content review, publication, payment, and performance reporting. Use creator management platforms to do this at scale.

  • Write creative briefs and script examples in the voice of GoodPower-owned brands, including rapid-response briefs tied to timely energy news.

  • Build lasting relationships with creators, talent managers, and agencies so GoodPower is seen as a long-term creative partner.

  • Recruit creators into the Collective from categories that reach broad, mainstream audiences.

  • Partner with the ads team to boost and repurpose creator content for paid distribution, including negotiating content usage rights.

  • Make sure campaigns follow FTC disclosure rules, platform policies, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

  • Manage SMS opt-in pathways, keywords, and tracking links so creator content can be measured.

  • Analyze performance in Looker dashboards and other tools, including comment and sentiment analysis. Produce campaign wrap reports with clear recommendations.

  • Work with internal and external research teams on experiments, including randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of Collective campaigns.

  • Keep creator records, contracts, and outreach up to date in Salesforce.

  • Bring learnings from newer platforms and formats, such as Twitch and podcasts, into Collective campaigns with the rest of the creator marketing team.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years managing creator or influencer campaigns end to end. Your experience should include brief writing, content review, and performance reporting.

  • Hands-on use of at least one creator management platform, such as GRIN, CreatorIQ, HypeAuditor, or Upfluence, and the ability to describe how you used it.

  • A track record of writing creative briefs or creator scripts on your own. Writing samples will be requested.

  • Experience analyzing creator performance data (reach, engagement, conversion, audience demographics) and turning it into recommendations.

  • Experience negotiating creator contracts, including content usage rights for paid media.

  • Working knowledge of FTC disclosure requirements and platform rules for sponsored content.

  • Strong attention to detail, with experience checking campaign copy, links, and tracking before launch.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of clean energy, energy policy, or the economics of the energy transition, whether from work experience or your own study.

  • An established network of creators, talent managers, or agencies in mainstream categories such as personal finance, home and DIY, auto, tech, news and explainer, or local and regional content.

  • Experience with comment or sentiment analysis.

  • A background in advertising or paid media, including how creator content is structured for use in ads.

  • Experience running or supporting experiments, A/B tests, or audience research.

  • Salesforce proficiency beyond basic data entry.

This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

  • Annual salary range: $75,000-85,000, commensurate with experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
  • 2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
  • 13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
  • 2 weeks of US office closure
  • 10 days of paid sick leave annually.
  • 403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
  • Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
  • Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
  • Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
  • Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
  • 8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
  • 8 weeks of paid parental leave

GoodPower offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because we operate in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.excerpt: It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!  About the role: The Senior Director, Product Marketing owns how 8am's full portfolio is positioned, packaged, launched and sold.
jobs.description:
It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

The Senior Director, Product Marketing owns how 8am's full portfolio is positioned, packaged, launched and sold. Reporting to the SVP, Marketing, this leader builds an AI-forward product marketing function mentoring a group of high performing marketers using agents and automated workflows to turn research and customer insight into sharper messaging, faster launches and better-equipped sellers. You will set the platform narrative so customers and sellers see 8am as one connected platform, and you will partner with Product, Sales, Brand and the broader marketing team to drive pipeline, adoption and cross-sell. Success is measured by launch adoption and revenue, win rates against key competitors, sales cycle length, cross-sell growth and the health of your team.

About us:

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

Founded in 2005, 8am™ (formerly AffiniPay) is the professional business platform built to help legal, accounting, and other client-focused professionals run stronger, more profitable businesses. Today, more than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. trust 8am to help them work smarter, serve clients better, and unlock their full potential. We have been recognized as one of Inc 5000’s fastest growing companies in the U.S. for 13 years in a row, and as a result, our teams continue to grow as well!

What you'll do:

Lead an AI-forward product marketing team

  • Hire, mentor and develop a high-performing team of product marketers and managers, and design coverage across products, audiences and launches.
  • Design and run AI workflows and agents for research synthesis, competitive monitoring, message testing, first drafts of launch and enablement content, and team reporting.
  • Set the standard for how the team uses AI, including shared workflow and prompt libraries, quality review, and accuracy and brand guardrails.
  • Set team OKRs, career paths and the operating rhythm: launch calendar, request intake and prioritization, and reusable templates and playbooks.

Build research frameworks and share market insight

  • Build repeatable frameworks for ICP definition, TAM and segment sizing, and competitive analysis across legal, accounting and adjacent professional services markets.
  • Run ongoing competitive intelligence and publish market insights to Marketing, Sales, Product and leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Turn findings into clear recommendations that shape positioning, segmentation, campaigns and the product roadmap.

Own the voice of the customer

  • Own buyer personas and taste profiles for each core segment and practice area: what buyers value, how they evaluate and buy, the language they use, and the content and channels they trust.
  • Run customer feedback loops, including win/loss analysis, customer interviews and customer advisory boards with Product.
  • Bring the customer's perspective into roadmap, pricing and customer experience decisions.

Own messaging and positioning across the portfolio

  • Own the platform narrative and positioning framework for 8am and each solution: MyCase, LawPay, CPACharge, CasePeer, Docketwise and 8am IQ.
  • Build differentiated value messaging by segment, practice area and buyer type, and keep it consistent across every internal and external touchpoint.
  • Partner closely with Brand so product messaging and marketing materials reflect 8am's tone and voice.
  • Partner with demand generation, lifecycle, content, web, paid media and events teams so programs and deliverables stay on message, and review key assets before they ship.

Partner with Product on packaging and pricing

  • Work with Product, Finance and Sales to define packaging and pricing models that reflect customer value and 8am's market position, including AI capabilities.
  • Translate pricing and packaging changes into positioning, enablement and customer communication.
  • Develop in-app upsell and cross-sell strategy across 8am products.

Equip sellers to deliver a strong message

  • Partner with Sales Enablement so sellers deliver a clear, consistent message at every stage of the sales cycle.
  • Own enablement content, including pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling, demo narratives and training.
  • Track asset usage, win rates and sales cycle length, and refine content based on results.

Launch and share product innovation

  • Own go-to-market for launches across the portfolio, with launch tiers, readiness standards and post-launch reviews that feed the next plan.
  • Build programs that share product innovation with customers, prospects and the market on a regular cadence, such as release roundups, launch webinars, in-app announcements and customer newsletters.
  • Lead GTM planning cycles and provide input on resourcing and budget.

About you:

  • 12+ years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, including GTM leadership for a portfolio of products across multiple verticals.
  • 6+ years managing and developing high-performing teams, including managers of managers.
  • Hands-on experience building AI workflows or agents that measurably increased team output, using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or automation platforms, and coaching others to do the same.
  • Experience building research programs, including ICP, TAM, segmentation, competitive intelligence and win/loss.
  • Deep positioning and messaging expertise across a multi-product portfolio, including building a platform narrative.
  • Experience leading packaging and pricing work with Product and Finance.
  • A track record of sales enablement that improved win rates or shortened sales cycles.
  • Experience in a high-velocity SMB sales environment. Free trial, product-led growth and land-and-expand experience is a plus.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority and resolve competing priorities.
  • An analytical mindset and the ability to turn market data into clear recommendations.
  • Strong writing, storytelling and presentation skills for audiences from end users to executives.
  • Comfort moving between strategy and hands-on execution.

Nice to have:

  • Experience marketing to legal, accounting, fintech or other professional services audiences, including payments or practice management software.
  • Experience bringing AI-powered products to market.
  • Bachelor's degree; MBA a plus.

Additional InformationThe annual salary range for this position is $135,000 to $220,000. The salary range for performing this role outside of the US / Austin / California may differ. 8am is committed to offering competitive, fair and commensurate compensation and has provided an estimated pay range for this role. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and education.
Why 8am:

At 8am, our culture is shaped by the people who bring it to life every day. Together, we build a company rooted in continuous learning, genuine community, holistic wellness, and meaningful engagement—values that empower us as individuals and unite us as a team. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Work Smart, Win Fast; Outshine Ordinary, and We Find a Way. These values drive how we serve our customers and work with each other in a collaborative, inspiring, and empowering environment, every day.

Here’s how we support our 8Team:

  • Health Insurance Coverage: We offer our 8Team a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit your needs, including a 100% company-paid HDHP plan for employees.
  • Financial perks: We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including annual bonuses, equity options and 401(k) or RRSP if in Canada, with a company match for all team members.
  • Time for what matters: Flexible Time Off, paid holidays, and a parental leave program for our new parents.
  • Wellness: Wellness stipends, mental health support, and one-on-one nutrition coaching.
  • Learning and Development: Continuous learning through , leadership programs, professional development funds, and individually focused talent development.
  • Giving back to the communities around us: Participate in our charitable matching gift program, paid time off for volunteer service, and company-sponsored volunteer events (both local and virtually).
  • Engagement: Virtual and in-person team-building events, quarterly award recognition through our Rise & Shine Award of Excellence Program, and our peer-to-peer appreciation platform.

At 8am, we don’t just offer benefits - we create an environment where people can thrive, grow, and make a real impact every day.

Diversity, equity & inclusion at 8am:

At 8am, we recognize that innovation occurs with a strong team of people who are diverse in background, personality, talent and ideas. Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Security advisory:

Our hiring teams at 8am are dedicated to recruiting top talent that share our passion for serving the professional services industry through innovative financial technology. As such, our Talent Acquisition Team only follows legitimate hiring practices. We will always communicate with our candidates using emails with the 8am domain and will never ask for sensitive/personal data during the application process. All interviews take place over phone call, Zoom/Google Meet or in person. All offers are communicated verbally by our Talent Acquisition Specialists with a written offer letter as a follow up.

Accenture is a premier Google Cloud partner helping organizations modernize data ecosystems, build real-time analytics capabilities, and responsibly scale AI. You Are

A hands-on Specialist with foundational experience in Data Engineering, Analytics, or Machine Learning—now building deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You are eager to apply technical skills, learn advanced Data & AI patterns, and support delivery teams in designing and implementing modern data and AI solutions.

You’re comfortable working directly with clients, supporting senior architects, and contributing to end-to-end project execution.


The Work (What You Will Do)

As a GCP Data Specialist, you will help deliver data modernization, analytics, and AI solutions on GCP. You will support architecture design, build data pipelines and models, perform analysis, and contribute to technical implementations under guidance from senior team members.


1. Hands-On Technical Delivery

  • Build data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and integrations using GCP services such as: BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage
  • Assist with data modeling, performance tuning, and query optimization in BigQuery.
  • Implement data ingestion patterns for batch and streaming data sources.
  • Support development of dashboards and analytics products using Looker or Looker Studio.

2. Support Agentic AI & ML Solution Development

  • Assist in developing ML models and AI solutions using:
    Vertex AI, Gemini Foundation Models, Gemini Enterprise, Model APIs & Embeddings
  • Implement ML pipelines and help establish MLOps processes (monitoring, retraining, deployment).
  • Support prompt engineering, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) experimentation.
  • Contribute to model testing, validation, and documentation.

3. Requirements Gathering & Client Collaboration

  • Participate in client workshops to understand data needs, use cases, and technical requirements.
  • Help translate functional requirements into technical tasks and implementation plans.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and insights to project leads and client stakeholders.

4. Data Governance, Quality & Security Support

  • Implement metadata management, data quality checks, and lineage tracking using GCP tools (Dataplex, IAM).
  • Follow best practices for security, identity management, and compliance.
  • Support operational processes for data validation, testing, and monitoring.

5. Continuous Learning & Team Support

  • Learn and apply GCP Data & AI best practices across architectural patterns, engineering standards, and AI frameworks.
  • Collaborate closely with senior data engineers, ML engineers, and architects.
  • Contribute to internal accelerators, documentation, and reusable components.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with Python or AI or GenAI tools (Vertex AI preferred).
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

Bonus points if you have

  • Familiarity with GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, and Looker.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants from USA in EST time zones only at this time.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Data Visualization

The Opportunity:

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the DataViz squad, owning its performance, delivery and customer outcomes. The squad owns a range of Grafana visualisations, their underlying libraries, configuration experiences and interactions, spanning core Grafana and standalone plugins. You’ll help shape how these capabilities enable users to understand their data and take action.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design to shape direction, and improve how the squad works, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be accountable for the performance of a distributed engineering squad: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
  • Own hiring and team planning, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
  • Lead discovery with your squad: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
  • Develop an informed point of view on product direction with Product, Design and senior engineers. Keep priorities explicit, assess new requests against business impact and capacity, and make clear decisions about what to stop or defer, balancing customer and community needs with long-term platform investments and operational demands.
  • Own delivery from discovery through rollout and measurement. Help the squad scope small, valuable increments, learn through short feedback loops and complete the most important work. Build the team’s ability to surface risks early and adapt plans as evidence and priorities change.
  • Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
  • Improve how the squad plans, makes decisions and delivers, including limits on work in progress. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
  • Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the squad’s visualisations, rendering libraries, panel configuration and interactions. Balance user experience, accessibility, performance, reliability and security with the evolution of shared foundations and the plugin ecosystem.
  • Build shared ownership so engineers recognise delivery risks, help one another and rally around the highest-priority outcomes. Coach the squad to make decisions together and shift effort across projects when needed.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
  • Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
  • Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
  • A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous problems into clear priorities and measurable results, delivering in small increments and adapting commitments as business needs and evidence change.
  • Strong product and customer judgement, with the curiosity to understand users’ workflows, develop a point of view and help teams make tough trade-offs between product needs and platform investments.
  • Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
  • Experience leading teams that balance shared technical foundations with user-facing product development, including plugins or extensions.
  • Experience with data visualisation, interactive analytical tools or workflows that help users understand data and take action.
  • Experience leading major library or platform migrations while protecting compatibility and the user experience.
  • Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is USD 214,860- USD 257,832. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

jobs.description:
The Office of Research Operations has two openings for the Associate Director, Research Support Office position.

Help build the future of pre-award research support at Stanford Medicine

Stanford Medicine is transforming how pre-award research administration is delivered across the School of Medicine. We are building a more integrated and responsive model designed to make research easier for faculty, strengthen service consistency, and match support to the needs of each sponsored research proposal. We are seeking an experienced research administrative leader to serve as Associate Director, Research Support Office (RSO) within the Office of Research Operations.

Reporting to the Director, Grants Pre-Award Services, the Associate Director will lead Stanford Medicine’s centralized RSO and play a key role in building a scalable, high-performing pre-award service across the School of Medicine. This is an opportunity to lead people, shape a new service model, and influence how faculty and departments experience pre-award research administration at scale.

About the Research Support Office

The RSO works alongside the Sponsored Proposals Office (SPO) as part of Stanford Medicine’s differentiated pre-award model.

The RSO provides centralized pre-award support across a broad and diverse research portfolio, with an emphasis on delivering timely, consistent, high-quality service to faculty. The team supports proposal development from intake through submission while helping faculty and departments navigate sponsor requirements, budgets, institutional approvals, routing, and other pre-award requirements.

At the center of the model is a simple goal: provide the right support at the right time, make pre-award easier to navigate, and deliver a consistently excellent experience for faculty and departments.

What you’ll do:

As Associate Director, you will:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Research Support Office team.
  • Partner with the Director, Grants Pre-Award Services to strengthen and scale the RSO service model.
  • Oversee intake, triage, proposal assignment, workload prioritization, and resource deployment across a high-volume pre-award environment.
  • Ensure proposals are supported consistently from intake through institutional review and submission.
  • Oversee proposal readiness, including sponsor requirements, budgets, subawards, institutional approvals, routing, and submission requirements.
  • Establish clear service standards, workflows, handoffs, and escalation pathways.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex operational, policy, compliance, and deadline issues.
  • Build strong partnerships with faculty, departments, the SPO, and other ORO teams to ensure coordinated and responsive support.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop staff while setting clear expectations for service, quality, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to manage capacity, improve workflows, and strengthen service delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce administrative burden, and improve the faculty and department experience.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement and change management as the RSO evolves into a mature, scalable School-wide service.
  • Represent the RSO in School- and University-level discussions on pre-award administration and service improvement.

Who we’re looking for:

We are looking for a seasoned research administration leader who is energized by building strong teams, improving services, and making complex organizations work better.

You will bring deep pre-award knowledge together with strong operational judgment and an instinct for excellent service. You will be comfortable managing a high-volume, deadline-driven environment; developing people; using data to make decisions; and building trusted relationships with faculty, departments, and institutional partners.

This role is particularly well suited to an accomplished research administrator who wants to move beyond managing an individual portfolio and take on the challenge of helping to lead a School-wide service, developing organizational capability, and shaping the future of pre-award support at Stanford Medicine.

Why this role matters:

Stanford Medicine’s research enterprise depends on pre-award support that is as sophisticated, responsive, and ambitious as the science it enables.

The Research Support Office is being built to provide a more scalable, consistent, and faculty-centered model of pre-award support across the School of Medicine. For the right leader, this is an exciting opportunity to shape a major School-wide service, build a high-performing team, and influence how research administration supports faculty, departments, and Stanford Medicine’s broader research mission.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Deep pre-award research administration expertise gained in an academic medical center, research university, or similarly complex environment, with strong knowledge of sponsor requirements, proposal development, budgets, routing, and institutional policies.
  • Proven leadership in high-volume research operations, including developing staff, managing competing priorities and capacity, and designing or improving centralized or shared-service models.
  • Strong partnership and change-leadership skills, with experience working across faculty, departments, senior leaders, and institutional partners to improve service delivery and navigate organizational change.
  • A data-informed, service-oriented approach, including experience using operational metrics and technology-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, quality, and the faculty experience.

jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon's Marketing & Communications team sits at the center of a fast-moving, cross-functional organization, and this role is designed to be the connective tissue that keeps that work moving. This is a highly operational, detail-driven role. You'll manage requests, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships across internal departments including Translational Medicine, Sales, Clinical Operations, Science, and Business Development, as well as external stakeholders, such as conference organizers, vendors, and partners. You will not be expected to be the strategist or the creative lead, but rather the person who makes the strategy and creative work actually happen on time, with the right people looped in at the right moments.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York and Paris.

What success looks like:

Cross-functional project management

  • Serve as the marketing team's primary point of contact for internal stakeholders across Life Sciences Business Development, Diagnostic Sales, Clinical Operations, Data Science Groups, etc.
  • Field, triage, and route incoming requests to the right marketing team member based on scope, urgency, and priority.
  • Manage regulatory and legal review and approval in the appropriate platforms.
  • Build and maintain working relationships with stakeholders across the org so requests come to Marketing with the context needed to act on them quickly.
  • Manage external vendors, including payments, receipts, portals, and timelines.

Deadline and pipeline management

  • Own and maintain a master calendar of marketing-relevant deadlines, including conference abstract submission windows, publication timelines, campaign launches, and material approval cycles
  • Track abstract submission deadlines across target conferences and flag upcoming windows to relevant stakeholders with enough lead time to act
  • Monitor project status across marketing's active work and proactively flag anything at risk of slipping

Inbox and intake triage

  • Triage incoming marketing and design requests, categorizing and prioritizing incoming intake forms
  • Draft first-pass responses to routine requests and escalate anything requiring specialized input
  • Maintain clear documentation of open requests, owners, and status so nothing sits unanswered
  • Run team meetings, highlighting new projects and at-risk tasks

Documentation and process

  • Maintain up-to-date records of stakeholder requests, submission deadlines, and recurring cross-functional workflows
  • Identify and document recurring bottlenecks or gaps in how work moves between Marketing and other departments, and propose process improvements
  • Keep shared project management tools current and accurate for marketing-facing work

Meeting and communication support

  • Coordinate cross-functional check-ins between Marketing and partner departments
  • Prepare status summaries and agendas for recurring stakeholder syncs
  • Follow up on action items to ensure commitments made in meetings are tracked to completion

What you will bring:

  • 2-4 years of experience in a coordination, project management, account management, or operations role, ideally in a cross-functional or client-facing capacity
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent deadlines and stakeholders without missing details
  • Strong written communication skills, comfortable drafting clear, professional messages to a wide range of internal and external audiences, including executives
  • Experience with project management tools; experience with CRM tools is a plus
  • A proactive, "no surprises" working style: someone who flags risks before they become problems rather than after
  • Comfortable operating with a moderate amount of ambiguity, and knows when to make a judgment call versus when to escalate
  • Experience in life sciences, healthcare, biotech, or a regulated industry is a plus, but not required
  • Genuine interest in understanding how different departments (Translational Medicine, Sales, Clinical Operations, Sciences) work, so you can anticipate their needs rather than just process their requests

The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

das bringst du mit

We strive to support all teams with technology aligned to their needs, amplify change agents' power, and ensure our relationship with technology and data reflects our values and mission to achieve a green and peaceful future.

In this role you will:

Work as an internal consultant leading the design, development, and automation of global data pipelines, services, and reports for our regional offices. You will provide organisation-wide data warehouse expertise with an emphasis on data design, data access, usage, and quality of information. Working directly with stakeholders to understand their needs, you will design purpose-built data systems and reports as part of a global team of data specialists.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Building and maintaining data transformations in dbt on BigQuery, including testing, documentation and version control, and supporting automated ETL/ELT pipelines.

  • Migrating workflows and reports from legacy analytics platforms to our central data platform, and supporting regional offices through the transition

  • Leading the creation and maintenance of reports and dashboards, alongside stakeholder consultation, business analysis, and design work.

  • Building key performance indicators by gathering requirements from stakeholders, validating possibilities and building them as semantic metrics for future proof, durable usage

  • Promoting the standardisation of Greenpeace data assets and handling supporter and fundraising data in line with GDPR and our data governance standards.

  • Leading data community initiatives through case studies, training, coaching, and mentoring colleagues, as well as responding to end-user support tickets.

Requirements

What we’re looking for:

We are seeking a collaborative, solutions-oriented individual with a global mindset who can navigate complex operational environments with diplomacy, composure, and a long-term perspective. You should bring sound judgement, clear communication skills for non-technical audiences, and technical expertise in data management, analysis, and reporting, combined with an ability to inspire others and foster an inclusive, supportive environment.

Remember no one has every skill or experience needed for this role and you’ll have the opportunity to learn a lot from the team. We believe someone who has a few of these is well suited to excel in this role:

  • Extensive experience as a business intelligence developer, including expertise to lead projects and design solutions without supervision (or equivalent professional accreditation/post-graduate qualification in Computer Science or a related field).

  • Experience building and maintaining dbt projects in production (models, tests, incremental loads, documentation), with strong SQL.

  • Experience with cloud data warehouses and data engineering solutions preferably BigQuery or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience in Python software development focused on data engineering and APIs

  • Experience with dashboard and reporting tools, such as Hex, Tableau and Google Data Studio.

  • Experience with fundraising or CRM data (e.g. Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce)

  • Ability to communicate effectively with non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrable commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion and ability to collaborate with cross-cultural teams.

  • Fluent in English, both verbal and written and preferably also Spanish.

  • Digitally literate: able to work with digital tools and online systems; willing and able to learn new ones.

  • Flexible approach to working with colleagues across multiple time zones and open to international travel.

  • Support for and belief in the core aims and values of Greenpeace.

What you can expect:

You’ll be encouraged to develop both personally and professionally, taking advantage of the wide range of learning and development opportunities available to our staff. Staff can also access our wellness initiatives, such as yoga and meditation and also have the opportunity to join our global Equity, Diversity & Inclusion staff communities.

Please visit the careers site, to learn more about working for Greenpeace.

Greenpeace is a global campaigning network. It comprises 26 independent national/regional organisations, and a coordinating organisation, Greenpeace International. Greenpeace uses peaceful, creative confrontation to expose global environmental problems, and develop solutions for a green and peaceful future.

Our goal is to ensure the ability of the earth to nurture life in all its diversity. That means we want to:

  • protect biodiversity in all its forms

  • prevent pollution and abuse of the earth’s ocean, land, air and fresh water

  • end all nuclear threats

  • promote peace, global disarmament and non-violence

To Apply

If you share our vision, please click 'Apply', to begin your application.

To apply for this role, we require you to answer a selection of key criteria and upload your CV (in English) via our online application form.

Addressing the key criteria is an important part of your application. We will be looking for evidence that demonstrates your skills and experience in these areas. Use examples where possible, to draw attention to experience, knowledge, achievements and skills gained in past employment or voluntary/leisure activities, provided they are relevant to the post.

It’s advisable to prepare your responses to the key criteria before starting your online application, as you are unable to save and return to it at a later date.

At GPI, we understand the benefits of using open AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT), however for the purpose of this application we prefer to see answers that were tailored by candidates themselves, without relying too much on these tools, so we can get a good impression on your thinking.

If you have any questions about this vacancy or the application process, please email us at . Please note that all applications have to be filled out via the website and can't be submitted via this email.

We welcome everyone to apply for our positions. We understand that some candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the criteria. However, we strongly encourage you to apply if you meet some of the key criteria for our roles. We’d love to know how your unique experience can bring value to our team. We believe in people power and having representation from many different communities to effect change.

Greenpeace International is an equal opportunity employer with a longstanding commitment of providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of each individual. We recognise and value the benefits and strengths that diversity brings to our employees and the whole organisation and we thrive in an environment that encourages respect and trust. We do not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of age, ancestry, citizenship, colour, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, political affiliation, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and would like to invite you especially to apply!

CLOSING DATE: November 29th, 23:59 (CET)

Highlights

Lead global data pipelines and BI solutions at Greenpeace! Build dbt/BigQuery models and dashboards to empower environmental campaigns. 12-month contract; flexible global locations.

  • Able to demonstrate strong customer service skills, including tact and diplomacy, both in person and telephonically when communicating with internal and external customers

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

AxiomSL Techno-Functional Consultant | Remote | Ireland-Based Client

Yadimen Consulting Limited is recruiting an experienced AxiomSL Techno-Functional Consultant for a regulatory reporting engagement with a financial services client in Ireland. This is a fully remote contract role, open to candidates based anywhere within the EU/EEA.

About the Role

You will be responsible for the end-to-end configuration, development, and support of regulatory reporting solutions on the Nasdaq AxiomSL ControllerView platform. This is a hands-on techno-functional role — you'll bridge the gap between business/regulatory requirements and technical implementation, working directly with finance, risk, and technology teams.

What You'll Do
  • Configure and develop regulatory reports using AxiomSL ControllerView including Data Sources, Data Models, Portfolios, Aggregations, FreeForm and Tabular Reports
  • Translate regulatory requirements (COREP, FINREP, CRR, Basel III/IV, LCR, NSFR, AnaCredit) into functional specifications and AxiomSL configurations
  • Build and maintain data integration pipelines from source systems into the AxiomSL platform working with SQL, PL/SQL, and ETL processes
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance across regulatory submissions
  • Support regulatory upgrades, schema changes, and new report implementation as regulations evolve
  • Manage SIT, UAT, and production deployment cycles for regulatory reporting changes
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, document processes, and ensure compliance accuracy
  • Provide production support including incident analysis, data investigation, and submission troubleshooting

What You Bring

Essential:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with AxiomSL ControllerView platform
  • Proven delivery of regulatory reports (at least 3 of: COREP, FINREP, CRR, LCR, NSFR, AnaCredit, SRB, MREL)
  • Strong SQL / PL/SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and validation
  • Understanding of banking products (loans, deposits, securities, derivatives) and their regulatory treatment
  • Experience with regulatory data models, data lineage, and data governance frameworks
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, cross-functional team environment
  • Fluent English communication (written and verbal)
  • EU/EEA work eligibility

Desirable:

  • AxiomSL ControllerView Functional Certification (Nasdaq certified)
  • Experience with IntegratedModelView (IMV) or BrokerView modules
  • Knowledge of PSD2/PSD3, DORA, or other emerging EU regulatory frameworks
  • Experience working with Irish or European financial institutions
  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, Oracle, or SQL Server

jobs.title: Power BI Adoption Lead-Remote UK Only
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position.  Power BI Adoption Lead Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Power BI Adoption Lead

Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified. This one asks you to decide how an entire enterprise uses Power BI — and then to make it happen.

A leading UK financial services organisation is standing up a modern cloud data platform, with Power BI as the strategic reporting layer on top of it. The governed semantic layer, certified datasets, enterprise design standards and community of practice are still being shaped — and the organisation is serious enough about data capability to have already invested in it. You will decide what good looks like, and own it end to end.

This is deliberately not a pure Power BI developer role, and equally not a change-management role. It is the rarer combination: someone who can build a performant enterprise semantic model, credibly challenge a developer's DAX, then stand in front of the business and teach it.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise Power BI adoption roadmap, with measurable adoption and value targets.
  • Build engagement from the ground up: stakeholder buy-in, a champions network, forums, clinics and a genuine community of practice.
  • Design and personally deliver structured training — workshops, learning materials and guidance, pitched from Excel-refugee to seasoned analyst.
  • Shape the governed semantic layer alongside data engineering: consistent KPI definitions, certification processes, naming conventions and refresh strategy.
  • Author the enterprise reporting Design Guide — standards, templates, palettes, UX conventions — and hold the organisation to it.
  • Establish workspace governance: deployment pipelines, Dev/QA/Prod design, RLS/CLS, sensitivity labelling and auditability.
  • Build and optimise flagship dashboards yourself, and troubleshoot performance where others are stuck.
  • Reduce duplicated, ungoverned reporting — and prove you have.

Requirements

Essential experience

  • Power BI technical depth — you have personally delivered enterprise-scale Power BI. Advanced DAX, Power Query/M, semantic model design and optimisation, large and complex datasets, workspace strategy and administration, RLS, certified datasets. You can coach on all of it and push back on poor implementation.
  • Adoption & change leadership — you have created an enterprise adoption roadmap, run champion networks, driven cultural change around data-driven decision making, and measured adoption and business value. This is the most critical dimension of the role.
  • Training & enablement — you have designed and personally delivered structured training programmes and built the materials yourself. Occasional knowledge-sharing is not what we mean.
  • Governance & operating model — reporting standards, dashboard design principles, workspace management, certified dataset processes and self-service controls. You know how to scale Power BI without creating a governance problem.

Desirable

  • Microsoft Fabric — architecture, capacity and medallion/lakehouse patter
  • Power Apps, ideally integrated with Power BI.
  • Sensitive, confidential or regulated data; Azure exposure; PL-300 and/or

Interview process

Shortlisted candidates will prepare a maximum of two PowerPoint slides on their approach to enterprise Power BI adoption, and demo a Power BI dashboard they personally designed and built on a dataset of their choice — covering the business problem, auorytelling, accessibility and how they would drive ongoing usage. Format and style are entirely your own.

To apply: send a CV or get in touch for a confidential conversation .
