jobs.excerpt: About SANS Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization.
jobs.description:
About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Product Development team. This role plays a key part in building web applications (frontend and backend) for the organization that trains much of the world's cybersecurity workforce. Security isn't a bolt-on here; it's the starting assumption, from OWASP-aware coding practices to solid authentication and authorization patterns. You'd work in a cross-functional, agile team, shipping well-tested code through CI/CD pipelines on AWS (Docker, ECS/Fargate, Lambda), and you'd own what you build in production with a true build-and-run, DevOps mindset. If you enjoy containerization, Kubernetes/orchestration, and automating the path from commit to production, you'll feel at home here: infrastructure and delivery pipelines are treated as part of the product, not someone else's problem. The stack is broad (Python, Node, PHP, REST APIs, React/TypeScript, SQL and NoSQL), so we value engineers who are comfortable moving across languages and projects and who enjoy peer reviews, good design discussions, and mentoring others toward architecturally sound solutions. We also value AI fluency: engineers who use AI tools thoughtfully to move faster and raise the quality bar, while still applying the judgment and security rigor that good software demands.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Developing software solutions as part of a cross-functional team· Participate in peer-reviews of solution designs and related code· Producing technical documentation as needed· Actively sharing responsibilities for meeting team commitments· Ability to coach/mentor other engineers, helping them devise and deliver solutions that are architecturally sound· Willingness to learn new technologies
  • Flexibility to move across language stacks and projects as required
  • Initiative to find ways to improve solutions, systems, and processes to solve problems
  • Willingness to work across the full web stack to develop efficient solutions
  • Operating with a DevOps mentality of build & run applications
  • Producing quality code with automated test coverage
  • Collaborate with other developers to plan, design, develop, and test components & applications
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent industry experience
  • Strong experience in creating, managing, versioning, and troubleshooting Rest API endpoints.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, SDLC, and modern development standards and best practices (OOP, API’s, TDD)
  • Familiarity with standard branching and versioning via Git & Gitflow, and GitHub pull requests
  • Familiarity with secure coding practices, OWASP Top 10, and using authentication/authorization protocols
  • Experience with relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) database technologies
  • Familiarity with the Atlassian suite of tools
  • Familiarity with ChatOps
  • Understanding of n-tier architecture and service-oriented architecture
  • Familiarity with DevOps, specifically CI/CD pipelines using AWS, Docker Containers, ECS/Fargate, and AWS Lambdas
  • Familiarity with monitoring/alerting software (New Relic, Site24/7, Pingdom, OpsGenie, or other)
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and other front-end technologies
  • Strong hands-on experience developing Web Applications using Python, Node, PHP or other modern web technologies.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • At least 6 years’ experience designing and developing modern web software

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $155,000-$170,000, plus bonus eligible, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Lifeforce is hiring a Controller to own accounting and cash management across the company. Your first focus will be our partnership with the Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC), a growing network of in-person franchise clinics across multiple states. You'll design and own how money moves between each ULC clinic's medical practice entity, its franchise entity, and Lifeforce, and you'll make sure every dollar is tracked, reconciled, and reported correctly.

This is a hands-on role. You'll use AI and automation tools to build and keep improving the workflows for reconciliations, cash transfers, month-end close, and executive reporting as the clinic network grows.

You'll start as an individual contributor and build out the finance team as the network grows. Over time, you'll become Controller for all of Lifeforce. You'll work closely with leadership, the ULC team and franchise owners, and our outside accountants.

Reports to: Co-Founder | President Joel Jackson

Cash Management & Fund Flows

  • Design and own a repeatable daily cash process between clinic practice entities, franchise entities, and Lifeforce, so each new clinic plugs in with minimal setup.
  • Open and manage bank accounts for new clinic entities as they launch.
  • Make sure cash is reconciled daily across every entity, by someone other than the person who moved it.
  • Track what each entity owes the others and settle intercompany balances on schedule.

Accounting & Close

  • Own the monthly close for Lifeforce and the clinic-related entities.
  • Prepare accurate financial statements and reporting for leadership.
  • Manage AP, AR, revenue recognition, and the general ledger.
  • Prepare franchisee statements and run true-up, reserve, and MSO fee calculations.
  • Track advances and startup loans to franchisees.
  • Account for state-specific fees as the network expands into new states.
  • Work closely with our outside accountants on bookkeeping, tax filings, and audits.

Automation & AI

  • Use AI tools like Claude to automate reconciliations, transfers, close tasks, and reporting.
  • Build workflows that scale with each new clinic, so the work doesn't grow one-for-one with the network.
  • Check automated outputs for accuracy and fix what breaks.

Controls & Process

  • Build the policies, controls, and documentation for the ULC multi-entity clinic model.
  • Set up dual approval on all transfers, and keep who moves money separate from who reconciles it.
  • Create a repeatable setup process for each new ULC clinic's accounts and fund flows.
  • Keep the books audit-ready.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work with leadership on cash position, reporting, and financial decisions.
  • Partner with ULC and franchise owners on reporting and payments.
  • Answer finance questions from operations, People, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: The cash process, controls, and reporting for the first ULC clinic are ready by its launch, including dual-approved transfers and daily reconciliation. The first monthly close for the clinic entities is done on time, and your core workflows are documented and partly automated.
  • First year: You're running the books for all of Lifeforce, and the monthly close happens on schedule. Each new clinic plugs into a standard, mostly automated setup for accounts, fund flows, and reporting, and you've laid out how the finance team grows with the network.

  • Multi-entity accounting experience, including intercompany transactions and consolidation.
  • Experience with MSO/PC structures or franchise accounting.

  • Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to automate or speed up accounting work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare experience, ideally with both MSO/PC structures and franchise accounting.
  • Experience working alongside an outsourced accounting firm.
  • Experience at a startup or high-growth company.
  • Experience building a finance function from a team of one.

Traits for Success

  • Automates repetitive work first, and adds people where judgment is needed.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just reviewing it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Organized and process-minded, and builds systems that hold up as volume grows.

About Collectly

Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation. Millions of patients navigate inefficient billing systems every day, while providers face delayed payments, rising administrative burden, and operational complexity.

Collectly applies artificial intelligence to automate workflows, accelerate cash flow, and modernize the patient financial experience, enabling healthcare organizations to operate more efficiently and focus on delivering care.

There could not be a hotter space to play in. Healthcare is a $4.9T industry and is adopting AI technology at 2.2x the rate of the rest of the economy. RCM is at the heart of this transformation because it delivers a clear, demonstrable ROI to our customers.

The Opportunity

We are hiring an RCM Consultant to join our sales team. This is a solutions consulting role built for someone who knows revenue cycle management from the inside. You will partner with our Account Executives from the first conversation, go deeper into a prospect's revenue cycle than anyone else on the deal, and turn what you find into demos and business cases that win.

Our buyers are large ambulatory provider groups. They want to work with someone who understands how their billing office runs, which EHR they are on, and where their money gets stuck. Your credibility in RCM is what earns their trust. Domain expertise matters more here than deep technical skills, but you need to be comfortable explaining how our platform connects to their EHR and how data moves between the two.

This is a highly collaborative role. Beyond the AEs and sales leadership, you will work with product, engineering, sales enablement, and our executive leadership team. You will be the voice of the customer inside Collectly and help shape how we sell, what we build, and how we tell our story.

Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management is required.

Key Responsibilties

  • Lead domain discovery: Pair with AEs early in the sales process to map a prospect's current revenue cycle workflows, from patient statements and payment collection to posting, follow-up, and reporting. Uncover the inefficiencies, manual work, and revenue leakage in those workflows, going deeper than a standard sales discovery can.

  • Deliver demos that land: Run tailored product demonstrations that reflect each prospect's specialty, EHR, and workflow. Customize demo environments and supporting assets so prospects see their own operation in the product. Improve the rate at which demos convert into later-stage opportunities.

  • Answer the integration and data questions: Explain how Collectly integrates with EHR and practice management systems, including athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Epic, ModMed, NextGen, Allscripts, Experity, and others. Speak clearly to where data lives, how it shows up in each system, what posts back, and how information flows between Collectly and the EHR. Partner with engineering and implementation on complex questions, and hand off clean requirements once a deal closes.

  • Build the business case: Own the technical side of our Financial Impact Analysis (FIA). Help prospects gather the financial and operational data we need, work with our internal AI agents to build the ROI calculation, and turn the results into a slide deck that gives executive buyers a clear business justification to buy.

  • Sharpen our storytelling: Use our assets and tools to build decks, demo flows, and visuals that make the value of Collectly easy to see. Bring an eye for detail to every slide and every demo.

  • Improve how we sell: Find and fix friction in our discovery, demo, and FIA processes, and execute those improvements alongside the AEs. Build reusable assets by specialty and EHR so the whole team gets faster.

  • Be the voice of the customer: Bring what you hear from prospects to product and engineering as clear, specific feedback. Partner with the VP of Sales and the executive leadership team on go-to-market strategy as we expand our product set and move into new markets.

  • Train the team: Partner with sales enablement to deliver training on RCM workflows, EHR integrations, demos, and the FIA process, so every seller can speak with more credibility.

What Success Looks Like

    Within the first 30 days, you will:

  • Learn the Collectly product suite end to end and deliver our core demo to sales leadership.

  • Learn our sales process, qualification methodology, and FIA process.

  • Shadow discovery calls, demos, and FIA presentations across the AE team.

  • Build working relationships with each AE you support and with sales leadership.

  • Meet your cross-functional partners in product, engineering, implementation, customer success, and enablement.

  • Learn how our integrations work with athenahealth and eClinicalWorks, and identify the specialties and EHRs where you need to fill gaps.

    • By 60 days, you will:

  • Run domain discovery and tailored demos independently with your AEs.

  • Build and present FIAs end to end, from data collection to the business case deck.

  • Answer integration and data flow questions for our most common EHRs without escalation.

  • Customize demo assets and decks for active opportunities.

    • By 90 days, you will:

  • Own domain discovery, demos, and FIAs across the pipeline of the AEs you support.

  • Deliver at least one improvement to our discovery, demo, or FIA process, such as a discovery guide, a demo library by specialty, or a faster FIA workflow.

  • Show measurable improvement in mid-funnel conversion, moving more demos into late-stage opportunities.

  • Lead or co-lead a training session with sales enablement.

    • Over two quarters, success includes:

  • Sustained improvement in demo-to-FIA and FIA-to-close conversion rates.

  • A growing library of reusable assets by specialty and EHR.

  • A regular flow of specific, prioritized customer feedback to product and engineering.

  • Recognition from AEs and prospects as a trusted advisor on revenue cycle.

  • Direct contribution to closed revenue.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, preferably in a solutions consulting or similar pre-sales role. Experience can come from working in a practice or billing office, at an RCM company, or implementing RCM-related software.

  • Working knowledge of ambulatory EHR and practice management systems, with exposure to athenahealth or eClinicalWorks strongly preferred.

  • The ability to explain how healthcare data moves between systems, including where it lives, how it is mapped, and what posts back, to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong financial acumen and comfort building ROI analyses and business cases from operational and financial data.

  • Excellent presentation and demo skills, with the credibility to earn the trust of practice administrators, revenue cycle leaders, and financial executives.

  • A strong eye for detail and the ability to build clear, compelling slides and visual assets.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with sales teams and cross-functional partners.

  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with prospects and attend industry events.

Preferred

  • Prior experience in a solutions consulting, sales engineering, or other pre-sales role at a healthcare SaaS company.

  • Implementation experience at an EHR vendor or at a software company that integrates with EHRs.

  • Experience across multiple ambulatory specialties and EHRs, such as Epic, ModMed, NextGen, Allscripts, and Experity.

  • Familiarity with healthcare integration methods such as APIs, HL7, FHIR, and file-based data exchange.

  • Experience with patient payments or the patient financial experience.

  • Experience using AI tools to build analyses, decks, and demo assets.

  • Background in early-stage, venture-backed companies.

Core Competencies

  • Deep curiosity and a strong growth mindset. In a market with this many specialties and EHRs, there is always something new to learn.

  • A love of solving problems and the persistence to get to the root cause.

  • A will to win and a competitive drive to improve how we sell.

  • Attention to detail in analysis, demos, and presentations.

  • High ownership and comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • We are owners: we have high ownership and take action.

Senior Product Engineer, LeadConduit

Company Overview

ActiveProspect is on a mission to make consent-based marketing the best channel for online customer acquisition. We provide marketers the products they need to acquire qualified customers at scale. Our platform is trusted by thousands of companies engaged in direct-to-consumer marketing, helping them save wasted spend, comply with ever-changing regulations, and manage a constantly evolving partner landscape.

Our flagship product, TrustedForm, is used to certify over 1 billion opt-in digital customer leads every year and is the gold standard for documenting prior express written consent for TCPA compliance. LeadConduit, our real-time lead processing and routing platform, connects lead sellers and buyers and checks consent, data quality, and delivery rules on every lead.

Job Summary

You own customer and business outcomes, not tickets. You work like a forward-deployed engineer: you belong to the LeadConduit team, and you contribute to projects, initiatives, and pods where the problem is, deliver your work across the full stack (Vue/Nuxt and React/Next.js on the frontend, Node.js and TypeScript services on AWS), and improve processes for delivery in future projects. The technical bar is high, but coding ability is only the starting point. What sets this role apart is judgment: knowing the smallest thing worth shipping, when to drop your own idea, and when AI output is good enough versus when to override it. On LeadConduit, that work splits evenly between two areas: keeping today's platform fast and reliable for the customers who run their business on it, and building the next-generation platform, including a new real-time engine for ping/post, call tracking, and buyer optimization.

You'll move between the LeadConduit team and the initiatives you deploy into, shipping early, talking to customers, and deciding fast.

Responsibilities

  • Own outcomes end-to-end, wherever you're assigned. Frame the problem, design it, ship it, own the metric. Distill to the cheapest version that works. Prototype in days.
  • Work across today's LeadConduit and the next-generation platform. Improve the current product (flows, integrations, reporting) and help build the new real-time engine (field mapping, ping/post, call tracking, buyer optimization).
  • Stay close to customers. Shadow sales and support, talk with lead buyers and sellers, join advisory conversations, and let customer reality drive technical decisions. Propose what to build, defer, and drop.
  • Own your domain and share it. Its interfaces, reliability, performance, and security, including on-call for the systems you own. Consent, TCPA compliance, and PII handling are central to customer trust. Bring patterns, tooling, and hard-won context back to the wider org rather than hoarding them.
  • Build and scale both the product surface and the platform beneath it. Ship responsive, accessible interfaces with a strong UI/UX eye (Vue/Nuxt today, React/Next.js for the new platform), back them with Node.js and TypeScript services and APIs, and keep the real-time, multi-tenant lead and call processing engine reliable and fast as volume grows.
  • Architect AI-driven leverage. Build AI-assisted workflows that hold up, evolve the team's practices as tooling changes (Cursor, Claude Code, and whatever comes next), and look for product wins AI unlocks (smarter routing, anomaly detection on lead flow, AI-built integrations, and more).
  • Make every team you work with stronger. Mentor on judgment and product sense, not just syntax. Write decision memos and ADRs. Enable Product and Design to self-serve.

Qualifications and Skills

  • A track record of shipping something end-to-end that you cared about and owning the outcome, not just the code.
  • Product judgment: pushing back on a bad spec, proposing the cheapest experiment, descoping, and collaborating with Product to suggest solutions rather than waiting for a fully specified ticket.
  • Comfort embedding with unfamiliar teams and codebases, getting productive fast, and leaving them better than you found them.
  • Deep full-stack expertise: React/Next.js and Vue/Nuxt (component lifecycle, state management, rendering optimization), JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern CSS on the frontend; Node.js and TypeScript services, RESTful APIs, and low-latency, high-volume asynchronous data handling on the backend.
  • Cloud and real-time systems depth: AWS core services (Lambda, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway) and event-driven, queue-based processing (SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar) to deliver multi-tenant, real-time products reliably at scale.
  • A strong UI/UX eye: you turn wireframes, mockups, and ambiguous requirements into intuitive, accessible, user-centric journeys.
  • Strong systems design judgment in ambiguous contexts, and a security mindset aligned with sensitive consumer data and compliance.
  • Lead generation or performance marketing experience is a strong plus: ping/post, lead routing and distribution, call tracking, or TCPA and consent rules.
  • Fluency building your own AI-assisted workflows and reading AI output critically. Daily use of AI-native tools (Cursor, Claude Code) and precise prompting across OpenAI and Claude models, with the judgment to know when to trust output, how to review it for hidden bugs and security issues, and when to override it.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. Mentorship experience. 5-10% travel.

How It Works

You'll report to an Engineering Manager who owns several teams and stays out of their daily flow. As you embed, you'll often act as the player-coach Tech Lead, owning technical direction while the EM owns delivery health and stakeholder alignment across the group.

Success looks like movement in a user or business metric your team owns, high-value work deliberately not built, decisions made fast, and teams that move faster after you've worked with them, not just while you're there.

Engineering Manager

jobs.description:
About demandDrive

demandDrive is a growth-focused go-to-market agency that helps B2B organizations accelerate pipeline and revenue through integrated sales, marketing, and revenue operations solutions. We partner with companies ranging from emerging businesses to enterprise brands to design and execute customized programs that align strategy, technology, and execution across the full customer journey. Our services include sales development, demand generation, digital marketing, website development, CRM optimization, and GTM systems support - all built to deliver measurable business outcomes. At our core, we combine smart technology, data-driven processes, and talented people to help clients grow faster and operate more efficiently.

Position Overview

As a Senior Demand Generation Strategist, you own a book of 6-8 B2B client accounts, including some of our largest, and you own whether marketing works on them.

You set the strategy, direct execution across paid media, SEO, content and CRO, and you are the one in the room with the people who hold the budget. You run the quarterly business reviews with client executives yourself - what the program produced, what it cost, what we are doing next.

Most of these accounts have a heavy paid media component, so you need real depth there - you will be in LinkedIn, Google Ads and Meta yourself. But the job is wider than the ad platforms. You design the full demand motion for an account: capture, creation, nurture, retargeting, intent-led targeting, and the way all of it connects to the SDR team and to pipeline in the client's CRM.

You also set the automation standard for the team. We expect the manual half of this job - pulling data, drafting reports, building variants, researching accounts, QA - to keep shrinking, and at this level you are the person building the workflows that shrink it and getting everyone else using them.

You partner with a Client Success Manager who owns the client relationship and contract, and you are supported by specialists in analytics/CRO and SEO. You report to the Senior Director of Demand Generation.

Who We Are Looking For

You are the person who sees a client report opening with impressions and CTR and thinks: that does not answer anything. You rewrite it to lead with pipeline, cost per qualified lead and what we should do next, because that is the only version a VP of Marketing can actually act on.

You are also the person who, having rewritten that report once, does not want to rewrite it by hand twelve more times. You go build something that drafts it - and then you get four other people using it. That instinct matters to us as much as the strategy does. The best strategists we have keep taking the repetitive half of the job and handing it to a machine, then spend the hours they bought back on the client.

Communication is the other half, and at this level it is the differentiator. You can explain a complicated program to a CMO in plain language, make a recommendation, and hold it when someone pushes back. You bring strategy to a client before they ask for it. You have told a client their targeting was wrong, or their offer was the problem, and made the case with data rather than opinion. You are comfortable being the most senior marketing voice on a call and you do not need to check with anyone before answering a hard question.

No two accounts look the same. One week you are rebuilding a medical device company's paid program around a new buying committee, the next you are figuring out why a manufacturer's content is ranking and converting nobody. You will own those accounts end to end, with a CSM beside you and specialists behind you, and you will be measured on what happens to the book - retained, grown, healthy.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

  • Your book of accounts, end to end. Strategy, plans, budgets and results across paid, SEO, content and CRO for every account you own, including some of our largest. No channel hand-offs. If it is marketing on your account, it is yours.
  • Modern demand generation programs. Designing the full motion for an account - demand capture, demand creation, nurture, retargeting, intent-led targeting - not just the campaigns inside one platform.
  • Automating the execution layer, for the team. Building AI-assisted workflows for the repetitive parts of the job: reporting drafts, search term and negative keyword review, ad copy variants, account and persona research, QA. Proving they work, documenting them, and getting the rest of the team using them.
  • Paid media, hands-on. Building, running and optimizing LinkedIn, Google Ads and Meta programs, including B2B targeting by account list, firmographics and buying committee.
  • Reporting on business impact. Monthly and quarterly client reporting built around pipeline, revenue, cost per qualified lead and ROI, always ending with a clear recommendation. Platform metrics are evidence, not the headline.
  • Executive-level client communication. Leading client calls and running quarterly business reviews with client executives and their sales leadership. Clients should hear from you before they have to ask.
  • The connection to pipeline. Making marketing programs and SDR outreach work together, and tracing spend through to meetings, opportunities and closed revenue in the client's CRM.
  • Measurement. Working with our analytics/CRO specialist on attribution, GA4 and GTM so the numbers you report hold up.
  • Account growth. Spotting upsell and expansion opportunities and building the case with your CSM.
  • Raising the bar. Mentoring strategists earlier in their careers, reviewing their programs and reporting, and setting the standard the rest of the team works to.

Required Qualifications

AI and Automation (non-negotiable). You use AI in your daily work, not as a novelty. You have built workflows that replaced manual work you used to do by hand, and you have gotten other people to adopt them - that second part matters at this level. You keep up with what is new and bring it into client work before anyone asks. Comfort with Claude or other leading models wired into real workflows, not just prompted in a chat window. Experience with automation tools (Zapier, n8n, Clay) is a strong plus. We are not looking for someone who needs to be taught this.

Communication and executive presence. You can run a QBR with a CMO and a VP of Sales in the room, present a recommendation, and hold it under pushback. Responsive, confident on camera, and you own follow-through rather than waiting to be chased.

Demand generation depth.

  • 6+ years in B2B demand generation or paid media, with at least 3 years at an agency or owning client accounts directly. Agency pace is a real requirement.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads and Meta, including B2B targeting by account list, firmographics and buying committee.
  • Fluency in demand generation well beyond the ad platforms: nurture, retargeting, intent signals, content and SEO working together on one account.
  • Strong working knowledge of HubSpot, attribution, GA4 and GTM, including where attribution breaks and how to talk about it honestly.
  • A track record of connecting marketing to sales and SDR pipeline, and reporting on pipeline, revenue, cost per qualified lead and ROI.
  • Experience growing accounts: you have spotted expansion opportunities and helped close them.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ABM platforms, Clay or Apollo.
  • Medical device or manufacturing marketing experience.
  • HubSpot certifications.

How We Work

  • Ownership model. Strategists own a book of accounts across every channel. There are no channel splits. You are paired with a Client Success Manager who owns the relationship and contract, and supported by specialists in analytics/CRO and SEO.
  • Measured on outcomes. Strategists are measured on their book's MRR retained, growth, and a monthly marketing health rating set alongside the CSM.
  • AI-first, and we mean it. Every strategist is expected to automate part of their own job and share it. We make time for it, we budget for the tools, and at the senior level what you build becomes how the team works.

Benefits Include

  • Hybrid or remote work model, depending on proximity to HQ in Waltham, MA (must reside in the U.S.)
  • Annual salary range: $105,000 - $120,000
  • Health coverage and other health & wellness benefits via BCBS, vision care, dental coverage (Delta Dental), paid maternity & paternity leave, life & disability insurance, 401(k) matching.
  • Paid time off and 14 paid holidays.
  • Internal growth opportunities.
  • Positive team culture.
  • Company laptop, full tech stack, tools, and other resources provided by demandDrive

About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the roleHello Heart’s AI team builds Nia, an AI health assistant for people managing their cardiovascular health. As a Clinical AI Quality Specialist, you will evaluate and monitor Nia’s clinical behavior before and after release, working alongside the Clinical AI Quality & Governance Team Lead. You will run evaluations, review production conversations, and turn findings into documented decisions with product and engineering. This is a hands-on role for a clinician who is comfortable working with AI tools.

Responsibilities

  • Run Nia’s offline evaluations for clinically relevant changes. Write test cases, including tricky and ambiguous ones, and score outputs against the expected clinical behavior. Build and maintain evaluation datasets and contribute to scoring methods
  • Review production conversations using defined sampling methods. Take part in the weekly review and help prepare monthly results that state what was and wasn’t covered.
  • Test whether Nia detects and correctly handles high-risk situations, including medical emergencies, self-harm, and medication safety. Measure how often it escalates too much or too little.
  • Describe each failure clearly enough for engineering to act on, and flag your best read of the cause (for example, a wrong answer, missing patient context, or an escalation that fired too late). Make sure each unsafe or incorrect finding has an owner, a ticket, and a decision.
  • Keep clinical specifications, review records, and evidence current and auditable. Write clear, precise clinical assessments that engineering and product can act on.

Qualifications:

  • PharmD (or equivalent clinical doctorate) with an active US license. 3+ years of combined clinical practice and clinical AI evaluation.
  • Questions assumptions and investigates before drawing conclusions. Reads current guidelines, drug labels, and primary sources, and cites them in written assessments. Uses AI tools to work faster, and verifies AI output against sources before relying on it.
  • Experience designing or running evaluations for LLM-based systems, reviewing production conversations, and using monitoring tools (e.g., Langfuse).
  • Command of triage and escalation, crisis and self-harm handling, and medication safety, grounded in current guidelines.
  • Comfortable working with AI tools and evaluation workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Explains clinical risk clearly to engineering and product audiences, writes precise clinical assessments and documentation, and accepts feedback without defensiveness.
  • Genuine passion for how AI can improve preventive care and chronic disease management. Curious, open to learning, and comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-moving field.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Clinical experience in cardiovascular care or hypertension management.
  • Experience with structured rating of clinical transcripts, including agreement between raters.
  • Experience reviewing crisis and self-harm behavior.
  • Experience designing or running evaluations for LLM-based systems, or using monitoring tools such as Langfuse.

jobs.title: Senior CX Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. This is a software engineering role, not ticket-taking internal IT, AI evangelism disconnected from shipped code, or customer-billable Professional Services delivery.

What you'll do

  • Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.
  • Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.
  • Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.
  • Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.
  • Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.
  • Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.
  • Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.
  • Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.
  • Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.
  • Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.
  • Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.
  • Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.
  • Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.

We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.

About the team

CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. We reward leverage, not heroics, and don't leave tools dependent on one person.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.excerpt: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.
jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

In the exciting and challenging role of Global Account Manager for TE Sensors, you will lead the development and execution of account strategies for large medical device OEMs and be based in the Northeast United States. The role combines the hands-on customer ownership and opportunity development responsibilities of a Key Account Manager with the global coordination, executive engagement, and strategic planning responsibilities of a Global Account Manager.
You will establish and maintain strong business relationships, manage complex sales pipelines, generate demand through design wins, and deliver profitable revenue growth and customer satisfaction. As the primary commercial leader for assigned accounts, you will coordinate regional and global teams, align TE Connectivity business units, and develop relationships across customer engineering, procurement, operations, and executive leadership. You will elevate the TE Sensors brand and expand our position within strategic medical device OEMs, regional key accounts, and their global design, manufacturing, and supply-chain organizations.

Strategic Account Management and Business Development

  • Develop, continually refine, and lead the execution of multi-year global account plans for assigned large medical device OEMs.
    • Serve as the primary commercial point of contact for key customer stakeholders and coordinate engagement across customer locations, functions, and regions.
    • Build and maintain long-term credibility and relationships across engineering, procurement, operations, supply chain, and executive leadership.
    • Develop and lead senior-level customer relationships, executive business reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
    • Coordinate regional account priorities and global opportunities to ensure consistent strategy, communication, and execution.
    • Identify new business opportunities, strategies, and partnerships that expand TE Sensors content across customer platforms and applications.
    • Stay current on medical device industry trends, competitive products, emerging sensing technologies, regulatory requirements, material durability requirements, and application-specific needs.
    • Monitor competitive threats and market positioning across regions and adjust account strategies accordingly.

Job Responsibilities

Customer Engagement

  • Maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships by understanding customers’ business objectives, technical requirements, product roadmaps, and global operating models.
    • Enhance customer satisfaction and retention through superior service, support, and consistent execution across regions.
    • Engage with customers and medical-device ecosystem partners to identify market trends and application needs that can accelerate growth for the Sensors business.
    • Identify and respond to key customer needs, converting the sales funnel into design wins and realized revenue.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer needs and know when to escalate within the TE Sensors organization.
    • Coordinate internal resources to provide quotations, resolve lead-time issues, support complaint resolution, coordinate logistics, negotiate commercial and legal agreements, and transfer technical information.
    • Foster a customer-centric approach with Field Application Engineers, Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Customer Care,

Manufacturing/Operations, Quality, and Marketing.

  • Coordinate global customer activities and multi-site projects to provide a consistent customer experience.

Delivering Revenue Target

  • Achieve and exceed annual global and regional sales targets within assigned accounts.
    • Develop a robust sales pipeline, forecast sales, and track key account metrics across customer regions and business units.
    • Own and convert opportunities into tangible results that deliver profitable growth for Sensors.
    • Expand TE Sensors content, revenue, and market share within existing accounts while identifying new divisions, platforms, applications, and customer locations.
    • Balance near-term revenue delivery with development of strategic opportunities that may involve long qualification and medical-device product development cycles.

Leadership

  • Develop account-specific global strategies and spearhead alignment across regional sales, Field Application Engineering, Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and other supporting functions.
    • Lead account teams through influence, clear priorities, defined ownership, and consistent follow-through.
    • Establish a common global account direction while accommodating regional customer requirements and business practices.
    • Provide executive-level visibility into account performance, strategic opportunities, competitive threats, resource requirements, and execution risks.

More Responsibilities

Collaboration

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Quality, Operations, and Customer Service, to ensure a cohesive and effective account strategy. Evening virtual meetings with colleagues in Asia may be required at times.
    • Collaborate extensively with Global Account Managers and commercial leaders from other TE Connectivity business units to align strategies, coordinate customer engagement, support multi-business-unit opportunities, and reinforce a “One TE” perception within the customer base.
    • Coordinate with regional sales teams to ensure global account priorities are translated into clear local actions and customer coverage.
    • Align internal technical resources with the highest-value customer programs while managing engineering capacity and customer expectations.

Pipeline Management & Reporting

  • Utilize Salesforce CRM to track opportunities, customer interactions, design-win progression, and pipeline conversion.
    • Leverage additional information systems, including SAP, for forecasting, account reporting, and performance analysis.
    • Maintain high accuracy and cadence in CRM entries to support organizational visibility and decision making.
    • Consolidate regional opportunity and revenue information into a clear global account view.
    • Track account health, opportunity quality, project milestones, customer engagement, and risks across assigned accounts.

Key Goals & Performance Metrics

  • Formulate specific, actionable global account strategies and drive execution.
    • Deliver profitable revenue growth within assigned medical device accounts.
    • Develop and convert a high-quality pipeline, with emphasis on self-generated opportunities and conversion to design wins.
    • Expand TE Sensors content across customer platforms, applications, divisions, and global locations.
    • Strengthen senior-level customer relationships and improve TE Sensor’s strategic position within assigned accounts.
    • Maintain effective cross-regional coordination, clear ownership, and consistent execution of global account priorities.
    • Track customer engagement activity, including calls, visits, demonstrations, project meetings, and executive reviews, through Salesforce CRM.

What your background should look like

  • 7+ years of sales or strategic account management experience with large corporate customers.
    • Demonstrated success managing key, strategic, or global accounts with complex organizational structures.
    • Experience selling technical components, sensors, or engineered solutions to medical device OEMs.
    • Strong understanding of medical device product development cycles and the FDA and CE regulatory environment.
    • Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales targets and delivering profitable revenue growth.
    • Experience navigating complex, long-cycle sales opportunities involving multiple customer functions and geographic regions.
    • Track record of building strategic opportunities, negotiating, and closing large technology-oriented agreements.
    • Ability to understand the big picture, uncover customer business and technical needs, and translate those needs into selling opportunities.
    • Experience negotiating commercial and legal agreements to achieve desired business results.
    • Demonstrated strong business instincts, market awareness, and competitive positioning skills.
    • Ability to develop and execute multi-year global account plans.
    • Ability to lead cross-functional and cross-regional teams through influence rather than direct authority.
    • Skilled at communicating and leveraging value propositions externally and internally with global, cross-cultural, and cross-functional teams.
    • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills, both virtually and in person.
    • Strong familiarity with CRM tools and systems, including Salesforce.
    • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field. Technical aptitude and the ability to engage credibly with customer engineering teams are required.
    • Ability to travel domestically an average of 40%-60%, with potential international travel.

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

We are seeking a driven, systems-minded Manager, Operations - HPHS to lead and elevate our front-door care team. This team is the critical first touchpoint for our members, converting interest into booked appointments through fast outbound outreach and reliable inbound queue coverage.

Our current team possesses incredible empathy, strong dedication to our members, and a deep desire to help. As we prepare to scale this function over the next year, we are maturing our operations to support this rapid growth. We need a leader to guide the team's evolution into a rigorous, metrics-driven inbound/outbound enrollment engine.

You won’t just manage the people; you will optimize the machine. We need a leader who can get in the weeds of our tech stack (specifically Salesforce), identify opportunities to streamline patient profiles and workflows, and advocate cross-functionally to make our systems better, faster, and stronger.

Establish clear KPIs around enrollment conversion, schedule adherence, and capacity utilization. Level-set expectations and build a foundation of high performance, reliability, and trust.

  • Tech & Systems Optimization: Act as the operational subject matter expert for our CRM. Proactively identify missing Salesforce fields, clunky workflows, and routing inefficiencies. Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions that reduce friction and extend our tech stack.

  • Real-Time Queue Management: Own daily frontline service delivery. Ensure outreach occurs within one business day and the inbound front door is consistently covered during operating hours. Monitor answer rates, SLA adherence, and daily staffing logistics to consistently hit volume targets.

  • Data Advocacy & Consumption: Analyze existing reports to identify daily trends, and confidently advocate to Data/Analytics teams for the specific reporting metrics you need to monitor queue health and individual enrollment success.

  • 90-Day Vision & Execution: Within your first 90 days, successfully transition the team's workflows to support active queue management, establish baseline performance metrics, and build a repeatable training/onboarding playbook to prepare for headcount growth.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 3+ Years of Frontline Management: Direct experience managing a contact center, queue-based operations team, or inside sales team with strict accountability for KPIs, schedule adherence, and conversion metrics.

  • Change Management & Scaling: Proven track record of stepping into evolving environments, establishing baseline expectations, and coaching highly empathetic teams into metrics-driven professionals.

  • Systems Orientation (Salesforce): Deep familiarity with CRM workflows. You know how to map a process, identify missing data fields, and write clear business requirements for technical teams to execute.

  • Analytical Consumption: Strong ability to read, interpret, and manage to operational dashboards. You know exactly what metrics matter to run a queue and can advocate for data visibility when it’s lacking.

  • Resilience & Empathy: You can balance rigorous performance management with the emotional intelligence required to build trust and morale during periods of operational transformation.

jobs.description:
Marketing and Communications Manager

Location: Remote, US Based, EST

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role, not a marketing strategy role. We are looking for someone with approximately four years of marketing experience who wants to roll up their sleeves and do the work: write the content, build the campaign, update the website, manage the calendar, chase the follow-ups, coordinate the event, and keep things moving. If you have spent 10 or 20 years leading marketing strategy and teams, this is not the role we are hiring for.

Over the past year, Underscore has built the foundation for a stronger marketing and new business engine, including a refreshed brand and positioning, a redesigned website, a defined ideal client profile, HubSpot infrastructure, an earned media program, and a growing portfolio of events designed to connect us with leaders across biopharma.

Now we’re looking for a Marketing and Communications Manager who can execute on that foundation, consistently.

This is an execution role. The Marketing and Communications Manager will own the day-to-day work of Underscore’s marketing: content for prospect outreach, case studies, our quarterly Rare Company newsletter, website and sales collateral updates, lead follow-up, events, and PR support. You will work closely with our leadership, subject matter experts, Sales Enablement, and our PR agency to make sure great ideas become great content and, ultimately, business opportunities.

You will also help execute our events. This includes our Rare Company Dinner series, which will be held at least four times in 2027. You will work on invitations, follow-ups, and venue management, and help make sure we deliver a valuable experience for senior leaders in biopharma. You will support internal efforts as well, such as our Town Hall and Gratitude events.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable keeping a content calendar on track, interviewing a media expert for a case study, working with Sales Enablement on a HubSpot campaign, and supporting an industry event.

What You’ll Do

Content

  • Create content at scale for prospect outreach. It has to be highly relevant to biopharma leaders and build on Underscore’s recognition and reputation.
  • Own and execute Underscore’s editorial calendar across the website, LinkedIn, email, and other marketing channels.
  • Own the quarterly Rare Company newsletter, an opt-in publication that gives prospects, and potentially clients, new news and new perspectives relevant to biopharma. Underscore’s subject matter experts are the source of the information.
  • Reuse everything. Take the expertise that already exists across Underscore (an award, a partner meeting, a conference takeaway, a dinner theme) and turn each one into a LinkedIn post, a newsletter item, a web update, and a line in the deck.
  • Maintain Underscore’s voice across everything we publish.

Case Studies

  • Publish case studies and maintain a strong library of them, with a goal of approximately two new case studies per quarter.
  • Partner with account leads, media teams, analytics, and other subject matter experts to identify compelling stories and results.
  • Own the case study process from beginning to end, including interviews, results gathering, writing, internal review, client approval, publishing, and inclusion in the sales library.
  • Work within client confidentiality requirements to develop compelling blinded case studies.

Website and Sales Collateral

  • Keep the Underscore website current on a monthly cycle: new team members, company news, articles, events, and awards.
  • Keep our capabilities decks, credentials, team bios, case studies, RFP content, and other sales materials current and easy to access.

Lead Follow-Up and Sales Enablement

  • Make sure every lead gets a follow-up within 48 hours, whether it comes from a conference, an event, a campaign, the website, or a Rare Company Dinner. Your job is to make lead routing and follow-up a standing process with clear owners.
  • Serve as the day-to-day marketing partner to Sales Enablement on the coordination and execution of prospect management in HubSpot.
  • Supply the content for tailored communications to different prospect audiences. This will be structured by audience so we can test and learn what works, and what doesn’t.

Events, PR and Awards

  • Help execute Underscore’s events, including the Rare Company Dinner series and major industry moments such as Fierce Pharma Week.
  • Support internal efforts such as Town Hall and Gratitude.
  • Serve as the execution partner to our PR agency, providing the company information, executive bios, subject matter expertise, quotes, images, and approvals needed to support earned media.
  • Own the annual marketing calendar (events, awards, etc) and coordinate awaard submissions from initial opportunity through final deadline.

Planning

  • Maintain the master marketing and new business calendar that our CEO and executive leadership team work from.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 4 years marketing experience
  • Excellent writing and storytelling. You write clear, jargon-free content that is engaging, from LinkedIn posts to case studies. You can interview a subject matter expert and turn the conversation into something a senior biopharma marketer would want to read.
  • Some familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.
  • Working knowledge of PowerPoint.
  • 1 to 2 years of event experience.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to keep a calendar and several projects moving at once.

Preferred

  • Three years b2b experience for healthcare, pharma, or a healthcare agency.
  • Agency-side experience, ideally in media or digital, so you can talk with the people who build media plans.
  • Exposure to rare disease, oncology, or specialty pharma.
  • Enough design literacy to make a one-pager in a template, and to know when you need a designer.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first year, success in this role will mean:

  • Underscore has a consistent editorial calendar that is being executed across channels.
  • The Rare Company newsletter goes out every quarter and has become a recognizable and valuable read for our target audience.
  • New case studies are being developed and added to our credentials library each quarter.
  • Every lead from events, campaigns, and the website has a clear owner and a follow-up within 48 hours.
  • The website and sales materials are updated monthly rather than reactively.
  • Strong ideas and insights from across Underscore are consistently turned into useful, market-facing content, and reused across channels.
  • Our CEO and executive leadership team work from one current marketing and new business calendar.

Who Will Thrive Here

You’re a doer.

You like taking something from idea to finished product. You know how to pull a good story out of people who may not think of themselves as storytellers. You care about the quality of the writing, but you also care whether someone opened it, responded to it, or wanted to have a conversation because of it.

You’re comfortable working in an environment where there are plenty of ideas and opportunities, and part of your value is bringing the structure, discipline, and follow-through that turns those ideas into a real marketing program.

At Underscore, you’ll have access to deep expertise across media, analytics, strategy, and healthcare. Your job is to help make sure the market sees it

Interested?
Apply by submitting your resume and a brief note outlining your healthcare or media experience.

 Underscore Marketing is a woman-owned, independent agency specializing in life sciences. Since 2002, we've helped clients gain a competitive edge through bold, data-driven promotional strategies that deliver measurable results.  

Our team comprises media, strategy, and omnichannel analytics experts who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and results. When you join Underscore, you become part of a dynamic environment where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work helps elevate brands in a competitive healthcare landscape.  

If you're passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a team that values integrity, creativity, and results, if that sounds like you, we invite you to share.  

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement 
Underscore is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

  • No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking
  • Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)
  • Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation
  • Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)
  • Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)
  • LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

In-House Counsel, Securities & Generalist

About the role

Pacaso is hiring an In-House Counsel to lead our SEC reporting and securities compliance, and to be a trusted generalist partner across the business. You will own the legal side of our periodic filings and disclosure process. You will also support the business on a wide range of other legal matters as they come up.

Roughly half your time will go to securities and governance. The other half will be whatever the business needs, from commercial agreements and real estate to employment, marketing and privacy.

This role suits a lawyer with 3 to 5+ years of law firm or in-house experience in securities or capital markets work who now wants breadth, direct business impact and a seat close to decision-makers. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Operations and executive leadership.

What you'll do

SEC reporting and securities

  • Own the preparation and review of the company's SEC filings, including annual, quarterly and current reports, proxy statements and offering materials.
  • Lead the disclosure process with Finance and Accounting.
  • Advise on securities law compliance, including offerings, equity issuances and insider trading.
  • Stay current on SEC rules and guidance, and update policies and processes as needed.

Public company governance and compliance

  • Serve as a primary legal advisor on the company's obligations as an SEC reporting company.
  • Support the board and its committees, including meeting materials, minutes and written consents.
  • Maintain governance documents and company policies.
  • Partner with Finance on disclosure controls and related processes.
  • Maintain entity records and good standing across subsidiaries.

Business and general legal support

You will be a true generalist and a day-to-day legal partner to teams across the company, from the front line to the executive team. We need someone who is excited by variety, comfortable learning new areas quickly, and ready to build legal processes as the company grows.

  • Draft, negotiate and manage agreements, including vendor, partnership, technology and services contracts.
  • Support real estate and property-related matters, including entity structuring, transactions and state-by-state regulatory questions.
  • Partner with People on employment matters such as policies, offer and separation agreements, leave and accommodation questions, and wage-and-hour compliance.
  • Advise Marketing and Sales on advertising, promotions, disclosures and licensing requirements.
  • Support privacy and data protection, including policies, vendor data processing agreements and responses to individual requests.
  • Help manage intellectual property, including trademarks, brand protection and software licensing.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation, disputes and regulatory inquiries, and manage their budgets and scope.
  • Build scalable legal processes, such as contract templates, intake and approval workflows and playbooks, so the business can move faster with fewer one-off requests.

What you bring

Required

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing.
  • 3 to 5+ years of experience at a well-regarded law firm or in-house legal team, with substantial securities or capital markets work.
  • Hands-on experience drafting or reviewing SEC periodic reports and disclosure documents.
  • Working knowledge of federal securities laws and SEC reporting requirements.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, at a law firm or in-house.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar areas of law quickly, and to recognize when to escalate or engage outside counsel.
  • Sound judgment, clear writing, and the ability to explain legal risk in plain terms to non-lawyers.

Drive continuous improvement

  • Identify process inefficiencies, contribute to documentation and refinement, and share lessons learnt to improve team practices.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager delivering customer-facing software implementations (ideally in a start-up, healthcare SaaS or another regulated domain).

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of overall software engineering experience.
