The Rapid7 Incident Responder is a hands-on, technical role focused on digital forensics and incident response that offers various customer-facing and consulting opportunities. Rapid7 Incident Responders split their time between reactive breach response cases—supporting Rapid7 customers in their greatest time of need—and proactive customer engagements, delivering threat hunting and detection and response exercises with dedicated internal security teams. Rapid7 aims to provide sustainable work-life balance that allows talented Detection & Response experts to thrive in a reactive Incident Response setting.


About the Team

The Rapid7 Incident Response team is the tip of the spear within Rapid7's Detection & Response practice, ensuring 24/7 breach response coverage for MDR and retainer customers. Delivering services through Rapid7's portfolio—including InsightIDR and Velociraptor—the team's frontline experiences directly inform Rapid7's Product organization to drive continuous improvement across both managed and standalone solutions.


About the Role

As an Incident Responder, your primary responsibility will be to manage major incident response engagements embedded within Rapid7 MDR SOC pods, with oversight from Senior Incident Responders, while dedicating time to ongoing research and service enablement. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Deliver end-to-end incident response services, managing customer engagements from initial scoping to final reporting across the entire IR lifecycle.
  • Coordinate and guide SOC Analysts during major investigations and provide mentorship on minor incident investigations.
  • Conduct forensic investigations using real-time telemetry from the InsightIDR platform and endpoint artifacts from Velociraptor.
  • Lead proactive threat hunting through Rapid7’s Compromise Assessment offering utilizing Velociraptor and other EDR technologies.
  • Execute threat emulation activities as part of Rapid7’s Detection & Response Workshop, helping clients assess their readiness against major threats using existing tools.
  • Advise clients on security best practices and mitigation strategies through enterprise security controls.
  • Research and apply knowledge of emerging attacker methodologies to enhance internal methodologies, procedures, and response efforts.
  • Contribute to public blogs and webinars by sharing actionable insights on the latest attacker techniques uncovered during investigations.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • Bring 2-3 years of hands-on incident response experience, including technical investigations, forensic analysis, and analyzing Windows, Mac, or Linux artifacts to assess threat actor activity.
  • Apply deep knowledge of enterprise security, integrating technologies such as EDR, SIEM, Velociraptor, and OSQuery to enhance threat detection and streamline response.
  • Demonstrate strong technical expertise in at least two specialized areas, including host forensics (Windows, Mac, Linux), network traffic analysis, log review, malware triage, or cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Communicate complex investigation findings and remediation steps in a clear, structured manner that conveys objectives and rationale to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, including executives and legal teams.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across internal SOC pods and external customer teams to understand business needs, align on response strategies, and deliver measurable value.
  • Hold yourself and others responsible for driving end-to-end investigation outcomes, meeting strict timelines, and maintaining high standards of delivery across competing priorities and an on-call rotation (including evening and weekend shifts).
  • Navigate evolving threat landscapes and shifting incident priorities with agility, remaining forward-focused while adapting investigation approaches in high-pressure, ambiguous environments.
  • Hold relevant industry certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GDAT, GCFE, GFCA, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.

jobs.excerpt: Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together Our Meaningful Mission At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates.
jobs.description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together
Our Meaningful Mission

At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

Our Core Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes:We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We are embarking on an exciting journey to build out our global Marketing analytics capability. Our culture is built on high trust, which empowers colleagues and fosters the high ownership necessary to meet our shared expectations and deliver high performance. As a remote-first company, you have the flexibility to work wherever you feel most focused and productive within your employing country. This freedom comes with wonderful, tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. These benefits include unlimited annual leave, great healthcare, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact, and in turn, we expect high ownership and commitment. This is a place where trust and high performance are valued, and we provide the environment and support you need to excel. We prioritise an environment where we openly share ideas, embrace our mistakes, and learn from them—collaboration is key to everything we do!

About the role
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will champion data science within our FinCrime-Fraud-AI-ML team. You will design, build and own the machine learning models that stop bad actors, while improving the experience for our legitimate customers. You'll start by finding the quick wins, then lead more ambitious, innovative work.
You'll join a highly collaborative FinCrime squad of Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and Backend Engineers, and partner closely with fraud analysts, operations and product. Your initial focus is fraud detection; as the role evolves, you'll have the chance to extend your impact into areas such as risk and credit rating.

What you'll do
  • Model lifecycle: own fraud detection models end to end, from problem framing and feature engineering to training, evaluation and deployment. Automate training and deployment so models are scalable, documented, tested and monitored for drift.
  • Fraud detection: build models that score transactions, accounts and customer behaviour in real time, covering threats such as account takeover, stolen payment credentials, first-party fraud, scams and mule activity.
  • Data and features:work with Data and Analytical Engineering to bring new data sources into our models using dbt best practices, including transactional, device, behavioural and identity signals.
  • Experimentation: design and run experiments to measure the impact of new models, third-party data sources and emerging tools on fraud losses, approval rates and customer experience.
  • Commercial translation:turn complex business needs into solvable data science projects, and set thresholds that balance fraud losses against friction for legitimate customers.
  • Continuous improvement:keep scrutinising our methods to improve model accuracy and the quality of data inputs, and respond quickly as fraud patterns change.
  • Empowerment:build tools and strategies that help non-technical stakeholders understand and act on model results.
  • Leadership: mentor other data scientists, review their work and help set technical standards for the team.
What you'll bring
  • 6+ years' in the Data Science space, including but not limited to, hands on experience with regression analysis, clustering methods, boosting algorithms, feature/model selection, training and deploying models that deliver measurable value
  • Results Driven: Excels at driving technical results in a business oriented framework.
  • Experience in fraud, financial crime, risk or a similar adversarial domain, ideally in payments, fintech or banking, including imbalanced classification and delayed or noisy labels.
  • Strong Coding Skills in Python and ability to use Python for automation, application deploymentSQL: Expert skills in CTEs, joins, and subqueries to manipulate complex datasets for modeling.
  • The ability to deploy your own models and set up the monitoring they need.
  • Familiarity with a modern stack: scikit-learn, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, and visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau or Streamlit.
  • A problem-solving mindset that balances technical excellence with commercial impact. You're comfortable over-communicating and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

Nice to have
  • Experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, ECS and EMR.
  • Advanced knowledge of experimentation design and evaluation.
  • Graph analytics or graph ML for detecting fraud rings and mule networks.
  • Real-time or streaming ML with low-latency scoring.
  • Model explainability techniques such as SHAP, and experience with model risk governance.
  • Knowledge of cross-border payments or remittances, and the regulations around fraud and AML.
  • A “tenacious” attitude—you are willing to do things manually when necessary but seek to automate at every opportunity.

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.

Ready to Apply? Let’s Go!

Embedded within the client environment, you will identify, investigate, assess, and communicate threats and emerging risks impacting personnel, operations, assets, facilities, and brand reputation, while providing day-to-day leadership and oversight to a small team of Threat Intelligence Analysts.

In addition to the analytical responsibilities, as a Threat Intelligence Team Lead, you will oversee the team's day-to-day intelligence delivery, establish priorities, coordinate workloads, quality-assure analytical products, and provide coaching and mentorship to team members. You will serve as a key point of contact for client stakeholders, helping translate intelligence requirements into clear team priorities and ensuring the consistent delivery of timely, relevant, and high-quality intelligence.

You will work closely with stakeholders across corporate security, physical security, investigations, and business operations teams to deliver timely intelligence products, investigative findings, and operational support.

Working hours and arrangement: this is a fully remote role working hours are Monday to Friday, 8 am .- 5 pm, with occasional weekend coverage expected.

Essential Functions / Responsibilities

  • Monitor, collect, and analyze information from a variety of sources to identify threats, risks, and emerging trends impacting personnel, operations, assets, facilities, and brand reputation.
  • Conduct online investigations into threat actors, online communities, suspicious activity, and emerging risks, leveraging OSINT, social media, public records, and commercial intelligence platforms to develop investigative leads, conduct due diligence and attribution research, and produce actionable intelligence.
  • Produce and quality-assure timely intelligence products, investigative reports, alerts, and briefings, ensuring analytical accuracy, relevance, and consistency across team deliverables.
  • Triage and respond to requests for intelligence and investigative support, set team priorities, coordinate workloads, and delegate tasks to ensure timely delivery against client requirements.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, direction, coaching, and mentorship to Threat Intelligence Analysts, supporting professional development and maintaining high analytical standards across the team.
  • Engage proactively with stakeholders across corporate security, physical security, investigations, and business operations to understand and refine intelligence requirements, translate requirements into team priorities, and enhance threat identification, risk mitigation, and security outcomes.
  • Support critical incident response efforts through rapid research, analysis, and dissemination of relevant information, providing direction to the team and serving as an escalation point for complex or time-sensitive matters.
  • Maintain intelligence records, analytical databases, and case management systems, and support the development and consistent application of team SOPs, investigative workflows, and analytical standards.
  • Identify opportunities to continuously improve the intelligence function, including processes, analytical methodologies, tools, AI capabilities, and emerging technologies that enhance team effectiveness and intelligence delivery.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience supporting security, intelligence, investigations, trust and safety, or risk management programs within technology companies, government agencies, or private-sector intelligence organizations.
  • Strong understanding of threat intelligence, investigative methodologies, threat actor research, intelligence collection and analysis practices, and online investigative techniques.
  • Strong proficiency in OSINT collection, social media analysis, public records research, and commercial investigative and intelligence platforms such as LexisNexis, Dataminr, Flashpoint, or similar technologies.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and editorial skills, with the ability to assess risk, manage ambiguity, produce actionable intelligence, and quality-assure analytical products for accuracy, relevance, sourcing, rigor, and clarity.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop intelligence professionals while fostering collaboration, accountability, and consistently high analytical standards.
  • Ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple intelligence requirements across a team, manage competing demands, and exercise sound judgment in dynamic or time-sensitive situations.
  • Strong written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate findings, understand client requirements, and translate those requirements into actionable intelligence priorities.
  • Experience utilizing AI and emerging technologies to enhance research, information analysis, investigative workflows, and operational efficiency, with an ability to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and a commitment to objectivity, professional ethics, analytical rigor, and continuous learning.
  • Ability to transform complex information into actionable intelligence that enables decision-makers to mitigate risk, enhance security operations, and support informed security and business decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Political Science, Intelligence Studies, Business Management, Journalism, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in threat intelligence, intelligence analysis, investigations, OSINT, corporate security, trust and safety, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting investigative research, intelligence collection, threat analysis, and research into threat actors, online communities, or emerging security threats.
  • Proven ability to produce and review high-quality analytical reports, investigative findings, and intelligence products.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or providing substantive analytical oversight to intelligence, investigative, or security professionals.
  • Experience managing stakeholder requirements and translating them into clear analytical, investigative, or operational priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in dynamic, time-sensitive environments while coordinating multiple priorities and exercising sound professional judgment.

Interview Process

  • Meet and Greet with the client

Research indicates that certain groups are less likely to apply for a position unless they meet every single requirement. If you meet some of the requirements and can offer a unique perspective for this role, we strongly encourage you to apply—you might be the perfect fit we're looking for!

Sibylline is committed to the recruitment and selection of candidates without regard for sexual orientation, gender, ethnicity, age, political beliefs, culture, and lifestyle. We are committed to fostering a business culture that reflects these values and promotes equal opportunity.

Sibylline is a leading intelligence and strategic risk consultancy in the security sector. Since 2010, we have supported businesses, governments, and NGOs by providing high-quality risk analysis, due diligence, and consultancy services.

The firm provides an innovative, entrepreneurial, and fast-growing working environment, offering employees ever greater exposure to high-profile clients and challenges. Sibylline offers fantastic opportunities for career progression within a successful company, and we aim to help our employees build their own personal profiles as well-regarded analysts within the broader industry.

Key attributes of Sibylline employees are:

jobs.excerpt: About RSAC RSAC is the premier series of global events and year‑round learning for the cybersecurity community.
jobs.description:
About RSAC

RSAC is the premier series of global events and year‑round learning for the cybersecurity community. RSAC is where the security industry converges to discuss current and future concerns and gain access to experts, unbiased content, and ideas that help individuals and companies advance their cybersecurity posture and build stronger, smarter teams.

Both in‑person and online, RSAC brings the cybersecurity industry together and empowers the collective “we” to stand against cyberthreats around the world. RSAC is the ultimate marketplace for the latest technologies and hands‑on educational opportunities, helping industry professionals discover how to make their organisations more secure while showcasing the most enterprising, influential, and thought‑provoking thinkers and leaders in cybersecurity today.

We are now building a year-round membership platform where security practitioners and leaders gain knowledge, earn CPE credits, upskill through hands-on learning, and network with peers and experts.

This role leads the team building that platform. You will grow the product into a daily destination, add AI-native and agentic experiences, define the next generation of our mobile app, and support consumer and enterprise (team) memberships. Our users defend organizations for a living, so the bar for security, reliability and quality is exceptionally high.

What You’ll Do

Lead and grow the engineering organization

  • Lead front-end, back-end, full-stack and iOS engineers, our DevOps / SRE function, and the Quality Engineering team.

  • Hire, coach and develop engineers and engineering managers. Build a culture that values both delivery speed and quality.

  • Set clear goals, career paths and performance expectations, and give regular, candid feedback.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Content and Marketing as an equal member of the product leadership team.

Own delivery and engineering excellence

  • Run agile delivery practices that make commitments predictable and keep the team shipping frequently in small increments.

  • Establish engineering standards for code quality, architecture review, documentation and incident management.

  • Track and improve delivery metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and time to recovery.

Build secure, scalable platforms

  • Set the technical direction for our TypeScript / React web app, APIs and services on Azure, including Cosmos DB data design and performance.

  • Build security into the full lifecycle: secure design, threat modeling, identity and access, secrets management, dependency and supply-chain security, and vulnerability response.

  • Lead cloud engineering, infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation so every change ships safely and automatically.

  • Own reliability, observability and cost efficiency, with clear service-level objectives (SLOs).

Deliver AI-native and agentic experiences

  • Build AI-native features (for example, our AI assistant, content summaries, mind maps and personalized learning) and agentic workflows that act on members' behalf.

  • Set standards for safe and secure AI: evaluation, guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, data privacy, and cost and latency management.

Define the next-generation mobile experience

  • Shape and deliver the vision for RSAC's mobile app, including the switch from conference mode to year-round membership.

  • Lead native iOS development and drive a mobile strategy that balances speed, consistency across platforms and user experience.

Champion quality

  • Lead Quality Engineering, with test automation across web and mobile, quality built into CI/CD, and a shift-left testing culture.

  • Define release-readiness criteria and quality metrics and use them to make release decisions.

Support consumer and B2B growth

  • Build for individual members and for enterprise team memberships: account hierarchies, admin controls, SSO, entitlements and subscription billing.

What success looks like in your first year

  1. First 90 days: assess the team, architecture, security posture and delivery process. Agree on engineering goals and a 12-month technical roadmap with the CPO.

  1. By 6 months: predictable delivery with measured improvements in release frequency and quality. Automated test coverage and CI/CD in place across web and mobile.

  1. By 12 months: a secure, scalable platform supporting weekly member engagement, the first AI-native and agentic features in production, a next-generation mobile app launched, and the foundations for enterprise team memberships. An engineering culture known for both speed and quality.

Application Requirements

  • 10+ years managing software engineering teams, including leading managers and multi-discipline teams across web, mobile, back end, DevOps and QA.

  • Experience building web applications for professionals, in both direct-to-consumer and B2B settings, including subscriptions, entitlements and enterprise features such as SSO and team administration.

  • Hands-on technical depth in TypeScript / JavaScript and React, API and service design, and NoSQL data modeling (Azure Cosmos DB or similar).

  • Cloud engineering experience on Azure (or AWS / GCP with a clear path to Azure), including infrastructure as code, containers and serverless.

  • Proven DevOps and CI/CD practice: automated build, test and deploy pipelines, environment strategy, observability and incident response.

  • Security-first engineering: a track record of building security into apps and the tech stack, such as OWASP-aligned secure coding, threat modeling, identity and authentication (OAuth / OIDC), secrets management, software supply-chain security and secure SDLC practices.

  • Practical experience with AI-native applications: LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and an understanding of agentic architectures, including tool use, orchestration and their security risks.

  • Mobile app development leadership, ideally native iOS, with the product judgment to define a next-generation mobile experience.

  • Quality Engineering leadership: test strategy and automation for web and mobile, built into CI/CD.

  • Deep fluency in agile development and a record of predictable, high-quality delivery.

  • A coach and culture builder who has grown engineers and managers and built teams known for both speed and quality.

  • Clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to executives and non-technical partners.

Nice to have

  • Background in community, content or membership products (video, events, discussions, personalization).

  • Experience with online learning platforms or learning management systems (LMS): courses, labs, cohorts, progress tracking or certification and CPE credit workflows.

  • Experience building for a cybersecurity audience, or at a security product company.

  • Experience with Azure identity services (e.g., Azure AD B2C / Entra External ID) and password less authentication.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Location & Eligibility

Please be aware that although this is a remote position, to be considered for the vacancy you must have residency in one of the following states:

California, Colorado, Florida, Kansas, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington

Benefits

RSAC believes in investing in our people. We offer:

  • Salary range: $250,000 – $280,000

  • Employer‑subsidised medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401K retirement employer match

  • Home office equipment stipend and monthly technology stipend

  • Thirteen paid holidays per calendar year

  • Flexible personal time off

  • Annual employee bonus dependent on company and personal performance

  • Annual company‑wide offsite

Our Culture

We believe that our differences make us stronger, and we are committed to fostering a culture of respect, empathy, and understanding.

  • We are a fully remote team operating across the United States, giving our employees the flexibility to work from wherever they choose.

  • Our team is passionate and results‑oriented, striving to achieve excellence in everything we do.

  • We strongly believe in creating an inclusive environment that values diversity and encourages our team members to share their unique perspectives.

  • We recognise that by collaborating and working together, we can achieve our goals faster and more effectively.

Why RSAC?

The RSAC team takes great pride in helping shape the future of cybersecurity and being part of an expansive global community. We’re always looking for imaginative and visionary individuals who share our passion for providing cutting‑edge programs that equip cybersecurity practitioners worldwide with the intel and knowledge they need to thrive and safeguard organisations against cyberthreats.

Our Values

  • Adaptability: In our ever‑changing world, we innovate through determination, creativity, and resourcefulness.

  • Community: We bring people together and build trust by embracing the unique thoughts and perspectives of others with kindness and respect.

  • Excellence: Because we are where the world talks security, we have the highest expectations of ourselves and our partners.

Equal Opportunity Statement

RSAC is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusion and diversity. We take affirmative action to ensure all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: AI Transformation Architect [IC4]
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.

With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.

Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.

If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.

Working hours

🌎 While we are an all-remote company and hire almost anywhere in the world, we do require successful candidates to be located in the United States.

Preferred location:

  • USA

Why this job is exciting

Every engineering organization has bought coding agents. Yet very few can confidently tell you that they’re making the impact they thought they would. They are falling short, not because the model isn’t good enough, but because the codebase is too complex and, outside of a few thousand people employed by OpenAI and Anthropic, nobody understands what good context looks like. Agents can’t access all the code they need, they burn tokens hunting for the right code, and fill the gaps by guessing. Organizations build internal harnesses and knowledge bases using techniques that are outdated before the product is even in use. You’ll be the person to show customers how to actually fix these problems.

Sourcegraph gives the largest, most sophisticated engineering organizations in the world full codebase context so their teams and their agents can understand, oversee, and change their codebase with confidence. As agent adoption grows, and agents write more code, having the right context matters more and more.

Being a brand new role, you’ll be building from scratch. You’ll define what the AI maturity curve looks like inside of enterprise organizations, turn that into a framework customers can use to assess themselves against, and lead engagements with customers where you’ll directly dig into their environment, build an action plan, and work with them to action it. Then you’ll measure again and show what changed and the results they’ve achieved.

You’ll spend your time in customer environments, in the room with VPs of Engineering and staff engineers, and in the product. You’ll also shape the broader market’s view on what good context looks like for agents, which is a question the whole industry is still figuring out. Your results will show up in how customers use the Sourcegraph platform and in the ways they are able to actually make agents work in enterprise codebases.

📅 Within one month, you will…

  • Build relationships across Sales, Field Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product
  • Learn our products, our value prop, and how our largest customers use Sourcegraph
  • Shadow customer calls and interview customers about where their agents succeed and fail today
  • Review our existing benchmark studies and draft a first point of view on the dimensions of context that matter most

📅 Within one quarter, you will…

  • Publish Sourcegraph’s first perspective on context maturity, grounded in what you’ve learned from customer conversations and our own data
  • Ship v1 of the maturity framework: the categories, the criteria that define each stage, and how evidence maps to a score
  • Partner with Marketing to launch a self-serve version
  • Equip Solutions Engineers to run a lightweight version of the assessment inside of trials
  • Run your first assessment with 1-2 select customers, and refine the framework based on what you find

📅 Within six months, you will…

  • Be a recognized voice on context and agent readiness, with a steady cadence of writing, talks, or research that engineering leaders reference
  • Publish findings from real assessments: what you’re seeing across enterprise codebases, where agents break, and what moves the needle
  • Own a repeatable paid engagement with a defined scope, deliverables, and readout
  • Deliver action plans that customers execute with you — activating workflows, integrations, and agentic use cases in their own environment
  • Re-measure your first customers and show movement up the curve
  • Feed what you learn back to EPD as a standing input on agent effectiveness in the enterprise

About you

You’re a consultant at heart, with technical chops and credibility. You can walk into a complex engineering organization, find what’s broken, and leave with a plan people act on. You’re equally comfortable telling a VP of Engineering their environment isn’t where they think it is as you are debating a staff engineer on why.

You build things that didn’t exist before: frameworks, practices, points of view. You can turn insight into action and you’re energized by a blank page as a starting point.

Finally, you’re in the middle of the AI shift yourself. You have deep experience and strong opinions on where agents work and where they don’t, and you share them publicly. You stay on top of AI development, use new models and harnesses as they’re released, and have a perspective on how every generation of these products changes the story.

Your skill-set:

  • 7+ years experience advising enterprise technology or engineering organizations
  • Systems or solutions architecture experience in large-scale software, the developer ecosystem, or SDLC environments
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and a point of view on how enterprises are adopting them
  • Experience creating structured, repeatable approaches to diagnosing problems, such as frameworks, assessments, playbooks, or methodologies others can use
  • Experience turning technical findings into an executive-ready business roadmap, then working hands-on with customers to deliver it

Nice to Have

  • You’ve run your own consulting practice or built a consultative services offering from scratch
  • Background in developer tooling, platform engineering, developer experience, or DevOps
  • A public voice - writing or speaking - you have a body of work people reference
  • Experience with consumption or usage-based products

Level

📊 This job is an IC4. You can read more about our job leveling philosophy in our Handbook.

Compensation

💸 We pay you an above-average salary because we want to hire the best people who are fully focused on helping Sourcegraph succeed, not worried about paying bills. As an open and transparent company that values competitive compensation, our compensation ranges are visible to every single Sourcegraph teammate.

Your salary is determined by your pay band for the IC4 job level. For determining pay bands, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources, along with your location zone, and target the high-end of the range to ensure we’re always paying above market regardless of where you live in the world. Both U.S. and international locations are divided into one of four zones, determined by the cost of labor index for each area. The salary for a successful candidate will be based on level, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location zone. Please note that the salaries below may be adjusted in the future.

💰 The salary for this role is $200,000 USD.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer equity (because when we succeed as a company, we want you to succeed, too) and generous perks & benefits.

Interview process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role (you can read more about the types of interviews in our Handbook). It may look like a lot of steps, but rest assured that we move quickly and the steps are designed to help you get the information needed to determine if we’re the right fit for you… Interviewing is a two-way street, after all!

We expect the interview process to take about 4.25 hours in total.

👋 Introduction Stage - we have initial conversations to get to know you better…

  • Recruiter screen (30 min)
  • Hiring manager interview with Hiring Manager (45 min)

🧑‍💻 Team Interview Stage - we then delve into your experience in more depth and introduce you to members of the team, including cross-functional partners…

  • Technical deep dive with Field Engineering (45 min)
  • Conversation with Marketing (30 min)

🎉 Final Interview Stage - we move you to our final round, where you gain a better understanding of our business and values holistically…

  • Working session with Aimee, Sales, Customer success (45 min)
  • Values Interview (30 min)
  • CEO interview (30 min)

Please note - you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet, but didn’t get to meet during the interview process.

Learn more about us

You can learn more about what it is like to work at Sourcegraph by reading our handbook.

We are an ambitious team who are collectively working hard to build the most influential company in the world. You can read more about our culture, competitive compensation and benefits here.

Sourcegraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

Sourcegraph participates in E-Verify for U.S. Employees.

jobs.description:
Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data

Avicado is seeking an experienced Solution Architect to design and deliver practical technical solutions for construction-industry clients. This client-facing role combines construction project management and accounting knowledge with hands-on technical problem-solving across PMIS platforms, enterprise financial systems, integrations, data, and custom applications.

The ideal candidate can lead discovery with business and IT stakeholders, translate operational needs into implementable designs, and personally validate technical approaches by exploring APIs, reviewing code, analyzing data, and building proofs of concept. The architect owns solution direction from discovery through development handoff and supports delivery teams as designs are implemented.

What You’ll Do

  • Solution Architecture & Hands-On Technical Design
    • Lead technical discovery and design workshops; identify requirements, constraints, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
    • Design integrations, data flows, custom applications, and automation solutions connecting PMIS, ERP, and other enterprise systems.
    • Document architecture diagrams, interface specifications, data mappings, transformations, and actionable development requirements.
    • Investigate APIs, webhooks, databases, file interfaces, and existing code to understand capabilities and technical limitations.
    • Build scripts, prototypes, and proofs of concept to test assumptions and demonstrate feasibility.
    • Guide developers through design decisions, technical troubleshooting, implementation reviews, and solution handoffs.
  • Construction & Financial Process Consulting
    • Apply construction project controls knowledge across budgets, commitments, cost codes, change orders, invoices, and reporting.
    • Understand how construction PMIS processes connect with accounting, procurement, job costing, and ERP workflows.
    • Evaluate solution options against real business operations, data integrity, financial controls, and long-term maintainability.
  • Client Relationships & Consulting Delivery
    • Build trusted relationships with customers, software vendors, partners, and internal delivery teams.
    • Communicate technical tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to business and technical audiences.
    • Own technical design deliverables while contributing to billable engagements, estimates, scoping, and proposals.
    • Support existing client solutions, identify enhancements, and uncover opportunities to create additional value.
    • Take initiative, make sound decisions with limited guidance, and remain responsive in a collaborative remote environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in solution architecture, technical consulting, systems integration, software development, or comparable client-facing technical work.
  • Experience with construction operations, construction PMIS platforms, or closely related project management business processes.
  • Working knowledge of construction financial workflows, including budgets, commitments, change orders, invoices, and ERP/accounting relationships.
  • Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, and/or file-based interfaces.
  • Ability to read code, query data with SQL, troubleshoot interfaces, and develop scripts or technical proofs of concept.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into architecture, technical specifications, and actionable implementation recommendations.
  • Strong client-facing communication, relationship-building, ownership, and independent problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Procore, Trimble Unity Construct (e-Builder), Kahua, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or similar construction platforms.
  • Experience with ERP or accounting platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, or Workday.
  • Deeper construction accounting knowledge, including job costing, general ledger structures, accounts payable, and reconciliation.
  • Experience with Boomi, Workato, MuleSoft, or other integration platforms; familiarity with SOAP, XML, and SFTP.
  • Hands-on experience with C#, Python, JavaScript, Power BI, cloud services, or Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Experience with AI-assisted technical investigation, code review, prototyping, or solution design.
  • Experience developing estimates, statements of work, and technical proposals in a consulting environment.
  • Experience mentoring technical professionals, leading technical teams, or managing direct reports.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline, equivalent practical experience, or relevant certifications.

Characteristics of an ideal candidate 

  • Responsive; Avicado takes great pride in reacting quickly and positively to our clients and teammates, both internal and external 
  • Innovative; a desire to drive innovation through new and unique solutions while embracing creative ideas
  • Entrepreneurial; the drive to take initiative, deliver results, and create value for our clients
  • Empowered; bring solutions instead of problems
  • Performance Driven & Accountable; sets goals and challenges our high-performance culture
  • Even-tempered; handles pressure and thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Coachable; recognizes strengths & weakness and open to guidance 

Why Avicado 

  • Competitive compensation 
  • Health insurance 
  • Flexible PTO
  • Remote work
  • Philanthropic Matching Gift Program  And more… 

About Avicado 

Avicado LLC, was established in 2015 with a focus on utilizing the latest cloud-based tools and applications to enhance our clients' experience. As a technology consultancy, we empower construction owners to make the most of their systems and data. Our team of experts collaborates with enterprise organizations such as data centers, universities, hospitals, and real estate developers to promote seamless interoperability across their teams and technologies. We are experiencing an exciting phase of expansion and actively searching for new talent to join our team.

We’re a close-knit team with a high-performance culture, but we don’t like to take ourselves too seriously.

Our diversity and inclusivity are a point of pride, and we have created a highly interactive remote work environment that encourages mutual respect and individuality while fostering opportunities for employees to excel both personally and professionally. We offer competitive benefits, remote work experiences, flexible work arrangements, various career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and more.

Avicado's unwavering dedication to creating a remarkable workplace experience has been widely acknowledged by experts in the industry. We are thrilled to have attained the highly coveted "Great Place to Work" certification and to have been included on Inc.'s esteemed Best Workplaces list for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are humbled to have received the AYA Award, which recognizes allies who promote equality and actively foster positive change for women in technology. At Avicado, we take great pride in fostering a culture that is both inclusive and supportive, especially for women in the technology industry.

These accolades are a testament to our ongoing efforts to foster a culture of inclusion, mutual respect, and professional growth for all members of our team.

If you are a self-motivated individual who wants to work with Fortune 500 clients in a rapidly growing company, we encourage you to join us!

The Project Manager (PM) plays a critical role in ensuring successful delivery of RSI Security’s cybersecurity and compliance engagements. This role bridges Sales, Technical Operations, and the Client Experience team to drive execution and reinforce client trust throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Role Purpose

The Project Manager at RSI Security is responsible for orchestrating the seamless execution of client-facing cybersecurity and compliance engagements. This role exists to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest standards of quality, while fostering trust and transparency with clients and internal teams. By aligning cross-functional efforts and driving operational discipline, the Project Manager plays a vital role in preserving client satisfaction, optimizing resource utilization, and reinforcing RSI Security’s reputation for excellence.

Core Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own end-to-end project delivery: scope, timeline, resource coordination, and risk mitigation
  • Facilitate project kickoffs, weekly status calls, and closeout activities
  • Monitor project performance using KPIs and internal dashboards
  • Ensure documentation, deliverables, and milestones are completed on time and to quality standards

Client Experience & Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution
    Provide clear and proactive communication to manage expectations and enhance satisfaction
  • Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities based on observed client needs

Internal Collaboration

  • Coordinate with assessors, consultants, and technical SMEs to ensure aligned project delivery
  • Work closely with the Sales and CX teams on pre-engagement planning and post-project review
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing

Compliance & Operational Rigor

  • Ensure all activities comply with internal standards, client contracts, and industry best practices
  • Maintain accurate records in project management tools (e.g., Monday.com, HubSpot)
  • Support internal QA efforts and contribute to lessons-learned reviews

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

3+ years of project management experience delivering client-facing engagements in professional services, consulting, or IT/cybersecurity.

Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of concurrent client projects from kickoff through closeout, including scope, timeline, hours budget, and risk.

Working familiarity with at least one cybersecurity or compliance framework (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, CMMC, FedRAMP) and how audit or assessment engagements are structured.

Hands-on experience with a work management platform (Monday.com, Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar) and a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar), with disciplined record-keeping.

Experience leading client kickoffs, weekly status calls, and escalations as the primary point of contact.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate technical assessors and SMEs alongside non-technical client stakeholders.

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You’ll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to join our Product Development team. This role plays a key part in providing senior technical and organizational leadership for SANS’ Cloud Platform Engineering organization — spanning platform core services (identity, product administration, and entitlements), DevOps tools and services, website engineering, and courseware & platform orchestration — while serving as the engineering executive for Project CORE, SANS’ enrollment and entitlement modernization program. This role leads individual contributors and engineering teams through their managers and leads; owns shared engineering platforms, standards, tooling, and vendor relationships; and drives the architecture, delivery, and cross-functional coordination required to modernize SANS’ enrollment, entitlement, and administrative systems. The Director partners closely with Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and fellow engineering directors to translate business strategy into secure, scalable, and maintainable systems.

As a Director of Software Engineering, you will:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor individual contributors and engineering teams through managers and leads.

  • Direct modernization of core product platforms — enrollment, entitlement, identity, and product services — including integration with enterprise systems and retirement of legacy tooling.
  • Measure engineering effectiveness and drive continuous improvement across teams.
  • Champion incident management discipline and publish regular engineering communications to stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • At least 10 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years managing through engineering managers or leads.
  • Demonstrated success leading a large, multi-team modernization or systems-integration program from design through delivery.
  • Strong technical acumen with prior hands-on development experience and the ability to guide architectural decisions across services, integrations, and data flows.
  • Experience with modern AI development techniques and best practices.
  • Experience with enterprise business systems and integrations (e.g., Salesforce/Service Cloud, identity providers, payment/order management).
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices, including AWS, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, software procurement, licensing, and budgets.
  • Experience with Agile, SDLC, and modern development standards and best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting and cross-functional coordination.
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Experience in education technology, training delivery platforms, or certification systems.
  • Experience facilitating architecture governance (architecture councils, RFC processes, engineering standards).
  • Familiarity with identity and access management platforms (PingIdentity, Entra ID) and entitlement modeling.
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted development tooling and governing its safe, cost-effective adoption.
  • Interest in a security-first mindset and secure coding practices.
  • Ability and passion for developing both individuals and teams.

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $240,000 OTE (comprised of base salary and bonus), depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

jobs.excerpt: As Director of Product Management for Achieve Debt Optimizer*, you will own the company's next-generation consumer debt product end to end.
jobs.description:
As Director of Product Management for Achieve Debt Optimizer*, you will own the company's next-generation consumer debt product end to end. Achieve Debt Optimizer*evaluates a consumer's whole debt picture and matches them to the right solution across Achieve and partner products, loan and non-loan alike. It is not a budgeting app and not a single-product lender.

This is a core product leadership role with two amplified mandates: building the partner ecosystem that powers the marketplace and taking the product to market. You will turn a validated zero-to-one concept into a scaled, monetized platform heading into 2027. Achieve Debt Optimizer* is a strategic initiative anchoring the company's long-term growth objective. It runs a decoupled front end and back end, and its roadmap evolves on transitioning from single product solutions into multi product bundles that include multiyear debt plans that transform consumers’ future and shape the way they think about debt. Many concepts are backed by user research that clearly point out that users are highly interested in comprehensive solutions.

What you'll own

1. Product strategy and execution

  • Lead the product from validated prototype to scaled platform: define requirements, sequence releases and make clear trade-offs across scope, speed and risk.
  • Define the decisioning experience: whole-portfolio debt evaluation, Fit Score and account-level ratings, Smart Move recommendations, bundling logic and liability drag.
  • Partner with design and research to run rapid concept tests and turn findings into product decisions.
  • Shape AI-enabled and agentic experiences, including the conversational navigator, so they lift conversion and consumer trust.

2. Partner integration and ecosystem

  • Build the partner strategy for loan and non-loan solutions and partnerships: partner with BD to identify, prioritize and onboard partners across refinance, auto and student lending, balance transfer, credit counseling and other external solutions.
  • Own the partner API and integration product: pre-qualification and pricing exchange, eligibility, offer return, attribution and reporting.
  • Define partner onboarding, certification and performance standards; manage the integration pipeline with Partner B2B and Engineering.
  • Design marketplace economics with Finance and Partnerships: revenue share, lead and funded-loan monetization, and partner-level reporting.
  • Evolve the platform toward partner and B2B packaging, including platform-as-a-service use cases.
  • Ensure every partner offer meets compliance, fair-lending and data-sharing requirements, in partnership with Legal and Compliance.

3. Go-to-market

  • Partner with Marketing on GTM for each release: positioning, target segments, pricing and packaging, launch plans and success criteria.
  • Partner with Marketing, Channel and MarTech to plan acquisition across paid, owned, partner and direct channels, and to optimize channel mix.
  • Integrate Debt Navigator into the unified prequalification platform across business units so it becomes a front door to the Achieve portfolio.
  • Build the measurement framework: funnel conversion, engagement and return visits, partner yield, revenue per user and unit economics.

4. Agentic strategy

  • Define product content and functionality so the product can be properly represented and show up in LLMs and agents
  • Develop the decision methodology on how the product, bundle and logic are exposed in a form agents can explain and trust.
  • Define MCP and API interfaces so agents use to query and act on the product.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in product management, with hands-on experience.
  • A track record of taking a zero-to-one consumer product to scale and owning its P&L or revenue outcomes.
  • Experience building marketplace or platform products with third-party partners: partner APIs, integrations, offer exchange and partner economics.
  • Hands-on go-to-market leadership: positioning, pricing and packaging, launch, and channel strategy with Marketing and Sales.
  • Consumer-facing experience and strong understanding in experimentation.
  • Strong analytical skills: funnel and unit-economics fluency, experiment design and data-driven prioritization.
  • Executive presence and the ability to align senior leaders, partners and cross-functional teams around a clear direction.

Preferred

  • Experience with lending marketplaces, loan-matching or offer-aggregation platforms.
  • Experience shipping AI-enabled or conversational products in a regulated setting.
  • Familiarity with credit data, tradelines, credit decisioning or credit prediction models.
  • Experience with B2B or platform-as-a-service packaging of a consumer product.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with senior executives to shape and pressure-test product direction. You'll also work cross functionally with Design, Research, Engineering, Marketing, BD and Legal & Compliance.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for a leader who is hands-on that thrives in ambiguity, moves fast and wants to define a new category in consumer debt.

The Impact You'll Make

Your work will directly reshape how millions of people find financial freedom and think about debt. You'll define the experience that power the company's core growth engine. You'll measure success by how many people you empower to take control of their financial future—and by how much you help Achieve grow sustainably and responsibly.

Achieve well-being with:

  • Hybrid and remote work opportunities
  • 401 (k) with employer match
  • Medical, dental, and vision with HSA and FSA options
  • Competitive vacation and sick time off, as well as dedicated volunteer days
  • Access to wellness support through Employee Assistance Program, Talkspace, and fitness discounts
  • Up to $5,250 paid back to you on eligible education expenses
  • Pet care discounts for your furry family members
  • Financial support in times of hardship with our Achieve Care Fund
  • A safe place to connect and a commitment to diversity and inclusion through our six employee resource groups

Note: We will be unable to facilitate H1-B Visa transfer or sponsorship, along with STEM-OPT Visa.

Work from home/hybrid:

We are proudly offering hybrid options in the San Francisco, CA and Phoenix, AZ metro markets. Hiring remotely in selected locations throughout PST, MST, CST.

Salary Range: $210,000 to $240,000 salary + bonus + benefits.

This information represents the expected salary range for this role. Should we decide to make an offer for employment, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

Join Achieve, change the future.

At Achieve, we’re changing millions of lives.
From the single parent trying to catch up on bills to the entrepreneur needing a loan for the next phase of growth, you’ll get to be a part of their journey to a better financial future. We’re proud to have over 3,000 employees in mostly hybrid and 100% remote roles across the United States with hubs in Arizona, California, and Texas. We are strategically growing our teams with more remote, work-from-home opportunities every day to better serve our members. A career at Achieve is more than a job—it’s a place where you can make a true impact, have a sense of belonging, establish a fulfilling career, and put your well-being first.

Attention Agencies & Search Firms: We do not accept unsolicited candidate resumes or profiles. Please do not reach out to anyone within Achieve to market your services or candidates. All inquiries should be directed to Talent Acquisition only. We reserve the right to hire any candidates sent unsolicited and will not pay any fees without a contract signed by Achieve’s Talent Acquisition leader.

Achieve is a leading digital personal finance company. We help everyday people move from struggling to thriving by providing innovative, personalized financial solutions. By leveraging proprietary dataand analytics, our solutions are tailored for each step of our member's financial journey to include debt consolidation, personal loans, home equity loans, financial tools and education. Every day, we get to help our members move their finances forward with care, compassion, and empathetic touch. We put people first and treat them like humans, not account numbers.

The fintech industry is large and growing. Over $11T in home equity is sitting untapped across US homeowners - most haven’t borrowed against it yet, while personal loan balances just hit a record $276Bn from four years in a row of growth, with no signs of slowing. Consumers continue to face mounting debt. Credit card delinquencies are up 38%, leading to more demand for debt relief services. Achieve continues to support members and meet them wherever they are on their journey. Since 2002, Achieve has grown into one of the largest private consumer fintech unicorns in the U.S., with over $57B in enrollments for our industry-leading, tech-enabled debt resolution services business, and over $16Bn in personal and home loans originations.

Senior Analytics Engineer (SQL/dbt/Snowflake/Python) · Remote · Argentina

Opening: 1037
Ubicación: Argentina, preferentemente Córdoba o Buenos Aires

Industria: Fintech / Servicios Financieros

Conocé Darwoft

En Darwoft desarrollamos productos digitales y soluciones tecnológicas que generan impacto real. Somos una compañía de tecnología con presencia en Latinoamérica, que trabaja junto a empresas innovadoras para construir soluciones escalables y centradas en las personas.

Nuestra cultura combina colaboración, aprendizaje continuo, autonomía y desafíos tecnológicos que impulsan el crecimiento profesional.

Sobre la oportunidad

Estamos sumando Senior Analytics Engineers para participar en un proyecto de gran escala dentro de la industria fintech, enfocado en evolucionar una plataforma moderna de datos.

El desafío será diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar productos de datos confiables, escalables y reutilizables, transformando información compleja en soluciones que generen valor para el negocio.

Buscamos perfiles con sólida experiencia en SQL, dbt y arquitecturas analíticas cloud, capaces de aplicar buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software, garantizar la calidad de los datos y participar activamente en decisiones técnicas.

Además, tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en la evolución de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial, automatización y Generative BI (GenBI), habilitando nuevas formas de explorar y consumir información.

¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos?

  • Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener modelos analíticos escalables utilizando SQL y dbt.
  • Construir productos de datos reutilizables, confiables y orientados a las necesidades del negocio.
  • Implementar buenas prácticas de modelado dimensional, transformaciones y organización por capas.
  • Optimizar consultas, procesamiento y almacenamiento, considerando performance y costos.
  • Aplicar prácticas de DataOps, versionado con Git, code reviews y pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Implementar testing automatizado, controles de calidad, monitoreo y observabilidad de datos.
  • Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y evolución de plataformas analíticas cloud.
  • Desarrollar automatizaciones e integraciones utilizando Python.
  • Colaborar en la construcción de modelos semánticos y productos de datos preparados para soluciones de IA y GenBI.
  • Trabajar junto a equipos de Data Engineering, Data Science, Plataforma y áreas de negocio.
  • Actuar como referente técnico, promoviendo buenas prácticas y acompañando a otros integrantes del equipo.

¿Qué conocimientos y experiencia buscamos?

  • Experiencia sólida como Analytics Engineer Senior o en posiciones similares de ingeniería de datos analíticos.
  • SQL avanzado/experto: consultas complejas, CTEs, funciones analíticas, optimización y modelado dimensional.
  • dbt avanzado: desarrollo de modelos, materializaciones incrementales, macros, tests, sources, documentación y dependencias.
  • Experiencia con Snowflake u otros Cloud Data Warehouses, incluyendo optimización de consultas, almacenamiento y costos.
  • Conocimientos de Git y CI/CD, incluyendo estrategias de branching, code reviews y despliegues.
  • Experiencia implementando controles de Data Quality, testing automatizado, monitoreo y trazabilidad.
  • Python intermedio para automatización, procesamiento de datos e integración con APIs.
  • Conocimientos de AWS y herramientas de orquestación como Apache Airflow.
  • Comprensión de arquitecturas modernas de datos: Data Warehouse, Data Lake y soluciones híbridas.
  • Autonomía para resolver problemas técnicos complejos, tomar decisiones de diseño y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios.

Conocimientos que suman

  • Arquitecturas Data Mesh, Lakehouse y Apache Iceberg.
  • Semantic Layer y definición de métricas de negocio.
  • Experiencia o conocimientos en Generative BI, agentes de IA y consultas en lenguaje natural.
  • Integración de modelos de Machine Learning y sus resultados en productos analíticos.
  • Herramientas de visualización como Power BI, Tableau o QuickSight.
  • Experiencia con plataformas self-service y frameworks de DataOps.
  • Conocimientos de FinOps aplicados a infraestructura analítica.

¿Qué valoramos de tu perfil?

Buscamos personas con autonomía, pensamiento crítico y fuerte orientación al negocio, capaces de transformar necesidades complejas en soluciones de datos sostenibles.

Valoramos especialmente la capacidad de asumir ownership técnico, colaborar con distintos equipos, impulsar mejoras continuas y compartir conocimientos para elevar los estándares de ingeniería.

locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
El Institute for War & Peace Reporting (IWPR) es una organización independiente sin fines de lucro que trabaja para empoderar a las voces locales en primera línea, promoviendo cambios positivos en contextos de conflicto, crisis o transición en todo el mundo. Desde hace más de 30 años, IWPR fomenta el acceso a información confiable y el debate público para contribuir a la construcción de sociedades más estables, justas e inclusivas.

El Institute for War and Peace Reporting (IWPR) busca contratar un/a consultor/a especializado/a en monetización de plataformas digitales, con énfasis en YouTube, para brindar asesoría a medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina. La consultoría se centrará en fortalecer las capacidades de estos medios para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que les permitan generar y aumentar sus ingresos en dichas plataformas, de acuerdo con su contexto, sus recursos y sus prioridades editoriales.

El/la consultor/a prestará apoyo de asesoramiento continuo y personalizado a los medios de comunicación participantes para evaluar el potencial de monetización de sus canales digitales actuales, identificar oportunidades para generar y diversificar ingresos, y recomendar mejoras en las estrategias de contenido, la frecuencia de publicación y otras prácticas que puedan potenciar la monetización. A partir de estas evaluaciones, el consultor colaborará con cada medio para desarrollar y poner en práctica un plan de monetización a medida, destinado a aumentar los ingresos y reforzar la sostenibilidad financiera.

Asimismo, el/la consultor/a analizará el desempeño de los contenidos y ofrecerá recomendaciones prácticas para mejorar el alcance, la fidelización de la audiencia, la participación y el potencial de ingresos. Esta labor incluirá la definición de objetivos y el seguimiento de indicadores, el análisis de las métricas disponibles y el apoyo a la implementación de ajustes que contribuyan a la sostenibilidad financiera de cada medio.

La asesoría deberá considerar las políticas de monetización, los derechos de autor y las restricciones geográficas o de acceso a pagos que puedan afectar a los medios participantes. Las recomendaciones deberán adaptarse a estas condiciones y a las capacidades de cada equipo, respetando en todo momento su independencia editorial y cumpliendo estrictamente con los protocolos de seguridad establecidos por IWPR.

El/la consultor/a deberá mantener una coordinación permanente con IWPR durante toda la consultoría, documentar los avances y demostrar flexibilidad para trabajar de forma remota con equipos que pueden enfrentar limitaciones de conectividad o desenvolverse en contextos complejos.

Alcance de la consultoría:

  • Brindar asesoría remota y personalizada en monetización de plataformas digitales, con énfasis en YouTube, a equipos de medios independientes que operan en entornos restrictivos de América Latina.
  • Acompañar el diagnóstico, diseño e implementación de un plan de monetización adaptado al estado de los canales, el contexto, los recursos y las necesidades de cada medio.
  • Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para gestionar sus canales, optimizar sus contenidos e identificar y aprovechar opciones de monetización que contribuyan a su sostenibilidad económica.
  • Orientar la definición de objetivos, metas de ingresos, indicadores y herramientas de seguimiento que permitan evaluar los resultados y ajustar las estrategias de contenido y monetización.
  • Aplicar una metodología práctica y orientada a resultados, basada en el acompañamiento continuo, recomendaciones que los equipos puedan implementar con sus recursos y la documentación de avances y productos.
  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de los protocolos de seguridad y los requisitos de reporte establecidos por IWPR, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes y considerando las políticas y restricciones aplicables a la monetización en cada plataforma.

Funciones:

  • Realizar un diagnóstico de los canales (particularmente Youtube) y las capacidades de cada medio, identificar oportunidades y obstáculos para la monetización y acordar un plan de trabajo con objetivos, cronograma e indicadores de seguimiento.
  • Asesorar sobre los requisitos de elegibilidad, las políticas y las opciones de monetización disponibles, considerando los derechos de autor y las restricciones geográficas o de acceso a pagos que puedan afectar a cada medio.
  • Acompañar la implementación de las iniciativas de monetización y analizar las métricas de alcance, retención, tiempo de visualización e ingresos disponibles para identificar mejoras y orientar ajustes.
  • Fortalecer las capacidades de los equipos para interpretar sus resultados y tomar decisiones que contribuyan a generar ingresos de manera sostenida, de acuerdo con sus recursos y prioridades editoriales.
  • Coordinar con IWPR, documentar avances y aplicar los protocolos de seguridad del proyecto, respetando la independencia editorial de los medios participantes.

Entregables:

Minutas de las reuniones con los medios, informes escritos sobre los avances logrados por cada equipo, las actividades planificadas y, cuando corresponda, recomendaciones estratégicas, utilizando la plantilla proporcionada por IWPR.

Requisitos mínimos:

  • Licenciatura en Periodismo, Comunicación, Marketing Digital, Administración de Empresas o áreas afines, o acreditación de al menos tres años de experiencia comprobada en monetización de plataformas digitales.
  • Experiencia mínima de tres años en el diseño e implementación de estrategias de monetización de plataformas digitales, especialmente YouTube, con resultados demostrables en la generación o el crecimiento de ingresos.
  • Conocimiento de las herramientas, los requisitos de elegibilidad y las políticas de monetización de YouTube, incluidos aspectos relacionados con derechos de autor, restricciones geográficas y acceso a pagos.
  • Experiencia en el análisis de métricas de desempeño e ingresos y en la optimización de canales y contenidos para mejorar el alcance, la retención de audiencias y los resultados de monetización.
  • Experiencia en la asesoría a equipos y en el diseño y la facilitación de talleres o mentorías, con capacidad para formular recomendaciones adaptadas a sus recursos.
  • Disponibilidad horaria flexible para coordinar reuniones, mentorías y talleres de forma remota con equipos en diferentes zonas horarias.
  • Dominio pleno de español e inglés.
  • Sensibilidad cultural y capacidad demostrada para adaptar el acompañamiento a diversos contextos y necesidades.
  • Ética profesional.
Salary: $40 to $80 per hour

The Role:

We’re looking for a Business Analyst in Mexico to support the ongoing operation, maintenance, and enhancement of a US-based client’s commerce platform. The role combines backlog management, functional analysis, technical investigation, production monitoring, and hands-on production support to ensure platform stability and business continuity throughout the client’s peak sales season. Key Responsibilities:

Backlog Management & Issue Analysis

  • Review and analyze backlog items to determine whether previously reported issues are still occurring or have already been resolved
  • Investigate existing issues by reviewing reported scenarios, system behavior, and available production information
  • Create and document bugs when issues are confirmed, including detailed steps to reproduce, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, and QA teams to clarify requirements, assess issue priority, and support backlog refinement

Functional Analysis & Documentation

  • Perform functional investigations and document system behavior, business rules, and existing functionality
