  • Research undocumented or unclear functionality to help Product Owners and development teams understand system behavior
  • Provide detailed analysis to support enhancements, bug fixes, and ongoing platform improvements

Production Monitoring & Operational Metrics

  • Monitor production dashboards to track platform health, operational indicators, and reported issues
  • Review dashboard metrics and identify anomalies, data inconsistencies, and potential production problems
  • Investigate issues identified through operational monitoring and coordinate the appropriate corrective actions
  • Maintain visibility into critical platform operations, particularly during peak sales periods

Production Support & Issue Resolution

  • Investigate and support the resolution of production issues reported through operational dashboards and business teams
  • Perform data corrections and operational fixes involving customer accounts, orders, and other platform records

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA Engineers, and Operations teams to investigate and resolve functional and production issues
  • Provide technical and functional context to development teams through clear documentation and reproducible scenarios
  • Support QA activities by validating reported issues and confirming expected system behavior
  • Communicate investigation findings, operational risks, and resolution status to relevant stakeholders

Peak Season Support

  • During the peak sales season, the role places increased emphasis on production monitoring, incident investigation, operational data corrections, and rapid issue resolution
  • Help maintain business continuity by monitoring production indicators, investigating customer-impacting issues, and performing operational corrections across the platform to minimize disruptions to users

  • 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Production Support Analyst, or similar role on enterprise e-commerce platforms
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Commerce (Hybris), including Backoffice and HAC (Hybris Administration Console)

  • Strong ability to write clear bug reports, including steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and supporting evidence
  • Experience documenting functional behavior, business rules, and findings in Confluence
  • Experience managing and refining backlogs in Jira
  • Experience monitoring production dashboards and operational reports to identify anomalies and data inconsistencies
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA, and business stakeholders
  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • Experience troubleshooting system integrations and data transmission issues
  • Familiarity with FlexibleSearch, SQL, or other data query tools

jobs.excerpt: *Open to remote US and Canada The role As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll partner with 15 to 20 of our largest customers.
jobs.description:
*Open to remote US and Canada

The role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll partner with 15 to 20 of our largest customers. You’ll learn how their field operations really run and where TrueContext can make them better, then help them get there. You’ll be their strategic advisor and their most knowledgeable guide to the platform. Inside TrueContext, you’ll be their strongest voice.

Why this work matters

When a hospital's imaging system goes down, patients wait for answers. When a substation fails, a neighborhood loses power. When an inspection is missed in a building’s fire system, people are at risk. A skilled field engineer stands behind each of those moments. Their work keeps hospitals, cities and energy systems running, and most of it goes unseen.

TrueContext is the Field Intelligence platform built for those engineers. Leading companies in medical technology, utilities, energy and building systems use us to guide their teams through complex work and capture what happens at every asset. That knowledge then turns into better decisions. Each visit makes the next one faster, safer and smarter.

We’re early in a big shift. Customers have known us as the tool that digitized their forms, and we’re becoming the platform that makes field work intelligent. Our Customer Success team guides customers through that change, and it’s a chance to help define a category while it’s still taking shape.

What you’ll do

  • Understand the business behind the work. Learn each customer’s field workflows, assets and goals well enough to see opportunities they haven’t spotted yet.
  • Drive adoption that changes outcomes. Bring the right capabilities into the right workflows and expand to new teams and sites. Help customers move from capturing data to acting on it.
  • Build customer self-sufficiency. Turn admins and builders into confident power users who can carry the platform forward and keep it running when people change roles.
  • Make the impact visible. Agree on success with each customer using metrics they already track, such as first-time fix rate, compliance or time to invoice. Measure progress and share it with their leadership in regular business reviews.
  • Make every conversation useful. Bring something to each one: a fix, an idea, an insight from their own data.
  • Find what’s next. Spot the next workflow, team or site where we can help, and work with your Account Manager to turn it into growth.
  • Build relationships across the organization, from engineers in the field to the operations leaders setting priorities.
  • Be the customer’s voice inside TrueContext. Bring what you learn back to Product and Engineering and help shape what we build next.
  • Solve problems hands-on. Know the product well enough to configure it and fix issues yourself. Bring in Support, Solutions or Product when the problem calls for it.
  • Partner with your Account Manager. You build the value story all year and they lead the commercial conversation. Together you share one account plan and catch risk early.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Mentor other CSMs, shape our playbooks, and help build how Customer Success works as we grow.

What success looks like

Your customers use more of the platform, in more parts of their business, and can point to results in their own numbers. They see you as part of their team. Renewals and growth follow from that work. You’ll be assessed on the customer value you deliver, measured through feature adoption, product utilization, and gross and net revenue retention.

Why you’ll love it here

You’ll join a company of about 100 people at a turning point, where your work is visible and your input changes what we build. You’ll work with customers whose work matters, on a platform that’s adding AI and intelligence to some of the most demanding jobs in the field.

What you bring

  • 4 - 6+ years in customer success or account management at a B2B software company, including ownership of enterprise accounts and their renewals.
  • A track record of results your customers could measure, and of strong relationships with the executives who decide.
  • Comfort with technology. You learn a configurable platform quickly and solve problems hands-on.
  • Experience with a CRM such as Salesforce.
  • Clear writing and speaking, for field teams and executives alike.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience in software for field service, inspection, safety and compliance, utilities, energy or industrial operations.
  • ChurnZero, Gainsight or Gong.

Location

Remote US or Canada, with a preference of working Eastern or Central time zone hours

Some extra benefits

  • Company-wide & team social events
  • Yearly wellness allowance
  • Great time off benefits (3 weeks of vacation + 2 True2ME days + 1 TrueCrewCares day)
  • ½ day FriYAYs (from Victoria Day until Labour Day)

Ready to make an impact? Apply today.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Data Product Delivery Manager to prioritize the data analysis and business intelligence product backlog supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This SME-level position will work with Government mission owners, users, and technical teams to translate operational needs into clear product requirements, backlog priorities, and measurable acceptance criteria. The manager will coordinate requirements for data ingestion, governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting. The Data Product Delivery Manager will connect mission priorities with technical delivery, helping teams understand the intended value, dependencies, and acceptance expectations for each data product. The role will collaborate with data engineers, database personnel, governance specialists, BI developers, testers, and program leadership throughout planning, development, validation, and release.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Data Product Delivery Manager will:

  • Maintain and prioritize the data analysis and BI product backlog in coordination with Government stakeholders.
  • Gather and clarify user needs, operational challenges, reporting requirements, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate mission needs into product features, user stories, business rules, and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Refine backlog items so delivery teams understand scope, dependencies, data needs, and completion expectations.
  • Coordinate priorities for data ingestion, data governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting.
  • Recommend sequencing based on mission value, urgency, technical readiness, dependencies, and available capacity.
  • Facilitate backlog refinement, planning discussions, product demonstrations, and stakeholder reviews.
  • Coordinate with governance personnel on ownership, definitions, authoritative sources, access decisions, and approved uses.
  • Work with data engineers and database teams to clarify ingestion, transformation, integration, and warehouse requirements.
  • Work with BI teams to define reporting behavior, calculations, filters, visualizations, and self-service capabilities.
  • Maintain traceability among user needs, backlog items, acceptance criteria, test results, and delivered functionality.
  • Support acceptance testing by clarifying expected outcomes, resolving requirements questions, and documenting stakeholder feedback.
  • Track dependencies, impediments, risks, scope changes, and decisions affecting product delivery.
  • Coordinate release readiness and communicate delivered capabilities, limitations, and outstanding issues.
  • Collect user feedback and assess whether delivered products meet mission needs.
  • Maintain product documentation, decision records, backlog status, and delivery briefings.

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field.

  • Ability to clarify user needs and define measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to coordinate requirements for data ingestion, governance, warehouse capabilities, dashboards, and self-service reporting.

  • Experience managing enterprise data, analytics, or BI product backlogs.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience developing user stories, business rules, requirements traceability, and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, data warehouses, metadata, data quality, and governance practices.
  • Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, demonstrations, and product releases.
  • Familiarity with Agile backlog and delivery-management tools.
  • Strong stakeholder facilitation, analytical problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

About Figure

We’reFigure (Nasdaq: FIGR), and we’re building the future of capital markets with blockchain and AI. We make lending faster and cheaper for everyone by automating the origination process and using blockchain as the source of truth for loan ownership and connection to our capital marketplace.

It’s all one ecosystem that spans three lines of business:

  • Lending: HELOCs, cash-out refinance, DSCR loans, and crypto-backed loans for homeowners, investors, and small businesses. Through Kiavi, a Figure company, we also finance real estate investors with bridge, fix-and-flip, rental, and new construction loans.
  • Markets: On Figure Markets, people can lend and earn with Prime and $YLDS, an SEC-registered, interest-bearing security that settles like cash. OPEN is our blockchain infrastructure for issuing, distributing, and trading equities.
  • Partnerships: Banks, credit unions, fintechs, home improvement companies, and other lenders and brokers originate loans on our platform. DART records loan ownership on blockchain, and Figure Connect connects originators with institutional loan buyers.

See all of our products on figure.com.

Here’s where we are today:

  • $35B+ in equity unlocked for homeowners on Figure’s platform
  • 382K+ households served
  • 800+ B2B partners, including banks, credit unions, and fintechs
  • AAA-rated HELOC securitizations from S&P, KBRA, and Moody’s
  • $23B+ funded for real estate investors through Kiavi since 2013
  • Recognized by CNBC (World’s Top Fintech Companies 2026), Fortune (Crypto 100, 2026), and Inc. (2026 Inc. 5000)

If you want to help build the next era of lending, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals to join our growing team! As Senior Product Manager, Integrations and New Verticals, you’ll own the third-party integrations that power Figure’s mortgage and lending products and drive the product roadmap for a set of emerging HELOC growth channels. Integrations run through every step of our HELOC funnel and loan origination system (LOS): property and public record data, collateral valuation, credit, income and identity verification, document generation and eSign, notarization, and recording. Each one shapes how quickly a borrower gets an offer, how confidently we underwrite, and how smoothly a loan officer or partner gets a loan to funding. You’ll own the full lifecycle of these integrations, from improving the vendors we have and onboarding new ones to holding vendors accountable to the quality and SLAs our borrowers and partners depend on. You’ll build the monitoring that makes integration health visible across the company and use funnel, conversion, and quality data to decide where the next investment goes. This is a hands-on role: you write the requirements, run the vendor calls, and stay close to the details. You’ll also own the core product roadmap for new HELOC growth channels like SMB brokers, select fintech partnerships, and home improvement and solar contractors, early, high-upside channels where the product and partner workflow are still being defined.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for all third-party integrations across Figure’s mortgage and lending products, including data integrations, integrations that feed credit and underwriting workflows, and the vendor services behind each stage of the HELOC funnel (property data, valuation, credit, income and identity verification, document generation, notarization, recording, and debt payoff)
  • Drive a prioritized roadmap of improvements to existing vendor integrations, measured by funnel conversion, borrower and loan officer engagement, underwriting quality, and LOS usability
  • Evaluate, select, and onboard new vendors that improve HELOC and LOS functionality or unlock new capabilities, from due diligence through contracting, build, QA, and launch, with Engineering, Credit, Compliance, Legal, and Operations
  • Navigate the trade-offs that make or break an integration, including data quality and coverage, latency, cost, security, compliance, redundancy, and cross-team dependencies
  • Build and maintain dashboards that monitor integration health and vendor performance against contracted quality and SLA commitments, surface issues early, and drive resolution
  • Hold vendors accountable when they breach SLAs or fall short of borrower and partner needs, and own escalations, remediation plans, and renewal and replacement decisions with Legal and Finance
  • Own the core product roadmap for emerging HELOC verticals and GTM channels (SMB brokers, select fintech partnerships, and home improvement and solar contractors), defining the partner workflow, product experience, and integration surface each needs to scale
  • Synthesize feedback from borrowers, loan officers, partners, Operations, and Support into clear priorities: what problem to solve, for whom, and why it matters
  • Drive feature development end to end: write requirements, partner with Engineering, GTM, Design, and other cross-functional stakeholders, launch, analyze results, and iterate

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience as a Product Manager
  • Fintech, lending, or mortgage experience (preferred)
  • Experience shipping and owning third-party integrations, such as vendor APIs, data providers, embedded partner services, or platform integrations
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data contracts, and failure modes, enough to hold peer-level conversations with Engineering and vendor technical teams
  • Track record of managing vendor relationships with commercial rigor: evaluating options, negotiating scope and SLAs, measuring performance, and making renewal or replacement calls
  • Experience defining monitoring, KPIs, and SLA frameworks for operational systems, and using that data to drive prioritization and accountability
  • Active use of AI tools in your own work, with a point of view on how automation, insights, and agents should show up in integration and verification workflows
  • Proven ability to operate with speed and ownership in fast-moving environments, driving clarity and execution without heavy process
  • Energized by external-facing work with vendors and channel partners
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking, with comfort evaluating trade-offs across cost, quality, speed, and compliance
  • Highly collaborative and low-ego, working seamlessly with Engineering, Design, Data, Credit, Compliance, Operations, GTM, and executive stakeholders to turn ideas into an end product
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and excitement about defining the product and partner model for new channels at the intersection of mortgage lending and fintech
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $154,000 - $190,000/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

jobs.excerpt: About us NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend.
jobs.description:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

About the Role

NinjaOne provides a unified IT management platform that simplifies IT operations, endpoint management, and security. We are looking for a Staff Network Architect, Cloud and Datacenter to own the enterprise network architecture across our Austin datacenter, AWS, and our production and corporate environments. You will design, build, and run the enterprise network behind our Austin datacenter and AWS environments, which support our QA, Development, and Sales teams, and set the network standards that other teams build on.

You will combine architectural vision with hands-on engineering: designing secure, scalable, highly available networks across datacenter and AWS, connecting them through hybrid and WAN architectures, and automating how they are deployed and operated. You will work closely with Datacenter Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure as Code and Build and Release, Security, QA, Development, and Sales. Expect roughly half your time on the Austin datacenter and half on cloud and platform work across the organization.

Must-have: hands-on AWS network architecture experience, including hybrid connectivity between AWS and a physical datacenter.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OH, OR, TN, TX, VA, and WA. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option. Candidates in the Austin area are preferred.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS. Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Architecture and design: Own the network architecture for the Austin datacenter, AWS, and our production and corporate environments: design diagrams, IP addressing and CIDR/IPAM standards, routing designs, and design standards, and lead architecture reviews and vendor evaluations.
  • Design and scale core network boundaries by establishing robust CIDR allocation strategies, IPAM (IP Address Management) frameworks, and non-overlapping subnets across all corporate domains.
  • Cloud network design lead: As we move to infrastructure as code, serve as lead network designer for our cloud environments. Build and maintain a complete map of the network, from VPCs and front ends to subnets and CIDR blocks.
  • VPN replacement: Define the strategy for replacing our VPN, covering both the Austin datacenter and all users accessing AWS, and run the project end to end.
  • AWS networking: Design VPCs, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, and multi-account topologies; build hybrid connectivity with Direct Connect, site-to-site VPN, and BGP; secure it with Network Firewall, PrivateLink, and Route 53 Resolver.
  • Datacenter networking: Design, deploy, and troubleshoot leaf-spine, VXLAN/EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VRF, and MLAG environments, and take part in cabinet builds, cabling validation, and network cutovers.
  • Hybrid cloud: Build WAN and routing fabrics that connect on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud, with predictable failover paths.
  • Security and resilience: Implement segmentation, firewall policy, and least-privilege connectivity with Security; support IPv4/IPv6, incident response, root-cause analysis, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Automation and IaC: Automate provisioning, validation, and drift detection using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and CloudFormation, and fit network changes into version control and CI/CD.
  • Monitoring and reliability: Improve telemetry, alerting, and runbooks; lead troubleshooting of complex issues across datacenter, firewall, and cloud networking.
  • Leadership and influence: Act as the senior technical authority for networking, mentor engineers, work with vendors, carriers, and cloud providers, and communicate risks and decisions to leadership. Drive projects forward across SRE, Platform Engineering, and engineering teams, influencing and aligning teams beyond your own to adopt network standards and make changes.
  • Other duties as needed

About You

  • 15+ years in network engineering, datacenter networking, cloud networking, or infrastructure architecture.
  • Proven record of owning a network architecture end to end and leading major network transformations, from design through delivery.
  • Demonstrated hands-on AWS network architecture: VPC, Transit Gateway, VPC peering, security groups and NACLs, Direct Connect, site-to-site VPN, and hybrid connectivity to physical datacenters.
  • Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, Layer 2/3, VLANs, VRFs, BGP, OSPF, LACP, and high-availability design, with hands-on enterprise switching and routing experience.
  • Practical experience with segmentation, firewall integration, routing policy, and IP address management.
  • Network automation and infrastructure-as-code experience with Python, Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across datacenter, AWS, firewalls, and hybrid connectivity, and the ability to write clear architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
  • Ability to influence and align engineering teams you do not manage, and to communicate risks and decisions to senior leadership and vendors.
  • Able to travel to the Austin datacenter as needed, with occasional after-hours maintenance or incident response.
  • Engineer strategic solutions (including advanced NAT/PAT and VRF segmentation) to resolve overlapping CIDR block challenges during multi-tenant cloud integrations.
  • Architect highly scalable, hierarchically structured CIDR blocks to maximize address efficiency and minimize routing table sizes via route summarization.
  • Architect and implement high-availability hybrid paths connecting enterprise datacenters (e.g., Element Critical) to major cloud providers like AWS and Azure.
  • Design robust WAN transit architectures leveraging AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, SD-WAN, and managed MPLS networks.

Nice to haves

  • AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty and/or Solutions Architect – Professional.
  • AWS Cloud WAN, Network Firewall, PrivateLink, and multi-account shared services design.
  • Experience leading a VPN or remote-access replacement.
  • Juniper, Cisco, or Arista platforms; Juniper Mist; VXLAN/EVPN fabrics; IPv6 design.
  • Familiarity with virtualization networking, enterprise storage, and bare-metal infrastructure; network telemetry and observability tools.

What You’ll Love 

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community. 
We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.
We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.
We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.
We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.
We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
  • You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
  • Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
  • Running observability for a production platform at scale
  • Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 - $227,249. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Shopify Developer (Independent Contractor)
jobs.excerpt: Love Wellness is looking for an independent Shopify developer to partner with our ecomm team.
jobs.description:
Love Wellness is looking for an independent Shopify developer to partner with our ecomm team. You'll know our ecommerce stack inside out, build and launch what we ship on lovewellness.com, and lead QA and fixes. You'll work closely with our Senior Director of Ecommerce and the ecomm team.

We're a small, collaborative team, and you'll be our technical partner: when an idea comes up, you help shape how it gets built, not just build it.

In a typical month you might build a new landing page for a product launch, set up a promo that swaps offers across the site on a schedule, chase down why a subscription option isn't showing in the cart, and help us figure out whether a new idea is a quick win or a bigger build.

Scope of work:

1. Know our ecomm stack and help keep it healthy

  • Learn how our Shopify store, subscription and cart apps, email and SMS tools, testing tools, tracking and consent setup fit together
  • Spot when a change in one tool affects another, and flag app updates or conflicts before they reach customers
  • Help run a regular integration and tracking audit
  • Document how things work so knowledge is shared across the team

2. Build and launch

  • Build new sections, templates, product pages, collection pages and landing pages from Figma designs
  • Build promo experiences: sale themes, buy boxes, countdowns, and scheduled banner and offer swaps
  • Build cart and subscription features, like subscribe-and-save options and upsell and post-purchase modules
  • Make sections flexible and reusable so the team can move quickly together
  • Run launches end to end: preview, scheduled go-live, rollback plan, post-launch checks

3. Lead QA and fixes

  • Test every release across devices and browsers, subscription and one-time purchases, discounts and gifts, tracking and page speed
  • Build and maintain a QA checklist for our releases
  • Triage and fix site bugs, including ones our CX team hears about from customers, and fix the root cause, not just the symptom

4. Lead technical discovery

  • When the team has a new idea, scope how to build it, what it touches and how long it'll take
  • Dig into tricky issues, like apps conflicting or tags firing when they shouldn't, and come back with options and a recommendation
  • Bring your own ideas for improving site speed, UX and conversion

5. Keep tracking, consent and site health in good shape

  • Keep analytics and pixel events accurate as the site changes
  • Make sure tags respect customers' consent choices
  • Keep an eye on Core Web Vitals and accessibility

6. Keep our workflow clean

  • Manage the theme in GitHub, use preview themes for every change, and keep the changelog up to date for every release, so the team always knows what changed, when and why

What you bring:

  • 5+ years building Shopify themes in Liquid, JavaScript and CSS, including Online Store 2.0 sections, blocks and schema
  • Experience as the main developer for a DTC brand, owning work from scoping through launch
  • Hands-on work with Shopify subscriptions (selling plans and subscription apps) and the Cart AJAX API
  • Experience with cart, upsell and post-purchase apps
  • Working knowledge of tracking and consent: server-side tracking, GA4/GTM, and consent management platforms
  • A QA habit: you test your own work before anyone else sees it, and you write down what you tested
  • Shopify CLI and GitHub workflow; you never edit a live theme directly
  • Comfort with metafields and metaobjects, Shopify Flow, and app-embed troubleshooting
  • An understanding of ecommerce metrics like conversion rate, AOV and subscription retention, and how your work moves them
  • Curiosity about how systems connect: you like finding out why something broke, not just patching it
  • A collaborative style: you bring a point of view, flag risk early, and say when something will slip

Nice to have:

  • Email and SMS onsite forms and scripts
  • A/B testing tools
  • Shopify Functions or Checkout Extensibility
  • Cloudflare DNS
  • Core Web Vitals and accessibility work
  • Experience with health, beauty or wellness brands

Why work with us:

  • Real ownership of a site customers use every day, and a say in what we build and how
  • A small, collaborative team where people trust each other to make decisions
  • An ongoing engagement, not a one-off project
  • Fully remote, on your own schedule and your own setup

Engagement details:

  • Independent contract, estimated at 15–20 hours a week on average, with more hours around big launches like Black Friday, agreed in advance
  • Remote, with at least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern time

jobs.excerpt: THE ROLE We are seeking skilled, English-speaking Freelance AV Quality Control Technicians for upcoming projects with one of the world’s largest streaming platforms.
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

We are seeking skilled, English-speaking Freelance AV Quality Control Technicians for upcoming projects with one of the world’s largest streaming platforms. Operating at the level of a Master AV QC Technician, you will ensure promotional marketing creative – including trailers, teasers, TV spots, and social cutdowns (each up to ~3 minutes in duration), as well as finishing/localization-source files – meets strict client delivery specs and studio quality standards.

You’ll

  1. Execute multi-pass watch-downs (including frame-by-frame reviews in 4K) and discrete 5.1 and stereo listen-downs of AV assets and finishing files.

  2. Review and refine automated compliance reports.

  3. Inspect After Effects graphic collects and associated finishing files.

  4. Log and document all technical and creative issues clearly for the finishing team. Your focus is strictly on identification and reporting – you will not be responsible for fixing the files.

  5. This is a project-based freelance opportunity with a variable workload depending on release schedules and volume.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Native speaker of English.

  • Based in Australia (ideally East Coast) or the US / Canadian West Coast.

  • 3+ years of professional AV QC Technician experience.

  • A sharp eye for video-specific defects to the pixel level (e.g. dead pixels, camera or lens aberrations, watermarks and other finishing errors, etc.)

  • Proven experience performing frame-by-frame picture inspection at native resolution.

  • Strong judgment to separate real, verifiable defects from false positives.

  • Strong grasp of video and audio standards, including codecs, color space, frame rates, channel configuration, loudness (LKFS), true peak (dBTP), and AV sync verification.

  • Hands-on experience conducting discrete 5.1 surround listen-downs and channel mapping verification.

  • Demonstrated working experience in Premiere Pro and After Effects, including scopes and loudness metering in Premiere, and opening and inspecting collected After Effects projects (comps, fonts, plug-ins, linked media).

  • Availability evenings (US time zones) and mornings (Australian time zones) – especially Friday evening (US) / Saturday morning (Australia).

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Fast, modern PC with strong internet download speed with low latency.

  • An in-room discrete 5.1 speaker system (no headphones, virtual surround or soundbars) and a native color and pixel accurate 4K display, 55 inches minimum, with consumer image processing turned off.

  • All QC is performed on a remote server, which you access through the NICE DCV client. On the server, you’ll work in the following, provided tools:

  • QScan for automated ingest and report review

  • Premiere Pro for watch-downs, scopes, and loudness

  • After Effects for Graphic Collect review

TURNAROUND TIMES

Most projects (90%+) run on standard turnaround. A defined set of priority assets is due within 4 hours of receipt, and the remaining assets within 12 hours. Rush projects require every asset to be QC’d within 3 hours of receipt.

Work will often be sent to you around 3 pm Mountain Time, but where possible we will give you a heads up in advance, so you know it’s coming.

RATES

We pay a flat rate that varies depending on the asset type. These flat rates average out to between $44 per hour across a full title. We’ll share a detailed breakdown with you.

PAYMENTS

We settle invoices through Wise or by bank transfer at the end of the month following the month of the invoice.

WORK AT WORDBANK

Join a team that collaborates with incredible clients on global creative production that ignites your ambition, fuels your creativity, and pushes your drive to new heights. You’ll show up as your true self, work with great people, and put your smarts to work.

OUR IMPACT

Built for marketing and creative localization at scale, we help global streaming brands reach and inspire users wherever they are in the world. We partner with our clients to deliver locally impactful creative that drives seamless UX and meaningful engagement. It’s our frame of mind that sets us apart – rooted in operational excellence, elevated by human creativity, and guided by triple bottom line standards of people, planet and profit.

OUR PEOPLE

As a certified B Corp and Investors in People Gold employer (top 16%), we're as serious about our people and planet as we are about performance. Human creativity drives everything we do, so we do everything we can to empower our people. Wordbankers live, work, and play globally, bringing their perspectives to help drive meaningful outcomes, contribute measurable value, and create the difference.

​

THE WORDBANK WAY

  • Self-motivated: Talent-dense teams that drive remarkable results

  • Freedom & responsibility: Empowered decision-making and ownership

  • Candid feedback: Open, timely feedback with positive intent accelerates growth

  • Global-first mindset: Global operations across 118 countries that produce creativity at scale

  • Agile & adaptive: Confidence to embrace change, iterate quickly, and pivot with purpose

  • Data-driven excellence: Informed decision-making that drives continuous optimization

  • Out-of-the-box mindset: Curiosity, innovation and optimization

  • CX-focused: Customer experience that’s functional, easy, and enjoyable

  • Clear communication: Precise, simple, direct, and easy to understand

  • Intelligent failure: Risk-taking, learning from mistakes, and openness about failure

Wordbank is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. We welcome all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, age, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
About Reproductive Freedom for All (Formerly NARAL Pro-Choice America)

For more than 55 years, Reproductive Freedom for All and its chapters have fought to protect and expand reproductive freedom —including access to abortion and contraception — for everybody. We are powered by our more than 4 million members from every state and congressional district in the country, representing the 8 in 10 Americans who believe every person should have the freedom to make the best decision for themselves about if, when, and how to raise a family.

Reproductive Freedom for All centers diversity, equity, inclusion, and justice in our organization and our work. Continuously learning from our history, we hold ourselves accountable to achieve reproductive freedom with equitable access for everybody. As the oldest and largest national membership organization primarily focused on advocating for abortion access, we organize and mobilize, galvanizing millions of people to take action to defend reproductive freedom, and shining a spotlight of accountability on bad actors who work to impose their ideological agenda on others. We also work to elect champions for reproductive freedom and advance state and federal legislation to safeguard it. For more information on Reproductive Freedom for All, please visit our website.

Job Details

Compensation: $19.61/hour
Start Date: January 25, 2027
End Date: April 23, 2027
Location: This position will be fully remote
Hours: Part-time; Between 20-30 hours per week, with flexible hours as needed

In this internship, you will:

  • Provide general administrative support to the Political Department, as needed;
  • Analyze state and federal laws and policies related to reproductive freedom;
  • Research elected officials' and candidates' records on reproductive freedom;
  • Other research projects as assigned;
  • Research and coordinate resources on candidates for elected office and key electoral races in the 2028 cycle;
  • Create campaign and race updates on candidates before staff and leadership attend campaign events;
  • Research and report regularly on polling and FEC fundraising data;
  • Create and maintain internal tracking documents to inform political strategy efforts;
  • Aid drafting endorsement rollout materials and assist in updating Reproductive Freedom for All’s endorsement and PAC websites;
  • Gain insight into the day-to-day operations of Reproductive Freedom for All’s political arm, including our endorsement process, PAC (Political Action Committee).

In this internship, you will learn:

  • Political and Policy Skills Development: Electoral strategy, political analysis, collaboration across the progressive movement, knowledge of political processes, preparing briefings/memos for key stakeholders, and policy analysis;
  • Communication Skills Development: Speaking, writing, interpersonal, teamwork, leadership, and listening;
  • General Professional Skills and/or Knowledge: Develop and strengthen skills in research, analysis, time management, teamwork, prioritizing work assignments, initiative, adaptability, and project completion

We're looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about advancing reproductive freedom;
  • Has a demonstrated commitment to contributing to a workplace environment in which diversity is valued and supported;
  • Demonstrates an alignment with our organization’s values;
  • Has strong writing and research skills;
  • Can summarize information in a concise manner;
  • Has prior knowledge/experience in political campaigns and/or issue advocacy, including past engagement in a volunteer capacity;
  • Is able to be flexible and adapt to changing priorities;
  • Can manage several ongoing projects at a time and appropriately prioritize tasks
  • Has a detail-oriented work style;
  • Can be entrusted with handling confidential information;
  • Is enthusiastic about electing pro-reproductive freedom candidates up and down the ballot in 2028;
  • Preference of junior or senior level undergraduate, graduate education in progress, or recent graduate.
Reproductive Freedom for All does not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, socioeconomic status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or political affiliation.
Candidates with backgrounds, identities, and experiences that are historically underrepresented in reproductive freedom non-profits are encouraged to apply.

Reproductive Freedom for All does not permit staff to work from a country outside of the United States.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are Prowess Consulting is a consulting firm that specializes in helping the largest enterprises in the technology industry define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Prowess Consulting is a consulting firm that specializes in helping the largest enterprises in the technology industry define, manage, benchmark, and market their solutions and services. We take great pride in investing the time and effort to gain a deep understanding of our clients’ technologies, their customers, and the stories and strategies they need to tell to be successful in the market. Our team of technology and marketing experts is immersed in the technology trends that affect our clients’ businesses, so we can add value at every stage of engagement to help them succeed.

Who you are
We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically adept SharePoint Communications Specialist who has strong experience with SharePoint Online, M365 tools, Power Automate, and communications within large organizations to manage, publish to, and improve our clients’ internal communications and marketing sites and channels. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, the ability to learn quickly, and proficiency with Microsoft tools. The ideal candidate will handle daily publishing and support requests quickly and accurately, keep sites accessible and well organized, and help find smarter, more automated ways of working.

To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

This is a full-time role that can be worked remotely, however, collaboration with teammates centered in the Pacific time zone will be essential. No third-party agencies, please.

Key responsibilities

  • Monitor a shared support inbox daily; resolve access requests, process publishing requests from content owners, and troubleshoot or escalate technical issues.
  • Publish content to SharePoint communication sites and related channels (Teams, Viva Engage, Outlook, and employee advocacy tools), including content uploads, new sites and pages, and web part updates.
  • Manage site settings, layout, navigation, and permissions, including security and distribution groups in Entra ID and Microsoft 365 groups; run periodic access audits.
  • Maintain and build Power Automate flows that support publishing, intake, and site operations.
  • Produce weekly and monthly site analytics reports using SharePoint tools, run ad-hoc reports, and recommend actions to improve content visibility and engagement.
  • Make sure sites meet accessibility standards using tools such as Accessibility Insights for Web and respond to accessibility issues.
  • Provide light editorial and formatting support, and advise content owners on layout, formatting, and graphics.
  • Prioritize work by business urgency and meet defined service levels, including same-day turnaround for standard requests and publishing urgent executive announcements within minutes of receiving content.
  • File, track, and escalate bugs, performance, security, and compliance issues with the right support teams through to resolution.
  • Maintain site maps, process documentation, and user guides, and provide informal training on SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Power Automate.
  • Support strategic initiatives such as Copilot and SharePoint agents, improved findability and search, and pilots that use AI and automation to streamline communications workflows.

Required qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on SharePoint Online experience, including building and managing sites, pages, web parts, lists, libraries, and permissions.
  • Experience publishing and managing content across Microsoft 365 communication channels, such as Teams, Viva Engage, and Outlook.
  • Working knowledge of Power Automate, including maintaining and troubleshooting flows.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint usage analytics and reporting.
  • Understanding of web accessibility standards and how to apply them to site content.
  • Ability to learn new tools and processes quickly and apply them effectively.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Able to work independently, manage your own task list, and handle time-sensitive requests calmly.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly and concisely communicate with clients via email, Teams chat, and video calls.

Nice to have

  • AI experience, such as writing and refining reusable prompts, building Copilot or SharePoint agents, and automating manual, prompt-based processes.
  • Experience managing identity and access groups in Entra ID or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting internal communications or marketing teams in a large enterprise.
  • Microsoft certifications (for example, MS-900 or PL-900).
  • Experience at a consulting or professional services firm.
Additional Details
  • The offered pay range for this position is $80,000 – 100,000 per year, depending on experience.
Prowess Consulting is an equal-opportunity employer, and diversity is a core value for us. We are a Minority/Women-owned Business Enterprise (WMBE) in Washington, and we committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Prowess Consulting, we are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable working and learning environment for all employees. We provide a well-rounded benefits package including health insurance, flexible spending account, life and disability insurance, paid time off, and retirement plan investing. jobs.description:
Our Commercial Lines team is currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst in our Worcester, MA location. Position is eligible for Hybrid/Flex work arrangement or remote location. This is a full-time, exempt role.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Incumbents serving in the Business Analysis job family are responsible for the collection, development, analysis, documentation, and communication of business needs and requirements. Throughout an assignment, Business Analysts may act like a liaison while they interface and work collaboratively with technology and business organizations. Business Analysts usually assess the needs of the assignment by directly interacting with management, leadership, technology, the business and the customer. Business Analysts are also expected to use their working understanding of information systems, business operations, and processes to analyze requirements, develop specifications, story-boarding and prototyping to facilitate the design of integrated solutions. Their knowledge of business analysis, business processes and project methodologies is applied to all of their assignments. Incumbents in this job family must have a solid understanding of their business partners existing business processes, the key drivers and measures of success for the business, and the short and long-term direction of the business and technology. They assess the needs of a business partner through direct interaction, and look for opportunities to develop and grow the business through effective use of technology. They take a broad perspective to determine how solutions will impact existing work processes and systems, and how to manage the integration. Incumbents must be innovative in identifying, proposing and executing solutions, negotiating requirements across multiple partners or departments, and must have an understanding of project scope management and prototyping. Business Analysts should have a high-level understanding of the overall IT architecture in order to understand the issues and implications of proposed system and hardware solutions.

SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST PROJECT COMPLEXITY:

  • Performs work across multiple initiatives and processes. • Supports and/or leads highly complex business/technical processes or multiple products, requiring design or integration of technical solutions across multiple departments or lines of business. • Serves primarily as a subject matter expert and may lead projects of large scope and moderate to high complexity. • Works independently and leverages resources when needed. Has an understanding of and an ability to apply knowledge of multiple technical business systems.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

  • Providing technical expertise across business functions, understanding the relationship between the business and the data and technology that support the business or product. • Responsible for managing the collection, analysis, documentation and coordination of multiple business and/or technical requirements which may include, but is not limited to: • Facilitating planning sessions with multiple business partners to improve business processes or products Involves using and improving information systems. • Establishing relationships with one or more business partners by demonstrating expert knowledge of business processes/drivers and technical systems, being proactive, and managing the development and implementation of innovative solutions. • Providing technical coaching and mentoring to less experienced team members. • Proactively researches and applies Best Practices to technology solutions for areas of expertise. • Acts as a resource to less experienced personnel in the application and execution of Best Practices. • Recommending improvements to Best Practices procedures. • Working with business partners to define needs to align with business priorities and assess impact on other business processes. • Leading requirements gathering sessions to identify and articulate needs/requirements i.e. JAD sessions, story-boarding. • Advising business partners on options, technical limitations, risks and cost vs. benefits and ensuring a structured requirements process for the business is adhered to. • Leading the development, of structured requirements gathering through various techniques i.e. JAD and storyboarding for the design and implementation of solutions. • Overseeing the documentation of requirements. • Participating in the development of prototypes. • May be accountable for a portion of a project plan in collaboration with project managers, from requirements phases through design, testing, implementation and maintenance. • Acts as a resource to less experienced personnel in developing and executing test/use cases. • Defining when to employ automation and determining impact. • Identifies, recommends and may approve improvements when appropriate. • Participates, facilitates and leads project meetings/sessions. • May act as a resource in the design, development, and execution of complex reports and/or report requirements. • Identifies and recommends improvements when appropriate. • May analyze and provide production support for more complex or escalated issues. • Partners with technology development to provide a solution. • Seeks guidance from more experienced resources when needed. • May provide support through the warranty period.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

TYPICAL EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Typically requires seven to ten years of relevant technical and business work experience. • Requires /in-depth knowledge of business operations, requirements processing, business modeling concepts, information systems and project life-cycle knowledge, and business process development. • Knowledge of Industry Business Analysis Best Practices preferred. • Bachelor’s degree in related field specialized training, certification or equivalent work experience.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES:

  • Analytical Thinking: Applies analytical techniques, e.g., separating a complex whole into its parts or elements to resolve problems or issues. • Communication for Results: Expresses technical and business concepts, ideas, feelings, opinions, and conclusions, so that others understand or are persuaded to act. Creates an environment that encourages and values the opinions of others and promotes sharing of information and ideas. • Conceptual Thinking: Synthesizes facts, trends, inferences, and key issues and/or themes in complex situations Recognizes patterns and relationships between apparently unrelated entities or situations consulting: Uses professional or technical expertise to advise, intervene, and/or influence a customer or internal partner over whom there is no direct authority. • Information Seeking: Thoroughly investigates and researches multiple sources to expose details and complete information about resources, issues, and problems and so forth Involves in-depth research, asking probing questions and transcending surface issues. • Innovation: Motivated to improve organizational performance through the introduction of new ideas, methods, processes, products, services, and so forth develops new ways of looking at a situation. • Mentoring/Developing Others: Shares knowledge, skills or expertise with others; coaches others. Encourages and rewards learning, growth, etc., in others. Creates an environment where employee ownership of self-development is encouraged supports continual development of staff through assignments, coaching, and training. • Relationship Building: Understands the importance of developing and maintaining cooperative relationships with others at all levels of the organization by making others feel their concerns and contributions are important builds positive relationships with others to accomplish organizational goals. • Self-Management: Effectively plans and organizes their work to achieve desired outcomes Demonstrates flexibility in applying different approaches to changing work demands is confident of own abilities to meet challenges and can maintain performance under stress seeks improvement through learning, development and feedback. Business Function Knowledge: An understanding of business functions and the corresponding strategies, benefits, risks, and costs that impact the business. Example business functions include: IT, marketing, sales, finance, HR, and engineering. Business • Operations Analysis: Analyzes the business impact of markets, trends, issues, technologies, economies, and competition applies that analysis to business issues and challenges. • Business Requirements Analysis: Thorough familiarity and understanding of the intricacies of a customer's business, e.g. function, processes, and operations. Understands and can delineate technical design requirements for supporting information systems. Business Data Requirements Knowledge: Analyzes data requirements based on knowledge of client data needs, and defines the critical data components to be incorporated into information delivery vehicles. • Information Systems Knowledge: Maintains and applies specific knowledge of information systems elements (hardware, software, and network) and their application to business functions/processes.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential function of this job. The Company

Would you like to create the future of a product used by thousands of businesses and millions of consumers? Phorest Salon Software powers almost 10,000 hair and beauty salons in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Australia, Finland, USA, Canada, UAE and Netherlands, and the platform processes 7 million appointments a month for hair and beauty consumers. Phorest is the number 1 salon software brand for premium independent salons in those markets, and our next goal is to become a platform upon which other companies can build applications for premium salons.

Our system touches every point of the salon experience, from the in-salon appointment calendar and CRM with a fully integrated marketing suite, to staff apps and payments. More recently we have expanded this to include EMR (electronic medical records) for MedSpa clinics.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a new Software Engineer (Backend) to join our Consultations Team. You will join a multidisciplinary group of technology, product, and design folks in building the future of the hair, beauty, and MedSpa industry. This team looks after the client and patient journey from enquiry, consultation, documentation, and care management. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants a new challenge, where you will grow your skills in a supportive, growth-mindset environment that will help us achieve our goals.

You will contribute to a high-scale, distributed system, working with event-driven architecture and modern cloud technologies like Docker and Serverless. Your work will impact millions of users globally. You will solve well-defined problems with the guidance of senior engineers and take on more complexity as you grow, in an environment where we continuously improve and learn. We work with feature flags and continuous delivery to get our work to production as fast as possible.

The type of person we want

  • Someone who owns their work end to end: accountable for code quality, delivery and operational health, and sees features through development, deployment, monitoring and iteration.

  • Someone who works with our product designers and owners to turn user stories into shippable features, and contributes to breaking stories down into tasks.

  • Quality and high standards really matter to us. You will apply good coding techniques including maintainability, reuse, clean code and unit testing, with excellent attention to detail.

  • Someone who weighs trade-offs in design and performance, and escalates early when requirements or approach are unclear.

  • Never stops learning: curious, acts on feedback, picks up new tools and practices, and takes a pragmatic approach to solution design.

  • Someone who is open to code reviews and pairing, and who supports teammates in return.

  • Someone who takes initiative and is not afraid to ask questions, share ideas and voice an opinion.

  • Someone who understands how technical decisions affect the user experience and business outcomes.

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a similar related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn and grow

  • Strong proficiency and at least 4 years of professional experience building production software with an object-oriented or JVM language, primarily Java or Kotlin

  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs and event-driven services, and an understanding of designing distributed services

  • Proficiency with or willingness to learn TypeScript/JavaScript, specifically for implementing GraphQL APIs and schema design

  • Experience with GraphQL would be beneficial but not mandatory

  • Experience with modern software engineering practices such as Git, continuous delivery, CI/CD pipelines, TDD, and observability tooling

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and query optimisation, and familiarity with NoSQL databases

  • Experience working in a scrum environment

  • Great communication: cross-team collaboration is key in our organisation, so we are looking for people who understand others' ideas and explain theirs clearly

What success looks like

  • First 3 months: ramp up on the product, work on bugs and small tasks, and pair with and learn from senior team members through code review.

  • 6 months: contribute to breaking stories into tasks, own stories end to end, and be proficient in the product.

  • 12 months: full proficiency in the product, meaningful input into project planning, and ownership of features, potentially delivered end to end.

Benefits

🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days.

Want to learn more about Phorest? Check out for our blog and Insights on building an evergreen company from the team here at Phorest.

Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest!

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.
