jobs.title: Sr. Application Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Your role in our mission We are seeking a Sr.  Application Security Engineer to join our security team.
jobs.description:
Your role in our mission

We are seeking a Sr. Application Security Engineer to join our security team. In this role, you will be a critical partner to engineering, product, and SRE teams, helping to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will drive security by design, shape our product security standards, and ensure vulnerabilities are identified, tracked, and resolved efficiently.

This is a hands-on technical role. You’ll lead secure architecture and design reviews, code reviews, and penetration testing, and you’ll be a core part of how Prosper builds and uses AI securely. That covers threat modeling agentic systems, red teaming AI applications, building AI defenses, and assessing AI risk across internal tools and vendors.

The expected working hours for this role are based in Pacific Time.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Partner with engineering and product teams to define and implement security requirements for applications, APIs, microservices, and AI systems (AI platform foundations, AI agents, MCP/tool integrations) during design and architecture reviews.

  • Conduct in-house penetration testing, secure code reviews, and threat modeling for high-impact features, including AI-specific threat models covering models, retrieval, tools, identity, and data flows.

  • Plan and execute AI red teaming: prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, data exfiltration through tools, excessive agency, and output abuse.

  • Design and implement AI defenses such as guardrails, input/output filtering, gateway controls, least-privilege tool scopes, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, logging, and kill switches.

  • Lead application vulnerability management, including triaging and driving the remediation of security findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, and penetration tests.

  • Consult and advise cross-functional teams (engineering, SRE, product) on secure coding practices, security architecture, and remediation strategies.

  • Establish and maintain application security and secure AI development standards, guidelines, and best practices, aligned with OWASP, NIST, ISO, and industry frameworks.

  • Stay up-to-date on emerging security threats, especially the fast-moving AI attack landscape, to continuously improve Prosper’s security posture.

Skills that will help you thrive

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, with 8+ years of relevant experience (or Master’s degree with 6+ years).

  • Strong hands-on experience in application security, secure coding, and penetration testing.

  • Development background with expertise in Java/Python, SQL, JavaScript, including scripting against model APIs to build test harnesses and automation

  • Experience working with modern web application frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, .NET, J2EE, Rails, REST, SOAP).

  • In-depth understanding of web and API security vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, CWE).

  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization protocols (e.g., OAuth2, OIDC, SAML).

  • Knowledge of application security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST) and methodologies.

  • Proven experience working with DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines, integrating security tools and automation.

  • Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and regulatory frameworks (e.g., PCI DSS, GDPR, SOC 2).

Extra credit

  • Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Security experience in Agile, CI/CD, and fast-paced product development environments.

  • Industry certifications such as OSCP, CSSLP, GWAPT, CEH, GPEN, CISSP.

  • Familiarity with mobile application security testing and API security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Postman, ZAP, Insomnia).

  • Knowledge of network security, infrastructure security, and microservices architecture.

  • Experience driving secure SDLC initiatives and developer security education.

Resources to help you prosper

  • A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported.
  • Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security.
  • Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage.
  • Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace.

Interview process

  • Recruiter Call: A brief screening to discuss your experience and initial questions.
  • Department Interview: Deeper dive into technical skills and project alignment with the Hiring Manager or team member.
  • Technical Interview: Deeper dive into coding skills.
  • Team Interview: Meet team members for collaborative discussions, problem-solving, or technical exercises.

The ideal candidate is passionate about learning the Fintech domain and delivering cutting-edge, high-quality solutions to solve business problems. We utilize a progressive, test-driven, Agile development methodology that places a high premium on communication, teamwork, sound design and clean implementation.

About Us

Prosper introduced U.S. consumers to an innovative approach to personal finance as the first peer-to-peer lending platform in the country. Since 2005, Prosper has helped over 2 million customers achieve financial well-being through a comprehensive suite of digital personal finance products.

Come join us on this exciting journey!
Stoneridge Software is seeking a Solution Architect who will play a strategic role in guiding clients through the successful implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE and the Power Platform. The Solution Architect will shape the overall application architecture, drive key design decisions, and ensure project solutions are rooted in scalable, enterprise‑grade standards. Acting as a project lead, they will oversee complex CE and Power Platform engagements, translating business needs into robust, well‑aligned systems that support organizational goals and integrate seamlessly within the broader enterprise landscape.

A Day in the Life

  • Owns end-to-end accountability for CE/Power Platform solution architecture and delivery, balancing business requirements, technical integrity, and delivery execution across the project lifecycle.
  • Assists the functional resources/business analysts with requirements gathering and provides design guidance for mid- to large-sized Dynamics 365 (CE) and Power Platform projects. Facilitates discussions with business and technical stakeholders to extract critical business requirements and present functional vision and solutions in software products, customizations, and integrations to meet those needs within Dynamics 365 (CE).
  • Deep knowledge of the Power Platform and Dynamics 365 CE (Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights – Journeys and Project Operations). Strong understanding of when to use native features and when it is appropriate to use custom development. Ability to successfully communicate this information to both internal and client teams.
  • Works with our implementation delivery team to develop a solution blueprint that includes an estimate, scope, assumptions, epics and features, implementation plan, technology solution, architecture diagrams, ERD, and business process diagram options to meet project goals and longer-term needs.
  • Provides leadership to the project team throughout the implementation to ensure accurate delivery of project plans.
  • Maintains knowledge of third-party software vendors to leverage complementary offerings and effectively compare and contrast solutions.
  • Provides current best practices and solution alternatives as part of functional or technical design documents.
  • Communicates complex topics regarding solutions and related projects to audiences both with and without deep technical skills.
  • Ability to be client-facing including effectively communicating with the client, leading meetings, and capturing and distributing action items.
  • Assists with upgrades of on-premises CRM environments.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Description Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery.
jobs.description:
Description

Exodigo is the leading underground mapping solution for non-intrusive discovery. Our platforms combine multi-sensor fusion, 3D imaging, and AI technologies to create complete, accurate underground maps that enable confident decision-making for customers across the built world. We transform the project lifecycle for our customers, who include key community stakeholders in the utilities, transportation and government sectors.

We are experiencing sky-rocketing growth and closed a historically large $96M Series B round in July of 2025.

Job description

Exodigo engineers the underground without digging. Our platform combines multi-sensor fusion and AI to produce complete, accurate 3D maps of buried utilities, foundations, and geotechnical conditions, which utilities, transportation agencies, and engineering firms use to plan, design, and build with confidence. Behind every map is a team of civil engineers, BIM modelers, and mapping specialists who turn raw subsurface data into engineering-grade deliverables.

We are looking for an AI BIM Engineer to help that team move faster, stay consistent, and scale with our growth. You will work alongside our Mapping, Delivery, and Engineering Services teams, learn how a project moves from field scan through interpretation to Civil 3D and OpenRoads models and client-ready utility maps, and find where AI can take on the repetitive work so our engineers can focus on engineering judgment.

This is a hands-on, builder role. You will scope the problem, build the solution, ship it into live projects, and stay with it until it becomes part of how the team works. You will be the bridge between engineers who know the underground deeply and the AI agents that can amplify them: you can discuss utility quality levels, model QA/QC, and client CAD standards in the morning, and write a new integration for an AI agent in the afternoon. What you learn on our projects will shape the AI capabilities we give every team.

What You'll Do

Embed with engineering teams

  • Work side by side with highway, structures, water, and site development teams to understand their design processes, tools, standards, and pain points.
  • Lead discovery sessions with engineers and project leads, and translate what you hear into clearly scoped, prioritized opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Own delivery end to end: from first conversation and rapid prototype through to a stable tool in daily production use.
  • Coach engineers on using AI effectively and safely in their work, through hands-on sessions, office hours, and one-on-one support.

Turn expertise into repeatable workflows

  • Partner with senior engineers to capture their know-how (checking procedures, design criteria, QA/QC steps, naming and modeling standards) as reusable AI workflows, prompts, and playbooks.
  • Design workflows that are repeatable and reviewable: clear inputs, clear outputs, and an engineer in the loop wherever professional judgment or sign-off is required.
  • Build evaluation sets from real project data so we can measure whether a workflow is accurate and reliable before it scales.
  • Document what you build and help teams own and extend their workflows themselves.

Extend what our AI agents can do

  • Design and build integrations that let AI agents read, query, and act on civil engineering data: BIM models, alignments, surfaces, pipe networks, drawings, specifications, and project records.
  • Develop tools and connectors on top of platforms such as Autodesk Civil 3D, Revit, and Autodesk Platform Services / ACC, Bentley OpenRoads and iTwin, and open formats such as IFC and LandXML.
  • Build automations with Dynamo, pyRevit, Python, and C#/.NET where a deterministic script is the right answer and expose them as capabilities an AI agent can call.
  • Make sound trade-offs between speed, scope, and quality, and keep everything you ship secure, version-controlled, and maintainable.

Close the loop

  • Spot patterns across teams and turn one-off solutions into shared, reusable capabilities.
  • Feed field insights back to our digital, IT, and data teams to shape platform priorities and roadmap.
  • Contribute to our AI governance, data-handling, and BIM standards so adoption stays responsible as it grows.

Requirements

  • Degree in Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years combining software development with BIM, CAD, or digital delivery work, ideally on infrastructure or civil projects.
  • Strong coding skills in Python, plus experience with C#/.NET or TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience automating BIM workflows using tools such as Dynamo, pyRevit, the Civil 3D or Revit APIs, or Autodesk Platform Services.
  • Practical experience building with large language models: prompt and workflow design, tool or function calling, retrieval over documents, and evaluating model output.
  • A working understanding of civil design deliverables: alignments and profiles, corridors, grading, drainage and utility networks, sheet production, and model coordination.
  • Comfort working directly with end users: you listen first, explain clearly to non-technical audiences, and build trust by shipping.
  • Ownership and a bias for action. You are happy working in ambiguity, scoping your own work, and seeing it through to adoption.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building agent integrations, for example using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool frameworks.
  • Familiarity with openBIM and infrastructure data standards such as IFC 4.3, LandXML, and ISO 19650.
  • Experience with Bentley OpenRoads, OpenFlows, or iTwin; Navisworks; or GIS platforms such as ArcGIS.
  • Experience with document AI on drawings, specifications, and reports, including PDF and OCR pipelines.
  • Background as a practicing civil engineer or BIM coordinator before moving into software.
  • Experience delivering training or leading change-management programs in an engineering organization.

Learn more

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Embedded with several project teams and built a clear map of where AI can save the most time and reduce the most risk.
  • Shipped AI workflows that engineers use every week, with measurable time savings and quality improvements.
  • Added new civil-specific capabilities to our AI agents, so they can work directly with the models and data our teams produce.
  • Built a library of documented, evaluated workflows that other teams can pick up and adapt.
  • Become the go-to person engineers call when they think, "There has to be a better way to do this."

Why Join Us

  • Real impact: your work goes straight into the maps that help infrastructure owners avoid utility strikes, delays, and safety risks on major projects.
  • An AI-native company: AI already sits at the core of how we read the subsurface. You will extend it to how we engineer and deliver.
  • A rare mix of disciplines: geophysics, civil engineering, BIM, and modern AI in one role, with a global team spanning the US, Israel, and beyond.
  • Room to shape, from the ground up, how a fast-growing company scales its engineering delivery with AI.
  • Close collaboration with field, mapping, and engineering experts who care about getting the underground right.

Our mission is to power the next era of underground exploration – saving time, money, lives, and the planet. We are focused, intentional, confident, and hard working. We solve big problems, but we are approachable, open-minded, and love hard questions.

You can learn more about us on our website or check out this short video.

jobs.title: Non-Human Identity and Cloud IAM – Platform Lead
jobs.excerpt: This position is part of AbbVie's Information Security & Risk Management (ISRM) team within Business Technology Solutions.
jobs.description:
This position is part of AbbVie's Information Security & Risk Management (ISRM) team within Business Technology Solutions. The Identity & Access Management (IAM) team is responsible for the development, implementation, and oversight of the organization's IAM strategy, ensuring secure, efficient, and compliant access to systems and data. The NHI and Cloud IAM function addresses one of the fastest-growing attack surfaces in enterprise security—machine identities now outnumber human ones, and the rapid expansion of AI agents is accelerating that trend. This role does not own the AI agent or cloud platforms themselves—those are owned by partner teams across BTS—but it is the IAM team's authoritative voice on how those platforms must integrate with identity governance, and it is accountable for ensuring that no non-human identity operates outside of AbbVie's visibility or control.

Take the next step in your career with an organization that strategically invests in the long-term health of the company, its technology and its people. The AbbVie Business Technology Solutions (BTS) team shapes the digital transformation necessary for our treatments to positively impact patients' lives. In the role of Non-Human Identity and Cloud IAM – Platform Lead, you'll tackle one of the most complex and rapidly evolving challenges in enterprise security: establishing a unified strategy for non-human identities, AI agent governance, and cloud IAM—bridging today's fragmented landscape into a coherent, observable, and future-ready program. This is a senior, highly technical role that requires both architectural depth and the organizational influence to drive accountability across the teams that own AI, agentic, and cloud platforms—ensuring that every non-human identity is visible, governed, and secured from AbbVie's IAM systems.

In this role, you'll be responsible for:

  • Define and drive the enterprise Non-Human Identity (NHI) strategy—rapidly assessing all in-flight initiatives across the organization, rationalizing overlapping efforts, and establishing a centralized, authoritative governance program covering all machine identities across on-premises, cloud, and agentic environments
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive NHI registry encompassing service accounts, APIs, bots, application identities, robotic process automation (RPA), and AI agents—ensuring every non-human identity is discovered, inventoried, classified, and continuously governed within IAM systems
  • Own AbbVie's identity governance posture for AI agents: while the creation and operation of AI agent platforms is owned by other teams, this role is accountable for ensuring those platforms integrate with IAM—so that every AI agent is inventoried in the NHI registry, mapped to its owning human or system identity, governed through appropriate access controls, and visible for security monitoring
  • Proactively discover and identify new AI agents and agentic workloads as they are introduced across the enterprise; partner with AI platform, cloud, and business teams to ensure timely onboarding into the NHI governance framework, and drive remediations or mappings where gaps exist
  • Serve as the IAM point of accountability for all agent-related identity questions: defining standards for how agents authenticate, what credentials they use, how those credentials are secured, and how agent activity is observable from an identity and access perspective
  • Establish centralized NHI observability by driving integration between IAM platforms and external systems—including AWS, Azure, GCP, and agentic platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, AWS Bedrock, or similar)—so that IAM maintains a living, authoritative view of all non-human identities regardless of where they originate
  • Design and implement modern NHI credential security controls including just-in-time (JIT) access, dynamic secrets, short-lived certificates, automated credential rotation, and runtime authentication—reducing standing privilege for machine identities to near zero where possible
  • Assess the current tooling landscape for NHI and cloud IAM; determine whether existing platforms can be extended or reconfigured, or whether new capabilities are needed; and build a pragmatic, phased modernization roadmap
  • Own and evolve the Cloud IAM and IGA strategy, closing the integration gap between cloud-native identity platforms (AWS IAM, Azure Entra ID, GCP IAM) and AbbVie's central IAM/IGA tools—ensuring cloud identities, entitlements, and access certifications are governed consistently and automatically
  • Design cloud identity governance frameworks including role-based access models, entitlement management, access certifications, and least-privilege enforcement across cloud environments
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across IAM, AI Platform, Cloud, Security Architecture, Compliance, Audit, and business teams—translating complex, fast-moving requirements into executable roadmap priorities and holding partner teams accountable for IAM integration commitments
  • Establish KPIs and maturity metrics for the NHI and Cloud IAM program, providing executive-level visibility into inventory completeness, risk posture, program progress, and open gaps
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI-DSS) for machine identities and cloud access controls; respond to and remediate audit findings
  • Manage budget, resources, and vendor relationships for all NHI and Cloud IAM technologies and solutions
  • Lead and mentor a team of technical specialists, cultivating a culture of proactive governance, automation, and continuous improvement
  • Bachelor's degree with 8 years experience OR 7 years of experience OR PhD with 3 years experience
  • Hands-on experience with non-human identity management, cloud IAM, or machine identity governance in large enterprise environments
  • Demonstrated experience establishing or maturing NHI programs—including service accounts, API credentials, application identities, and/or automated/agentic workloads
  • Strong hands-on expertise with cloud IAM frameworks: AWS IAM, Azure Entra ID, and/or GCP IAM, including integration with central IGA platforms
  • Experience designing and implementing cloud IGA processes: entitlement management, access certifications, role-based access models, and least-privilege enforcement in cloud environments
  • Proven experience with secrets management platforms and modern credential security patterns (JIT access, short-lived certificates, dynamic secrets, automated rotation)
  • Architecture-level understanding of identity federation, service-to-service authentication, and cloud-native identity patterns (OAuth, OIDC, SAML, workload identity)
  • Strong track record of driving complex, cross-functional programs in matrixed organizations—including influencing and holding accountable teams that are not direct reports
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively identify governance gaps, drive partner teams to remediate, and establish scalable, automated processes to prevent recurrence
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and build alignment across organizational boundaries

Beneficial:

  • Familiarity with AI agent platforms and their identity/credential patterns (e.g., Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, AWS Bedrock agents, or similar agentic frameworks)
  • Experience building NHI discovery and inventory capabilities, including integration with platforms not originally designed for identity governance
  • Familiarity with containerization and Kubernetes service account management
  • Hands-on experience with IGA platforms and their cloud connectors (Saviynt, SailPoint, or equivalent)
  • Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, Python, Terraform, or other IaC tools)
  • Knowledge of certificate management, PKI infrastructure, and API security platforms
  • Understanding of CIS, NIST, and other cloud security compliance frameworks
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS/Azure/GCP security certifications, or equivalent
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry

Tools and skills you will use in this role:

  • Cloud IAM platforms: AWS IAM, Azure Entra ID, GCP IAM — and their integration with enterprise IGA
  • Secrets management platforms: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or equivalent
  • IGA platforms with cloud connectors: Saviynt, SailPoint, or equivalent
  • NHI discovery, inventory, and governance tooling
  • Just-in-time access, dynamic secrets, and runtime authentication frameworks
  • Integration APIs and connectors for agentic platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, AWS Bedrock) — for identity inventory and observability, not platform ownership
  • Service-to-service authentication protocols: OAuth, OIDC, SAML, workload identity federation
  • Containerization and Kubernetes service account management
  • CI/CD pipeline integrations for identity and secrets (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Terraform)
  • Scripting and automation: PowerShell, Python, Infrastructure as Code
  • Certificate management and PKI
  • Audit and compliance reporting for cloud and NHI controls
  • Strong architectural thinking, cross-functional influence, and executive communication skills

jobs.excerpt: Powering the world’s payments ecosystem ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI.
jobs.description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem

ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.

Job Summary

The VP, Cloud Platform Engineering leads the infrastructure layer beneath ACI's application platform. This leader owns the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the paved roads, tooling, and guardrails that let application teams build, deploy, and run on Azure (primary), AWS (secondary), and ACI datacenters quickly, securely, and at a predictable cost. The role leads a global organization across the US and India, including the Cloud Infrastructure, Engineering & Operations and Cloud Architecture functions, and partners with Product, Security, Application Platform, Observability, and FinOps leadership to move ACI to a consistent, supported cloud foundation.

Job Responsibilities

  • Set the vision, multi-year roadmap, and operating model for Cloud Platform Engineering; define success metrics and report progress to executive leadership.

  • Own paved roads and Terraform modules: supported, opinionated ways to build and deploy infrastructure on Azure and AWS, delivered as versioned, reusable infrastructure as code.

  • Own Kubernetes as a service: one control tier across the datacenter and cloud, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, multi-tenancy, and supportability.

  • Own the infrastructure automation, provisioning, and deployment capabilities required to deliver Cloud Platform Engineering services, and partner with Application Platform on standardized application CI/CD patterns, developer tooling, and integration points.

  • Own landing zones and network as code: account and subscription setup and connectivity declared in files and provisioned automatically, with consistent segmentation and hybrid connectivity.

  • Own baseline identity, secrets, and guardrail patterns: access patterns, secrets handling, and policy as code, in partnership with Security and Compliance.

  • Own lifecycle, end-of-life, and resilience standards: rebuild rather than patch, standard images, pinned versions, tracked exceptions, and DR patterns.

  • Lead the Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) for cloud infrastructure standards, reference architectures, governance, and enablement, in partnership with Architecture, Security, Application Platform, and other technology teams.

  • Partner with the Director, Cloud FinOps on unit economics, tagging, and cost visibility, including AI token costs, and hold platform teams accountable to cost targets.

  • Own the infrastructure platform capabilities required to securely run and scale the AI Gateway, partnering with the accountable AI/Application Platform team and Cloud FinOps on service integration, governance, and token economics.

  • Drive adoption through lighthouse application teams, publish clear service catalogs and SLAs, and treat application teams as customers of the platform.

  • Support PCI, SOC, FFIEC, and other audit and regulatory evidence requests, and ensure platform controls are measurable and automated.

  • Manage platform reliability, capacity, and hyperscaler relationships, including technical input to commercial agreements and spend commitments.

  • Build, develop, and retain a high-performing, globally distributed leadership team; set clear goals, hold the team to them, and manage organizational budget and headcount.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

  • Understand and comply with Risk Management program requirements including identification of risks, key controls, and control testing as applicable to their responsibilities.

Scope Boundaries

  • The Application Platform and observability capabilities are owned by other teams. Cloud Platform Engineering owns the underlying cloud infrastructure platform, infrastructure automation, and cloud-foundation services. This role partners with Application Platform, Observability, Architecture, Security, and Product through clearly defined interfaces and shared standards, but does not own application-platform capabilities, application developer experience, or observability tooling.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 15+ years of information technology experience, including 8+ years leading engineering or infrastructure teams, with experience leading managers.

  • Deep, hands-on background in public cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS in large enterprise or regulated environments.

  • Proven delivery of infrastructure as code (Terraform), Kubernetes platforms, and CI/CD at scale.

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

  • Experience operating in 24/7 mission-critical production environments with strict availability and compliance requirements.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Experience building an internal developer platform or platform engineering organization with measured developer adoption.

  • Familiarity with FinOps practices, cloud cost governance, and AI or LLM cost management.

  • Payments, banking, or other regulated financial services background.

  • Experience with policy as code, secrets management, and landing zone frameworks, for example Azure Landing Zones or AWS Control Tower.

  • Experience with hybrid environments spanning datacenter and public cloud.

  • Master's degree or MBA; relevant cloud certifications.

  • Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.

Work Environment

  • Remote work within the United States; periodic travel to ACI offices, including Bangalore and Pune, India.

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

  • Up to 25% travel, which could be international.

  • Participates in executive escalation for major incidents in 24/7 mission-critical environments.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future.

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.

Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at Job ID (Requisition #20443)

ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.

Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

jobs.description:
Senior Support Solutions Consultant

Colombia, Remote · Full-Time

About Snowplow

Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning. Snowplow’s event tracking is leveraged across 2M+ websites and applications globally, processing over one trillion events per month.

More than 250 companies, including Experian, AutoTrader, Strava, Condé Nast, and HelloFresh, rely on Snowplow to build a well-governed, first-party data foundation that powers their customer-facing AI agents, in-session personalization and recommendations, and real-time analytics.

How we work
  • High agency. When you see a problem or an opportunity we’re missing, you act on it. Managers build alongside their teams.
  • Make it count. Every piece of work points at a goal that matters, with a number that shows whether it’s working.
  • Move fast. We work at the pace AI makes possible and improve as we go, except where customers trust us with their data, service, security and contracts. Those we get right the first time.
  • Challenge, and be open to challenge. Say what you think, with evidence, to the person who can act on it, and expect the same back.
This Opportunity

Snowplow’s customers run event pipelines inside their own AWS, GCP, and Azure accounts, and products like Snowplow Signals are pulling them into AI and personalization work, which only works as well as the behavioral data underneath it. More of them now need more than a fast answer to a ticket. They need someone who understands their setup and their data, spots problems before they become cases, and helps them get more out of what they’ve bought.

That’s the Support Solutions Consultant. It’s one of two specialist tracks we’re building inside Support, and this is one of its first senior seats. Everyone on the team keeps our 24x7 service running, so roughly 75-80% of your time is core support: first response against our SLAs, complex technical cases, and incident management. The other 20-25% is your focus, which is going above and beyond the normal scope of support to help customers achieve their end goals with the product and the behavioral data it creates.

You’ll be a calm, trusted technical voice for customers in the Americas during their working day, with real autonomy and a direct say in how we support them.

What you will own

Core support (roughly 75-80% of your time)

  • Complex technical escalations. Investigate and resolve the hardest cases: pipeline failures, failed events, enrichment and schema issues, loader and warehouse problems, and cloud infrastructure faults across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • The customer relationship during an incident. Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates when their data is at stake, and work with Engineering to restore service and recover data.
  • Root cause, not just resolution. Go past the immediate fix and turn what you learn into bug reports and enhancement requests Engineering can act on.
  • AI in your everyday toolkit. Use AI assistants and agents to investigate issues, analyze logs and data, and draft responses, while keeping your own judgment on accuracy and customer impact.

Consultative focus (roughly 20-25% of your time)

  • Support beyond the ticket. Give customers deeper, proactive time, not just a reply to the case in front of you. Learn their setup, their data, their goals, and what they’re building next.
  • Tracking and data design. Review customers’ tracking plans, schemas, and implementation, and help them design behavioral data that answers the questions they actually have.
  • Proactive data health checks. Run consult-and-activate check-ins on the quality of their behavioral data: failed events, schema drift, enrichment configuration, and gaps in what they track. Find real issues and real opportunities, not box-ticking reviews.
  • Getting more from their data. Understand what a customer is building, whether that’s AI agents, personalization, or real-time analytics, and show them how to get there with the data they already collect, from modeling it in the warehouse to new capabilities like Signals.
  • Knowing where the line sits. Work alongside Customer Success and the wider customer team. Recognize when an account needs more than light-touch help and hand it over cleanly.
  • Sharing what you know. Answer in our community channels, write knowledge base articles and runbooks on tracking and data quality that serve both people and the AI tools that draw on them, and mentor colleagues on consultative work.
We would love to hear from you if you have
  • A track record in technical support. Several years in technical support, support engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role, ideally for a B2B SaaS or data infrastructure product.
  • Consultative instincts. You’ve worked with customers beyond the ticket, in an education, solutions engineering, customer success, onboarding, or similar customer-facing role. You ask what the customer is trying to achieve before you answer what they asked.
  • Credibility with customers. You can run a call with a senior technical stakeholder, explain complex issues clearly and empathetically, and follow through on what you said you’d do.
  • Commercial awareness without the sales hat. You can tell when a customer’s needs go beyond support and bring in the right colleague.
  • Technical depth to back it up. Hands-on with AWS or GCP (Azure is a plus), strong troubleshooting instincts, and comfort reading JavaScript.
  • Data and tracking fluency. You understand how behavioral data gets created, from tracker implementation and schema design to enrichment and warehouse modeling. You write SQL against large datasets, and you can tell when the data isn’t telling the truth.
  • Real fluency with AI tools. You use LLMs and agent tools every day, and you know where they work well, where they get things wrong, and how to check the difference.
  • Calm under pressure. You can prioritize when several things are urgent, stay steady during incidents, and know when to escalate.
  • A share-by-default attitude. You document, demo, and teach.
  • Availability for our coverage window. Monday to Friday, approximately 8am–5pm Colombia time (UTC-5).
Bonus points for
  • Experience as a solutions engineer or consultant for a data or SaaS product
  • Experience with event tracking, tracking plans, or data modeling, such as analytics engineering
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or dbt
  • Experience building with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or MCP-style tool integrations
  • Spanish, which will help with some of our Latin American customers
Where this role can take you

The Support Solutions Consultant track grows toward wider customer-facing and solutions roles at Snowplow. Moving between our two tracks later stays open as an internal move.

We know some of you will read this and think you need to tick every box before applying. You don’t. We value diversity and hire for potential as much as for experience. If you think you can help solve our challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

•Generous PTO

jobs.description:
Lead Product Designer

Full-time · Remote-friendly (Amsterdam, Cape Town)

ABOUT CAPCADE

Capcade is building the collaboration infrastructure for private markets. Fund managers, investors, and the service providers around them run their most important work across scattered tools and email threads. That work covers fundraising, due diligence, investor onboarding, post-close reporting, and structured-product programmes. We replace all of it with one secure, structured environment where people, documents, data, and tasks live in the same place.

We run the operational side of private funds: the entities, documents, workflows and reporting that sit between a fund manager, their administrator and their investors. The people using Capcade aren’t there to enjoy software. They are there to close something, prove something or answer to someone. Design here is about making consequential work clear, fast and hard to get wrong.

Many of the best names in global finance already use the platform, including hundreds of the Fortune 500. We are a team of around 50 people across seven jurisdictions. That’s small enough that your work shows up the week you ship it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are turning investor (LP) reporting into a product of its own, and we’re building a set of fund management products around it. We want a lead designer to own that area.

You will lead design for LP reporting from start to finish. You will shape what the product is together with product management, not only how it looks. As new fund management products arrive, such as fundraising and investor onboarding, you will make sure they work as one experience rather than as separate tools.

You will report to our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with our product designer, who leads design on our other products.

This is a hands-on lead role. You will be in the work every day: prototyping, testing and shipping. You will also help shape how design works as the team grows.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own LP reporting design from start to finish. Run discovery, prototyping and testing with fund managers and investors, and stay involved through to what ships.
  • Connect the fund management products. Bring the same approach to fundraising, investor onboarding and the products that follow, so users experience them as one product.
  • Prototype in code. We build proposed changes as working prototypes behind feature flags rather than static mock-ups, and we test them with real users before they’re built. You’ll use AI tools like Claude Code daily to do this.
  • Run your own research. Plan and moderate usability sessions with internal users, clients and design partners. Write up what you find as evidence the team can act on.
  • Get design in early. Work alongside product and engineering from the start of scoping, and make the case for the user before the work is decided.
  • Write it down. Turn decisions into design-system patterns and specs so the next team doesn’t have to make them again.
  • Help build the team. Mentor designers, run critique sessions, and help shape how design works as we grow.

HOW WE WILL MEASURE SUCCESS

This is what good looks like in your first 90 days:

  • An LP reporting prototype tested with at least three fund managers.
  • The main user flows in your area mapped and walked through, with the friction in each one recorded.
  • Design involved in scoping LP reporting from the start.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 7+ years designing complex, data-heavy B2B products, ideally reporting, dashboards or analytics.
  • Experience owning a product’s design from start to finish, including shaping what gets built, not only the interface.
  • Comfort prototyping in code (for example React, Next.js or Tailwind), or a clear track record of picking up tools like these quickly.
  • Hands-on research experience: you’ve planned, run and synthesised your own usability testing.
  • Confidence holding a design position with product and engineering, backed by evidence.
  • Clear writing. You document your decisions as a matter of course.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in fund administration, private markets, fintech, or another regulated, document-heavy area. You can learn the domain here.
  • Design-system experience, such as tokens, component libraries or Storybook.
  • Experience mentoring or leading other designers.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A base salary benchmarked to your location and in line with the market for this level of seniority.
  • An annual equity grant that vests over four years. This is real ownership in a company still small enough for your work to move its value.
  • Ownership of a product area that is being built now, with a real say in what it becomes.
  • 25 days of paid holiday, remote-friendly working, and the latest modern tools.
  • Honest, regular feedback, and great colleagues who are good at their jobs.

The product is growing quickly, the AI landscape moves even faster, and our users expect a lot. You will need to enjoy working in that kind of environment.

We are not offering relocation or visa sponsorship, so you will need the existing right to work where you are based.

HOW TO APPLY

Send us your CV and a link to your portfolio. We especially want to see work on data-heavy products, reporting or dashboards, and any coded prototypes or experiments.

By submitting your application and CV, you consent to the processing of your personal data in accordance with the Law on Personal Data Protection (you can find our Recruiting Privacy Policy here).

jobs.description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role

The AI Enablement team gives every team at Extend the AI tooling it needs to do its best work. We pair directly with business users in finance, support, claims, sales, recruiting, and operations to understand how they work, then build the agents, connectors, and skills that change it. This is an engineering role first. Sitting beside a business user is how you find the right problem. Solving it takes real engineering judgment about agent harnesses, protocols, security, and reliability.

You will build on the platform that turns one-off prototypes into durable, secure, measurable tooling: MCP connectors to the systems we run on, agent-to-agent (A2A) integrations, a shared library of agent skills, and the evaluation practice that tells us whether any of it actually works.

What You'll Do

  • Pair with business users to run workflow analysis and process mapping, find the highest-leverage problems, and turn ambiguous requests into scoped technical plans.
  • Design and ship secure MCP connectors to Extend's internal systems and third-party SaaS: finance, CRM, data warehouse, expense management, product analytics, support, ATS, and the long tail beyond.
  • Build agent-to-agent integrations using A2A and similar protocols, so specialized agents can delegate to each other safely across domains.
  • Choose and configure the right agent harness or orchestrator for each job, and build multi-agent patterns (planner/executor, specialized sub-agents) where they genuinely help.
  • Stand up Extend's evaluation practice for agents and skills: golden datasets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge, tracing, and drift detection. Every shipped skill should have a way to prove it works and to notice when it stops working.
  • Build and curate the shared library of agent skills every team composes from. Codify patterns and raise the floor for what a safe, high-quality skill looks like. Treat every engagement as a source of reusable skills and connectors.
  • Design credential scoping and vending for agent connectors: per-user, per-skill, per-connector keys, OAuth/OIDC where it fits, least-privilege everywhere.
  • Build the risk-tier and review model for shared skills, including sandboxing and dependency scanning for skills that pull in untrusted packages. Partner with legal, security, and privacy on governance review for agents that touch sensitive data or take autonomous actions.
  • Instrument the platform end to end with OpenTelemetry so every MCP call, skill execution, and credential use is visible in Coralogix.
  • Own adoption. Write self-serve guides, onboard teams, and run the feedback loop between what shipped and what users actually need. The work is done when the team using it is self-sufficient.
  • Mentor more junior engineers on the team in evals, agent design, and secure integration work.

What We're Looking For

The Role: We are looking for an engineer who builds real solutions to real business problems. You will sit with teams across YA Group, learn how their work gets done, find where AI and automation can make it faster, more accurate or less manual, and then build those solutions yourself. This is an internal, hands-on role. You are not selling products or running demos for customers. You will design, build and ship working tools that our people use every day, using modern AI development tools such as Claude Code alongside solid engineering practice. Understand the business

Spend time with the business to map how work flows today, including the manual steps, handoffs and workarounds. Identify and size opportunities for AI and automation, and help prioritize them by business value and effort. Translate business needs into clear, practical solution designs that non-technical stakeholders can understand and approve.

Build and ship

Design, build, test and deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations and integrations. Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code and similar) to move fast, while owning the quality, security and maintainability of what ships. Run and improve

Measure outcomes such as hours saved, error reduction and cycle time, and report them in plain terms. Help triage and manage the queue of AI requests from across the business. Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. The Platform SRE is a member of the Platform SRE team, the group responsible for the operational health, resiliency, and modernization of our hosting and cloud infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, site reliability engineering, and automation : combining hands-on technical debt remediation with large-scale automation and reliability practice.

The Platform SRE team owns three core mandates:

1. Technical debt reduction : systematically identifying and remediating aging firmware, kernels, operating systems, and software across the managed hosting fleet and managed application environments.

2. Automation of critical operational workflows : provisioning, patching, remediation, and release processes across both managed apps and managed hosting fleets, with automated release planning and execution under human supervision (not “automation for automation’s sake,” but automation with a human checkpoint before production impact).

3. Reliability and incident support : defining, instrumenting, and tracking SLIs/SLOs for platform engineering and operations, visualized through dashboards and reporting tools, and providing fast, expert frontline response and remediation during service-impacting events (incident command and process ownership sit with the Incident Management team; this team is the technical responder, not the incident owner).

This position serves as a senior technical point of contact for platform engineering, driving initiatives around scalability, fault tolerance, automation, and operational excellence across production infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Debt & Platform Modernization

  • Own the lifecycle of firmware, kernel, OS, and software patching across the managed hosting fleet and managed application environments
  • Build a standing inventory and risk model of technical debt (end-of-life OS versions, unpatched firmware, deprecated software) and drive prioritized remediation plans
  • Evaluate and implement infrastructure modernization initiatives, replacing manual or legacy processes with supportable, automated alternatives

Automation & Release Engineering

  • Design and build automation for provisioning, deployment, patching, remediation, and configuration management across managed apps and managed hosting fleets
  • Own the design of automated release pipelines : planning, staging, and executing releases with defined human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Develop self-healing and auto-remediation capability for common failure modes to reduce manual operational load
  • Support and extend CI/CD workflows and infrastructure-as-code practices across the platform

Reliability Engineering, SLIs/SLOs & Observability

  • Instrument systems to measure SLIs accurately and build SLO tracking into standard reporting
  • Build and maintain dashboards (e.g., Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent visualization tooling) to make SLI/SLO performance, error budgets, and platform health visible to engineering and leadership
  • Continuously improve platform observability : monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing : across distributed and containerized environments

Incident Response & Remediation (Support Role)

  • Serve as the frontline technical responder: acknowledge pages quickly, diagnose, and remediate platform-level issues
  • Partner with the Incident Management team, who own incident command, severity classification, and customer communication : this role provides the technical hands and expertise, not incident ownership
  • Contribute technical findings to blameless root cause analysis (RCA) and own follow-through on corrective actions for platform systems
  • Maintain runbooks and on-call readiness for platform and infrastructure systems
  • Track incident trends on platform systems and feed them back into the technical debt and automation roadmap

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership and knowledge-sharing across the team
  • Maintain clear operational documentation and contribute to team standards and process improvement

  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD and automated release/deployment pipelines
  • Experience defining and tracking SLIs/SLOs and working with observability/visualization tools (e.g., Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent)
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale, high-concurrency, or customer-impacting production environments
  • Demonstrated experience as a technical responder in production incidents, including root cause analysis and corrective action follow-through
  • Strong scripting ability (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for automation and tooling

  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted, managed hosting, or hybrid infrastructure environments

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

Are you ready for your next real security challenge? Are you passionate about helping organizations stop breaches using a platform that just works? If so, CrowdStrike is seeking a Sales Engineer with significant security expertise. You should be able to articulate how current security solutions are designed and deployed, and why they are failing. You will be part of a team responsible for changing what the security market and customers believe is possible with a next-generation endpoint technology.


You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment on multiple engagements.


What You'll Do:

  • Experienced in endpoint or network security space – AV, EDR, incident response, forensics, SIEM, firewall, HIPS/IDS, etc.
  • Strong understanding of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems
  • Can easily articulate complex security problems to a set of audiences
  • Strong self-starter with the ability to work independently
  • Can work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing, Support, and Engineering; the Sales Engineer should be the technical bridge between CrowdStrike and prospects/customers
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to present to a variety of external audiences, including C-level executives
  • Extensive contacts in the information security field and strong references

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field
  • Sales engineering background or 5+ years of relevant work experience
  • Ability to travel as required
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
  • English and German language fluency

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with malware, threat intelligence, and/or sandbox analysis
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, and Bash
  • Experience with virtualization/VDI technologies
  • Experience with large scale cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.
  • Understanding of the OSI model
  • Certifications such as CEH, CISSP, OSCP, and SANS


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.
